programme.title: Miljuška in Japan / Miljuška u Japanu

programme.title: Aunt Kacina's secrets / Tetka Kaćine tajne

Let's meet Serbia - we're taking you to the climate you haven't seen yet, we're talking about places you may not have heard, we learn how you live in the ends you haven't been. Meet the lamb, shout, Guc, Kolare, Borac and many other hidden jewels of our country. / Znaci moga mesta je emisija kratke forme koja predstavlja znamenitosti i najvažnije karakteristike sela i varošica u Srbiji. Upoznajmo Srbiju - vodimo vas u podneblja koja još niste videli, govorimo o mestima za koja možda niste čuli, saznajemo kako se živi u krajevima u kojima niste bili. programme.title: Closely / Izbliza
programme.desc: The emission of close up to the viewers brings interviews with the largest Hollywood stars, but also interesting things related to the world of film. programme.title: Madam Bovari / Madam Bovari
programme.desc: The shop of the film leads us to the 19th century in France. Emma comes from a peasant family, but dreams of better life and a romantic relationship. In order to save the fittings and life on the edge of existence, he is married to Charles Bovaria, a rich village doctor. It quickly bored with a comfortable, monotonous life, so in search of romance soon sailed into a link to the landowner and then with the student. / Radnja filma vodi nas u 19. vek u francusku. Ema potiče iz seljačke porodice, ali sanja o boljem životu i romantičnoj vezi. Da bi se spasila okova i života na rubu egzistencije, udaje se za Čarlsa Bovarija, bogatog seoskog lekara. Njoj brzo dosadi udoban, monoton život, pa u potrazi za romantikom ubrzo uplovljava u vezu sa zemljoposednikom, a zatim i sa studentom.

programme.title: The dream of a laying night / San letnje noći
programme.desc: Film adaptation of Šeksir's comedy about lovers whose romantic feelings are played by fairy magic. This version leads us in the 19th century in a Tuscan city located on hills. / Filmska adaptacija Šeksirove komedije o ljubavnicima čijim romantičnim osećajima se poigrava vilinska magija. Ova verzija vodi nas u 19. vek u toskanski grad smešten na brežuljcima.

programme.title: Curse of King Tuta 1 / Prokletstvo kralja Tuta 1
programme.desc: Deni Frimont is an archaeologist who does not stop shocking the public with their eccentric attitudes and theories. When the Deni reveals that there is a board that can bring great powers, it along with the colleague of the barracks moving in search of this valuable item. / Deni Frimont je arheolog koji ne prestaje da šokira javnost svojim ekscentričnim stavovima i teorijama. programme.desc: John and Jenny are a young married couple who hesitates the puppy Labrador to whom they give Marla's name. programme.desc: Malkim Tarnner is a secret agent master disguise. He expects him a new mission in Georgia. programme.title: She is male / Ona je muško
programme.desc: Violin Brother Sebastian traveled to London. Dressed into him, Viola goes to his elite school, and falls in love with his teammate of Djuk, but he thinks she is a man. programme.title: Hockey - KHL: tractor - Dynamo MSK, PF2 G5 / Hokej - KHL: Traktor - Dynamo Msk, PF2 G5
programme.desc: The strongest hockey hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called KHL or a continental hockey league. Only the competition was created from the Russian Super League in 2008. And since then the competition is spreading to increasingly European and Asian countries and thus becomes an unofficial other Hockey League of the world after the American-Canadian NLA. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL Plejofa received a prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed the Russian team wins the title of Russia Champions. Since 2011. The League except the clubs from the former USSR includes clubs from Central Europe, while since 2016. One Chinese representative enters first. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: CSKA - locomotive / Košarka - VTB liga: CSKA - Lokomotiv
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine were also involved. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Belorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football: WWIN League BiH: Posusje - Željezničar / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Posušje - Željezničar
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: The Croatian football league was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Apsolutni rekorder po broju postignutih pogodaka legenda je Varteksa Davor Vugrinec sa 144 gola.

programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Partizan - Spartak G1 / Košarka - ABA liga: Partizan - Spartak G1
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Velez - Fighter / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, the annual continental competition in which only the champions of their states are performed. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of its state. The Champions League finals became a television the most watched football event on the planet. The most conquered titles of the Champions of Europe has Madrid Giant Real. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Footbal - League of Europe: Roma - Braga / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Roma - Braga
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Bahcesehir - Yalovaspor / Košarka - Turska liga: Bahcesehir - Yalovaspor
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G4 / Košarka - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G4
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. programme.desc: Dreaming on the run on a sunny island or a villa next to the beach, but you can't afford to buy your own place in the sun? Then this is the show for you! We search Europe and the United Kingdom looking for holiday homes for rent - without huge mortgages here! Today, real estate expert Amanda Lamb, Head and Zvezda Jls JB Gill and DJ and the head of Pinkham are located on the southeast coast of England, competing to find their favorite house on the coast in Deal in Kent. Each of them has a house for a holiday supported, and to stay on guard, there is a fourth mysterious real estate that none of them has seen. They will evaluate each house by the factors of WOW, amenities, location, as well as the values for money. Deal is a peaceful and historic city known for its beautiful buildings, fishing pillars and a beautiful coastal belt, which is why one of the best coastal cities in the UK. The former fishing cottage itself itself is the choice of light, spacious holiday house for six people with a balcony and a beautiful view of Kingsdown Beach. JB-EV selection is a Georgian city house filled with history and stylish furniture, located on a busy main street in Deal. But how will Amanda's real estate compare? It supports a very colorful, three-story holiday home for six guests, with lots of character and charm, and only a short walk to the beach. However, the mysterious real estate of the day could turn a few heads, because it is a warm and pleasant house from the 18th century for four people. Will her dark decor and wood stove do / Sanjate o bekstvu na sunčano ostrvo ili vilu pored plaže, ali ne možete da priuštite da kupite sopstveno mesto na suncu? Onda je ovo emisija za vas! Pretražujemo Evropu i Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo u potrazi za kućama za odmor za iznajmljivanje - bez ogromnih hipoteka ovde! Danas, stručnjak za nekretnine Amanda Lamb, voditeljka i zvezda JLS JB Gill i DJ i voditelj Sam Pinkham nalaze se na jugoistočnoj obali Engleske, takmičeći se da pronađu svoju omiljenu kuću na obali u Dealu u Kentu. Svako od njih ima kuću za odmor koju podržava, a da bi ostali na oprezu, postoji i četvrta misteriozna nekretnina koju nijedan od njih nije video. Ocenjivaće svaku kuću po faktorima wow, sadržajima, lokaciji, kao i vrednosti za novac. programme.desc: The stopwatch quiz consists of two rounds, whereby the answer time is measured by the stopwatch. In the first round competitors respond to three questions, and for each response they have 10 seconds each. If exactly the answers, they conquer the guaranteed amount. In another round waiting for six questions, with 20 seconds for each answer. Depending on the speed and accuracy of the answers they give, they can conquer up to 15,000 dinars. / Kviz Štoperica se sastoji iz dve runde, pri čemu se vreme za odgovaranje meri štopericom. U prvoj rundi takmičari odgovaraju na tri pitanja, a za svaki odgovor imaju na raspolaganju po 10 sekundi. Ukoliko tačno odgovore, osvajaju zagarantovanu sumu. U drugoj rundi ih čeka šest pitanja, sa po 20 sekundi za svaki odgovor. U zavisnosti od brzine i tačnosti odgovora koje daju, mogu da osvoje i do 15.000 dinara.

programme.title: The circle of happiness / Kolo sreće
programme.desc: A series of wheel of happiness is a romantic triller about a concomma woman who struggles with all the adversary that bears the life of a single mother of two adult children. Rasted between desire to provide money for the survival of their family and care about the households, Mara Raketić will experience the crafts of the rare - the lottery and becomes one of the richest people in the country. With Marina's wealth, however, they will set up big secrets and intrigues that people around it have, but the biggest secret is the one that Mara is carrying from early youth. / Serija Kolo sreće je romantični triler o skomnoj ženi koja se bori sa svim nedaćama koje nosi život samohrane majke dvoje odrasle dece. Rastrzana između želje da obezbedi novac za opstanak svoje porodice i brige o ukućanima, Mara Raketić doživeće obrt kakav se dešava retkima - dobija na lutriji i postaje jedna od najbogatijih osoba u zemlji. Sa Marinim bogatstvom, međutim, krenuće da se raspliću velike tajne i intrige koje ljudi oko nje imaju, ali najveća tajna je ona koju Mara nosi od rane mladosti.

programme.title: Sponge Bob Kockalone / Sunđer Bob Kockalone
programme.desc: In the cartoon series whose action carries the characters, you will enjoy nautical and often absurd adventures of Sponge Bob, incurably optimistic and honest sea sponge, and his marine friends. Ten meters below the tropical coral island, in the underwater city of Koral, in two-story pineapple, the lives Sponge Bob. Instead of logical access to everyday challenges, sponge bob access to life in a twisted and unconventional way. Whether it is seeking spatula for improving the turning technique or is a dangling friend Patrick (benevolent marine star), good intentions and an overly enthusiastic character of the Bob sponge, mostly challenges chaos in his underwater world. / U crtanom serijalu čiju radnju nose likovi, uživaćete u nautičkim i često apsurdnim avanturama Sunđera Boba, neizlečivo optimističnog i poštenog morskog sunđera, i njegovih morskih prijatelja. Desetak metara ispod tropskog koralnog ostrva, u podvodnom gradu Koralovu, u dvospratnom ananasu živi Sunđer Bob. Umesto logičnog pristupa svakodnevnim izazovima, Sunđer Bob pristupa životu na uvrnut i nekonvencionalan način. Bez obzira da li je to traženje spatule za usavršavanje tehnike okretanja pljeskavica ili je dangubljenje sa najboljim prijateljem Patrikom (dobroćudnom morskom zvezdom), dobre namere i preterano entuzijastičan karakter Sunđera Boba uglavnom izazivaju haos u njegovom podvodnom svetu.

programme.desc: If you believe in conspiracy theories, then you are in the right place, because the emission the theory of the authors and the leaders of Sasha Borojević grasp your curiosity. The show will include an analysis of popular conspiracy theories from history, politics, science and culture, as well as interviews with experts, witnesses and skeptics. His work often involves researching the way the theories of the conspiracy is spread, affect society and shape public opinion. Njegov rad često uključuje istraživanje načina na koji se teorije zavere šire, utiču na društvo i oblikuju javno mnjenje. programme.title: All inclusive / All inclusive
programme.desc: Alisa Jovanović journalist is in the mission to prove that it is possible to spend hedonistic in the best hotels in the Balkans, even with a smaller budget. / Novinarka Alisa Jovanović je u misiji da dokaže da je moguće provesti se hedonistički u najboljim hotelima na Balkanu, čak i sa manjim budžetom.

programme.title: Hideman / Gurman
programme.desc: Our leader, Dejan Dragićević, is located in an unusual gastro adventure in search of the most diverse gourmet specialties of the Balkans. He will restaurants, cafes, mehane, fast food, treats and other culinary sites - show people who know these places and are their best critics. / Naš voditelj, Dejan Dragićević, se nalazi na nesvakidašnjoj gastro avanturi u potrazi za najrazličitijim gurmanskim specijalitetima Balkana. Njemu će restorane, kafane, mehane, lokale sa brzom hranom, poslastičarnice i druga kulinarska mesta - pokazati ljudi koji poznaju ova mesta i najbolji su njihovi kritičari.

programme.title: Golden hands / Zlatne ruke
programme.desc: Go with us on a journey through time. The golden-hand emission reveals you the oldest Balkan crafts. Forgotten skills occupying a special place in the cultural heritage of the people of these areas. Kazandžijska craft, Kosovo embroidery, naive painting of Slovaks, are just some of the crafts to introduce you in this series. / Pođite sa nama na putovanje kroz vreme. Emisija Zlatne ruke vam otkriva najstarije zanate Balkana. Zaboravljene veštine koje zauzimaju posebno mesto u kulturnom nasleđu naroda ovih prostora. Kazandžijski zanat, kosovski vez, naivno slikarstvo Slovaka, samo su neki od zanata koje ćemo vam predstaviti u ovom serijalu.

programme.title: Cake and salt / Pogača i so
programme.desc: The emission of the cake and with is leading us to Serbian villages, in the homes of the village population, where the kind hosts and rich dining are waiting for us. We're leaving the path of the Serbian hospitality, come with us! / Emisija Pogača i so vodi nas u srpska sela, u domove seoskog stanovništa gde nas čekaju ljubazni domaćini i bogata trpeza. Krećemo na put srpskog gostoljublja, pođite sa nama!

programme.title: Tourist news / Turističke Vesti
programme.desc: Passport Do you have a while and your suitcase is packed? Then you just need to listen to our tourist news to be completely ready for your trip! / Pasoš imate uza se i vaš kofer je spakovan? Onda još samo trebate da poslušate naše Turističke vesti kako biste u potpunosti bili spremni za svoje putovanje!

programme.title: Nicer than Paris / Lepše od Pariza
programme.desc: The show is better than Paris discovery of which rural households to visit if you want to experience the real life of the Serbian peasant, relax in nature and enjoy good food. We will also show you where you can leave if you are interested in an active vacation, and where if you want to learn more about the rich history and culture of Serbia. / Emisija Lepše od Pariza otkriće vam koja seoska domaćinstva da posetite ako želite da iskusite pravi život srpskog seljaka, opustite se u prirodi i uživate u dobroj hrani. Prikazaćemo vam i gde možete da odete ako vas zanima aktivan odmor, a gde ako želite više da saznate o bogatoj istoriji i kulturi Srbije.

programme.title: China - a holy taste / Kina - Svet Ukusa
programme.desc: China - The world of Drustaja Chinese documentary on food that was produced by the Tencent, Doclabs Beijing and the Chinese International Television Corporation. This documentary series after the series of bite of China, another work of Chen Xiaoqing, which provides wider insight and a higher view of the world of food. The biggest advantage of this DuCument series is his world character, that the uniqueness of Chinese food is evoking from the global perspective, so that the Chinese culinary culture in the international framework once again receives the interpretation and promotion. / Kina - Svet Ukusaje kineski dokumentarac o hrani koji je nastao u produkciji Tencent-a, Doclabs Beijing i Kineske međunarodne televizijske korporacije. Ovaj dokumentarni serijal je nakon serijala Zalogaj Kine još jedno delo reditelja Chen Xiaoqing-a, koje pruža širi uvid i viši pogled na svet hrane. Najveća prednost ovog dukumentarnog serijala je njegov svetski karakter, to da iz globalne perspektiv dočarava jedinstvenost kineske hrane, tako da kineska kulinarska kultura u međunarodnom okviru još jednom dobija interpretaciju i promociju.

programme.title: Right in target / Pravo u metu
programme.desc: The right in target is a series where you experienced hunters lead you through famous Serbian hunting grounds showing the importance of hunting for ecology and maintaining balance in nature as well as the potential of the hunting Turmeric of our country. Serbia is rich in numerous hunting grounds in which there are many noble species of wild animals that hunters take care of, breaking the prejudice that they are just those who liquidate them. Get ready to hear the call of nature that will open your lavish door by getting to know you with all the mysteries of the fauna that lives in it. Our hunters will also introduce you to security measures to be taken when you enter the world of wild animals, as well as how to not experience you as intruders. Find out if all hunting stories are true, get ready to adrenaline and arm yourself for adventure. / Pravo u metu je serijal u kome vas iskusni lovci vode kroz čuvena srpska lovišta prikazujući značaj lova za ekologiju i održavanje balansa u prirodi kao i potencijal lovnog turzima naše zemlje. programme.title: Right in target / Pravo u metu
programme.desc: The right in target is a series where you experienced hunters lead you through famous Serbian hunting grounds showing the importance of hunting for ecology and maintaining balance in nature as well as the potential of the hunting Turmeric of our country. programme.desc: Documentary series dedicated to prehistoric cultures in Serbia. Numerous historians and other experts talk about the nations that have lived and created in our spaces before thousands of years ago. / Dokumentarni serijal posvećen praistorijskim kulturama u Srbiji. Brojni istoričari i drugi stručnjaci govore o narodima koji su pre više hiljada godina živeli i stvarali na našim prostorima.

programme.title: Cake and salt / Pogača i so
programme.desc: The emission of the cake and with is leading us to Serbian villages, in the homes of the village population, where the kind hosts and rich dining are waiting for us. We're leaving the path of the Serbian hospitality, come with us! / Emisija Pogača i so vodi nas u srpska sela, u domove seoskog stanovništa gde nas čekaju ljubazni domaćini i bogata trpeza. Krećemo na put srpskog gostoljublja, pođite sa nama!

programme.title: Bodybuilder / Kulturista
programme.desc: The series of culturist emissions is engaged in the research of cultural heritage (customs) and locations in the Balkans witnessing ancient times. The cultural and tourist offer of the Balkans is rich in incredible and few-known places, which keep renovation of the picturesque past, people and events that have lived in this area by printing them almost a fairytale history that is the cultural foundation of our people today. Through the series, we will discover an unconventional type of ethno-tourism, relying on the far well-known Serbian hospitality, giving an incentive and idea to see the viewers and those of our space travel and research. / Serijal emisija Kulturista se bavi istraživanjem kulturnog nasleđa (običaja) i lokacija na Balkanu koje su svedoci davnih vremena. Kulturna i turistička ponuda Balkana je bogata neverovatnim i malo poznatim mestima, koja čuvaju sećanje na živopisnu prošlost, ljude i događaje koji su živeli na ovim prostorima ispisujući im gotovo bajkovitu istoriju koja je kulturološki temelj našeg naroda danas. Kroz serijal ćemo otkrivati nekonvencionalni tip etno-turizma, oslanjajući se na daleko poznato srpsko gostoprimstvo, dajući podstrek i ideju gledaocima da se i oni osmele na ovakav vid putovanja i istraživanja naših prostora.

programme.title: 5X5 / 5X5
programme.desc: 5x5 is a half-hour show composed of five unusual stories of five minutes each. By a specific author's approach, from the seemingly ordinary interlocutors - we get interesting life stories about people, places, about work, about things that life mean ... / 5x5 je polusatna emisija sastavljena od pet nesvakidašnjih priča od po pet minuta. Specifičnim autorskim pristupom autora, od naizgled običnih sagovornika – dobijamo zanimljive životne priče o ljudima, mestima, o poslu, o stvarima koje život znače...

programme.title: Serbian circuit / Srpsko Kolo
programme.desc: The series make up 10 episodes of 25 minutes each. The National Project of the Serbian Race was realized in cooperation with the national ensemble, Belgrade, the Serbian National Federation in Pittsburg (USA), the National Ensemble of the Venac of Kosovo and Metohija and the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts (SANU) and the Tourist Organization of Serbia. So far, the project has supported the Ministry of Culture and Information of the Republic of Serbia, the Provincial Secretariat for the Culture of AP Vojvodina, the city of Nis, the city of Pirot, the city of Zajecar and the city of Uzice, as well as the Serbian Cultural Center of Opančići in Washington. / Serijal čine 10 epizoda od po 25 minuta. Nacionalni projekat Srpsko kolo realizovan je u saradnji sa Nacionalnim ansamblom Kolo, Etnografskim muzejom Beograd, Srpskim nacionalnim savezom u Pitsburgu (SAD), Nacionalnim ansamblom Venac sa Kosova i Metohije, Srpskom akademijom nauka i umetnosti (SANU) i Turističkom organizacijom Srbije. Projekat su do sada podržali Ministarstvo kulture i informisanja Republike Srbije, Pokrajinski sekretarijat za kulturu AP Vojvodine, grad Niš, grad Pirot, grad Zaječar i grad Užice, kao i Srpski kulturni centar Opančići u Vašingtonu.

programme.title: Water paths / Vodene Staze
programme.desc: In the continuation of the water trail series, we will feel the wild and tame of the Green River, Vrbas, which flows through the largest city of Republika Srpska. We will drop with its most beautiful parts, stop in the best places and meet a spa port from another angle. You will find out what is the difference between Base and Kajmak, how to go down the rapids in the boat, we will visit the monastery near the river Vrbas, drive a boat dajak which is part of the interesting tourist offer Banja Luka, see how kraft beer is cooked. / U nastavku serijala Vodene staze osetićemo divlju i pitomu stranu zelene reke, Vrbas, koja protiče kroz najveći grad Republike Srpske. Spustićemo se njenim najlepšim delovima, zaustaviti na najboljim mestima i upoznati Banja Luku iz drugog ugla. Saznaćete koja je razlika između base i kajmaka, kako je spuštati se brzacima Vrbasa u čamcu, šta se jede posle rafatinga… Obići ćemo manastir u mestu Krupa, trapistički samostan u blizini reke Vrbas, voziti se čamcem dajak koji je deo zanimljive turističke ponude Banja Luke, videti kako se kuva kraft pivo.

programme.title: Natural reserves / Prirodni rezervati
programme.desc: Meet the numerous nature reserves and different plant and animal species that live in them. We take you to an incredible journey of knowledge and discovering numerous interesting things about the world that surrounds us. / Upoznajte brojne rezervate prirode i različite biljne i životinjske vrste koje u njima žive. Vodimo vas na neverovatno putovanje saznanja i otkrivanja brojnih zanimljivosti o svetu koji nas okružuje.

programme.title: Stories from the lobby / Priče Iz Lobija
programme.desc: The Balkan Trip is a completely new review of everything that could be interested in a tourist in search of an ideal place for rest or adventure in the region. The Balkan Trip is the largest source of information from the Balkan Regional Tourism, covering news and publications from the newly discovered resorts and family households, and to luxury spa centers and elite hotels with renoome. / Balkan Trip predstavlja potpuno nov osvrt na sve što bi moglo da interesuje jednog turistu u potrazi za idealnim mestom za odmor ili avanturu u regionu. Balkan Trip je najveći izvor informacija iz sveta regionalnog turizma Balkana, pokrivajući vesti i objave od tek otkrivenih etno odmarališta i porodičnih domaćinstava, pa do luksuznih spa centara i elitnih hotela sa renomeom.

programme.title: Report / Reportaža
programme.desc: See the report prepared by a group of valuable journalists, meet unknown landscapes and find out something new! / Pogledajte reportažu koju je pripremila grupa vrednih novinara, upoznajte nepoznate predele i saznajte nešto novo!

programme.title: Invisible neighbors / Nevidljivi susedi
programme.desc: Invisible neighbors are an exclusive Chinese series that reveals you the world of flora and fauna of the endless expanse of China. In the middle of the rapid spread of cities, the animals were convicted to adapt to newly formed conditions. In this series, you will introduce yourself to the functioning of the joint life of people and birds on the periments of Pekinda, and this magnificent city will also experience from a bird's perspective. Unlike a short human memory, the animal, especially birds, unmistakably feel nostalgia for places where they lived for generations. However, despite that unbreakable relationship with the past, they find new ways to create their empire. They inhabit parks, swamps, struggles for survival and become magnificent, invisible neighbors that have a lot to tell. / Nevidljivi susedi su ekskluzivni kineski serijal koji vam otkriva svet flore i faune nepreglednog prostranstva Kine. Usred rapidnog širenja gradova životinje su osuđene da se prilagođavaju novonastalim uslovima. U ovom serijalu upoznaćete se sa funkcionisanjem zajedničkog života ljudi i ptica na obodima Pekinda, a ovaj velelepni grad ćete doživeti i iz ptičje perspektive. Za razliku od kratkog ljudskog pamćenja, životinje, a naročito ptice, nepogrešivo osećaju nostalgiju za mestima na kojima su generacijama živele. Ipak, uprkos toj neraskidivoj vezi s prošlošću, one pronalaze nove načine da stvore svoje carstvo. Naseljavaju parkove, močvare, bore se za opstanak i postaju veličanstveni, nevidljivi susedi koji imaju mnogo toga da ispričaju.

programme.title: Storm / Oluja
programme.desc: The shop is located in the period - a few days before the Operation Storm until the end of the operation, with an epilog, which is briefly displayed and the refugee life of our heroes and their navigation outside Krajina. The action occurs through two dominant lines. One follows the life of Ilija, deer and their son Petra. Ilija is a diversal that a storm is followed while on the front and Ilija from the War Hell is cramping tricked to return to the family. Ilija does not know that his wife and son is in the column, nor does he assume where and how their persecution will end. In search of them, Ilija loses his friends from the company and barely saves his own life. The second line follows the life of the former legionary of honor - Danet, the perfect soldier and the killer, who returns to the gender village after he learned that Ustashas killed his brother of the twin somewhere in Croatia. Dane Mother gives the promise to bring the body of his brother and will be buried in a family tomb. While Serbian troops are drawn up as the storm destroyed Krajina through persecution, in contrast, it is deeply pierceed towards the interior of Croatia, cleaning every enemy on the road, would not come to his brother's body and returned him home. The family represents the nucleus of these stories and through their suffering, escape, sacrifice and struggle, the whole context and horror through which the inhabitants of the Serbian Krajina are through. This story also abounds in episodes and images that are leaning into true stories, destinies and confessions of Krajina refugees. The vision from which the story is observed comes from the twelve-year-old Petra, / Radnja je smeštena u period - nekoliko dana pre operacije Oluja sve do završetka operacije, s epilogom koji se ukratko prikazuje i izbegličku život naših junaka i njihovo snalaženje izvan Krajine. Radnja se događa kroz dve dominante narativne linije. Jedna prati život Ilije, Jelene i njihovog sina Petra. Ilija je diverzant kojeg Oluja zadesi dok je na frontu i Ilija iz ratnog pakla grčevito pokušava da se vrati porodici. Ilija ne zna da su mu supruga i sin u koloni, niti pretpostavlja gde i kako će se završiti njihov progon. U potrazi za njima, Ilija gubi svoje prijatelje iz čete i jedva spašava sopstveni život. Druga linija prati život bivšeg legionara časti – Daneta, savršenog vojnika i ubicu, koji se vraća u rodno selo nakon što je saznao da su ustaše ubili njegovog brata blizanca negde na teritoriji Hrvatske. Dane majci daje obećanje da će doneti telo svog brata i da će biti sahranjen u porodičnoj grobnici. Dok se srpske trupe povlače i dok Oluja razara Krajinu kroz progon, Dane se, nasuprot tome, duboko probija prema unutrašnjosti Hrvatske, čisti svakog neprijatlja koji mu se nađe na putu, ne bi li došao do bratovog tela i vratio ga kući. Porodica predstavlja nukleus ove priče i kroz njihovo stradanje, bežanje, žrtvovanje i borbu prikazuje se ceo kontekst i užas kroz koji su prošli stanovnici Srpske Krajine. Ova priča obiluje i epizodama i slikama koje se naslanjaju i na istinite priče, sudbine i ispovesti krajinskih izbeglica. Vizura iz koje se priča posmatra dolazi od dvanaestogodišnjaka Petra,

programme.desc: In the center of the intriguing, entertainment, but on moments and heavy and tragicomic stories is an urban Belgrade family and a married couple Popović. programme.title: Matvej and Beate on swimming / Matvej i Beate na plivanju
programme.desc: The fragile story of the beginning of friendship between Matvej, who recently moved from Moscow to Berlin, and Beate, a free -spirited locals. / Krhka priča o početku prijateljstva između Matveja, koji se nedavno preselio iz Moskve u Berlin, i Beate, slobodoumne lokalke.

programme.title: SNEG I Medved / Sneg i medved
programme.desc: In a small town in Turkey, winter has always been difficult, but this year seems infinite. People are afraid that the bears will arrive in the city soon. Asli is a young nurse. A membrane disappears a cold night. Aslı is found in the vortex of power, secrets and doubts. / U malom gradu u Turskoj, zima je uvek bila teška, ali ove godine deluje beskrajno. Ljudi se plaše da će medvedi uskoro stići u grad. Asli je mlada medicinska sestra. Jedne hladne noći nestaje meštanin. Aslı se nađe u vrtlogu moći, tajni i sumnji.

programme.title: Last chance / Poslednja šansa
programme.desc: Dodi decides to participate in a dance competition on a long skate. But there are two problems in that plan. First, in the late forties, it is much older than other competitors. In addition, there is no idea to drive a long skate. He is making friends with a teenager sandroom, who is willing to teach him. Although it seems like they don't have much in common, while they exercise together, they realize that they both use skates to deal with unresolved problems. They can help each other make the first steps to healing. / Dodi odlučuje da učestvuje na plesnom takmičenju na dugačkom skejtu. Ali postoje dva problema u tom planu. Prvo, u kasnim četrdesetim, mnogo je stariji od ostalih takmičara. Povrh toga, nema pojma da vozi dugački skejt. On se sprijatelji s tinejdžerkom Sandrom, koja je voljna da ga podučava. Iako deluje kao da nemaju mnogo toga zajedničkog, dok zajedno vežbaju, shvataju da oboje koriste skejtove da bi se izborili s nerešenim problemima. Mogu da pomognu jedno drugom da naprave prve korake ka izlečenju.

programme.title: Totem / Totem
programme.desc: The totem is a life movie. The seven-year salt spends a day at his grandfather's home, helping his aunt nuri and Alehandri in preparing for the fun of the surprise they make for a solo father of Tony. As the day light fades, the rule of a strange and chaotic atmosphere, and the connections held by the family together. The salt will understand that its world will change dramatically, will accept the essence of release and nurturing the breath of life. / Totem je film o životu. Sedmogodišnja Sol provodi dan u domu svog dede, pomažući svojim tetkama Nuri i Alehandri u pripremama za zabavu iznenađenja koju prave za Solinog oca Tonatijua. Kako dnevno svetlo bledi, vlada čudna i haotična atmosfera, i razbijaju se veze koje drže porodicu na okupu. Sol će shvatiti da će se njen svet dramatično promeniti, prihvatiće suštinu puštanja i negovanja daha života.

programme.title: Thank God the boyfriend is / Hvala Bogu, dečak je
programme.desc: Jordan, today. After the sudden death of husband, Naval, the woman in his thirties, must fight for his part of the inheritance to save his daughter and home in a society in which it would be crucial to have a son. / Jordan, danas. Nakon iznenadne smrti muža, Naval, žena u svojim tridesetim, mora da se bori za svoj deo nasledstva kako bi spasila ćerku i dom u društvu u kojem bi bilo presudno imati sina.

programme.title: Rise / Naratorka
programme.desc: Marija Margarita is the youngest of four siblings in the family living in the mining town in the desert atacam in Chile. Sunday is a special day for a family. Then everyone goes to the cinema to enjoy stories through which they run from everyday life to other worlds. The girls of the girl soon realize that she has an exceptional gift of almost amazing ability to recount every movie. Its outstanding talent will get through all over the village and change the fate of her family while the Earth changes forever. / Marija Margarita je najmlađa od četvoro braće i sestara u porodici koja živi u rudarskom gradu u pustinji Atakama u Čileu. Nedelja je za porodicu poseban dan. Tad svi idu u bioskop da uživaju u pričama kroz koje beže od svakodnevice u druge svetove. programme.desc: Rafael, a one-eyed man, is a janitor of an abandoned magnificent estate. In front of his 60th birthday, he lives with his mother in a small house at the entrance to the possession. Sutradan, Piter je uveren da je postao vampir. Iako niko ne deli njegovo mišljenje, a ni fizički se nije promenio, Piter počinje da nosi lažne očnjake i prati žene.

programme.title: Heart of darkness / Srce tame
programme.desc: Robert Claire leaves his partner Sadu in France to return to Prague and find half-brother somewhere in the Balkans. programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Juri lives with a protected life with his older aunt in a small Italian city surrounded by nature. Jednog dana Juri upoznaje Agostina, lutajućeg klovna, harizmatičnog zabavljača i mađioničara za dečije zabave. programme.title: Reason and sensitivity / Razum i osećajnost
programme.desc: This Oscar was awarded the adaptation of the classical novel Jane Austin talks about the sisters Dashwood: Pragmatic Elinor (Emma Tompson) and passionate Mercial (Kate Vinslett). Obe sestre pokušavaju da ostvare romantičnu vezu u društvu opterećenom finansijskim i društvenim statusom - Elinor sa stidljivim i šarmantnim Edvardom (Hju Grant), a Merijen sa samouverenim Vilobijem (Greg Vajz) ili napaćenim pukovnikom Brandonom (Alan Rikman) - i moraju da nauče da udruže razum i osećajnost u svom ophođenju sa muškarcima i novcem.

programme.title: American / Amerikanka
programme.desc: According to the true story between Jojy Vomak (Talija Rajder), one of the few Americans who managed to penetrate the elite rows of the Baln Ballet. As we examine the boundaries of commitment, determination, sacrifice and virtuosity, Jojina Brilliance is an inspiring journey through the most competitive ballet school in the world. Engaged by Wolf (Dian Kruger), a charismatic, exceptional teacher of the Bolshower, as well as the burning passion of the first love, Joja's jump in the unknown touches immortal perfection: but at what price? / Po istinitoj priči Džoj Vomak (Talija Rajder), jedne od retkih Amerikanki koja je uspela da prodre u elitne redove Boljšoj baleta. Dok ispitujemo granice posvećenosti, odlučnosti, žrtvovanja i virtuoznosti, Džojina brilijantnost predstavlja inspirativno putovanje kroz najkonkurentniju baletsku školu na svetu. Podstaknuta Volkovom (Dajan Kruger), harizmatičnom, izuzetnom učiteljicom Boljšoja, kao i gorućom strašću prve ljubavi, Džojin skok u nepoznato dotiče besmrtnu savršenost: ali po koju cenu?

programme.title: Tomorrow's war / Sutrašnji rat
programme.desc: The passenger group of time from 2051. arrives with an emergency message - humanity loses the global war against the dangerous alien species. Soldiers and civilians from the present must move to the future and engage in combat. Den Forester, determined to save the world for his young daughter, teamed up with a brilliant scientist and his alienated father in desperate desire to reprint the destiny of the planet. / Grupa putnika kroz vreme iz 2051. godine stiže s hitnom porukom - čovečanstvo gubi globalni rat protiv opasne vanzemaljske vrste. Vojnici i civili iz sadašnjosti moraju da pređu u budućnost i uključe se u borbu. Den Forester, odlučan da spasi svet za svoju mladu ćerku, udružuje se s briljantnim naučnikom i svojim otuđenim ocem u očajničkoj želji da ponovo ispiše sudbinu planete.

programme.title: Bagzi / Bagzi
programme.desc: Bagzi is a study of the character of Gangster Benjamin Bagzija Sigel, packed in a gangster film. Sigel (Warren to be) comes to California in the 1940s to control the Losanceles racket. He soon informed him Glamor Hollywood and Actress Virginia Hill (Anet Bening), with which he steps in a romantic relationship even though he is aware that he can't leave his wife and children. Sigel soon comes up with how to turn the Jalo plot in Nevada's desert into an oasis of gambling and fun - he sowed from which later Las Vegas later. It was funded by the mafia bosses, including the Majer Lanish (Ben Kingsley), but the confident Sigel exceeded the original budget of $ 6 million, which significantly contributed to the fact that Virginia embezzled two million. Due to the superior problems, Sigel returns to Los Angeles to face the consequences, speaking Virginia to keep the money. He didn't experience to see that his dream of Las Vegas was realizing. / Bagzi je studija karaktera gangstera Bendžamina Bagzija Sigela, upakovana u gangsterski film. Sigel (Voren Biti) dolazi u Kaliforniju 1940-ih godina da bi kontrolisao losanđeleske reketaše. Ubrzo ga zavode glamur Holivuda i glumica Virdžinija Hil (Anet Bening), s kojom stupa u romantičnu vezu iako je svestan da ne može da ostavi ženu i decu. Sigel ubrzo smišlja kako da jalovu parcelu u pustinji Nevade pretvori u oazu kockanja i zabave - posejao je seme iz kojeg je kasnije nikao Las Vegas. Finansirali su ga šefovi mafije, uključujući Majera Lanskog (Ben Kingsli), ali samouvereni Sigel je premašio prvobitni budžet od 6 miliona dolara, čemu je značajno doprinela činjenica da je Virdžinija proneverila dva miliona. Zbog problema sa nadređenima, Sigel se vraća u Los Anđeles da se suoči s posledicama, govoreći Virdžiniji da zadrži novac. Nije doživeo da vidi da se njegov san o Las Vegasu ostvaruje.

programme.title: Champions / Šampioni
programme.desc: Marko is auxiliary coach in the first Basketball League of Spain. One day, after getting drunk, his frustration and the way of nature lead to a traffic accident that ends in court. He loses his job and girlfriend, and convicted him in the worst sentence for his ego: to train a group of people with special needs, who never took the ball into their hands. Through their innocence, tenderness and much good humor, they will learn the brand what is important in life. They are the real champions of life. / Marko je pomoćni trener u prvoj košarkaškoj ligi Španije. Jednog dana, nakon što se napije, njegova frustracija i preka narav dovedu do saobraćajne nesreće zbog koje završi na sudu. On gubi posao i devojku, a osude ga na najgoru moguću kaznu za njegov ego: da trenira grupu osoba sa posebnim potrebama, koje nikada nisu uzele loptu u ruke. Kroz njihovu nevinost, nežnost i mnogo dobrog humora, oni će naučiti Marka šta je u životu važno. Oni su pravi šampioni života.

programme.title: Lusia's story / Lusijina priča
programme.desc: During one night in 1989. in the middle of the Civil War in Salvador, six Jesuit priests were killed at the University of UC. The news has an immediate international echo as their contribution was key in the future peace agreement after the whole decade of the bloody war. Who killed them? The government immediately blamed Gerilce, but one eyewitness denied the official version. It's called Lussia and works as a cleaner in the UC. She saw who were real killers - the army. The United States will have to elect between testimony for the truth and protection of their families. / Tokom jedne noći 1989. godine, usred građanskog rata u Salvadoru, šest jezuitskih sveštenika ubijeno je na Univerzitetu UCA. Vest ima neposredan međunarodni odjek pošto je njihov doprinos bio ključan u budućem mirovnom sporazumu posle cele decenije krvavog rata. Ko ih je ubio? Vlada je odmah okrivila gerilce, ali jedan očevidac demantovao je zvaničnu verziju. Zove se Lusija i radi kao čistačica u UCA. Videla je ko su bile prave ubice ― vojska. Sad će morati da bira između svedočenja za istinu i zaštite svoje porodice.

programme.title: A man who knew too little / Čovek koji je znao premalo
programme.desc: While he thinks he participates in the play of the street theater, the American worker from the video club replacement for the international spy and he breaks through the grid of spygies, while international conspiracy takes place. / Dok misli da učestvuje u predstavi uličnog pozorišta, američkog radnika iz video-kluba zamene za međunarodnog špijuna i on se probija kroz mrežu špijunaže, dok se oko njega odvija međunarodna zavera.

Film je zasnovan na istinitoj priči, a narator je Kristof Valc.

programme.title: Dinner / Večera
programme.desc: Since she had to face the deadly cancer of his mother, the Iciator became aware that she was in 1977. Eta stole and killed grandfather. Thanks to the senior efforts to lighten the family memory, she and her father will be together again and find a common language and a new look at the past to face the future and continue to live. / Pošto je morala da se suoči sa smrtonosnim rakom svoje majke, Icijar postaje svesna da joj je 1977. godine ETA otela i ubila dedu. Zahvaljujući Icijarinim naporima da rasvetli porodično sećanje, ona i njen otac ponovo će biti zajedno i pronaći zajednički jezik i novi pogled na prošlost kako bi se suočili s budućnošću i nastavili da žive.

programme.title: Samaritan / Samarićanin
programme.desc: With Silvester Stalone in the main role, Samaritan is following a young boy (Javon wants Volton) while he reveals whether he is a mythic hero (Stallone) who kept his neighborhood - and who disappeared 20 years after one tragic event - still alive. Based on the graphic novel Bragija F. Shuta, directed by Julius Avery, This sharp thriller is imaginative new view of the genre of the action hero. / Sa Silvesterom Staloneom u glavnoj ulozi, Samarićanin prati mladog dečaka (Džavon Želi Volton) dok otkriva da li je mitski heroj (Stalone) koji je čuvao svoj komšiluk - i koji je nestao 20 godina pre toga nakon jednog tragičnog događaja - još uvek živ. Zasnovan na grafičkom romanu Bragija F. Šuta, u režiji Džulijusa Ejverija, ovaj oštri triler je maštoviti novi pogled na žanr akcionog heroja.

programme.title: Talks of women / Razgovori žena
programme.desc: Shaken due to several accusations of sexual abuse, newly discovered in their isolated menonite religious colony, a group of women gather in Senik to discuss how to react. While men are absent, women narrow their options on three: not to take anything, to stay and fight or go. Some are afraid that every act of defiance will endanger their entry into paradise, while others believe they cannot survive without husbands and sons. Some are ready to take all measures to avoid the horror of their family lives and insist that the truth is stronger than the rules. / Potresene zbog nekoliko tačaka optužnice za seksualno zlostavljanje, novootkriveno u njihovoj izolovanoj menonitskoj verskoj koloniji, grupa žena se okuplja u seniku da razgovaraju o tome kako da reaguju. Dok su muškarci odsutni, žene sužavaju svoje mogućnosti na tri: da ne preduzmu ništa, da ostanu i bore se ili da odu. Neke se plaše da će svaki čin prkosa ugroziti njihov ulazak u raj, dok druge veruju da ne mogu da prežive bez muževa i sinova. Neke su spremne da preduzmu sve mere da izbegnu užas svojih porodičnih života i insistiraju da je istina jača od pravila.

programme.title: Seven continent / Sedmi kontinent
programme.desc: The film monitors three members of the family that belongs to the middle layer, while their lives slowly disintegrate. Nothing is spectacular not happening: it is only endless and boring life and aimless existence. The final scene of the film reminds of fazbinder, while this troque is forgiven from all in the grotesque way. programme.desc: While he thinks he participates in the play of the street theater, the American worker from the video club replacement for the international spy and he breaks through the grid of spygies, while international conspiracy takes place. / Dok misli da učestvuje u predstavi uličnog pozorišta, američkog radnika iz video-kluba zamene za međunarodnog špijuna i on se probija kroz mrežu špijunaže, dok se oko njega odvija međunarodna zavera.

programme.title: Total recall / Totalni opoziv

For the worker in the factory, Kolin Farrel), although he has a beautiful wife (Kate Bekinsale) that he loves, the hallucination sounds like a perfect vacation of tense life - the actual memories of superpower may be what really needs. But when the procedure goes wrong, the quad becomes a hostel. Running the police controlled by Koharn Kohagen, the leader of the free world, the Kvejd associations with the rebel (Jessica Bill) to find the leader of the underground resistance movement (Bill of Naji) and stopped Kohagen. programme.title: Senki Society / Društvo senki
programme.desc: There is not many room for humanity and compassion in the Zein Dystopian world. It is managed by a shadow organization known as section. Neprijatelj joj je dobro poznat. Ali ubrzo otkriva da Sekcija ne ostaje uvek u senci. Istina će uskoro probuditi čudovište u njoj i primorati da rat izađe na svetlost dana. Pazite se, Zea ne plače... Zea puca. I puca da ubije.

programme.title: Turn me on / Uključi me
programme.desc: In the world in which the unpleasant human emotions are eradicated using government daily vitamins, one young couple jumps on their dose and reveals love, joy, sex and everything comes with it. / U svetu u kojem su neprijatne ljudske emocije iskorenjene pomoću vladinih dnevnih vitamina, jedan mladi par preskače svoju dozu i otkriva ljubav, radost, seks i sve ono što dolazi s tim.

programme.title: Cup of coffee and new shoes / Šoljica kafe i nove cipele
programme.desc: Agim and Gezim, identical twins in their thirties, feel strong brother's love. They are deaf, but that doesn't mind in everyday life in urban tyrants. One day they get the news that changes everything: they have a row of genetic disease and will lose sight. Together, and with the support of the Gezim Girls of Ana, they face a change of his relationship to the world. With a cup of coffee, two brothers must re-determine their relationship while trying to adapt to new life. / Agim i Gezim, identični blizanci u svojim tridesetim, osećaju snažnu bratsku ljubav. Oni su gluvi, ali to im ne smeta u svakodnevnom životu u urbanoj Tirani. Jednog dana dobijaju vest koja menja sve: imaju retku genetsku bolest i izgubiće i vid. Zajedno, i uz podršku Gezimove devojke Ane, suočavaju se s promenom svog odnosa prema svetu. Uz šolju kafe, dva brata moraju ponovo da odrede svoju vezu dok pokušavaju da se prilagode novom životu.

programme.title: Keri / Keri
programme.desc: Done based on the novel Stephen King, the film Kerry is a story about a girl who grew up in almost complete isolation that she imposed her psychotic religious mother, Margaret. After a humiliating incident that makes the classmates from the class to tear the Carrie teased, the teacher is punishing them sharply. Reselled to revenge her, students devise her anti-keri, which turns against them when Kerin's unusual mental powers get rid of the prom night. / Urađen na osnovu romana Stivena Kinga, film Keri je priča o devojčici koja je odrastala u gotovo potpunoj izolaciji koju joj je nametnula njena psihotično religiozna majka, Margaret. Posle ponižavajućeg incidenta zbog kojeg drugovi iz razreda počinju da surovo zadirkuju Keri, nastavnik ih oštro kažnjava. Rešeni da joj se osvete, učenici smišljaju zaveru protiv Keri, koja se okrene protiv njih kada se Kerine neobične mentalne moći oslobode tokom proslave maturske večeri.

programme.title: Statesman / Statista
programme.desc: A man is following a group of workers who come to work in the industrial zone. He soon changes his clothes and identities, he was dressed in a military uniform and armed. And then his determination is not to lag behind the others placed in the temptation with a series of disturbing events. / Čovek prati grupu radnika koji dolaze na rad u industrijskoj zoni. Ubrzo menja odeću i identitet, obučen je u vojnu uniformu i naoružan. A onda je njegova odlučnost da ne zaostaje za ostalima stavljena na iskušenje nizom uznemirujućih događaja.

programme.title: I came, I saw, I conquered / Veni vidi vici
programme.desc: Mejnardovi and their kids lead the almost perfect family life billionaire. Amon is a passionate hunter, but does not kill animals, and family wealth allows them to live freely and without consequences. / Mejnardovi i njihova deca vode skoro savršen porodični život milijardera. Amon je strastveni lovac, ali ne ubija životinje, a porodično bogatstvo im omogućava da žive slobodno i bez posledica.

programme.title: Zimski San / Zimski san
programme.desc: The poor, but proud of the Teenager Ulis living with the family in Jurtama Ulan Bator. The genius is for physics and decided to win the competition in order to get a scholarship. When his mother finds a job in the countryside, he leaves him and his younger brothers and sisters to fight with cruel winters. The Ulis will have to accept a risky job to take care of them and heat their home. / Siromašni, ali ponositi tinejdžer Ulzi živi sa porodicom u jurtama Ulan Batora. Genije je za fiziku i odlučio je da pobedi na takmičenju kako bi dobio stipendiju. Kad njegova majka pronađe posao na selu, ostavlja njega i njegovu mlađu braću i sestre da se sami bore sa surovom zimom. Ulzi će morati da prihvati rizičan posao da bi brinuo o njima i grejao njihov dom.

programme.title: Inspectorate / Inspekcija
programme.desc: Julia, experienced history teacher in a quiet high school, should receive the visit of education inspectors. He wants to talk to her. But what is this really about? Is it about her burrow relationship with the director? Or about changing the programs that allowed yourself? Or is it about the way they teach about the Holocaust? / Džulija, iskusna nastavnica istorije u mirnoj srednjoj školi, treba da primi posetu inspektora obrazovanja. On želi da razgovara sa njom. Ali o čemu se tu zapravo radi? Da li o njenoj burnoj vezi s direktorom? Ili o izmenama programa koje je sebi dozvolila? Ili se radi o načinu na koji predaje o holokaustu?

programme.title: 15 years / 15 godina
programme.desc: Former Piano Wunderkind Jenny was sentenced to a prisonment of 15 years due to the murder that did not commit. After release, he tries to numb his hatred against him with prayers in one Christian rehabilitation home. When he meets the Syrian War Refuge Omar who is gifted to sing, she agrees to play a piano on TV competition for music talents. However, by appearing in this show, Jenny must also face a man who committed the crime she was convicted. While she was 15 years in prison, a flajcher, her first and only love, he became a pop-star and a member of the jury in the competition of musical talents in which Jenny and Omar were possible winners. After all these pain years in prison, the moment of choice is: the desire for revenge or fragile happiness and the future. / Bivši klavirski vunderkind Dženi osuđena je na zatvorsku kaznu od 15 godina zbog ubistva koje nije počinila. Nakon puštanja na slobodu, pokušava da otupi svoju mržnju prema sebi molitvama u jednom hrišćanskom domu za rehabilitaciju. Kad upozna sirijskog ratnog izbeglicu Omara koji je nadaren za pevanje, pristaje da mu svira klavir na TV-takmičenju za muzičke talente. Međutim, pojavljivanjem u ovoj emisiji, Dženi takođe mora da se suoči sa čovekom koji je počinio zločin za koji je ona osuđena. Dok je ona bila 15 godina u zatvoru, Flajšer, njena prva i jedina ljubav, postao je pop-zvezda i član žirija na takmičenju muzičkih talenata u kojem su Dženi i Omar mogući pobednici. Posle svih ovih bolnih godina u zatvoru, za Dženi je trenutak izbora: želja za osvetom ili krhka sreća i budućnost.

programme.title: Ignore the night / Zanemari noć
programme.desc: La Kanjada Real, the largest unhygienest settlement in Europe on the outskirts of Madrid, is no more than a year without electricity. Tonino who is 13 years old, and his best friend Naser made their playground from this end and the center of his adventure. But one day Naser tells her friend to go to France with his family. / La Kanjada Real, najveće nehigijensko naselje u Evropi na periferiji Madrida, bez struje je više od godinu dana. Tonino koji ima 13 godina, i njegov najbolji prijatelj Naser napravili su od ovog kraja svoje igralište i središte svoje avanture. Ali jednog dana Naser kaže drugaru da sa porodicom odlazi u Francusku.

programme.title: Game at the jungle / Zver u džungli
programme.desc: Freely renovated according to the novel Henry James, the film beast in the jungle brings a dizzying story about a man and a woman who visit a huge nightclub in anticipation of mysterious events. From 1979. until 2004. year, from the disk to techno music, it is a love story and an obsession story. When it finally happens, it takes a more tragic form than expected. / Slobodno adaptiran prema romanu Henrija Džejmsa, film Zver u džungli donosi vrtoglavu priču o muškarcu i ženi koji dvadeset pet godina posećuju ogroman noćni klub u iščekivanju misterioznog događaja. Od 1979. do 2004. godine, od diska do tehno muzike, to je ljubavna priča i priča o opsesiji. Kad se to konačno desi, poprima tragičniji oblik nego što se očekivalo.

programme.title: First love / Prva ljubav
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old eliali feels appealing towards a new neighbor and another from the class of Alexander. He soon realizes that he was truly in love for the first time. Interaction with friends and family brings more questions than answers. Confused with his increasing feelings, Elijas tries to sort out his inner chaos to prove that he is worth alexandra's heart. / Četrnaestogodišnji Elijas oseća privlačnost prema novom komšiji i drugu iz razreda Aleksandru. Ubrzo shvata da je po prvi put istinski zaljubljen. Interakcija sa prijateljima i porodicom donosi više pitanja nego odgovora. Zbunjen svojim sve jačim osećanjima, Elijas pokušava da sredi svoj unutrašnji haos kako bi dokazao da je vredan Aleksandrovog srca.

programme.title: Patriot / Patriota
programme.desc: South Carolina, 1776. Benjamin Martin, a hero in the fight against French and Indians, wants to live in peace with the family while the new war wins the country. When one of his sons kills, anger and pain returns him to the battlefield. / Južna Karolina, 1776. Bendžamin Martin, heroj u borbi protiv Francuza i Indijanaca, želi da živi u miru s porodicom dok novi rat osvaja zemlju. Kad jedan od njegovih sinova pogine, bes i bol vraćaju ga na bojno polje.

programme.title: Dark night / Tamna noć
programme.desc: The film speaks about Ishak, a lonely musician wandering at the nightclubs of Anatolia and who is forced to return to his hometown after eight years of self-polling. It's a story about the Ferhat, a disturbed outlaw, and Sirmi, a woman from a city that visits a small town from time to time to worry about his sick father. It is a story about trauma, a disappearance that is known to everyone, but it is not discussed - the disappearance of a young Ali, a forestry who came to the city eight years ago and disappeared without a trace. The story of the works buried deep in the past, the secret part of the Ishs and his childhood friends, and who returns to persecute them, their friends, their community and the whole country, leading everything to the inevitable destiny. / Film govori o Išaku, usamljenom muzičaru koji luta po noćnim klubovima Anadolije i koji je prinuđen da se vrati u rodni grad nakon osam godina samoizgnanstva. To je priča o Ferhatu, poremećenom odmetniku koji luta sam šumama, i Sirmi, ženi iz grada koja s vremena na vreme posećuje mali grad da bi brinula o svom bolesnom ocu. To je priča o traumi, nestanku koji je poznat svima, ali se o njemu ne razgovara - nestanku mladog Alija, šumara koji je došao u grad pre osam godina i nestao bez traga. Priča o delima zakopanim duboko u prošlosti, tajni koju dele Išak i njegovi prijatelji iz detinjstva, a koja se vraća da progoni njih, njihove prijatelje, njihovu zajednicu i celu zemlju, vodeći sve ka neizbežnoj sudbini.

programme.desc: Neurosururg Christopher Datch, under the nickname Dr. Death, destroys the lives of many who finish in his operating room, in two cases leading to death. His work is so bad that people question whether he is a doctor at all. / Neurohirurg Kristofer Danč, pod nadimkom Dr Smrt, uništava živote mnogih koji završe u njegovoj operacionoj sali, u dva slučaja dovodeći do smrti. Njegov rad je toliko loš da se ljudi dovode u pitanje da li je on uopšte lekar.

programme.title: Imperfect murder / Nesavršeno ubistvo
programme.desc: The tragic case done by the Greek Anthony, women known for their lively and positive personality, took place as a creepy story about domestic violence and deceit. In March 2020. year, her alienated husband, David Anthony, killed her in their house in Florida. / Tragični slučaj Grečen Entoni, žene poznate po svojoj živahnoj i pozitivnoj ličnosti, odvijao se kao jeziva priča o nasilju u porodici i prevari. U martu 2020. godine, njen otuđeni muž, Dejvid Entoni, ubio ju je u njihovoj kući na Floridi.

programme.title: Meet, marry, kill / Upoznaj, oženi, ubij
programme.desc: Scott Gelatli knocked off his legs his Sustk Lori Jackson. But her mother Mary doubted Scott. He controlled where Lori is leaving and whoever discusses. When things started to be violent, it wasn't just Lori on the line of fire. / Skot Gelatli je oborio sa nogu svoju susetku Lori Džekson. Ali njena majka Meri je sumnjala u Skota. On je kontrolisao gde Lori odlazi i sa kim razgovara. Kada su stvari počele da bivaju nasilne, nije se samo Lori našla na liniji vatre.

programme.title: Late justice / Zakasnela pravda
programme.desc: After the last day of the school, in 1984. year, the fifteen-year-old Risa Treksler was found killed in the house of Grandma and Children. Ten years old investigation launches city rumors, which indicate Risa's thirteenth-off sister. / Nakon poslednjeg dana škole, 1984. godine, petnaestogodišnja Risa Treksler je pronađena ubijena u kući bake i deke. Deset godina stara istraga pokreće gradske glasine, koje ukazuju na Risinu trinaestogdišnju sestru.

programme.desc: The research series examining cases of murder told through the personal experience of retirement detective, Lieutenant Joe Kenda from Colorado. / Istraživačka serija koja ispituje slučajeve ubistva ispričane kroz lično iskustvo penzionisanog detektiva, poručnika Džoa Kende iz Kolorada.

programme.desc: On the last day as a secret agent, Bergen Carlos Detective James experiences his first shooting, and the ATF agent Jen Essku is presented as a paid killer to investigate the possible murder. / Svog poslednjeg dana kao tajni agent, detektiv okruga Bergen Karlos Džejms doživljava svoju prvu pucnjavu, a agent ATF-a Džen Eskju se predstavlja kao plaćeni ubica da bi istražila moguće ubistvo.

programme.title: Once in America / Однажды в Америке
programme.desc: Until 1867, Alaska belonged to the Russian Empire. Today it is the northern worst and largest state of the United States. programme.title: America. A big journey / Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Aidaho is like a magnet. Arriving once, you immediately think to return here again. Как минимум потому, что местные готовят самую лучшую печеную картошку во всей Америке.

programme.title: New York New York / Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: A trip by bus along Manhattan after the introduction of a paid travel to the city center. The New Yorkers guide is a book about the inhabitants of a large apple. Intellectual art dinctions are a successful business of recent immigrants from Russia. The exhibition is pure gold in the Brooklyn Museum and the most expensive dessert in the world. / Поездка на автобусе по Манхеттену после введения платного проезда в центр города. Путеводитель по ньюйоркцам - книга об обитателях Большого Яблока. Интеллектуальные арт-ужины - успешный бизнес недавних иммигрантов из России. Выставка Чистое золото в Бруклинском музее и самый дорогой десерт в мире.

programme.title: Winning chaos / Побеждая хаос
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, chaos came in Europe. As a result of the bombing of Germany and the countries of the anti -Hitler coalition, millions of civilians died. Many large cities lay in ruins, and hundreds of thousands of people who lost the roof above their heads needed new housing. Gavr, London, Berlin and Warsaw were among the most injured. Documentary series The winning chaos talks about how these European cities were reborn after the war / После окончания Второй мировой войны в Европе наступил хаос. В результате бомбардировок Германии и стран антигитлеровской коалиции погибли миллионы мирных жителей. Многие крупные города лежали в руинах, и сотни тысяч людей, потерявших крышу над головой, нуждались в новом жилье. Гавр, Лондон, Берлин и Варшава были в числе наиболее пострадавших. Документальный сериал Побеждая хаос рассказывает о том, как эти европейские города возрождались после войны

programme.title: Amur Golgotha / Амурская Голгофа
programme.desc: Taxi player Viktor Toroptsev from an endangered city in the Far East decides that a critical moment has come in his life. He starts the YouTube channel Vitek Live to become the main people's journalist in the region and rally surrounding fellow countrymen. Victor is sure that it is he who should turn his city and all of Russia into paradise on earth. To do this, he goes on the most important journey of his life, not yet imagining what chain of events he launched. Amur Golgotha. / Таксист Виктор Торопцев из вымирающего города на Дальнем Востоке решает, что в его жизни наступил критический момент. Он заводит ютуб-канал Витек Live, чтобы стать главным народным журналистом в регионе и сплотить вокруг себя земляков. Виктор уверен, что именно он должен превратить свой город и всю Россию в рай на земле. Для этого он отправляется в важнейшее путешествие своей жизни, еще не представляя, какую цепь событий запустил. Амурская Голгофа.

programme.title: Morning / Утро
programme.desc: Morning program every weekday opens the information line of the TV channel present. The morning comes out live from the Kyiv studio and tells the audience about what they need to know at the very beginning of the day. The main news, the main events of the coming day, the most important topics for discussion are in the morning air every day. / Программа Утро каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала Настоящее Время. Утро выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Signs of life / Признаки жизни
programme.desc: But they belong not only to the older generation, proud of the longevity of their cars. Young people also buy old VAZ cars: this is an opportunity to get their own car cheaply when, at 18, they surrendered to the rights, or lovingly rebuild the old car from exclusive factory spare parts, which is already half a century, or strengthen and strengthen it and participate in amateur races, drift. / Но принадлежат они не только старшему поколению, гордящемуся долгожительством своих машин. Старые ВАЗовские машины покупает и молодежь: это возможность дешево получить свою собственную машину, когда в 18 лет сдал на права, или любовно пересобрать из эксклюзивных заводских запчастей старый автомобиль, которому уже под полвека, или укрепить и усилить его и участвовать в любительских гонках, дрифтовать.

programme.title: We are waiting for a visit / Ждем в гости
programme.desc: Under the Sun Tasabername - the program of the new program of programs from Spain of the project we are waiting for a visit with Zurabu Dwal. Together with her colleague, Masha Wibberly, who invited the film crew to Andalusia, Zurab will tell about the small town of the Tsarmakh region. Located near the famous resort of Malag. He was in the mountains and in the distance from traditional tourist routes, he was able to maintain the unique charm of the Andaluz style in architecture, authenticity in traditions and cooking. The program will also tell about interesting people living in Zabernmekh, who found their new vocation here. / Под солнцем Касабермехи - программа нового цикла передач из Испании проекта Ждем в гости с Зурабом Двали . Вместе со своей коллегой Машей Уибберли, которая пригласила съёмочную группу в Андалусию, Зураб расскажет о небольшом городке края Касабермеха. Расположенного недалеко от знаменитого курорта Малага. Находящийся в горах и в дали от традиционных туристических маршрутов он смог сохранить неповторимый шарм андалузского стиля в архитектуре, аутентичность в традициях и кулинарии. Программа расскажет и об интересных людях живущих в Касабермеха, нашедших здесь свое новое призвание.

programme.title: Crossroads / Перекресток
programme.desc: In September 2024, the Russian military struck a guided bomb at the nursing home in Sumy. The bomb hit the top floor, where older people and disabled people rested in their rooms, destroyed the nursing home and fell behind it, exploding. A 78-year-old woman died, and 12 people were injured in her head, faces and hands. 222 inhabitants of the nursing home, most of which are more than eighty years old, were resettled in five similar institutions in Ukraine. / В сентябре 2024 года российские военные нанесли удар управляемой бомбой по дому престарелых в Сумах. Бомба попала в верхний этаж, где в своих комнатах отдыхали пожилые люди и инвалиды, разрушила дом престарелых и упала за ним, взорвавшись. Погибла 78-летняя женщина, а 12 человек получили ранения головы, лица и рук. 222 обитателя дома престарелых, большинству из которых больше восьмидесяти лет, были переселены в пять аналогичных заведений в Украине.

programme.desc: After the end of World War II, chaos came in Europe. As a result of the bombing of Germany and the countries of the anti -Hitler coalition, millions of civilians died.
