programme.title: A person has the right / Человек имеет право
programme.desc: In the program of Maryany Torocheshnikova, human rights activists, civil activists and ordinary citizens summarize the main results of the week. / В программе Марьяны Торочешниковой юристы, правозащитники, гражданские активисты и обычные граждане подводят главные итоги недели.

programme.title: Asia 360 / Азия 360
programme.desc: Ulken appeared on the map of Kazakhstan in the early 80s. The village was built for power plants for power plants - they planned to build a the largest thermal power station in the south of Kazakhstan in two five -year planes. But the Soviet Union fell apart, and the boiler houses did not appear here. Only houses managed to build, in which the builders themselves settled. Therefore, it would be more correct to call Ulken a town not of power engineers, but builders. However, many residents are still hoping here that one day there will still be some station: whether it is thermal, whether it be atomic. / Улькен появился на карте Казахстана в начале 80-х. Поселок ударными темпами строили для энергетиков - планировали в две пятилетки возвести здесь крупнейшую на юге Казахстана тепловую электростанцию. Но Советский Союз развалился, и котельные здесь так и не появились. Успели возвести лишь дома, в которых и заселились сами строители. Поэтому, правильнее было бы называть Улькен городком не энергетиков, а строителей. Впрочем, многие жители здесь до сих пор надеятся, что однажды тут все-таки появится какая-нибудь станция: будь то тепловая, будь то атомная.

programme.title: European values / Европейские ценности
programme.desc: Italy confidently becomes the country of long -livers and a pan -European example of an old age. Umbria, the central region. Pensioners ride on retro cars, dance at parties, drink coffee in the morning in a cafe, enter universities of the third age to obtain a new education and increase their involvement in society. In small high -mountain Borgo, fundamentally new projects of silver villages develop: fast medical logistics, additional financing, general activity. Almost every town has centennial people. The national system of the life of the Italian society has long been comprehensively rebuilt into the concept of a silver economy: the restructuring of social spheres, taking into account the new life expectancy of people. Here we want to find out and show how the country can take care of older people, how it is possible to give people a long happy life even without ultra -high pensions. We will see how they live and what the long -livers of Italy are doing - from the capital to a deep province. / Италия уверенно становится страной долгожителей и общеевропейским примером отношения к старости. Умбрия, центральный регион. Пенсионеры катаются на ретроавтомобилях, танцуют на вечеринках, пьют кофе по утрам в кафе, поступают в университеты третьего возраста для получения нового образования и повышения своей вовлеченности в жизнь общества. В маленьких высокогорных Борго развиваются принципиально новые проекты серебряных деревень: быстрая медицинская логистика, дополнительное финансирование, общие активности. Почти в каждом городке есть столетние люди. Национальная система жизни общества Италии давно уже комплексно перестраивается в концепцию серебряной экономики: перестройка социальных сфер с учетом новой продолжительности жизни людей. Здесь мы хотим узнать и показать, как страна может заботиться о пожилых людях, как возможно дать людям долгую счастливую жизнь даже без сверхвысоких пенсий. Мы увидим, как живут и что делают долгожители Италии — от столицы до глубокой провинции.

programme.title: Special project / Спецпроект.док
programme.desc: The cycle of documentary programs of the TV channel is present. / Цикл документальных программ телеканала Настоящее Время.

programme.title: Dangerous neighborhood / Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Dangerous neighborhood is a documentary cycle about how residents of independent states adjacent to the Russian Federation live and feel themselves in connection with Russia's aggression in relation to Ukraine. Do they fear the invasions or hybrid violations of the sovereignty of their country on the part of Russia? Or, perhaps, consider themselves part of the Russian world? What problems do they face in connection with the influence of their country in Russia? Do they like such a neighborhood and do they consider it dangerous? / Опасное соседство - документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью русского мира? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: In the evening / Вечер
programme.desc: The evening program is about the most interesting and important events that the team of our journalists is following. Exclusive interviews, unexpected guests, the widest look at topical topics - every evening on the air from Monday to Friday. We do not run after the news, but find them for you. We show all points of view and talk about everything that happened at the end of the day. / Программа Вечер — о самых интересных и важных событиях, за которыми следит команда наших журналистов. Эксклюзивные интервью, неожиданные гости, самый широкий взгляд на злободневные темы - каждый вечер в прямом эфире с понедельника по пятницу. Мы не бежим за новостями, а находим их для вас. Мы показываем все точки зрения и рассказываем обо всем, что случилось, в конце дня.

programme.title: #the Vukraine / #вУкраине
programme.desc: Ukrainian farmers continue to work, despite the full -scale invasion of Russia. In Sumy, only 20 kilometers from the border with the aggressor state, they collected wheat, soy, sunflowers and other crops. In the agricultural sector of Vladislav Pelevin, all the granaries and almost all the equipment were destroyed with a missile blow, but it is already preparing for sowing. In addition, Pelevin, who had been engaged in pig farming for 30 years, killed about 1000 tribal heads. Does the state help farmers? Will they be able to continue work while being so close to Russia? / Украинские фермеры продолжают работать, несмотря на полномасштабное вторжение России. На Сумщине, всего в 20 километрах от границы с государством-агрессором, собрали пшеницу, сою, подсолнухи и другие культуры. В агрохозяйстве Владислава Пелевина ракетным ударом были уничтожены все зернохранилища и почти вся техника, но он уже готовится к посевной. Кроме того, у Пелевина, который 30 лет занимался свиноводством, убили около 1000 племенных голов. Помогает ли фермерам государство? Смогут ли они продолжать работу, находясь так близко к России?

programme.desc: New York, New York - Sunday video magazine about the city of Big Apple and its inhabitants. What to see, find out, eat, put on and ... understand about New York. programme.title: Asia 360 / Азия 360
programme.desc: Ulken appeared on the map of Kazakhstan in the early 80s. The village was built for power plants for power plants - they planned to build a the largest thermal power station in the south of Kazakhstan in two five -year planes. But the Soviet Union fell apart, and the boiler houses did not appear here. Only houses managed to build, in which the builders themselves settled. Therefore, it would be more correct to call Ulken a town not of power engineers, but builders. However, many residents are still hoping here that one day there will still be some station: whether it is thermal, whether it be atomic. / Улькен появился на карте Казахстана в начале 80-х. Поселок ударными темпами строили для энергетиков - планировали в две пятилетки возвести здесь крупнейшую на юге Казахстана тепловую электростанцию. programme.title: Dangerous neighborhood / Опасное соседство
programme.desc: Dangerous neighborhood is a documentary cycle about how residents of independent states adjacent to the Russian Federation live and feel themselves in connection with Russia's aggression in relation to Ukraine. Do they fear the invasions or hybrid violations of the sovereignty of their country on the part of Russia? Or, perhaps, consider themselves part of the Russian world? What problems do they face in connection with the influence of their country in Russia? Do they like such a neighborhood and do they consider it dangerous? / Опасное соседство - документальный цикл о том, как живут и как чувствуют себя жители независимых государств, соседствующих с РФ, в связи с агрессией России в отношении Украины. Опасаются ли вторжения или гибридного нарушения суверенитета их страны со стороны России? Или, возможно, считают себя частью русского мира? С какими проблемами сталкиваются в связи с влиянием на их страну России? Нравится ли им такое соседство и считают ли они его опасным?

programme.title: #the Vukraine / #вУкраине
programme.desc: Ukrainian farmers continue to work, despite the full -scale invasion of Russia. In Sumy, only 20 kilometers from the border with the aggressor state, they collected wheat, soy, sunflowers and other crops. In the agricultural sector of Vladislav Pelevin, all the granaries and almost all the equipment were destroyed with a missile blow, but it is already preparing for sowing. In addition, Pelevin, who had been engaged in pig farming for 30 years, killed about 1000 tribal heads. Does the state help farmers? Will they be able to continue work while being so close to Russia? / Украинские фермеры продолжают работать, несмотря на полномасштабное вторжение России. На Сумщине, всего в 20 километрах от границы с государством-агрессором, собрали пшеницу, сою, подсолнухи и другие культуры. В агрохозяйстве Владислава Пелевина ракетным ударом были уничтожены все зернохранилища и почти вся техника, но он уже готовится к посевной. Кроме того, у Пелевина, который 30 лет занимался свиноводством, убили около 1000 племенных голов. Помогает ли фермерам государство? Смогут ли они продолжать работу, находясь так близко к России?

programme.title: The process over evil / Процесс над злом
programme.desc: The trial after the most cruel terrorist attacks in the history of France, which happened on November 13, 2015. Экстраординарный кейс с 20 обвиняемыми, переданный в специально созданный суд. 220 томов материалов и почти 1700 потерпевших. Это событие столь же долгожданное, сколь и страшное: оно вновь откроет раны, которые едва начали заживать

programme.title: Odessa / Одесса
programme.desc: The issue of the work of Odessa rescuers who act daily in conditions of constant shelling. The main character is the head of the guard Oleg Ryabushenko. Through his personal experience, the viewer sees how the war changed the life of firefighters and Odessa herself. The Ryabushenko team extinguishes fires after missile strikes, disassembles the rubble, looking for survivors. Each challenge is associated with the risk: repeated blows on the already affected goals have become part of the military tactics of Russia. Ryabushenko himself admits - not a single exit guarantees a return. / Выпуск о работе одесских спасателей, которые ежедневно действуют в условиях постоянных обстрелов. Главный герой — начальник караула Олег Рябушенко. Через его личный опыт зритель видит, как война изменила жизнь пожарных и саму Одессу. Команда Рябушенко тушит пожары после ракетных ударов, разбирает завалы, ищет выживших. Каждый вызов сопряжён с риском: повторные удары по уже поражённым целям стали частью военной тактики России. Сам Рябушенко признаётся — ни один выезд не гарантирует возвращения.

programme.title: Unknown Russia / Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Unknown Russia is the author’s project Vadim Kondakov. These are documentary stories about places and people that few people know about. Unknown Russia shows the country such as even the Russians themselves do not know it. / Неизвестная Россия - авторский проект Вадима Кондакова. programme.title: Asia 360 / Азия 360
programme.desc: What do you know about Central Asia? The fact that these countries were once part of the USSR and the fact that people now live poorly there and eat what they hit, ride on donkeys and often dangle to work? We decided to dispel the most common myths about Central Asia / Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно и едят что попало, катаются на ослах и часто мотаются на заработки? programme.title: All inclusive / Всё включено

programme.title: Anatane / Anatane
programme.desc: Paris, 2213. Anatan, 15-year-old boy knows that, like Father, he will soon be taken to Okura to transform him into binia, robotic will be destined to work for Dictator Klanka. The fate of Anatan and his team from the end, will change the day he discovered to have an incredible power of invisibility. Then he starts the way towards an eye, the place where all Klank's evil originates from. In a world full of hidden hazards, young Anatan, with its sister Arian and Nikit's best friends, moves in an epic adventure to preserve his country from constant threat. Guided by ancient prophecy, reveal a powerful relationship between nature and their own destiny, and their courage and friendship become the key to survival. Anan, more than ever, wants to discover the truth about his origin and unlock the power that can change the fate of humanity. In the distant future, the adventure begins, and freedom is the only goal! / Pariz, 2213. Anatan, 15-godišnji dečak zna da će, poput oca, uskoro biti odveden u Okuru kako bi ga transformisali u Bizija, robotizovano biće predodređeno da radi za diktatora Klanka. Sudbina Anatana i njegove ekipe iz kraja, promeniće se onog dana kada otkrije da ima neverovatnu moć nevidljivosti. Tada započinje put ka Okuri, mestu odakle potiče sve Klankovo zlo. U svetu prepunom skrivenih opasnosti, mladi Anatan, sa svojom sestrom Arijanom i najboljim prijateljima Nevenom i Nikitom, kreće u epsku avanturu kako bi sačuvao svoju zemlju od stalne pretnje. Vođeni drevnim proročanstvom, otkrivaju moćnu vezu između prirode i sopstvene sudbine, a njihova hrabrost i prijateljstvo postaju ključ opstanka. Anatan, više nego ikada, želi da otkrije istinu o svom poreklu i otključa moć koja može da promeni sudbinu čovečanstva. U dalekoj budućnosti, avantura počinje, a sloboda je ponovo jedini zacrtani cilj!

programme.title: Spin fighters / Spin borci
programme.desc: Soni, Johnny and Rocks entered a hundred twenty-six players who qualified for Spinfajteri Tournament after the basic test. The Spinfactor Association Getting the Competition to each of them spinner and the gun set so that they can achieve top results. Roki got his personal spinner Sonik Matrix and the Black Dragon gun but he wants to use the one who gave him Dad - Flejm Fajtera. programme.title: Be Svet / Bibin svet
programme.desc: The main heroine, Bibi, is a cheerful and wise girl, always ready to help others in trouble. On the way to which he is experiencing a variety of experiences, she is never alone since her company is making her best friend Bobby. Unlike the main heroine, Bobi is naughty and stubborn and often intrudes into trouble. In his joint adventures, Bibi and Bobby meet with diverse creatures - giant, dragons, they also encountered Santa, and neither the wicked witch failed to bypass. These encounters were beneficial, and will also mean the audience to keep the hygiene of the house in which we live, why it is important to take care of the body, how and why it is important to be modest and grateful, and how to help friend in trouble. With their faithful viewers, Bibi and Bobby will also show what is most valuable in friendship, why it is important to keep the environment and not pollute our surroundings, and many topics will be opened by great songs, which in addition to affecting lyrics, exude and extremely likable melodies. Welcome you all came to Bibin world! / Glavna junakinja, Bibi, vesela je i mudra devojčica, uvek spremna da pomogne drugima u nevolji. Na putu na kojem proživljava najrazličitija iskustva, ona nikada nije sama budući da joj društvo pravi najbolji prijatelj Bobi. Za razliku od glavne junakinje, Bobi je nestašan i tvrdoglav i često upada u nevolje. U svojim zajedničkim avanturama, Bibi i Bobi susreću se sa raznolikim stvorenjima – džinovima, zmajevima, naišli su čak i na Deda Mraza, a ni zlu vešticu nisu uspeli da zaobiðu. Ti susreti svima su bili od koristi, a značiće i publici da na zanimljivim primerima nauči kako treba održavati higijenu kuće u kojoj živimo, zašto je važno voditi računa o telu i zdravlju, o pravilnoj ishrani, kako i zašto je važno biti skroman i zahvalan, te kako pomoći prijatelju u nevolji. Svojim vernim gledaocima, Bibi i Bobi će pokazati i šta je najvrednije u prijateljstvu, zašto je bitno da čuvamo životnu sredinu i da ne zagađujemo svoje okruženje, a mnoge teme biće opevane sjajnim pesmicama koje pored poučnih stihova, odišu i izuzetno dopadljivim melodijama. Dobro došli ste svi, u Bibin svet!

programme.desc: Paris, 2213. Anatan, 15-year-old boy knows that, like Father, he will soon be taken to Okura to transform him into binia, robotic will be destined to work for Dictator Klanka. The fate of Anatan and his team from the end, will change the day he discovered to have an incredible power of invisibility. Then he starts the way towards an eye, the place where all Klank's evil originates from. In a world full of hidden hazards, young Anatan, with its sister Arian and Nikit's best friends, moves in an epic adventure to preserve his country from constant threat. Guided by ancient prophecy, reveal a powerful relationship between nature and their own destiny, and their courage and friendship become the key to survival. Anan, more than ever, wants to discover the truth about his origin and unlock the power that can change the fate of humanity. In the distant future, the adventure begins, and freedom is the only goal! / Pariz, 2213. Anatan, 15-godišnji dečak zna da će, poput oca, uskoro biti odveden u Okuru kako bi ga transformisali u Bizija, robotizovano biće predodređeno da radi za diktatora Klanka. Sudbina Anatana i njegove ekipe iz kraja, promeniće se onog dana kada otkrije da ima neverovatnu moć nevidljivosti. Tada započinje put ka Okuri, mestu odakle potiče sve Klankovo zlo. U svetu prepunom skrivenih opasnosti, mladi Anatan, sa svojom sestrom Arijanom i najboljim prijateljima Nevenom i Nikitom, kreće u epsku avanturu kako bi sačuvao svoju zemlju od stalne pretnje. Vođeni drevnim proročanstvom, otkrivaju moćnu vezu između prirode i sopstvene sudbine, a njihova hrabrost i prijateljstvo postaju ključ opstanka. Anatan, više nego ikada, želi da otkrije istinu o svom poreklu i otključa moć koja može da promeni sudbinu čovečanstva. programme.title: Spin fighters / Spin borci
programme.desc: Soni, Johnny and Rocks entered a hundred twenty-six players who qualified for Spinfajteri Tournament after the basic test. The Spinfactor Association Getting the Competition to each of them spinner and the gun set so that they can achieve top results. Roki got his personal spinner Sonik Matrix and the Black Dragon gun but he wants to use the one who gave him Dad - Flejm Fajtera. After the first fight in which Johnny convincingly wins him he begins to doubt his choice. However, a doctor of Vird jumped in his help and gives him a spinner of the Flame Storm. Will our young and inexperienced deadline succeed from overriding Johnny? Can he win the tournament in honor of his father? He is waiting for him a lot more challenges. / Soni, Džoni i Roki su nakon osnovnog testa ušli u sto dvadeset šest igrača koji su se kvalifikovali za turnir Spinfajtersa. Udruženje Spinfajter takmičenja poklanja svakom od njih spiner i pištolj koji su podešeni tako da mogu da postignu vrhunske rezultate. Ležeći na dubini od više od 3.800 metara ispod površine mora i 380 nautičkih milja od obale Njufaundlenda, u mrklom mraku, najpoznatiju olupinu na svetu izjeda kolonija bakterija koje se hrane gvožđem. Ovo sporo i neminovno propadanje će, smatraju mnogi zabrinuti eksperti, u roku od nekoliko decenija uništiti sve tragove tajni legendarnog putničkog broda. Koristeći se novim pristupom, ovaj dokumentarac povezuje podvodnu odiseju najvećih istraživačkih ekspedicija do Titanika i razvoj najproučavanije olupine na svetu. Od legendarnog otkrića olupine od strane francusko-američkog tima 1985. godine, nakon dvadeset neuspelih pokušaja, preko istraživačkih misija kojima je predvodio Džejms Kameron, koji je uspeo da osvetli olupinu poput holivudskog filmskog seta i uđe unutar broda zahvaljujući robotima na daljinsko upravljanje, sve do potraga za blagom kojima je izvučeno preko 5.000 objekata - moći ćemo da iskusimo uzbuđenje ovih prvih zaranjanja kojima nema premca. Po prvi put ikada, pet heroja istraživanja Titanika pozvaće nas da ponovo proživimo njihove fantastične avanture i misije čiji je cilj očuvanje poslednjih ostataka Titanika: Džejms Kameron (filmski reditelj i istraživač), Lori Džonston (biološkinja koja proučava bakterijski napad na Titanik), Anatolij Sagalevič (inženjer podmornica), Pol Anri Naržole (istraživač koji je predvodio sedam istraživačkih misija Titanika)

programme.title: Viking: Pad Narcotics / Viking: Pad narkobosa
programme.desc: Viking: The fall of the narcobos is a partial biographical film, a partially true criminal story. A true story about a man who spent 16 years in prison, of which two in one of the worst prisons in Brazil, where prisoners are happy if they manage to preserve their head. Desperately wishing not to hurt his son, the Malmkquist pretends to be a prison guard for 12 years, never revealing the reality of his life as a prisoner. But it is not behind bars, what burdens the Calaise Malmkvist - but the people he injured. Malmkvist's greatest regret is his attitude towards his son: the relationship completely built on lies. / Viking: Pad narkobosa je delimično biografski film, delimično istinita kriminalistička priča. Istinita priča o čoveku koji je proveo 16 godina u zatvoru, od čega dve u jednom od najgorih zatvora u Brazilu, gde su zatvorenici srećni ako uspeju da sačuvaju svoju glavu. Očajnički želeći da ne povredi svog sina, Malmkvist se pretvara da je zatvorski čuvar 12 godina, nikad ne otkrivajući stvarnost svog života kao zatvorenika. Ali nije život iza rešetaka ono što opterećuje Klauza Malmkvista - nego ljudi koje je povredio. Malmkvistovo najveće žaljenje je njegov odnos prema vlastitom sinu: odnos u potpunosti izgrađen na lažima.

programme.title: Titan collision / Sudar titana
programme.desc: Relations of China and the United States are currently the worst in modern history. How is historical forces of pride and shame sign that conflict? Understand Chinese life of humiliation and find out that poverty in America spreads anti-Chinese attitudes in public. As it worsens, we discover communities in confusion, companies on the edge of the abyss and the states that walk around the rope. / Odnosi Kine i SAD-a su trenutno najgori u savremenoj istoriji. Kako istorijske sile ponosa i sramote potpiruju taj sukob? Shvatite kineski vek poniženja i saznajte kako siromaštvo u Americi širi anti-kineske stavove u javnosti. programme.title: Nazi treasure hunt / Lov na nacističko blago
programme.desc: This series processes the largest robbery in history, and one of the biggest hunts on the treasure in the world today. Between 1933. and 1945. The Nazis stolen on millions of cultural artifacts and hundreds of tons of gold. They stole rings and gold fillings, untreated diamonds and crown jewels; The museums, libraries, churches, synagogues, shops, factories and family homes were covered. Some of the stolen things have not been found today, including approximately 100,000 artistic works of artists such as Degaa, Van Goga and Rafael, as well as gold stocks, diamonds, jewelery and other cultural values worth tens, if not hundreds of millions. Trying to get all right back in the last days of World War II, and lasts today. Hunting on the Nazi slight emphasis on modern research, detective work and authentic quest. Each episode follows the investigator team on the trail of missing plen. / Ovaj serijal obrađuje najveću pljačku u istoriji, i jedan od najvećih lovova na blago na svetu danas. Između 1933. i 1945. nacisti su pokrali na milione kulturnih artefakata i stotine tona zlata. Krali su burme i zlatne plombe, neobrađene dijamante i krunske dragulje; pročešljali su muzeje, biblioteke, crkve, sinagoge, radnje, fabrike i porodične domove. Neke od ukradenih stvari ni danas nisu nađene, uključujući i otprilike 100.000 umetničkih dela umetnika poput Degaa, Van Goga i Rafaela, kao i zalihe zlata, dijamanata, nakita i drugih kulturnih vrednosti vrednih više desetina, ako ne i stotina miliona. Pokušaj da se sve to povrati započeo je u poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, a traje i danas. Lov na nacističko blago stavlja naglasak na savremeno istraživanje, detektivski rad i autentičnu potragu. Svaka epizoda prati tim istražitelja na tragu nestalom plenu.

programme.title: Impossible repairs / Nemoguće popravke
programme.desc: Impossible repairs is an exciting documentary series that leads viewers behind the scenes of the largest and most complex machines in the world, in order to investigate dirty jobs and the most amazing missions of many heroes around the world. Huge machines and complex operations are in the focus of each episode, and Majk Davidson works together with teams responsible for working with daily hazards lurking behind the corner on the railroads, in the air and in the pučina. Small complications can become big problems for the blink of an eye, so the pilots, drivers, engineers and mechanics that Mike accompanies under constant pressure. Mother's instincts and knowledge in these areas are unprecedented, and he is always on the caution while the teams are dripping these beasts of these beasts, in order to keep them on the road, and eventually completed the mission. / Nemoguće popravke je uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija koja vodi gledaoce iza kulisa najvećih i najsloženijih mašina na svetu, kako bi istražio prljave poslove i najneverovatnije misije prekaljenih junaka širom sveta. Ogromne mašine i složene operacije su u fokusu svake epizode, a voditelj Majk Dejvidson radi zajedno sa ekipama koje su odgovorne za rad sa svakodnevnim opasnostima koje vrebaju iza ćoška na prugama, u vazduhu i na pučini. Male komplikacije mogu da postanu veliki problemi za tren oka, pa su neverovatni piloti, vozači, inženjeri i mehaničari koje Majk prati pod stalnim pritiskom. Majkovi instinkti i znanja u ovim oblastima su bez presedana, a on je uvek na oprezu dok ekipe prekopavaju utrobe ovih zverskih mašina, kako bi ih držali na putu, obavili posao, i na kraju, dovršili misiju.

programme.title: How did they build it? / Kako su to izgradili?
programme.desc: Incredible secrets behind the most impressive buildings of the world. From a luxurious subway in China, a riding to the top of the world, over the curved skeleton covered in a 15-meter in Singapore, this exciting agriculture that the world has ever seen - how did they build it? Od luksuznog podzemnog hotela u Kini, do vožnje liftom do vrha sveta, preko zakrivljenog nebodera na Menhetnu prekrivenog bakrom, do krovne bašte na visini od 500 metara u Singapuru, ovaj uzbudljivi serijal slavi neke od najvećih inženjerskih postignuća koje je svet ikada video - od kojih svako navodi na pitanje - kako su to izgradili? Putujući širom planete u potrazi za odgovorima, upoznajemo ljude koji su projektovali i izgradili ove građevine, i otkrivamo izuzetne tajne savremenog inženjerstva koje su učinile ova savremena čuda mogućim. Prelepe, hrabre i iznenađujuće, ovo je inženjerstvo razmera i složenosti kakve pre nisu viđene. Ovi inženjerski poduhvati će vam garantovano oduzeti dah.

programme.title: Meeting with death / Sastanak sa smrću
programme.desc: The death meeting will explore the turbulent era of the 1970s and reveal how the rule of terror of Gornia Alkale crossed the road from Los Angeles to New York. As a student of art, the Alkala grinded its photographic skills at UCLA universities and NYU. Thanks to the photographic craft, the Alkala received the opportunity to spoil girls and children throughout the free and focused decade. His collection of over 1,000 photos serves as the main resource for the Alkala to connect to other potential victims, but due to the explicit nature of these photos, only a small number of them are released to determine the identities and locations of his entities. This series returns us through time, until his first known crime in Los Angeles in 1968. year, when he kidnapped, raped and almost killed an eight-year-old girl. After her family did not allow her to testify, Alkalu waited only shorter custody. After premature release in 1974. Alkala has been returning back to prison for years for different offenses. In the end, the Federal Investigation revealed a number of victims into four federal states, between 1968. and 1979, which led to his arrest. Chasing women and children, Alkala managed to deceive and capture innocent target, pretending to be a successful photographer. With the coefficient of intelligence over 160, he was used by cunning to connect with the victims he later used for his sadist games. / Sastanak sa smrću će istražiti turbulentnu eru 1970-tih i otkriti kako je vladavina terora Rodnija Alkale prešla put od Los Anđelesa do Njujorka. Kao student umetnosti, Alkala je brusio svoje fotografske veštine na univerzitetima UCLA i NYU. Zahvaljujući fotografskom zanatu, Alkala je dobio mogućnost da uhodi devojke i decu tokom čitave slobodnjačke i pomodarske decenije. Njegova zbirka od preko 1.000 fotografija služi kao glavni resurs za policiju kako bi se Alkala povezao sa drugim potencijalnim žrtvama, ali zbog eksplicitne prirode tih fotografija, samo mali broj njih je pušten u javnost u nadi da će se utvrditi identiteti i lokacije njegovih subjekata. Ovaj serijal nas vraća kroz vreme, do njegovog prvog poznatog zločina u Los Anđelesu 1968. godine, kada je kidnapovao, silovao i skoro ubio osmogodišnju devojčicu. Nakon što joj porodica nije dozvolila da svedoči, Alkalu je sačekao samo kraći pritvor. Nakon preranog otpusta 1974. Alkala je godinama vraćan nazad u zatvor zbog različitih prestupa. Na kraju je federalna istraga otkrila čitav niz žrtava u četiri savezne države, između 1968. i 1979, što je dovelo do njegovog hapšenja. Progoneći žene i decu, Alkala je uspeo da obmane i zarobi nevine mete, pretvarajući se da je uspešan fotograf. Sa koeficijentom inteligencije preko 160, koristio se lukavstvom kako bi se povezao sa žrtvama koje je kasnije koristio za svoje sadističke igre.

programme.title: Murders by the sea / Ubistva pored mora
programme.desc: It may be up to the sea air or too much sun, but despite the joy we associate with sandy castles and ice cream, the asset riding, many British coastal cities have a suspicious reputation as cities in which the murder rate is extremely high. Some of the oddest and most terrible murders in the criminal history of Britain have taken place in their famous resorts: some of the most comfortable murders took place in these large hotels, and the seabed has become hunting tle for the most dangerous serial killers in history. / Možda je do morskog vazduha ili previše sunca, ali uprkos veselju koje povezujemo sa peščanim zamkovima i sladoledom, laganim šetnjama po promenadi i jahanjem magaraca, mnogi britanski primorski gradovi imaju sumnjivu reputaciju kao gradovi u kojima je stopa ubistava izuzetno visoka. Neka od najčudnijih i najstrašnijih ubistava u kriminalnoj istoriji Britanije odvila su se u njihovim poznatim primorskim odmaralištima: u tim velikim hotelima desila su se neka od najužasnijih ubistava, a morska riva postala je lovačko tle za najopakije serijske ubice u istoriji.

programme.title: DNA evidence / DNK dokazi
programme.desc: With the revolution in forensics, obsolete cases around the world are finally resolved, and DNA evidence emissions investigates and transmits stories of the most amazing cases that have been resolved so far. With the testimony of witnesses, new conversations, archival recordings and dramatic reconstructions, DNA evidence brings an exciting television program that will reveal new and dynamic forms of combating crime. / Pomoću revolucije u forenzici, zastareli slučajevi širom sveta se napokon rešavaju, a emisija DNK dokazi istražuje i prenosi priče najneverovatnijih slučajeva koji su do sada rešeni. Pomoću iskaza svedoka, novih razgovora, arhivskih snimaka i dramatičnih rekonstrukcija, DNK dokazi donosi uzbudljiv televizijski program koji će nam otkriti nove i dinamične oblike borbe protiv kriminala.

programme.title: Nurses who kill / Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju
programme.desc: They are angels patrol hospital corridors. People we entrust our lives. But some are not there to heal, but to kill. Why do they do that? In this document criminal series, superior medical, police and psychological experts will analyze the motives of these medical technicians who kill, the way they are extracted, and how difficult they are to prove their guilt. We will revive cases with the help of actors who will show real technicians in personal testimonies. In addition to the unprecedented evidence, the emissions of the nurses that kill reveals shocking cynicism and brutality behind the care of the care of those who tuck you into bed at night. / Oni su anđeli koji patroliraju bolničkim hodnicima. Ljudi kojima poveravamo svoje živote. Ali neki nisu tamo da bi lečili, već da bi ubijali. Zašto to rade? U ovoj dokudramskoj kriminalističkoj seriji, vrhunski medicinski, policijski i psihološki stručnjaci će analizirati motive ovih medicinskih tehničara koji ubijaju, načine na koji se izvlače, i koliko je nekada teško dokazati njihovu krivicu. Slučajeve ćemo oživeti uz pomoć glumaca koji će prikazati stvarne tehničare u ličnim svedočenjima. Uz do sada neobjavljene dokaze, emisija Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju otkriva šokantan cinizam i brutalnost iza brižnih ličnosti onih koji vas noću ušuškavaju u krevet.

programme.title: The killer in the family / Ubica u porodici
programme.desc: The killer in the family explores a different approach and story story from the perspective of the killer family, including the influence that the crime had on them. The show asks questions such as: Was there any early signs of the murderer's intention? Did they have any idea about the horror waiting for them? How did they feel when they learned a frightening truth? The episodes contain sincere and emotional interviews with family members and former partners of the observed killers, Fred West, Richard Ramirez, Phillip Fraser, Levi Bellfield, as well as those who participated in the Honor Murder Surjit Athwal. Each story involves reports from the media, personal archives, police testimony and journalists who worked on the case, as well as the psychological analysis of experts who investigate how the family was worn with trauma. / Ubica u porodici istražuje drugačiji pristup i priču pripoveda iz perspektive porodice ubice, uključujući i uticaj koji je zločin imao na njih. Emisija postavlja pitanja kao što su: da li je bilo ranih znakova namere ubice? Da li su imali bilo kakvu predstavu o užasu koji ih čeka? Kako su se osećali kada su saznali zastrašujuću istinu? Epizode sadrže iskrene i emotivne intervjue sa članovima porodice i bivšim partnerima ozloglašenih ubica kao što su Ian Huntley, Fred West, Richard Ramirez, Phillip Fraser, Levi Bellfield, kao i one koji su učestvovali u ubistvu iz časti Surjit Athwal. Svaka priča uključuje izveštaje iz medija, lične arhive, svedočenja policajaca i novinara koji su radili na slučaju, kao i psihološku analizu stručnjaka koji istražuju kako se porodica nosila sa traumom.

Trying to get all right back in the last days of World War II, and lasts today. Hunting on the Nazi slight emphasis on modern research, detective work and authentic quest. Each episode follows the investigator team on the trail of missing plen. / Ovaj serijal obrađuje najveću pljačku u istoriji, i jedan od najvećih lovova na blago na svetu danas. programme.desc: From the workshop of the largest joy on the domestic TV scene, Robert Knjaz, a new entertainment series (or better: Selija) is coming to us about the most picturesque European villages. Blue-White Greece Oia, White Andalusian village Setenil de las bodegas and unique Italian Manarola and Ryomađore, Norwegian Movie Frozen, French Eguisheim with flower and switzerland water waterfalls - All these villages You will watch open mouth and find out forces about the life and customs of local ones. You will get new ideas for romantic trips and discover how nine tourists come to ninety thousand each year. / Iz radionice najvećeg veseljaka na domaćoj TV sceni, Roberta Knjaza, stiže nam nova zabavno-poučna serija (ili bolje: selija) o najslikovitijim evropskim selima. I dok većina čovečanstva hrli u gradove, mi smo krenuli u suprotnom smeru i u šest čarobnih epizoda saznali kako je živeti na selu, jesu li seljaci veseljaci i kako izgledaju najlepša evropska sela. Plavo-bela grčka Oia, bijelo andaluzijsko selo Setenil de las Bodegas i unikatno plavo selo Juzcar, šarena italijanska Manarola i Riomađore, norveški Reine - model za film Frozen, francuski Eguisheim sa vodopadima cveća i švajcarski Lauterbrunnen sa vodopadima vode - sva ta sela gledaćete otvorenih usta i saznati štošta o životu i običajima lokalaca. Dobićete nove ideje za romantična putovanja i otkriti kako od devet turista godišnje doći do njih devedeset hiljada.

programme.title: Nicotine: drugs of the future / Nikotin: Droga budućnosti
programme.desc: Smoking is completely prohibited in public areas and in most restaurants, at least in the western world. Despite the reduction in the number of smokers in the west, the tobacco industry did not give up! New electronic products such as electric cigars and tobacco heaters arrived on the market. The colorful marketing campaigns sell the illusion of a new smoking: it is cool, it does not stink and do not displace you. But are these promises industry true? Or the same thing happens that always: the sales of fog to consumers? We cannot claim that the new electronic products are healthier: just like tobacco cigarettes, they contain nervous poison nicotine - and he makes you addicts, and above all and sick, as reportedly claims a new study. Also, new lung diseases like Evali mask a picture of healthy smoking. Products are developed, but strategies remain the same; How does this industry continue to earn without any thinking of health? / Pušenje je potpuno zabranjeno u javnim prostorima i u većini restorana, makar u zapadnom svetu. Uprkos smanjenju broja pušača na Zapadu, duvanska industrija nije odustala! Novi elektronski proizvodi poput električne cigare i grejača duvana stigli su na tržište. Šarolike marketinške kampanje prodaju iluziju novog pušenja: ono je kul, ne smrdi i ne razboljeva vas. Ali da li su ova obećanja industrija istinita? Ili se dešava isto što i oduvek: prodavanje magle potrošačima? Nikako ne možemo da tvrdimo da su novi elektronski proizvodi zdraviji: baš kao i duvanske cigarete, one sadrže nervni otrov nikotin - i on vas čini zavisnicima, a iznad svega i bolesnima, kako to navodno tvrdi nova studija. Takođe, nove bolesti pluća poput evalija maskiraju sliku o zdravom pušenju. Proizvodi se razvijaju, ali strategije ostaju iste; kako ova industrija nastavlja da zarađuje bez ikakvog razmišljanja o zdravlju?

programme.title: Černobilj - the last battle of the USSR - a / Černobilj - poslednja bitka SSSR - a
programme.desc: If 20. The century really started on the night 12. April 1912. He may have ended in the night on the night 26. April 1986. Reactor explosion 4 Nuclear power plants Lenin, also known as Chernobil. 35. Anniversary disaster.Tree decades after a nuclear explosion, almost everything has already been said about this ecological and sanitary disaster that enrolled in the name of the prepye in history. As the largest industrial accident changed the course of history, stirred global geopolitics and, directly or indirectly, redeployed the balance and power relations in the 20th century? The world will never be the same again. Following the trail of the amazing battle that the Soviet Union led against radiation, this film wants to trace and lighten one amazing story, exploring short-term and long-term historical roles. / Ako je 20. vek zaista počeo u noći 12. aprila 1912. potonućem Titanika, možda se završio prerano u noći 26. aprila 1986. eksplozijom reaktora 4 nuklearne elektrane Lenjin, poznate i kao Černobilj. 35. godišnjica katastrofe.Tri decenije nakon nuklearne eksplozije, skoro sve je već rečeno o ovoj ekološkoj i sanitarnoj katastrofi koja je upisala ime Pripjata u istoriju. Kako je najveća industrijska nesreća promenila tok istorije, uzburkala globalnu geopolitiku i, direktno ili indirektno, prerasporedila balans i odnose moći u 20. veku? Svet više nikad neće biti isti. Prateći trag neverovatne bitke koju je Sovjetski Savez vodio protiv radijacije, ovaj film želi da uđe u trag i rasvetli jednu neverovatnu priču, istražujući kratkoročne i dugoročne istorijske uloge.

programme.title: Where were you forty -fourth? / Gde si bio četrdeset i četvrte?
programme.desc: The film where you were 44 is a documentary fiction about the group of people in love with Ersoft, the type of sport in which players eliminate rivals by shooting from the replica of weapons, using plastic balls as ammunition. But the film is not just a fight, protagonists show us the importance of the historical context that is inseparable from this game. In addition to replicate of weapons, Ersoft players use costumes, cars and other items to revive events from the end of World War II. Interesting enthusiasts return us in childhood, when playing war games was part of growing up. This is the story of adults that fascinate history, and precisely because of the devotion to Ersoft, they introduced the game into a new dimension - instead of the war, it is a game today. / Film Gde si bio 44 je dokumentarna fikcija o grupi ljudi zaljubljenih u ersoft, vrstu sporta u kom igrači eliminišu suparnike pucanjem iz replika oružja, koristeći plastične kuglice kao municiju. Ali film nije samo o borbi, protagonisti nam pokazuju važnost istorijskog konteksta koji je nerazdvojan od ove igre. Pored replika oružja, igrači ersofta koriste kostime, automobile i druge predmete kako bi oživeli događaje s kraja Drugog svetskog rata. Zanimljivi entuzijasti vraćaju nas u detinjstvo, kada je igranje ratnih igara bilo deo odrastanja. Ovo je priča o odraslima koje fascinira istorija, a upravo zbog posvećenosti ersoftu, oni su igru uveli u novu dimenziju - umesto rata, to danas predstavlja igru.

programme.desc: This series, leading Sir Toni Robinson, takes us on a journey around the world in search of the most unusual and most innovative machines and vehicles. This exciting new series celebrates modern miracles of engineering - many of them are so unusual that you would never even think they exist. In each episode, tonnes reveals four completely amazing and unique machines. He meets people who use them, but also brilliant engineers, scientists and inventors who have created them. Through peeking behind the scenes and workshops, technical demonstrations and exciting challenges, tons of fun and accessible way explores Veneseric science and technology that drives these machines - and sometimes even seven for commands! / Ova serija, koju vodi ser Toni Robinson, vodi nas na put oko sveta u potrazi za najneobičnijim i najinovativnijim mašinama i vozilima. Prepuna je uzbudljivih vratolomija, epskih izazova i zanimljivih priča iz sveta nauke i inženjerstva - objašnjenih tako da ih svi mogu razumeti. Ova uzbudljiva nova serija slavi moderna čuda inženjerstva - mnoga od njih su toliko neobična da nikad ne biste ni pomislili da postoje. U svakoj epizodi, Toni otkriva četiri potpuno neverovatne i jedinstvene mašine. Upoznaje ljude koji ih koriste, ali i briljantne inženjere, naučnike i pronalazače koji su ih stvorili. Kroz zavirivanje iza kulisa u fabrike i radionice, tehničke demonstracije i uzbudljive izazove, Toni na zabavan i pristupačan način istražuje venserijsku nauku i tehnologiju koja pokreće ove mašine - i ponekad čak i sam sedne za komande!

programme.title: Titan conflict: New World Order / Sukob titana: Novi svetski poredak
programme.desc: The Rivalry of China and the United States continues to dominate the headlines around the world, and is becoming even more important in the light of the conflict in Ukraine. The relationship between China and Europe is worse than ever in the previous four decades. Across Asia, India, Japan and South Korea are consuming more and more money on the army. In Southeast Asia, the state nervously measure southern Sea, while the war ships of all major world powers are circulating there. While all this is happening, China warns that the American plan for Indopacifix is an introduction to the tragedy in the manner of Ukraine. / Rivalstvo Kine i SAD-a nastavlja da dominira naslovima novina širom sveta, a postaje još važnije u svetlu sukoba u Ukrajini. Odnos Kine i Evrope je gori nego ikad u prethodne četiri decenije. Širom Azije, Indija, Japan i Južna Koreja troše sve više para na vojsku. U Jugoistočnoj Aziji, države nervozno merkaju Južno kinesko more, dok tamo kruže ratni brodovi svih velikih svetskih sila. Dok se sve to dešava, Kina upozorava da je američki plan za Indopacifik uvod u tragediju u maniru Ukrajine.

programme.title: Storm is getting ready / Sprema se oluja
programme.desc: Long-term Tramp's advisor tries to manipulate the Danish director of Christopher Guldbrandsen in this shocking portrait of a puppet collected in his own strings. This film is recorded a combination of toxicity, hypocrisy and audacity which makes Roger Ston as an influential and dangerous American political landscape figure. It is an unusual, sometimes scary film. It is even more significant because the potential new tramps of the Presidential campaign for 2024 is taken place. Year. The film reveals that Stone sets figures and manages the Presidents as if it is his private game. And that is not a 3D chess, as you might think first, but somewhat strategically much less sophisticated - more like a children's monopoly party, in which the Roger Stone always has the first move and a ticket to exit prison. / Dugogodišnji Trampov savetnik pokušava da izmanipuliše danskog reditelja Kristofera Guldbrandsena u ovom šokantnom portretu lutkara koji se zapleo u sopstvene konce. Ovaj film beleži kombinaciju toksičnosti, licemerja i drskosti koja Rodžera Stona čini tako uticajnom i opasnom figurom američkog političkog pejzaža. To je nesvakidašnji, ponekad zastrašujući film. Još je značajniji jer se odvija uoči potencijalne nove Trampove predsedničke kampanje za 2024. godinu. Film otkriva kako Stone postavlja figure i upravlja predsednicima kao da je to njegova privatna igra. I to nije 3D šah, kako biste možda prvo pomislili, već nešto strateški mnogo manje sofisticirano — više nalik dečjoj partiji Monopola, u kojoj je jedina sigurnost to da Roger Stone uvek ima prvi potez i kartu za izlazak iz zatvora.

programme.title: Movement through the Atlantic / Veslima preko Atlantika
programme.desc: Follow Jason Koldvela and his team as they move on a dangerous and almost impossible task to translate over the Atlantic in 35 days, in an attempt to brush the world record. Jason Koldwel is an American athlete whose career marked the arrays of silver medals; He could professionally play basketball, if there was no injury that ended his career. He almost became a member of the Olympic Rowing Team, but it was running out of time. He is a tireless soul that is chasing the victory, and when he finds out for an almost unattainable, a lonely race race almost 5.000 kilometers long, he believes that the stars finally coincided. With the help of top rowers, Jasse's ambition is not just to win in the race, but also knocked down the world record in speed - except that he finished the wrong team and underestimates the dangers of the ocean. After only 10 days on the spruce, the team is falling apart, and two of the four team members give up in the middle of the Atlantic. Tired, humiliated and 13 kilograms easier, Jason draws to the target line, and the next day he begins to plan a new attempt. This time it was resolved to find the perfect team - selfless people who would fight for each other. Just a year later he returns to the field. But when the sea disease and hard stomas are coming back again, Jason faces an almost impossible task: to cross the last 650 kilometers in just five days, to knock down the record. / Pratite Džejsona Koldvela i njegov tim dok kreću na opasan i gotovo nemoguć zadatak da preveslaju preko Atlantika za 35 dana, u pokušaju da obore svetski rekord. Džejson Koldvel je američki sportista čiju karijeru su obeležili nizovi srebrnih medalja; mogao je profesionalno da igra košarku, da nije bilo povrede koja mu je okončala karijeru. Zamalo je postao član olimpijskog veslačkog tima, ali ponestalo mu je vremena. On je neumorna duša koja juri za pobedom, a kada sazna za gotovo neostvarivu, usamljeničku veslačku trku dužine skoro 5.000 kilometara, on smatra da su se zvezde napokon poklopile. Uz pomoć vrhunskih veslača, Džejsonova ambicija nije samo da pobedi u trci, već i da obori svetski rekord u brzini - osim što je završio sa pogrešnom ekipom i potcenjuje opasnosti okeana. Nakon samo 10 dana na pučini, ekipa se raspada, a dvojica od četiri člana tima odustaju usred Atlantika. Umoran, ponižen i 13 kilograma lakši, Džejson se dovlači do ciljne linije, a već sledećeg dana počinje da planira novi pokušaj. Ovog puta je rešen da nađe savršen tim - nesebične ljude koji će se boriti jedni za druge. Samo godinu dana kasnije se vraća na teren. Ali kada mu morska bolest i teško nevreme ponovo ugroze san, Džejson se suočava sa gotovo nemogućim zadatkom: da pređe poslednjih 650 kilometara za samo pet dana, kako bi oborio rekord.

programme.title: Face to face with head hunters / Licem u lice s lovcima na glave
programme.desc: In this enlightening documentary, Stacey joins contemporary hunters on outlaws and explores how this industry worth 14 billion dollars in the US exploits the desperate desire of people for freedom. On the rim of Denver in Colorado, Stacey is engaged in the world of a group of hunters on their heads, led by married couples and Lydia Grill. They love fugunions every day from justice, and catch up to eleven them in the week. She accompanies them as they break into other people's estates, examine accusations and arrests who are in Begus. Stace testifies to that as long as head hunters are ready to go to capture criminals and get a cash prize. / U ovom prosvetljujućem dokumentarcu, Stejsi se pridružuje savremenim lovcima na odmetnike i istražuje kako ova industrija vredna 14 milijardi dolara u SAD-u iskorištava očajničku želju ljudi za slobodom. Na obodima Denvera u Koloradu, Stejsi se upušta u svet jedne grupe lovaca na glave, predvođene bračnim parom Skotom i Lidijom Gribl. Oni svakodnevno love begunce od pravde, i hvataju čak i do jedanaest njih u toku nedelje. Ona ih prati dok upadaju na tuđa imanja, ispituju saučesnike i hapse optuženike koji su u begu. Stejsi svedoči tome dokle su lovci na glave spremni da idu kako bi zarobili zločinca i dobili novčanu nagradu.

programme.title: Detained orka - Kit killer whale / Zatočeni orka - kit ubica
programme.desc: The Orka-detained Kit killer brings a story about the fight of the trapped orc for survival and freedom. After a decade of unsuccessful attempts to return home, an unexpected partnership between indigenous Matriarch, billionaire of the Orca and the new Aquarium owner, was captured 53 years ago while the cub was closed in the smallest pool for orcs in North America. When Lolita gets sick under worrying circumstances, her advocates face a painful question: Is it too late to save her? / Orka-zatočeni kit ubica donosi priču o borbi zarobljene orke za preživljavanje i slobodu. Nakon decenija neuspešnih pokušaja da je vrate kući, neočekivano partnerstvo između autohtonih matrijarha, milijardera filantropa, stručnjaka za orke i novog vlasnika akvarijuma odlučuje da preuzme gotovo nemoguć zadatak oslobađanja Lolite, zarobljene pre 53 godine dok je bila mladunče, a zatim zatvorene u najmanjem bazenu za orke u Severnoj Americi. Kada Lolita oboli pod zabrinjavajućim okolnostima, njeni zagovornici suočavaju se s bolnim pitanjem: da li je prekasno da je spase?

programme.title: Viking: Pad Narcotics / Viking: Pad narkobosa
programme.desc: Viking: The fall of the narcobos is a partial biographical film, a partially true criminal story. A true story about a man who spent 16 years in prison, of which two in one of the worst prisons in Brazil, where prisoners are happy if they manage to preserve their head. Desperately wishing not to hurt his son, the Malmkquist pretends to be a prison guard for 12 years, never revealing the reality of his life as a prisoner. But it is not behind bars, what burdens the Calaise Malmkvist - but the people he injured. Malmkvist's greatest regret is his attitude towards his son: the relationship completely built on lies. / Viking: Pad narkobosa je delimično biografski film, delimično istinita kriminalistička priča. Istinita priča o čoveku koji je proveo 16 godina u zatvoru, od čega dve u jednom od najgorih zatvora u Brazilu, gde su zatvorenici srećni ako uspeju da sačuvaju svoju glavu. Očajnički želeći da ne povredi svog sina, Malmkvist se pretvara da je zatvorski čuvar 12 godina, nikad ne otkrivajući stvarnost svog života kao zatvorenika. Ali nije život iza rešetaka ono što opterećuje Klauza Malmkvista - nego ljudi koje je povredio. Malmkvistovo najveće žaljenje je njegov odnos prema vlastitom sinu: odnos u potpunosti izgrađen na lažima.

programme.title: Titan collision / Sudar titana
programme.desc: Relations of China and the United States are currently the worst in modern history. How is historical forces of pride and shame sign that conflict? Kako se to pogoršava, otkrivamo zajednice u zbrci, kompanije na ivici ponora i države koje hodaju po užetu.

programme.title: Impossible repairs / Nemoguće popravke
programme.desc: Impossible repairs is an exciting documentary series that leads viewers behind the scenes of the largest and most complex machines in the world, in order to investigate dirty jobs and the most amazing missions of many heroes around the world. Huge machines and complex operations are in the focus of each episode, and Majk Davidson works together with teams responsible for working with daily hazards lurking behind the corner on the railroads, in the air and in the pučina. Small complications can become big problems for the blink of an eye, so the pilots, drivers, engineers and mechanics that Mike accompanies under constant pressure. Mother's instincts and knowledge in these areas are unprecedented, and he is always on the caution while the teams are dripping these beasts of these beasts, in order to keep them on the road, and eventually completed the mission. / Nemoguće popravke je uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija koja vodi gledaoce iza kulisa najvećih i najsloženijih mašina na svetu, kako bi istražio prljave poslove i najneverovatnije misije prekaljenih junaka širom sveta. Ogromne mašine i složene operacije su u fokusu svake epizode, a voditelj Majk Dejvidson radi zajedno sa ekipama koje su odgovorne za rad sa svakodnevnim opasnostima koje vrebaju iza ćoška na prugama, u vazduhu i na pučini. Male komplikacije mogu da postanu veliki problemi za tren oka, pa su neverovatni piloti, vozači, inženjeri i mehaničari koje Majk prati pod stalnim pritiskom. Majkovi instinkti i znanja u ovim oblastima su bez presedana, a on je uvek na oprezu dok ekipe prekopavaju utrobe ovih zverskih mašina, kako bi ih držali na putu, obavili posao, i na kraju, dovršili misiju.

programme.title: How did they build it? / Kako su to izgradili?
programme.desc: Incredible secrets behind the most impressive buildings of the world. From a luxurious subway in China, a riding to the top of the world, over the curved skeleton covered in a 15-meter in Singapore, this exciting agriculture that the world has ever seen - how did they build it? Traveling across the planet in search of answers, we meet people who designed and build these buildings, and reveal exceptional secrets of modern engineering that made these modern miracles possible. Beautiful, brave and surprisingly, this is an engineering of the scale and complexity as soon as they have not been seen. These engineering ventures will be guaranteed to take away your breath. / Neverovatne tajne iza najimpresivnijih građevina sveta. Od luksuznog podzemnog hotela u Kini, do vožnje liftom do vrha sveta, preko zakrivljenog nebodera na Menhetnu prekrivenog bakrom, do krovne bašte na visini od 500 metara u Singapuru, ovaj uzbudljivi serijal slavi neke od najvećih inženjerskih postignuća koje je svet ikada video - od kojih svako navodi na pitanje - kako su to izgradili? Putujući širom planete u potrazi za odgovorima, upoznajemo ljude koji su projektovali i izgradili ove građevine, i otkrivamo izuzetne tajne savremenog inženjerstva koje su učinile ova savremena čuda mogućim. Prelepe, hrabre i iznenađujuće, ovo je inženjerstvo razmera i složenosti kakve pre nisu viđene. Ovi inženjerski poduhvati će vam garantovano oduzeti dah.

programme.title: The killer in the family / Ubica u porodici
programme.desc: The killer in the family explores a different approach and story story from the perspective of the killer family, including the influence that the crime had on them. The show asks questions such as: Was there any early signs of the murderer's intention? Did they have any idea about the horror waiting for them? How did they feel when they learned a frightening truth? The episodes contain sincere and emotional interviews with family members and former partners of the observed killers, Fred West, Richard Ramirez, Phillip Fraser, Levi Bellfield, as well as those who participated in the Honor Murder Surjit Athwal. Each story involves reports from the media, personal archives, police testimony and journalists who worked on the case, as well as the psychological analysis of experts who investigate how the family was worn with trauma. / Ubica u porodici istražuje drugačiji pristup i priču pripoveda iz perspektive porodice ubice, uključujući i uticaj koji je zločin imao na njih. Emisija postavlja pitanja kao što su: da li je bilo ranih znakova namere ubice? Da li su imali bilo kakvu predstavu o užasu koji ih čeka? Kako su se osećali kada su saznali zastrašujuću istinu? Epizode sadrže iskrene i emotivne intervjue sa članovima porodice i bivšim partnerima ozloglašenih ubica kao što su Ian Huntley, Fred West, Richard Ramirez, Phillip Fraser, Levi Bellfield, kao i one koji su učestvovali u ubistvu iz časti Surjit Athwal. Svaka priča uključuje izveštaje iz medija, lične arhive, svedočenja policajaca i novinara koji su radili na slučaju, kao i psihološku analizu stručnjaka koji istražuju kako se porodica nosila sa traumom.

programme.title: Murders by the sea / Ubistva pored mora
programme.desc: It may be up to the sea air or too much sun, but despite the joy we associate with sandy castles and ice cream, the asset riding, many British coastal cities have a suspicious reputation as cities in which the murder rate is extremely high. Some of the oddest and most terrible murders in the criminal history of Britain have taken place in their famous resorts: some of the most comfortable murders took place in these large hotels, and the seabed has become hunting tle for the most dangerous serial killers in history. / Možda je do morskog vazduha ili previše sunca, ali uprkos veselju koje povezujemo sa peščanim zamkovima i sladoledom, laganim šetnjama po promenadi i jahanjem magaraca, mnogi britanski primorski gradovi imaju sumnjivu reputaciju kao gradovi u kojima je stopa ubistava izuzetno visoka. Neka od najčudnijih i najstrašnijih ubistava u kriminalnoj istoriji Britanije odvila su se u njihovim poznatim primorskim odmaralištima: u tim velikim hotelima desila su se neka od najužasnijih ubistava, a morska riva postala je lovačko tle za najopakije serijske ubice u istoriji.

programme.title: DNA evidence / DNK dokazi
programme.desc: With the revolution in forensics, obsolete cases around the world are finally resolved, and DNA evidence emissions investigates and transmits stories of the most amazing cases that have been resolved so far. With the testimony of witnesses, new conversations, archival recordings and dramatic reconstructions, DNA evidence brings an exciting television program that will reveal new and dynamic forms of combating crime. / Pomoću revolucije u forenzici, zastareli slučajevi širom sveta se napokon rešavaju, a emisija DNK dokazi istražuje i prenosi priče najneverovatnijih slučajeva koji su do sada rešeni. Pomoću iskaza svedoka, novih razgovora, arhivskih snimaka i dramatičnih rekonstrukcija, DNK dokazi donosi uzbudljiv televizijski program koji će nam otkriti nove i dinamične oblike borbe protiv kriminala.

programme.title: Nurses who kill / Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju
programme.desc: They are angels patrol hospital corridors. People we entrust our lives. But some are not there to heal, but to kill. Why do they do that? In this document criminal series, superior medical, police and psychological experts will analyze the motives of these medical technicians who kill, the way they are extracted, and how difficult they are to prove their guilt. We will revive cases with the help of actors who will show real technicians in personal testimonies. In addition to the unprecedented evidence, the emissions of the nurses that kill reveals shocking cynicism and brutality behind the care of the care of those who tuck you into bed at night. / Oni su anđeli koji patroliraju bolničkim hodnicima. Ljudi kojima poveravamo svoje živote. Ali neki nisu tamo da bi lečili, već da bi ubijali. Zašto to rade? U ovoj dokudramskoj kriminalističkoj seriji, vrhunski medicinski, policijski i psihološki stručnjaci će analizirati motive ovih medicinskih tehničara koji ubijaju, načine na koji se izvlače, i koliko je nekada teško dokazati njihovu krivicu. Slučajeve ćemo oživeti uz pomoć glumaca koji će prikazati stvarne tehničare u ličnim svedočenjima. Uz do sada neobjavljene dokaze, emisija Medicinske sestre koje ubijaju otkriva šokantan cinizam i brutalnost iza brižnih ličnosti onih koji vas noću ušuškavaju u krevet.

Traveling across the planet in search of answers, we meet people who designed and build these buildings, and reveal exceptional secrets of modern engineering that made these modern miracles possible. Beautiful, brave and surprisingly, this is an engineering of the scale and complexity as soon as they have not been seen. These engineering ventures will be guaranteed to take away your breath. / Neverovatne tajne iza najimpresivnijih građevina sveta. Od luksuznog podzemnog hotela u Kini, do vožnje liftom do vrha sveta, preko zakrivljenog nebodera na Menhetnu prekrivenog bakrom, do krovne bašte na visini od 500 metara u Singapuru, ovaj uzbudljivi serijal slavi neke od najvećih inženjerskih postignuća koje je svet ikada video - od kojih svako navodi na pitanje - kako su to izgradili? programme.title: Impossible repairs / Nemoguće popravke
programme.desc: Impossible repairs is an exciting documentary series that leads viewers behind the scenes of the largest and most complex machines in the world, in order to investigate dirty jobs and the most amazing missions of many heroes around the world. Huge machines and complex operations are in the focus of each episode, and Majk Davidson works together with teams responsible for working with daily hazards lurking behind the corner on the railroads, in the air and in the pučina. Small complications can become big problems for the blink of an eye, so the pilots, drivers, engineers and mechanics that Mike accompanies under constant pressure. Mother's instincts and knowledge in these areas are unprecedented, and he is always on the caution while the teams are dripping these beasts of these beasts, in order to keep them on the road, and eventually completed the mission. / Nemoguće popravke je uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija koja vodi gledaoce iza kulisa najvećih i najsloženijih mašina na svetu, kako bi istražio prljave poslove i najneverovatnije misije prekaljenih junaka širom sveta. Ogromne mašine i složene operacije su u fokusu svake epizode, a voditelj Majk Dejvidson radi zajedno sa ekipama koje su odgovorne za rad sa svakodnevnim opasnostima koje vrebaju iza ćoška na prugama, u vazduhu i na pučini. Male komplikacije mogu da postanu veliki problemi za tren oka, pa su neverovatni piloti, vozači, inženjeri i mehaničari koje Majk prati pod stalnim pritiskom. Majkovi instinkti i znanja u ovim oblastima su bez presedana, a on je uvek na oprezu dok ekipe prekopavaju utrobe ovih zverskih mašina, kako bi ih držali na putu, obavili posao, i na kraju, dovršili misiju.

programme.title: Nazi treasure hunt / Lov na nacističko blago
programme.desc: This series processes the largest robbery in history, and one of the biggest hunts on the treasure in the world today. Between 1933. and 1945. The Nazis stolen on millions of cultural artifacts and hundreds of tons of gold. They stole rings and gold fillings, untreated diamonds and crown jewels; The museums, libraries, churches, synagogues, shops, factories and family homes were covered. Some of the stolen things have not been found today, including approximately 100,000 artistic works of artists such as Degaa, Van Goga and Rafael, as well as gold stocks, diamonds, jewelery and other cultural values worth tens, if not hundreds of millions. Trying to get all right back in the last days of World War II, and lasts today. Hunting on the Nazi slight emphasis on modern research, detective work and authentic quest. Each episode follows the investigator team on the trail of missing plen. / Ovaj serijal obrađuje najveću pljačku u istoriji, i jedan od najvećih lovova na blago na svetu danas. Između 1933. i 1945. nacisti su pokrali na milione kulturnih artefakata i stotine tona zlata. Krali su burme i zlatne plombe, neobrađene dijamante i krunske dragulje; pročešljali su muzeje, biblioteke, crkve, sinagoge, radnje, fabrike i porodične domove. Neke od ukradenih stvari ni danas nisu nađene, uključujući i otprilike 100.000 umetničkih dela umetnika poput Degaa, Van Goga i Rafaela, kao i zalihe zlata, dijamanata, nakita i drugih kulturnih vrednosti vrednih više desetina, ako ne i stotina miliona. Pokušaj da se sve to povrati započeo je u poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, a traje i danas. Lov na nacističko blago stavlja naglasak na savremeno istraživanje, detektivski rad i autentičnu potragu. Svaka epizoda prati tim istražitelja na tragu nestalom plenu.

programme.title: The most beautiful European village / Najlepša evropska sela
programme.desc: From the workshop of the largest joy on the domestic TV scene, Robert Knjaz, a new entertainment series (or better: Selija) is coming to us about the most picturesque European villages. And while most humanity rushes into cities, we have started in the opposite direction and learned in six magical episodes as living in the countryside, are they villagers of merry and how the most beautiful European villages look. Blue-White Greece Oia, White Andalusian village Setenil de las bodegas and unique Italian Manarola and Ryomađore, Norwegian Movie Frozen, French Eguisheim with flower and switzerland water waterfalls - All these villages You will watch open mouth and find out forces about the life and customs of local ones. You will get new ideas for romantic trips and discover how nine tourists come to ninety thousand each year. / Iz radionice najvećeg veseljaka na domaćoj TV sceni, Roberta Knjaza, stiže nam nova zabavno-poučna serija (ili bolje: selija) o najslikovitijim evropskim selima. I dok većina čovečanstva hrli u gradove, mi smo krenuli u suprotnom smeru i u šest čarobnih epizoda saznali kako je živeti na selu, jesu li seljaci veseljaci i kako izgledaju najlepša evropska sela. Plavo-bela grčka Oia, bijelo andaluzijsko selo Setenil de las Bodegas i unikatno plavo selo Juzcar, šarena italijanska Manarola i Riomađore, norveški Reine - model za film Frozen, francuski Eguisheim sa vodopadima cveća i švajcarski Lauterbrunnen sa vodopadima vode - sva ta sela gledaćete otvorenih usta i saznati štošta o životu i običajima lokalaca. Dobićete nove ideje za romantična putovanja i otkriti kako od devet turista godišnje doći do njih devedeset hiljada.

programme.title: Putin's war from the shadow / Putinov rat iz senke
programme.desc: The exciting documentary series on how to develop Putin's war from the shadow in Nordic countries, and in the rest of Europe. For more than a year, the award-winning research journalists and documentarist of Nordic state television, the NRK, YLE and SVT researched and recorded throughout Europe, how Russians operate under the mask in that part of the world. The result is frightening and reveals the creepy patterns and viewing angles. In the middle of the investigation, sabotage of the Severni Stream, the situation makes the situation more obvious and requires a closer examination of the activities of the Russian army in Western societies. / Uzbudljiva dokumentarna serija o tome kako se razvija Putinov rat iz senke u nordijskim zemljama, i u ostatku Evrope. Duže od godinu dana, ekipa nagrađivanih istraživačkih novinara i dokumentarista nordijskih državnih televizija DR, NRK, YLE i SVT su istraživali i snimali širom Evrope to kako Rusi operišu pod maskom u tom delu sveta. Rezultat je zastrašujući i otkriva jezive obrasce i uglove gledanja. Usred istrage, sabotaža gasnog sistema Severni tok čini situaciju očiglednijom i zahteva bliže ispitivanje aktivnosti ruske vojske u zapadnim društvima.

programme.title: Zapadni Front 1918 / Zapadni front 1918
programme.desc: German black and white war film taken in 1930. directed by George Wilhelm Pabst, to whom it was the first audible accident in his career. The shop is based on the novel Vier Von der Infanterie Ernsta Johanssen, and was housed in the last year of the First World War on the western front. Protogonists are four German soldiers who face scarcity, hunger and horrors of the Royalty War I, but also by cognition of growing futility and meaningless fight. Pubst showed a great skill with this film with new sound technology, especially in driving scenes above the trenches to get the war more effectively. Due to the content, but also the pacifist messages was often compared to the American classic film in the West Nothing new; For the same reasons, they attacked the Nazis due to promoting the defeatism, so after their arrival on the government was banned in Germany. / Njemački crno-beli ratni film snimljen 1930. u režiji Džordž Vilhelm Pabst, kome je to bilo prvo zvučno ostvarenje u karijeri. Radnja se temelji na romanu Vier von der Infanterie Ernsta Johanssena, i smeštena je u poslednju godinu Prvog svetskog rata na Zapadnom frontu. Protagonisti su četvorica nemačkih vojnika koji se suočavaju sa oskudicom, glađu i užasima rovovskog ratovanja, ali i spoznajom o sve većoj uzaludnosti i besmislenosti borbe. Pabst je ovim filmom pokazao veliku veštinu sa novom zvučnom tehnologijom, pogotovo u scenama vožnje iznad rovova kako bi što efektnije dočarao rat. Zbog sadržaja, ali i pacifističke poruke je često bio upoređivan sa američkim klasičnim filmom Na zapadu ništa novo; iz istih razloga su ga zbog promovisanja defetizma napadali nacisti, pa je nakon njihovog dolaska na vlast zabranjen u Nemačkoj.

programme.title: rum / Romul
programme.desc: Recorded in Latin, series Romul is a story of this world of three people whose lives are marked by death, loneliness and violence: Iemos, Viros and young Vestalke Ilija. While these men and women are trying to create their destiny instead of passively to its whirlpools, a ruthless and protective woman is led by the formation of a new society - setting the foundations for one of the most powerful empires in history. Romul is an epic story about the origin of Rome, told in a unique and original way. / Snimana na latinskom jeziku, serija Romul je priča o ovom svetu iz ugla troje ljudi čiji životi su obeleženi smrću, usamljenošću i nasiljem: Iemosa, Virosa i mlade vestalke Ilije. Dok ovi muškarci i žene pokušavaju da kreiraju svoju sudbinu umesto da se pasivno prepuste njenim hirovima, jedna nemilosrdna i zaštitnički nastrojena žena predvodi formiranje novog društva - postavljajući temelje za jedno od najmoćnijih carstava u istoriji. Romul je epska priča o poreklu Rima, ispričana na jedinstven i originalan način.

programme.title: Who finds a friend, found a mild / Ko nađe prijatelja, našao je blago
programme.desc: Alan gets a map of the distant Pacific Island where the slight Japanese military from the Second World War is buried. A group of local gangsters, finding out that, trying to steal Alan map. However, he is ingenious, so the map hides on the ship of his good friend Charlie, which is anchored in the port. Shortly then, they move on the road. Alan somehow manages to turn the compass, so Charlie, while sailing, in fact, is not even aware of to go to the distant island in Pacific, where he is slightly hidden. However, as soon as he stepped out on the island, he reveals that he was not abandoned as he was believed to still keep Japanese soldiers. / Alan dobija mapu udaljenog pacifičkog ostrva gde je zakopano blago japanske vojske iz Drugog svetskog rata. Grupa lokalnih gangstera, saznavši za to, pokušava da ukrade mapu Alanu. Međutim, on je domišljat, pa mapu sakriva na brod svog dobrog prijatelja Čarlija, koji je usidren u gradskoj luci. Ubrzo zatim, kreću na put. Alan nekako uspeva da okrene kompas, pa tako Čarli, dok plovi, u stvari, nije ni svestan da ide ka udaljenom ostrvu u Pacifiku, gde je blago sakriveno. Međutim, čim je iskoračio na ostrvo, otkriva da nije napušteno kako se verovalo i da blago i dalje čuvaju japanski vojnici.

programme.title: The man who bought the moon / Čovek koji je kupio Mesec
programme.desc: The Italian intelligence service came to the information that is difficult to believe: the unidentified Sardinian resident is the true owner of the month. This news reaches all the intelligence services in the world immediately, and when all governments announce that they also have the right to the moon, they send a secret agent on the island, which is originally from Sardinia. Although the agent in question was really born in Sardinia, he lost all the qualities of the population over there and must attend private classes to learn how to be a real Sardinian. / Italijanska obaveštajna služba došla je do informacije u koju je teško poverovati: Neidentifikovani stanovnik Sardinije je pravi vlasnik Meseca. Ova vest odmah stigne do svih obaveštajnih službi na svetu, a kada sve vlade objave da i one imaju pravo na Mesec, na ostrvo pošalju tajnog agenta koji je poreklom sa Sardinije. Iako je dotični agent zaista rođen na Sardiniji, on je izgubio sve osobine tamošnjeg stanovništva i mora da pohađa privatne časove da bi naučio kako da bude pravi Sardinijac.

programme.title: Homecoming / Povratak kući
programme.desc: The owner of the agricultural estate in northern Italy wakes up from a five-year-old to find that the life he knew he turned upside down and learned that he was suspected of murder that he does not remember. / Vlasnik poljoprivrednog imanja u severnoj Italiji budi se iz petogodišnje kome kako bi otkrio da se život kakav je poznavao okrenuo naglavačke i saznao da je osumnjičen za ubIstvo kojeg se ne seća.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her, because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, she learns that she is an uncle on the edge of bankrupt, and that he was accused of lighting the van of a reputable department stores for the ladies, for which he loses his job. The owner of the department store is PieTro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a series of peripes, he manages to hire, and show that he is an ambitious and enterprising girl who soon acquires a colleague trust. programme.desc: American Action Comedy with Bad Spenser and Terens Hill in the main roles. More than $ 20 million was stolen from the Detroit Central Bank.
