programme.desc: The series shows the life of Simon Bolivar, a South American revolutionary leader, who fought for the liberation of South America countries from Spain. / Serija prikazuje život Simona Bolivara, južnoameričkog revolucionarnog vođe, koji se borio za oslobođenje država Južne Amerike od Španije.

programme.title: Official story / Zvanična priča
programme.desc: In 1983. Alisha, mother 5 - a yearly adopted girls surrenders history in high school in Buenos Ayres. In both business and in private life, she always accepted the official version, until one day of the Facade regime and everything surrounding him did not start falling apart in front of her eyes. In cracks and huge lies, Ališa begins to suspect that Gabi, a girl she adopted, is actually a daughter of murdered political prisoners. He moves on a painful and inevitable trip to the truth - a journey on which he can lose everything. All these individual adventures are part of a dramatic story: Argentina is a company on the edge of the brief, which tries to build their future, cure the wounds and recognize themselves in their victims and perpetrators. / Godine 1983. Ališa, majka 5 - godišnje usvojene devojčice predaje istoriju u srednjoj školi u Buenos Ajresu. I u poslu i u privatnom životu uvek je prihvatala zvaničnu verziju, sve dok jednog dana fasada režima i sve ono što ga okružuje nisu počeli da se raspadaju pred njenim očima. U pukotinama te ogromne laži, Ališa počinje da sumnja da je Gabi, devojčica koju je usvojila, zapravo ćerka ubijene političke zatvorenice. Kreće na bolno i neizbežno putovanje ka istini - putovanje na kome može izgubiti sve. Sve te pojedinačne avanture su deo jedne dramatične priče: Argentina je društvo na ivici provalije, koje pokušava da izgradi svoju budućnost, izleči rane i prepozna sebe u svojim žrtvama i izvršiocima.

programme.title: Wolves land / Zemlja vukova
programme.desc: Antonio Lobo is a rich landowner in Spain who controls and possesses most of the country. When Caesar and Roman Bravo decide to return to the Chamber in which they are born in the lob's land, it causes a conflict between them. The situation is further complicated when the oldest of the four lobes of the daughter falls in love with Caesar. / Antonio Lobo je bogati zemljoposednik u Španiji koji kontroliše i poseduje većinu zemlje. Kada Cezar i Roman Bravo odluče da se vrate u dom u kome su rođeni a koji se nalazi na Lobovoj zemlji, to izaziva sukob između njih. Situacija se dodatno komplikuje kada se najstarija od četiri Lobove ćerke zaljubi u Cezara.

programme.title: Shoulder strap / Bandolera
programme.desc: Sara Rejes is a student literature on Oxford during the 19th century. As a great respector of Spanish literature, the opera and culture Sara will escape the Andalusia in the desire for adventure, true love and family. Andalusia will enchant Sarah and she will find his home in a small Andalusian village, where she will be done to finally fulfill his life's dream and write his first novel. Everything will take place at her will until her uncle returns to the intention to return to England one day. Sara will become an outlawful of Robin Hud, who will dedicate life to help people in trouble. This series will enchant your hearts as you meet the protagonist, her character, virtue and flaws. You will fall in love with her love and beautiful pictures of Andalusia that boots you and leave you breathless. / Sara Rejes je studentkinja književnosti na Oksfordu tokom XIX veka. Kao veliki poštovalac španske književnosti, opere i kulture Sara će pobeći u Andaluziju u želji za avanturom, pravom ljubavi i porodicom. Andaluzija će očarati Saru i ona će pronaći svoj dom u malom andaluzijskom selu, gde će joj se učiniti da će konačno ispuniti svoj živoni san i napisati svoj prvi roman. Sve će se odvijati po njenoj volji dok se jednog dana ne vrati njen ujak u nameri da je vrati u Englesku. Sara će postati odmetnik nalik Robin Hudu, koji će posvetiti život da pomogne ljudima u nevolji. Ova serija će očarati vaša srca dok upoznajete protagonistu, njen karakter, vrline i mane. Zaljubićete se u njenu ljubav i prelepe slike Andaluzije koje vas plene i ostavljaju bez daha.

programme.title: Queen of Rhythm / Kraljica ritma
programme.desc: The main heroine, Jeimi Montoja, is a modest and talented 16-year-old, a fan of urban music that dreams of becoming a famous singer. But her dream was abruptly interrupted after the scam set by the person she most trusted her, and she ended up in prison in New York. All her music was stolen, and her family was killed by the order of a dangerous trader narcotics. From then on, her sole purpose is to revenge everyone who ended her dreams and lives of her family. For years later, he returned to Medelin as a fierce, calculated person, which changes his identity to infiltrate into the world of his enemies and destroyed them one by one ... / Glavna junakinja, Jejmi Montoja, skromna je i talentovana 16-godišnjakinja, obožavateljka urbane muzike koja sanja da postane poznata pevačica. Ali njen san je naglo prekinut nakon prevare koju joj namesti osoba kojoj je najviše verovala, i ona zbog toga završi u zatvoru u Njujorku. Sva njena muzika je ukradena, a njena porodica ubijena po nalogu opasnog trgovca narkoticima. Od tada pa nadalje, njena jedina svrha je da se osveti svima koji su okončali njene snove i živote njene porodice. Godinama kasnije vraća se u Medelin kao žestoka, proračunata osoba, koja menja svoj identitet da bi se infiltrirala u svet svojih neprijatelja i uništila ih jednog po jednog…

programme.title: Wake up and die / Probudi se i umri
programme.desc: Colombian psychological horror thriller directed and screenwriter Miguela Ururutia about a girl who wakes up next to the man who is again and again, and with every new killer reveals a new detail that could save her next time. / Kolumbijski psihološki horor triler reditelja i scenariste Miguela Urrutia o devojci koja se svakog jutra budi pored čoveka koji je ponovo i ponovo ubija, a sa svakim novim ubistvom otkriva neki novi detalj koji bi je mogao spasiti sledeći put.

programme.title: Sarano family / Porodica Serano
programme.desc: Serano family is a series that accept all generations with enthusiasm. The center of attention is a large family that has all possible members, from the widower through teenagers to the Divorced Father, who tries to re-marry and merge two families into one. / Porodica Serano je serija koju sa oduševljenjem prihvataju sve generacije. U centru pažnje je velika porodica koja ima sve moguće članove, od udovca preko tinejdžera do razvedenog oca, koji pokušava da se ponovo oženi i spoji dve porodice u jednu.

programme.title: Secret child / Tajno detinjstvo
programme.desc: Argentina 1979. After years spent in exile, the family of the twelve-year-old Huan returned to Argentina with a false identity. Huan's parents and his uncle bet are in an organization fighting a military hunta that rules the earth. Due to their political engagement, they seek them tirelessly and constantly threatens the arrest, and even death. However, Huan's everyday life is filled with warmth and humor, and he fits quickly and easily into the new environment. His comrades in the school and a girl he loves, Mary, know him as Ernest, and that is the name that we must not forget, because the life of his vice is in danger. Huan accepts this and respects all the rules of parents, until the day they say they must move immediately, and that he is forced to leave his comrades and Maria without explanation? / Argentina 1979. Nakon godina provedenih u izgnanstvu, porodica dvanaestogodišnjeg Huana se sa lažnim identitetom vraća u Argentinu. Huanovi roditelji i njegov ujak Beto su u organizaciji koja se bori protiv vojne hunte koja vlada zemljom. Zbog njihovog političkog angažmana neumorno ih traže i konstantno im preti hapšenje, pa čak i smrt. Međutim, Huanov svakodnevni život je ispunjen toplinom i humorom, i on se brzo i lako uklapa u novu sredinu. Njegovi drugovi u školi i devojka koju voli, Marija, znaju ga kao Ernesta, i to je ime koje ne sme da zaboravi, jer je život njegove prodice u opasnosti. Huan ovo prihvata i poštuje sva pravila roditelja, sve do dana kada mu kažu da moraju odmah da se odsele, i da je primoran da ostavi svoje drugove i Mariju bez objašnjenja?

Situacija se dodatno komplikuje kada se najstarija od četiri Lobove ćerke zaljubi u Cezara.

programme.title: Maid / Služavka
programme.desc: He intended by his family decision to take new home assistance, the home assistant get involved in a series of frenetic acts to maintain their position in this comedy about the family, classes and self-kric. / Zaplašena odlukom porodice da uzme novu pomoć u kući, kućna pomoćnica se uplete u seriju frenetičnih činova kako bi održala svoju poziciju u ovoj komediji o porodici, klasama i samootkriću.

programme.title: Bolivar / Bolivar
programme.desc: The series shows the life of Simon Bolivar, a South American revolutionary leader, who fought for the liberation of South America countries from Spain. / Serija prikazuje život Simona Bolivara, južnoameričkog revolucionarnog vođe, koji se borio za oslobođenje država Južne Amerike od Španije.

programme.title: Marry me, hang out / Udaj se za mene, druže
programme.desc: To avoid deportation, Jasin asks his best friend Fred to marry him ... / Da bi izbegao deportaciju, Jasin zamoli svog najboljeg prijatelja Freda da ga oženi...

programme.title: Poor people / Jadnici
programme.desc: The story takes place in France, at the beginning of the nineteenth century. Jean Waldan, a ship's worker, ended in prison due to theft of food, after 19 years he was released. Initially, he only encounters distractions and closed doors; Only Bishop Benvu is kind to him and gives him a refuge. Bishop's Christian compassion and humanity not only to reap the faith return in goodness, but slowly return it to normal life. In addition to the fake identity as Mr. Madelein, Valzan soon becomes a rich, respected citizen and mayor of the small provincial city. Happiness is leaving him again when he meets Fantina, a worker in his factory and the mother of the extramarital child, who die of hunger. The well-meaning Valzan releases the Fantina's out-of-court daughter, Kozette, from the claw of the foster family and cares about her as if her father. Valzan reveals his true identity, to save the innocent man who the police suspect and threatens him by Lifetal Robia, because he reminds himself to his character, and re-convicted of Robi. Valzan successfully flies from prison again and again under false identity continues to live a few years in Paris. Kozette, now an adult girl, will love the young lawyer Marius Pontmers, but Valzan does not allow that love because he loves her himself. Marius will find out about Valzan's criminal past and feelings heels towards Kozet and decide in order to be best to keep him as far away from her. Valzan, in the manner of his last benefactor Bishop Benv, makes the inevitable sacrifice and makes a decision to live further without Cozet. After a short time валжан / Priča se odvija u Francuskoj, na početku devetnaestog veka. Žan Valžan, brodski radnik, koji je zbog krađe hrane završio u zatvoru, posle 19 godina je pušten na slobodu. U početku, nailazi samo na nepoverenje i zatvorena vrata; jedino biskup Benvju je ljubazan prema njemu i pruža mu utočište. Biskupovo hrišćansko saosećanje i humanost ne samo da Žanu vraćaju veru u dobrotu, već ga polako vraćaju i u normalan život. Uz lažni identitet kao g.Madelein, Valžan uskoro postaje bogat, poštovan građanin i gradonačelnik malog provincijskog grada. Sreća ga ponovo napušta kad upoznaje Fantinu, radnicu u njegovoj fabrici i majka vanbračnog deteta, koja umire od gladi. Dobronamerni Valžan oslobađa Fantininu vanbračnu kćerku, Kozet, iz kandži hraniteljske porodice i brine o njoj kao da je njen otac. Valžan otkriva svoj pravi identitet, da bi spasio nevinog čoveka kog policija sumnjiči i preti mu doživotnom robijom, jer likom podseća na njega, i ponovo biva osuđen na robiju. Valžan ponovo uspešno beži iz zatvora i opet pod lažnim identitetom nastavlja živeti nekoliko godina u Parizu. Kozet, sad već odrasla devojka, zavoleće mladog pravnika Mariusa Pontmersi, ali Valžan ne dozvoljava tu ljubav zato što je i sam voli. Marius će saznati za Valžanovu kriminalnu proslost i osećaje koje gaji prema Kozet i pri tome odlučiti da bi bilo najbolje da ga drži što dalje od nje. Valžan, u maniru njegovog prošlog dobročinioca biskupa Benvju, čini neizbežno žrtvovanje i donosi odluku živeti dalje bez Kozet. Posle kratkog vremena Valžan

programme.title: A delicatessic action / Delikatesna radnja
programme.desc: The story follows the group of tenants of one building in the post-apocalyptic period. The building lives a butcher that sells the tenants of human descent specialties. As stocks are closer to the end, everyone eagerly expect the next victim. However a new tenant is someone they really didn't expect. / Priča prati grupu stanara jedne zgrade u post-apokaliptičnom periodu. U zgradi živi mesar koji stanarima prodaje specijalitete ljudskog porekla. Kako se zalihe bliže kraju, svi željno očekuju sledeću žrtvu. Međutim novi stanar je neko koga zaista nisu očekivali.

programme.title: Biro / Biro
programme.desc: Within the Foreign Security Director, the department is known as legends. It is their duty to follow your agents in secret missions where information collects. Each agent gets a false identity. The main character recently returned from Damascus in which he was six years on the mission. But contrary to the protocol, he did not resolve his false identity upon arrival and thus jeopardized the entire system. / Unutar direktorata za spoljnu bezbednost nalazi se odeljenje poznato kao Legende. Njihova dužnost je da prate svoje agente na tajnim misijama na kojima sakupljaju informacije. Svaki agent dobija lažni identitet. Glavni lik nedavno se vratio iz Damaska u kojem je bio šest godina na misiji. Ali suprotno protokolu, on se nije rešio svog lažnog identiteta po dolasku i time je ugrozio čitav sistem.

programme.title: Black river / Crna reka
programme.desc: Dani, a teenager from the Arno family, disappeared. The case was added to the Fransoi Vikonti, a tired and disappointed detective, whom the woman had just left. He searches for the missing young man, while neglecting his sixteen -year -old son, Denis, who looks twisted into drug trade. When Mr. Belaj, Deni's professor of French, finds out about the disappearance of his former student, he offers his help to a detective. / Deni, tinejdžer iz porodice Arno, je nestao. Slučaj je dodeljen Fransoi Vikontiju, umornom i razočaranom detektivu, koga je žena upravo napustila. On traga za nestalim mladićem, a istovremeno zanemaruje svog šesnaestogodišnjeg sina, Denisa, koji se izgleda upleo u trgovinu drogom. Kada gospodin Belaj, Denijev profesor francuskog jezika, sazna za nestanak svog nekadašnjeg učenika, on nudi svoju pomoć detektivu.

programme.title: The art of a crime / Umetnost zločina
programme.desc: Released due to disobedience, Antoan Verlai, a good police officer in the team, is tied to OCBC (Central Fighting Department of Cultural Dobri) thanks to the intervention of the Commander of the Pardo, his friend who becomes, therefore his new superiors. Smart as an investigator, but a stranger in all that is related to culture, Antoan will cooperate with Florence Arts, who lives and breathes in the middle of daydream, to see and talk to large artists who disappeared as if they were acquaintances. Random partners represent a great tandem and solve crimes associated with artwork. Despite numerous disagreements that this unusual couple has, much indicates that this partnership may grow into something more ... / Otpušten zbog neposlušnosti, Antoan Verlai, dobar policajac koji teško funkcioniše u timu, vezan je za OCBC (Centralno odeljenje za borbu protiv trgovine kulturnim dobrima) zahvaljujući intervenciji komandanta Pardoa, njegovog prijatelja koji postaje, dakle i njegov novi pretpostavljeni. Pametan kao istražitelj, ali stranac u svemu što je vezano za kulturu, Antoan će morati da sarađuje sa Florens Šasanj, poznatom istoričarkom umetnosti, koja živi, govori i diše kulturu, do te mere da joj se dogodi u usred sanjarenja, da kao plod njene mašte vidi i razgovara sa velikim umetnicima koji su nestali kao da su joj poznanici. Slučajni partneri predstavljaju sjajan tandem i rešavaju zločine koji su povezani sa umetničkim delima. Uprkos brojnim nesuglasicama koje ovaj neobični par ima, mnogo toga ukazuje da će ovo partnerstvo možda prerasti u nešto više...

programme.title: Intruder / Nametljivac
programme.desc: People's Louis Trebor (M. Suborge) The 68-year-old, a self-tone and a heart patient who lives in the woods near the French-Switzerland border with two dogs. He has two sons, and one of them is the young Sidney (Mr. Colin), married to the Antoinette Customs Officer (F. Loiret-Caille). Sidney and Antoinette have two children, but they are all very rarely seeing Louis, which the son considers a very difficult and mentally disordered person. The drugs seriously endangered by Louis procures a pharmacist (Bambo), with which he maintains an occasional love connection, while simultaneously trying to get closer to his neighbor, an attractive dog breeder (B. Dalle). After his enigmatic Russian smuggling organizations organizes heart transplantation in the South Korace town of Pusan, Louis from there decide to go to Tahiti, in search of his other son he had never seen. / Osobenjak Louis Trebor (M. Subor) povučeni je 68-godišnjak, samotnjak i srčani bolesnik koji s dva psa haskija živi u šumi nedaleko francusko-švajcarske granice. Ima dvojicu sinova, a jedan od njih je mladi Sidney (G. Colin), oženjen carinskom službenicom Antoinette (F. Loiret-Caille). Sidney i Antoinette imaju dvoje dece, ali svi oni vrlo retko viđaju Louisa kojeg sin smatra vrlo teškom i mentalno poremećenom osobom. Lekove za ozbiljno ugroženo srce Louisu nabavlja apotekarka (Bambou), s kojom on održava povremenu ljubavnu vezu, dok se istovremeno bezuspešno pokušava zbližiti sa svojom komšinicom, privlačnom uzgajivačicom pasa (B. Dalle). Nakon što mu zagonetna ruska švercerka organima (J. Golubeva) organizuje transplantaciju srca u južnokorejskom gradu Pusanu, Louis odande odluči krenuti na Tahiti, u potragu za svojim drugim sinom kojeg nikad nije video.

programme.title: Ejector / Izbacivač
programme.desc: After being dressed in prison, he is forced to cooperate with the police and infiltrates in the organization of a dangerous gang leader to secure his freedom and regained custody of his daughter. / Nakon što je odeveden u zatvor, prisiljen je da sarađuje sa policijom i infiltrira se u organizaciju opasnog vođe bandi kako bi osigurao svoju slobodu i povratio starateljstvo nad svojom ćerkom.

programme.desc: November 1919. years, two soldiers who survived the war, devise malversation with veterans monuments. programme.title: Level 23 / Nivo 23
programme.desc: Level 23 is one of the oldest broadcasts that are continuously broadcast on TV Studio B. The show was designed, edited by Velja Pavlović. It is a nocturnal date of relaxed chat with guests who talk about culture in an engaged way, as culture defined Slobodan Jovanović - as a term wider than politics. At the beginning, guests and the author were sitting and talked without any scenography, on the black floor, against the black background. Even when the guests were so respected personnel, such as the academician Vladet Jerotić, or the Drama Writer of Aca Popović, the conversation was conducted from the floor because then the entire program was primarily protest against Slobodan Milosevic's regime. The show never weighed a mass audience or viewing. Without pretensions towards imaginary exclusivity and elitism, the author of time and attention was paid to exceptional, and unknown personalities than the mitle from the beholder. Insisting on the courage and morality of each guest, it was assumed that the guests regularly and the opponents of the regime. The show has repeatedly removed from the program, always when the violent police administration and the editorial office is introduced in the studio. From the Fifth October 2000. Emisee was going color, with renovated, Color Spicom (original was black and white) and a modern scenery. / NIVO 23 je jedna od najstarijih emisija koja se kontinuirano emituje na TV Studio B. Emisiju je osmislio, uređuje i vodi Velja Pavlović. To je noćni kasni termin opuštenog ćaskanja sa gostima koji govore o kulturi na angažovan način, onako kako je kulturu definisao Slobodan Jovanović - kao pojam širi od politike. Na početku, gosti i autor sedeli su i razgovarali bez ikakve scenografije, na crnom podu, nasuprot crnoj pozadini. Čak i kad su gosti bile tako uvažene ličnosti kao što je akademik Vladeta Jerotić, ili dramski pisac Aca Popović, razgovor je vođen sa poda jer je tada čitav program Studija B prvenstveno bio protest protiv režima Slobodana Miloševića. Emisija nikada nije težila masovnoj publici ili gledanosti. Bez pretenzija ka umišljenoj ekskluzivnosti i elitizmu, autor je vreme i pažnju pre poklanjao izuzetnim, a nepoznatim ličnostima nego miljenicima gledalaca. Insistiranje na hrabrosti i moralu svakog gosta, pretpostavljalo je da gosti redovno bivaju i protivnici režima. Emisija je više puta skidana sa programa, uvek kada je u Studiju B uvođena nasilna policijska uprava i uredništvo. Od petog oktobra 2000. godine emisija ide u boji, sa obnovljenom, kolor špicom (originalna je bila crno-bela) i modernom scenografijom.

programme.title: Serbia works, Serbia is being built / Srbija radi, Srbija se gradi
programme.desc: The new issue called Serbia works, Serbia is built premiered on TV Studio B, every Tuesday at 15.05. With the author and leader of the show Dragan Mandić, you will visit Serbia, meet different occupations, but also different ways of life. You will see how it is lived in all parts of Serbia, where the occupations are represented, as family businesses are developed, but also how some crafts are transferred from the knee knee. Dragana will take you in a witty way, to take a course of the Ćurcian and Footwear Court, will try to culinary, beekeeping, books, writing, and many other unusual occupations. There is always work, but our interlocutors say that there must be love for what you do. Rich in natural resources, Serbia is an inexhaustible treasury, and wherever we run across a valuable craft, fruit, cattle breeding, but we had the opportunity to see some unusual occupations, which and you can give you ideas to start your own business. In the show, Serbia is working, Serbia is being built and will learn what everything is built in our country, on the mountains, but also in large cities. / Nova emisija pod nazivom Srbija radi, Srbija se gradi premijerno se prikazuje na TV Studio B, svakog utorka u 15.05 časova. Sa autorkom i voditeljkom emisije Draganom Mandić obilazićete Srbiju, upoznati različita zanimanja, ali i različite načine života. Videćete kako se živi u svim krajevima Srbije, gde su zastupljena koja zanimanja, kako se razvijaju porodični biznisi, ali i kako se neki zanati prenose s kolena na koleno. Dragana će vas na duhovit način, provesti kroz kurs ćurčijskog i obućarskog zanata, okušaće se u kulinarstvu, pčelarstvu, moleraju, knjigovezanju, duborezu, i još mnogim drugim neobičnim zanimanjima. Posla ima uvek, ali naši sagovornici kažu da mora da postoji i ljubav prema onome čime se bavite. Bogata prirodnim resursima, Srbija je nepresušna riznica, te gde god smo se zaputili naišli smo na nekog vrednog zanatliju, voćara, stočara, šnajdera, ali imali smo priliku da vidimo i neka neobična zanimanja, koja i vama mogu dati ideje da pokrenete sopstveni posao. U emisiji Srbija radi, Srbija se gradi saznaćete i šta se sve gradi u našoj zemlji, na planinama, ali i u velikim gradovima.

programme.title: Your head / Kafana
programme.desc: The cafe is part of the culture of the Balkan peoples. The place where it all begins, it is created and ends. This is where the first love is created, the unhappy end. The only place where it is celebrated, grieves, tells and silent. This is where politics, states, make political decisions, disappear differences. Everyone knows everything about everything. The topics of sports, money, love, politics, economics, conspiracy theory, life are exchanged, and they are all professional, and those with a diploma and those without it. The Talk Show of the Caper is a 20 show series, and it involves talking to guests from different social spheres in the atmosphere of a cafe. In the focus, above all, an ordinary man of an interesting life story (writers, poets, lawyers, professors, waiters, utilities, takisists, fizers, sellers, street entertainers, police officers, firefighters, athletes, singers, students, educators). The stage concept of studies, ie the atmosphere of the cafes, creates a relaxed atmosphere, the intimacy between guests and leaders, and even conversations look more natural, deviating from the standard form of Interview. A relaxed atmosphere will also contribute to an indispensable part of every cafe - music. / Kafana je dio kulture balkanskih naroda. Mjesto gdje sve počinje, nastaje i završava. Tu se stvaraju prve ljubavi, nesretne završavaju. Jedino je mjesto na kojem se slavi, tuguje, priča i šuti. Tu se vode politike, nastaju države, donose političke odluke, nestaju razlike. Tu svako sve o svemu zna. Razmjenjuju se teme od sporta, novca, ljubavi, politike, ekonomije, teorija zavjere, života i svi su stručni, i oni sa diplomom i oni bez nje. Talk show Kafana je serijal od 20 emisija, a podrazumijeva razgovor sa gostima iz različitih društvenih sfera u ambijentu kafane. U fokusu je, prije svega, običan čovjek zanimljive životne priče (pisci, pjesnici, advokati, profesori, konobari, komunalci, takisisti, fizeri, prodavači, ulični zabavljači, policajci, vatrogasci, sportisti, pjevači, učenici, vaspitači). Scenski koncept studija, tj. ambijent kafane stvara opuštenu atmosferu, prisnost između gosta i voditelja pa i razgovori izgledaju prirodnije, odstupajući od standardne forme interview-a. Opuštenoj atmosferi će doprinijeti i neizostavni dio svake kafane – muzika.

programme.title: Positive geography / Pozitivna geografija

Međutim, mladić, koji se predstavi kao Sjena, izvuče pištolj i zaprijeti svima u uredu, uključujući Trottere. Čini se kako je mladićev cilj ukrasti veliku sumu novca iz sefa supermarketa kojim upravlja vremenski mehanizam.

programme.title: Both sides of the blade / Obje Strane Oštrice
programme.desc: Sara and Jean have been in a stable relationship for ten years. They seem happy. He is her rock, someone he can rely on. When they first met Sara, Sara was in a relationship with Francois, Jean's best friend. One day Sara sees Francois on the street. He doesn't see her, but she floods her the feeling that her life could change drastically. Francois soon appears to Jean and suggests that they work together again. Things suddenly get out of control. / Sara i Jean u stabilnoj su vezi već deset godina. Čine se sretnima. On je njena stijena, neko na koga se može osloniti. Kada su se prvi put upoznali Sara je bila u vezi s Francoisom, Jeanovim najboljim prijateljem. Jednoga dana Sara vidi Francoisa na ulici. On nju ne vidi, no preplavljuje ju osjećaj da bi joj se život mogao drastično promijeniti. Francois se uskoro javlja Jeanu i predlaže mu da ponovo zajedno rade. Stvari iznenada izmiču kontroli.

programme.title: Visa for the future / Viza za budućnost
programme.desc: The Bosniak family of Husika lives in the apartment of the Serbian family Golijanin because their apartment was destroyed in the war. But the court of both families firmly under the same roof. / Bošnjačka porodica Husika živi u stanu srpske porodice Golijanin jer je njihov stan uništen u ratu. Zaplet počinje kada se porodica Golijanin odluči vratiti iz Norveške u Sarajevo. Husike ne žele iseliti dok ne dobiju novi stan. Ali sud obje porodice smiješta pod isti krov.

programme.title: In the dragon's nest / U zmajevom gnijezdu

Ono je prava adresa za učenje mnogih vještina koje nije ni sanjao da će savladati pod vašim budnim okom. Zato on ne prestaje otkrivati kakav je vaš svijet čak i kad je naglavačke naopačke!

programme.title: Heroes: Izet Nanić / Heroji: Izet Nanić
programme.desc: Few people know that Izet Nanic left the JNA and came from Kragujevac to his native Buzim. His father, the father of seven sons of Nanic, was against Izet's takeover of the command, but after the death of his brother Nevzet Nanic, Izet decided to take on all that was possible. The fighters then the 105th Brigade's formation stood by their leader. For this man, a strategist, fighter and elder, they say that he did not know how to swear, and that he was his: I am surprised at you, it was the highlight of the warning. The lines he established at the very beginning at the border with the Republic of Croatia were left untouched by the end of the war. The way of action of his units was recognizable throughout the country because of the way he used combat morality, surprise factors and knowledge of the field. Because of Nanic's influence on his Buzim knight, Buzim became synonymous with victory. It is a rarity to hear the story of a man whose soldiers break through hostile territory with five bullets each, and even more rarely is the concept of imaginative to go to the military leader as he went to Izet Nanic and all his actions, many until August 1995 when Nanic commander was killed by a bullet from an enemy's ambush. / Malo ko zna kako je Izet Nanić je napustio JNA i iz Kragujevca došao u svoj rodni Bužim. Njegov otac, otac sedam sinova Nanića, bio je protiv Izetovog preuzimanja komande, ali nakon smrti njegovog brata Nevzeta Nanića, Izet je odlučio da preuzme na sebe sve što je bilo moguće. Borci tad već oformljenje 105. brigade stajali su uz svog vođu. Za ovog čovjeka, stratega, borca i starješinu kažu da nije znao psovati, a da je njegovo: Čudim se ja tebi, bilo vrhunac opomene. Linije koje je on u samom početku uspostavio na granici sa Repubikom Hrvatskom do kraja rata su ostale netaknute. Način djelovanja njegovih jedinica je bio prepoznatljiv u cijeloj zemlji i to zbog načina na koji je koristio borbeni moral, faktore iznenađenja i poznavanje terena. Zbog Nanićevog uticaja na njegove bužimske vitezove Bužim je postao sinonim za pobjedu. Rijetkost je čuti priču o čovjeku čiji vojnici probijaju neprijateljsku teritoriju sa po pet metaka u cijevi, a još je veća rijetkost da pojam maštovit ide uz vojskovođu kao što je išao u Izeta Nanića i sve njegove akcije kojih je bilo mnogo do augusta 1995. kada je komandant Nanić ubijen metkom iz neprijateljske zasjede.

These are information according to official meteorological data. / Pratite informacije o najnovijim vremenskim uslovima i prognozu za određeno područje grada, države, kontinenta ili celog sveta za narednih nekoliko dana. Ovo su informacije prema zvaničnim meteorološkim podacima.

programme.title: With a culture on you / Sa kulturom na ti
programme.desc: Learn all about cultural events, manifestations, but also the institutions of culture dealing with the preservation of national and cultural identity. / Saznajte sve o kulturnim dešavanjima, manifestacijama ali i ustanovama kulture koje se bave očuvanjem nacionalnog i kulturnog identiteta.

programme.title: Strong woman a strong village / Jaka žena jako selo
programme.desc: The aim of this project is to improve the position of women in rural areas, which are not only creative and innovative, but also ready to put their energy and knowledge in the function of own entrepreneurship and economic empowerment. / Cilj ovog projekta je poboljšanje položaja žena u seoskim sredinama, koje su ne samo kreativne i inovativne, već i spremne da svoju energiju i znanje stave u funkciju sopstvenog preduzetništva i ekonomskog osnaživanja.

programme.title: Vojvodina Business / Vojvođanski biznis
programme.desc: As a guide through the world of economics and business, this magazine contains an overview of economic events in Vojvodina, with an emphasis on the possibilities for the development of small and medium enterprises. / Kao vodič kroz svet ekonomije i biznisa, ovaj magazin sadrži pregled ekonomskih dešavanja u Vojvodini, sa akcentom na mogućnostima za razvoj malih i srednjih preduzeća.

programme.title: Mitrovic stories / Mitrovačke priče
programme.desc: Every weekday, watch the show of the Mitrovica story. Through the author's show Biljana Selaković, we present you Mitrovica artists, young talents, interesting people of the city on Sava. We promote cultural, tourist, sports events. One word, the media image of the city on the Sava are afraid of clear colors. / Svakim radnim danom gledajte emisiju Mitrovačke priče. Kroz autorsku emisiju Biljane Selaković predstavljamo vam mitrovačke umetnike, mlade talente, zanimljive ljude grada na Savi. Promovišemo kulturna, turistička, sportska događanja. Jednom rečju, medijsku sliku grada na Savi bojimo vedrim bojama.

programme.title: Vojvodina events / Vojvođanska događanja
programme.desc: In this broadcasting issue, you can find out all the latest information and news from the entire Vojvodina. All news that could be interested in Vojvodina, in one place. / U ovoj emisiji informativnog karaktera možete saznati sve najnovije informacije i aktuelnosti iz čitave Vojvodine. Sve vesti koje bi mogle zanimati Vojvođane, na jednom mestu.

programme.title: 45 minutes in Srem / 45 minuta u Sremu
programme.desc: Latest news, information and events from Srem. We bring you all the actualities from this area. / Najnovije vesti, informacije i dešavanja iz Srema. Donosimo vam sve aktuelnosti sa ovog područja.

programme.title: Marketing / Marketing
programme.desc: Take a break a few minutes with our marketing block! Learn news about various products, services or some completely new ideas through our marketing program. / Predahnite nekoliko minuta uz naš marketing blok! Saznajte novosti o raznim proizvodima, uslugama ili nekim sasvim novim idejama putem našeg marketing programa.

programme.title: People and events / Ljudi i događaji
programme.desc: This show has an informative-educational character, and the goal of her to remind us through time which people and events marked a certain date. / Ova emisija ima informativno-edukativni karakter, a cilj joj da nas putujući kroz vreme podseti koji su ljudi i događaji obeležili određeni datum.

programme.title: Horoscope / Horoskop
programme.desc: Find out what the stars predict for us for the next period, what to expect when it comes to love, work and health. Follow what stars warn your zodiac sign, adopt a useful advice or just just have fun. / Saznajte šta nam zvezde predviđaju za naredni period, šta da očekujemo kada su u pitanju ljubav, posao i zdravlje. Pratite na šta zvezde upozoravaju Vaš horoskopski znak, usvojite koristan savet ili se prosto samo zabavite.

programme.title: Travel with us / Putujte sa nama
programme.desc: Go with us at a variety of places in the world! We take a picture to the most beautiful landscapes and the most interesting cities on the planet. Let's meet the customs, culture, architecture and other sights of many destinations. / Pođite sa nama na najrazličitija mesta na svetu! Slikom vas vodimo u najlepše predele i u najzanimljivije gradove na planeti. Upoznajmo zajedno običaje, kulturu, arhitekturu i druge znamenitosti mnogih destinacija.

programme.title: Grain of life / Zrno života
programme.desc: See the emission of a grain of life intended for farmers, as well as all those who like to keep up to date with all the news related to this area. / Pogledajte emisiju Zrno života namenjenu poljoprivrednicima, kao i svima onima koji vole da budu u toku sa svim vestima vezanim za ovu oblast.

programme.title: B.B. show / B.B. show

He also launched numerous characters and characters who have laughed children and adults. 7000 jokes were recorded, without political and sex connotations. / BB Show je najdugotrajnija humoristička tv serija na prostorima bivše Jugoslavije. Koncipirana je kao red skeč viceva, red duhovitih muzičkih spotova. Lansirala je i mnogobrojne likove i karaktere koji su zasmejavali decu i odrasle godinama. Snimljeno je 7000 viceva, bez političkih i seksualnih konotacija.

programme.title: Face, before / Alo, alo
programme.desc: Rene Arto (Gorden Kay) is the owner of the cafe in the occupied French town of Navular at the time of the Second World War. It is between two fire: seemingly cooperates with the Nazis and in fact it is actually helped by the movement of resistance. German colonel) is in good relations with Rene but uses coffee to hide the stolen image, which plans to sell after the war. Unfortunately Hitler also wants a picture and sent by Gestapovaca Oto Flica (Richard Gibson) to find it. And on the other hand, the resistance movement, which led by Michelle (Kirsten Kuk) near Renea hides British aircraft. In the middle of all these confusion, Rene Mora and hides the affair with the waitresses from his wife Edit (Carmen Silver). / Rene Artoa (Gorden Kej) je vlasnik kafea u okupiranom francuskom gradiću Nuvionu u vreme Drugog svetskog rata. On se nalazi između dve vatre: naizgled sarađuje sa nacistima a u stvari potajno pomaže Pokretu otpora.Nemački pukovnik Von Strom (Ričard Marner) je u dobrim odnosima sa Reneom ali koristi kafe da sakrije ukradenu sliku, koju planira da proda posle rata. Nažalost Hitler takođe želi sliku i poslao je gestapovca Oto Flika (Ričard Gibson) da je pronađe. A sa druge strane Pokret otpora, koji predvodi Mišel (Kirsten Kuk) kod Renea krije britanske vazduhoplovce. U sred sve te zbrke Rene mora i da skriva afere sa konobaricama od svoje žene Edit (Karmen Silvera).

programme.title: Black Guja / Crna Guja
programme.desc: He is an egoist. He is selfish. He is evil. He is all what a normal man would be ashamed of. From what and how he eats and drinks, through what he excuses and thinks, to what he plans and turns into a conspiracy, he is a broken, self-sufficient, authoritarian, a hedonistic creature that is the right definition of everything that can describe man. But he can also be funny, fun, and even charming. His tricks are not ordinary, his plans are complicated and creative, his words sometimes so witty, and once you get into his head, you will realize that everything is just not boring and usually. Maybe because of all that, the Black Guja did not end up on a guidelty of history, but became an unusually witty reminder of what we are sometimes or the warning of what we should not be. The black man is a little distorted and a little dirty, but still the mirror of the human race. / On je egoista. On je sebičan. On je zao. On je sve ono čega bi se normalan čovek stideo. Od toga šta i kako jede i pije, preko onoga što izgovori i pomisli, do onoga što planira i pretvori u zaveru, on je jedan pokvareni, samoživi, autoritarni, hedonistički stvor koji je prava definicija svega lošeg što može da opiše čoveka. Ali on ume da bude i smešan, zabavan, pa čak i šarmantan. programme.title: Novice / Novajlije
programme.desc: New Fun - The Humorist Program of Novi is a project on which the Production Happy TV has long and carefully worked, with the desire to enemy hot summer days and to process the competition team as from fairy. In the newcomers, 17 young and valuable participants will be presented for the dream reward ... although many of their fantastic award see in banknotes, a team that bidges in the newcomers fight for dreams! What adorns competitors in newcomers is definitely youth, wit and ambitiousness that has in excess. Everyone has a clear goal in front of them and confidently rushes to fulfilling each task. They will face new tasks, challenges and with countless ways to prevent obstacles on the road to the stars every week. Through interesting tasks, they will employ their creativity, dexterity, persuasiveness, but also vispreciation, and courage to choose from shortcuts and petty cheats or honest and complete endeavors to work from dreams. Newcomers are not a classic competition, through this format, we are fighting our favorites, to fight bravely to achieve public and most intimate dreams, but also attend to conflicts, rivals and tests for tolerance, patience and readiness to teamwork. Who will go out of the reality show as a friend, and who will be ready for gossip and ignorance? / Novi zabavno - humoristički program Novajlije je projekat na kome je produkcija Happy TV dugo i brižno radila, sa željom da gleadocima ulepša vrele letnje dane i da na najbolji mogući način obraduje takmičarsku ekipu nagradom kao iz bajke! U Novajlijama će se predstaviti 17 mladih i vrednih učesnika koji će se takmičiti za nagradu iz snova...Iako mnogi svoju fantastičnu nagradu vide u novčanicama, ekipa koja se nadmeće u Novajlijama bori se za POSAO iz snova! Ono što krasi takmičare u Novajlijama jeste svakako mladost, pamet i ambicioznost koje ima na pretek. Svako ima jasan cilj pred sobom i samouvereno hrli ka ispunjenju svakog zadatka. Oni će se svake nedelje suočavati sa novim zadacima, izazovima i sa bezbroj načina na koje mogu da prenebregnu prepreke na putu ka zvezdama. Kroz zanimljive zadatke, oni će svakodnevno upošljavati svoju kreativnost, spretnost, ubedljivost, ali i visprenost i smelost kojom će se opredeliti za prečice i sitne varke ili poštene i kompletne poduhvate kojima će doći do posla iz snova. Novajlije nisu klasičan konkurs, kroz ovaj format bodrimo svoje favorite, pratimo kako se hrabro bore za ostvarenje javnih i najintimnijih snova, ali i prisustvujemo sukobima, rivalstvima i smicalicama koje predstavljaju svojevrstan podvig i test na toleranciju, strpljenje i spremnost na timski rad. Ko će iz reality show-a izaći kao prijatelj, a ko će biti spreman na ogovaranja i ignorisanja?

programme.title: In someone else's courtyard with osmani jich / U tuđoj avliji s Osmanom Džihom
programme.desc: The show in Tudjoj Avlija was launched before the aim of pointing out to her viewers to one simple fact: BiH gives birth to successful people we successfully drive away from the country to be successful in foreign countries, to pay taxes and contributions to employ Germans, Austrians, Swiss ... After we successfully expelled them from the country and after they became successful in the foreign country, allows you to invest money in their homeland. Why did our country become an obstacle, not a solution to its citizens? Why doesn't our country want to return and successful? Why are there no institutions in BiH that will bring together our successful entrepreneurs and experts in the diaspora and offer them to be a service to start the same jobs and employ our people? Why is there no institution in BiH that will bring together our successful entrepreneurs and experts in the diaspora and offer them to be a service to start jobs here and to employ our people ?? Because realistically, there is a danger of being left without a diaspora. This show is a kind of appeal to the authorities in BiH to answer the questions asked. / Emisija U tuđoj avliji je pokrenuta prije s ciljem da bi se njenim gledaocima ukazalo na jednu prostu činjenicu: BiH rađa uspješne ljude koje mi uspješno otjeramo iz države da budu uspješni u stranim zemljama, da tamo plaćaju poreze i doprinose, da tamo zapošljavaju Nijemce, Austrijance, Švicarce... Nakon što smo ih uspješno protjerali iz zemlje i nakon što su postali uspješni u tuđim zemljama, BiH uspješno ne dozvoljava da ulože novac u svojoj domovini. Zašto je naša zemlja postala prepreka, a ne rješenje svojim građanima? Zašto naša zemlja ne želi da se sposobni i uspješni vrate? Zašto u BiH ne postoje institucije koje će okupiti naše uspješne poduzetnike i stručnjaje iz dijaspore i ponude im da budu servis da isti pokrenu u njoj poslove i zaposle naše ljude? Zašto ne postoji institucija u BiH koja će okupiti naše uspješne poduzetnike i stručnjake u dijaspori i ponuditi im da bude servis da pokrenu poslove ovdje i da zaposle naše ljude?? Jer realno, postoji opasnost da ostanemo i bez dijaspore. Ova emisija svojevrstan je apel vlastima u BiH da odgovore na postavljena pitanja.

programme.title: Cases x / Slučajevi X
programme.desc: Emission Cases X, which is broadcast on Sundays in 22 hours in the Hayat TV program, is one of the most watched in BiH, and is recognizable outside the borders of our homeland. This specialist show treats the dark side of life in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the region. Where the police go with rotations inflamed, cases x come with a camera. Cases x are a specific TV show format and the first crime magazine in our country. From the first show, he turns a lot of attention to the viewers with almost every new episode. And it has been going on for years, since 2007, which confirms the shelf of the show, but also Million's inspections on YouTube. The primary target of the show is that in young people does not encourage the desire to go to a stranger, ie through crime, to understand that crime is not a model of behavior that is socially acceptable. Over time, due to social contribution, cases X have become multiple award-winning emissions. There is almost no Police Agency or Administration in BiH, which, due to the above, did not advance special recognitions and thanks. / Emisija Slučajevi X, koja se nedjeljom u 22 sata emitira u programu Hayat TV-a, jedna je od najgledanijih u BiH, a prepoznatljiva je i van granica naše domovine. Ova specijalistička emisija tretira tamnu stranu života u Bosni i Hercegovini i regionu. Tamo gdje policija ide s upaljenim rotacijama, Slučajevi X dolaze s kamerom. Slučajevi X su specifičan format TV-emisije i prvi kriminalistički magazin u našoj zemlji. Od prve emisije skreće veliku pažnju gledalaca gotovo svakom novom epizodom. I to traje već godinama, od 2007, što potvrđuje gledanost emisije, ali i milionski pregledi na Youtubeu. Primarni cilj emisije jeste da u mladima ne podstiče želju da idu stranputicom, odnosno putem kriminala, da shvate da kriminal nije model ponašanja koji je društveno prihvatljiv. Vremenom, zbog društvenog doprinosa, Slučajevi X su postali višestruko nagrađivana emisija. Gotovo da nema policijske agencije ili uprave u BiH koja, zbog navedenog, nije Slučajevima X javno dodijelila specijalna priznanja i zahvalnice.

Ertan uništava snimak koji je dokaz Orhunove nevinosti. Nakon što je Orhun osuđen na zatvor, Afife odlučuje Hiru učiniti zarobljenom.

programme.title: Summer kitchen / Ljetna kuhinja
programme.desc: The life of a BiH man from a person's perspective. The one who creates, lives and survives. The one who fights for a better tomorrow, relying only on himself, his country and hands. And despite everything, he remains smiling, ready to host, welcome and serve his soul just like the most delicious bite. In search of valuable BiH people, we travel to Bosnia and Herzegovina, we live the life of a BiH man, dignified and humble. With all the adversity, obstacles and the weight of reality, hard and hard work ... Man is smiling! / Život bh. čovjeka iz perspektive čovjeka. Onog koji stvara, živi i preživljava. Onog koji se bori za bolje sutra, oslanjajući se samo na sebe, svoju zemlju i ruke. I uprkos svemu, ostaje nasmijan, spreman da ugosti, dočeka i servira dušu baš kao najukusniji zalogaj. U potrazi za vrijednim bh. ljudima, putujemo Bosnom i Hercegovinom, živimo život bh. čovjeka, dostojanstven i ponizan. Uz sve nedaće, prepreke i težinu stvarnosti, težak i naporan rad... čovjek je nasmijan!

programme.title: Do you cook the darkness / Kuhate li mrnjao
programme.desc: Do you cook hate? The story is that the cats of the stripes and alien cats are telling us. Together they prepare simple and healthy meals that children can prepare alone - recipes do not contain cutting, frying, cooking and other potentially dangerous actions where children can be violated. / KUHATE LI MRNJAO? priča je koju nam pričaju mačak Pruga i vanzemaljski mačak Okac. Zajedno pripremaju jednostavne i zdrave obroke koja djeca mogu da pripreme sama - recepti ne sadrže sječenje, prženje, kuhanje i druge potencijalno opasne radnje u kojima djeca mogu da se povrijede.

programme.title: Hayatovci / Hayatovci
programme.desc: This is a show with which they grew up generations of little ones. Hayatovac, Lela, Lilo, but also Lina Raspberry and Dodas lead you to the exciting world of Hayatovac, a lot of knowledge, fun, great guests, in a favorite children's EMIS EVERYONE - Hayatovs! / Ovo je emisija uz koju su odrastale generacije mališana. Hayatovac, Lela, Lilo, ali i Lina Malina i Dodi vode vas u uzbudljivi svijet Hayatovaca, Mnogo spoznaja, zabave, super gostiju, u omiljenoj dječijoj emisji ikada - HAYATOVCI!

programme.title: My pet / Moj ljubimac
programme.desc: My pet is an emission of an educational entertainment character and wants to present pets as equal family members, and educate the owners of the proper posture and care of animals. The interlocutors are veterinarians, gromers, dog trainers, psychologists and other experts related to animals / Moj ljubimac je emisija edukativno zabavnog karaktera i želi predstaviti ljubimce kao ravnopravne članove porodice, te educirati vlasnike o pravilnom držanju i njezi životinja. Sagovornici su veterinari, groomeri, treneri pasa, psiholozi i ostali experti vezani uz životinje

programme.title: Children's hits / Dječiji hitovi
programme.desc: Enjoy music tracks, intended for the youngest viewers, numerous bh. Author. / Uživajte u muzičkim numerama, namjenjenim najmlađim gledateljima, brojnih bh. autora.

programme.title: An ant / Mravko Travko
programme.desc: The story of one of the favorite characters of the toddler in BiH Ant Travka is also translated into a series. After Mravko Travko revived from picture books and sang children's rhymes, he has now decided to entertain children otherwise, but also teach them many useful things. / Priča jednog od omiljenih likova mališana u BiH Mravka Travka pretočena je i u seriju. Nakon što je Mravko Travko oživio iz slikovnica i zapjevao dječije pjesmice, sada je odlučio da djecu zabavi i na drugi način, ali i nauči ih mnogim korisnim stvarima.

programme.title: Children's hits / Dječiji hitovi
programme.desc: Enjoy music tracks, intended for the youngest viewers, numerous bh. Author. / Uživajte u muzičkim numerama, namjenjenim najmlađim gledateljima, brojnih bh. autora.

programme.title: From the team / Z Ekipa
programme.desc: Z city is the only city in the world in which nature and technology are intertwined. The city owes this title with a renewable, secure energy source called the element. Thanks to the element, people live technologically and comfortable life. However, a man named Mr. B, who lives in the high tower on the edge of the city, wants z element. However, this will not be easy, because three children in the city, Arda, Ela and Efa, formed a team called the team and will try to disrupt these plans. / Z City je jedini grad na svijetu u kojem su priroda i tehnologija isprepletene. Grad duguje ovu titulu obnovljivom, sigurnom izvoru energije zvanom Z element. Zahvaljujući Z elementu, ljudi žive tehnološki i udoban život. Međutim, čovjek po imenu gospodin B, koji živi u visokoj kuli na rubu grada, želi Z element. Međutim, to neće biti lako, jer su troje djece u gradu, Arda, Ela i Efe, formirali tim koji zovu Z ekipa i pokušat će da poremete ove planove.

programme.title: Pyril / Piril
programme.desc: Animated series Piril aims to present a variety of academic occupations in a funny academic occupation. programme.title: From the team / Z Ekipa
programme.desc: Z city is the only city in the world in which nature and technology are intertwined. The city owes this title with a renewable, secure energy source called the element. Thanks to the element, people live technologically and comfortable life. However, a man named Mr. B, who lives in the high tower on the edge of the city, wants z element. However, this will not be easy, because three children in the city, Arda, Ela and Efa, formed a team called the team and will try to disrupt these plans. / Z City je jedini grad na svijetu u kojem su priroda i tehnologija isprepletene. Grad duguje ovu titulu obnovljivom, sigurnom izvoru energije zvanom Z element. Zahvaljujući Z elementu, ljudi žive tehnološki i udoban život. Međutim, čovjek po imenu gospodin B, koji živi u visokoj kuli na rubu grada, želi Z element. Međutim, to neće biti lako, jer su troje djece u gradu, Arda, Ela i Efe, formirali tim koji zovu Z ekipa i pokušat će da poremete ove planove.

programme.title: All that glamor of henna / Sav taj glamur Kana
programme.desc: All that glamor of the Cannes is a story that requires it to be told. The film enjoys glamor, red carpets, movies, folly, vratolomies, businesses, parties and personalities that are installed in the show-business every year every year in the French Riviera. It offers an exciting adrenal experience of what the festival represented over the years and what could offer in the future. We get the director of the FESTIVA Festival, the regular canning visitors to Tilde Svinton, Sajdo, Mike, Mike, Sean Baker, Ken Louč, and Vim Venders, and the team that includes producers, journalists, photographers, Director, program editors of the festival, fashion designers, organizers of the hotel and hotel managers. / Sav taj glamur Kana priča je koja zahteva da bude ispričana. Film uživa u glamuru, crvenim tepisima, filmovima, ludostima, vratolomijama, poslovima, zabavama i ličnostima koje se svake godine dve nedelje na francuskoj rivijeri ugrađuju u šou-biznis. Nudi uzbudljivo adrenalinsko iskustvo onoga što je festival predstavljao tokom godina i šta bi mogao da ponudi u budućnosti. Dobijamo uvid direktora festivala Tieri Fremoa, redovnih kanskih posetilaca Tilde Svinton, Žilijet Binoš i Lea Sejdu, filmskih stvaralaca kao što su Oliver Stoun, Lin Remzi, Majk Li, Kventin Tarantino, Šon Bejker, Ken Louč i Vim Venders, i ekipe koja uključuje producente, novinare, fotografe, direktore, programske urednike festivala, modne dizajnere, organizatore žurki i menadžere hotela.

programme.title: Spajdermen: Return home / Spajdermen: Povratak kući
programme.desc: Excited for experience with revenge, Piter returns home, where he lives with his aunt Mej, under the watchful eye of a new mentor, Toni Stark, and tries to return to everyday routine. But a new villain appears ... / Uzbuđen zbog iskustva sa Osvetnicima, Piter se vraća kući, gde živi s tetkom Mej, pod budnim okom novog mentora, Tonija Starka, i pokušava da se vrati svakodnevnoj rutini. Ali pojavljuje se novi zlikovac...

programme.title: Kung-Fu Panda: The Secret of Fierce Five / Kung-fu panda: Tajna žestoke petorke
programme.desc: Attention! Poov biggest challenge so far. Maybe that Lunga won, but our Dragon's warrior must face the Šifu's greatest challenge with the help of a snake, a tiger, monkey, crane and bogoms. The secrets of fierce five people are finally exasperated because we discover that it takes much more than fast feet and swivels to become a Kung Fu. / Pažnja! Poov najveći izazov dosad. Možda je pobedio Taj Lunga, ali naš Zmajev ratnik sad mora da se suoči sa Šifuovim najvećim izazovom uz pomoć Zmije, Tigrice, Majmuna, Ždrala i Bogomoljke. Tajne Žestoke petorke su konačno raskrinkane jer otkrivamo da je potrebno mnogo više od brzih stopala i okretnih ruku da biste postali majstor kung fua.

programme.title: Hollywood on shooting / Holivud na snimanju
programme.desc: The latest cinema premiere, the largest film stars, insight into what awaits us. Every week the latest news from a large screen. All that and much more in movies and stars. / Najnovije bioskopske premijere, najveće filmske zvezde, uvid u ono što nas očekuje. Svake nedelje najnovije vesti sa velikog ekrana. Sve to i mnogo više u Filmovima i zvezdama.

programme.title: Adventures Tintin: The secret of a unicorn / Avanture Tintina: Tajna jednoroga
programme.desc: In an attempt to discover the secret of a sunken ship that may be hiding a huge treasure - but the ancient curse - Tintin and his faithful dog snow moving on a journey around the world charged with action and adventures. / U pokušaju da otkriju tajnu potonulog broda koji možda krije ogromno blago - ali i drevno prokletstvo - Tintin i njegov verni pas Sneško kreću na putovanje oko celog sveta nabijeno akcijom i avanturama.

programme.title: My ingenious friend / Moja genijalna prijateljica
programme.desc: Elena's marriage is in crisis. PieTRO alienated and treated as a maid. The situation in the home further complicates the presence of Nin, which is a common guest in the house of Airota. / Elenin brak je u krizi. Pijetro se otuđio i tretira je kao sluškinju. Situaciju u domu dodatno komplikuje prisustvo Nina koji je čest gost u kući Airota.

programme.title: Transformers: Wake up of the beast / Transformersi: Buđenje zveri
programme.desc: Returning to the action and spectacle he won the viewers around the world 14 years ago with original transformers, Transformers: Waking the beasts increases the maximums, strangers and terrorcons in the current battle between Autobota and the desepticon. / Vrativši se akciji i spektaklu koji je osvojio gledaoce širom sveta pre 14 godina sa originalnim Transformersima, Transformersi: Buđenje zveri uvešće Maksimale, Predakone i Terorkone u trenutnu bitku na zemlji između Autobota i Deseptikona.

programme.title: Venom / Venom
programme.desc: The EDI Brok (Tom Hardi) planner to return to work after the scandal, but accidentally becomes hosted by an alien symbiot who gives it violent alteres, vein, and amazing superpower. / Istraživački novinar Edi Brok (Tom Hardi) planira da se vrati na posao nakon skandala, ali slučajno postane domaćin vanzemaljskog simbiota koji mu daje nasilan alter-ego, Venom, i neverovatne supermoći.

programme.title: Venom 2 / Venom 2
programme.desc: Edi Brok is still struggling to coexist with alien vein that changes the shape. When and the disturbed serial killer KLETUS Kasadi becomes hosted with an alien symbiote, Brok and Venoma team up in an attempt to stop him. / Edi Brok se još bori da koegzistira s vanzemaljskim Venomom koji menja oblik. Kad i poremećeni serijski ubica Kletus Kasadi postane domaćin vanzemaljskom simbiotu, Brok i Venom se udružuju u pokušaju da ga zaustave.​

programme.title: Hell Streets 10 / Paklene ulice 10
programme.desc: In the tenth part of the Saga Pakleni street, the home of Toreto and his family are on the target of the deadest opponent with which they have ever faced. When the powerful Dante Reyes (Jason Momo) comes out of the shadows of the past to revenge the father, he makes chaos unprecedented, and his only goal is to destroy Toreta and his family. Using their pilot skills on cars, motorcycles, planes - and even submarines - home and its allies will make everything, it will even defy the laws of physics, to protect their loved ones. / U desetom delu sage Paklene ulice, Dom Toreto i njegova porodica nalaze se na meti najsmrtonosnijeg protivnika s kojim su se ikad suočili. Kad moćni Dante Rejes (Džejson Momoa) izađe iz senki prošlosti da bi osvetio oca, on pravi haos bez presedana, a jedini cilj mu je da uništi Toreta i njegovu porodicu. Koristeći svoje pilotske veštine na automobilima, motociklima, avionima - pa čak i podmornicama - Dom i njegovi saveznici učiniće sve, čak će prkositi zakonima fizike, da zaštite svoje najmilije.

programme.title: Godzila x Kong: New Empire / Godzila x Kong: Novo carstvo
programme.desc: In this new chapter, we follow the Almighty Kong while traveling into the undiscovered layer of Holou Ert to find your family. But what reveals brings the most dangerous threat so far. It can oppose that threat - and maybe he is also victory - only if he associates the forces of congers and godzille, which are more advanced than ever. This is never a better Titan team! / U ovom novom poglavlju pratimo svemogućeg Konga dok putuje u neotkriveni sloj Holou Erta kako bi pronašao svoju porodicu. Ali ono što otkrije donosi najopasniju pretnju do sada. Toj pretnji može da se suprotstavi ― a možda je i pobedi ― samo ako se udruže snage Konga i Godzile, koji su napredniji nego ikad. Ovo je nikad bolji tim Titana!

programme.title: Either ... in Hollywood / Bilo jednom... u Holivudu
programme.desc: Anyone ... in Hollywood Quentina Taranta took place in 1969. in Los Angeles, where he was changing, and Television Star Rick Dalton (Lonard Pit) are trying to succeed in the industry that they can barely recognize. The ninth film of this scenarist / director adorns an extraordinary acting setup, and follows several intertwined stories dedicated to the last moments of the Golden Age Hollywood. / Bilo jednom... u Holivudu Kventina Tarantina odvija se 1969. godine u Los Anđelesu, gde se sve menja, a televizijska zvezda Rik Dalton (Leonardo Dikaprio) i njegov dugogodišnji dubler i kaskaser Klif But (Bred Pit) pokušavaju da uspeju u industriji koju jedva mogu da prepoznaju. With the help of his idiotic fictional friend, Adolf Hitler (Taika Vaititi), Jojo is facing blinding nationalism. / Scenarista i reditelj Taika Vaititi (Tor: Ragnarok) prožima svojim prepoznatljivim humorom i stilom svoj poslednji film, Jojo Rabbit, satiru o Drugom svetskom ratu koja prati nemačkog dečaka (Roman Grifin Dejvis) čiji pogled na svet se radikalno menja kada otkrije da njegova samohrana majka (Skarlet Džohanson) krije jevrejsku devojčicu (Tomasin Mekenzi) na tavanu. Uz pomoć svog idiotskog izmišljenog prijatelja, Adolfa Hitlera (Taika Vaititi), Jojo se suočava sa zaslepljujućim nacionalizmom.

programme.title: It ends with us / Sa nama se završava
programme.desc: The first Roman Colin Hover adapted for a large canvas brings a convincing story about Lili Blum, a woman who has overcome a traumatic childhood and started a new life in Boston, following a long-standing dream to start his job. Meeting with a charming neurosurgery Rajl Kinkeid launches a strong relationship, but while love is developing, Lili slowly recognizes the rice of the parties that remind the relationship of her parents. When Lilina suddenly appears suddenly, her relationship with the Riley shakes and Lily realizes that he has to learn to rely on himself to bring an impossible choice for his future. / Prvi roman Kolin Huver adaptiran za veliko platno donosi uverljivu priču o Lili Blum, ženi koja je prevazišla traumatično detinjstvo i započela novi život u Bostonu, prateći dugogodišnji san da pokrene svoj posao. Susret sa šarmantnim neurohirurgom Rajlom Kinkejdom pokreće snažnu vezu, ali dok se ljubav razvija, Lili polako prepoznaje Rajlove strane koje podsećaju na odnos njenih roditelja. Kad se Lilina prva ljubav iznenada pojavi, njen odnos sa Rajlom se poljulja i Lili shvata da mora da nauči da se oslanja na sebe da bi donela nemoguć izbor za svoju budućnost.

programme.title: Saturdays in the evening / Subotom uveče
programme.desc: At 11:30, 11. October 1975. year, the bright troop of young comedges and writers forever changed television - and culture. Djason Rightman directed, with the screenwriter, Kenan and Rightman, is based on a true story on Saturdays about what was happening behind the scenes for 90 minutes before the first broadcast on Saturdays in the evening. Full humor, chaos and the magic of the revolution that almost does not happen, we count down minutes in real time until we hear those famous words ... / U 23:30, 11. oktobra 1975. godine, svirepa trupa mladih komičara i pisaca zauvek je promenila televiziju - i kulturu. U režiji Džejsona Rajtmana, sa scenaristima Žilom Kenanom i Rajtmanom, Subotom uveče je zasnovana na istinitoj priči o tome šta se dešavalo iza kulisa tokom 90 minuta pre prvog emitovanja Subotom uveče uživo. Puni humora, haosa i magije revolucije koja zamalo da se ne desi, odbrojavamo minute u realnom vremenu dok ne začujemo te čuvene reči...

programme.title: Driver / Vozač
programme.desc: Young escape driver from crime rely on the rhythm of music in order to be the best in their job. But since he is forced to work for the chief of the mafia, he must face music when the failed robbery threatens to jeopardize his life, love and freedom. / Mladi vozač za bekstvo s mesta zločina oslanja se na ritam muzike kako bi bio najbolji u svom poslu. Ali pošto je primoran da radi za šefa mafije, mora da se suoči s muzikom kad neuspela pljačka preti da mu ugrozi život, ljubav i slobodu.

programme.title: River souls / Reka duša
programme.desc: Miki makes a big mistake in the hunt on the killer, but the family helps to solve this problem. The great calculation unites the neighborhood, but it becomes deadly. / Miki pravi veliku grešku u lovu na ubicu, ali porodica pomaže da se taj problem reši. Veliki obračun ujedinjuje komšiluk, ali postaje smrtonosan.

programme.title: The city belongs to us / Grad pripada nama
programme.desc: Michael and Diana try to get a baby while his criminal empire threatens betrayal from within. / Majkl i Dajana pokušavaju da dobiju bebu dok njegovom kriminalnom carstvu preti izdaja iznutra.

programme.title: Just bring him / Samo ga dovedi
programme.desc: Aaron Green ends up jobs. The ambitious summering year old received a task that would bring him great career progress. His mission: fly in London and bring the world legend of Rokenrol in the world-famous Greek theater in Los Angeles on a large return concert. The chief of the discographic house where Aron works warns him: This musician is the worst person in the world. You will be in danger if you turn your back. British rocker Oldus Snow is a brilliant musician, but because of the tragic termination and a failed career, he came out of the game and is now a wreck of man. Tired of the obedient and scared to enter the zone of the dusk of the greatest hits in his career, Snow ran into a nihilistic vortex that pulls him to the bottom. When he finds out that his true love, Manekenka / pop star Jeek Kju, Oldus decides to win it ... just before he returns to the scene as the best musician in the world. While the concert time is approaching, one innocent, young man must pass a MINISH field of London drug dealers, crazy / Aron Grin završava poslove. Ambiciozni dvedesetčetvorogodišnjak dobio je zadatak koji će mu doneti veliki napredak u karijeri. Njegova misija: Odleti u London i dovedi svetsku legendu rokenrola u svetski poznat Grčki teatar u Los Anđelesu na veliki koncert povratka. Šef diskografske kuće u kojoj Aron radi ga upozorava: Ovaj muzičar je najgora osoba na svetu. Bićeš u opasnosti ako mu okreneš leđa. Britanski roker Oldus Snou je briljantan muzičar, ali zbog tragičnog raskida i propale karijere, izašao je iz igre i sada je olupina od čoveka. Umoran od poslušnika i uplašen da ulazi u zonu sumraka najvećih hitova u karijeri, Snou je uleteo u nihilistički vrtlog koji ga vuče na dno. Kada sazna da je njegova prava ljubav, manekenka/pop zvezda Džeki Kju, u Los Anđelesu, Oldus odluči da je ponovo osvoji… Neposredno pre nego što se vrati na scenu kao najbolji muzičar na svetu. Dok se vreme koncerta približava, jedan nedužan, mlad čovek mora da prođe minsko polje londonskih dilera droge, lud

programme.title: Overtaking / Preticanje
programme.desc: BestSeler Memoars Amy Liptrot, the overtaking is located on the islands of Orkn in Scotland. Brutally sincere drama about addiction and recovery, strength and survival, mental health and power of the sea, countries and people to renew life and return hope. After a decade spent in London, the 29-year-old Ronan (Saoirse Ronan) returns home to the Orkn island. Sober but lonely, trying to push memories to events that brought her to this time recovery. Gradually, the mystical country penetrates her inner world and day by day, Ron finds hope and strength in winds and icy sea. / Zasnovan na bestseler memoarima Ejmi Liptrot, Preticanje je smešten na ostrva Orkni u Škotskoj. Brutalno iskrena drama o zavisnosti i oporavku, snazi i preživljavanju, mentalnom zdravlju i moći mora, zemlje i ljudi da obnove život i vrate nadu. Nakon decenije provedene u Londonu, 29-godišnja Rona (Saoirse Ronan) vraća se kući na Orkni ostrva. Trezna, ali usamljena, pokušava da potisne sećanja na događaje koji su je doveli na ovaj put oporavka. Postepeno, mistična zemlja prodire u njen unutrašnji svet i dan po dan Rona pronalazi nadu i snagu u vetrovima i ledenom moru.

programme.desc: The new type of tool allows a man to face deadly forces, which was once regarded as impossible. In this episode: a polar survival suit, a thermal mask for firefighters and life-saving vest for surfing a large wave. / Nova vrsta alata omogućava čoveku da se suoči sa smrtonosnim silama, što je nekada smatrano nemogućim. U ovoj epizodi: polarno odelo za preživljavanje, termalna maska za vatrogasce i prsluk za spašavanja za surfovanje na velikom talasu.

programme.title: Rome: The rise and fall of the empire / Rim: Uspon i pad carstva
programme.desc: 9. The cruel German chief of Arminia, was defeated by the General Vara army in the Teutoburg Forest in the Battle that will define the borders of the Empire. / 9. godine, okrutni germanski poglavica Arminije, porazio je vojsku generala Vara u Teutoburškoj šumi u bici koja će definisati granice carstva.

programme.desc: The team examines Peruvian mummy with his legs crossed. Why is she mummified in such a strange position? / Tim ispituje peruansku mumiju sa prekrštenim nogama. Zašto je mumificirana u tako čudnom položaju?

programme.desc: The story of the incredible journey of the tribe of Lemba from the Middle East in Africa. / Priča o neverovatno putovanju plemena Lemba sa Bliskog istoka u Afriku.

programme.desc: 1938. in China in China, hundreds of mysterious stone discs were found. Some people believe that stones are proof of contact with aliens. programme.desc: In this episode, we reconstruct the great hypostyl gym in Karnak. programme.title: Hunters to say / Lovci na reci
programme.desc: The said seeker for precious metals and YouTube sensations Bo Vimet and Rik Edwards leader are looking for underwater archeological sites related to the Civil War. / Rečni tragač za dragocenim metalima i YouTube senzacija Bo Vimet i voditelj Rik Edvards traže podvodna arheološka nalazišta vezana za Građanski rat.

programme.title: A marvel at monster / Pohod na monstrume
programme.desc: For centuries, Amazon was home to the scariest freshwater monsters of famous man - Piranama. Since these creatures also appear in American waters, the team explores whether carnivorous beasts can be reproduced and the destroy of local waters can be reproduced. / Vekovima je Amazon bio dom najstrašnijim slatkovodnim monstrumima poznatih čoveku - piranama. programme.title: Ancient aliens / Drevni vanzemaljci
programme.desc: There are a megalithic stone buildings around the world whose construction confuses archaeologists. programme.desc: Rik Edwards and River Researcher Bo Ouimet are in North Wales where river flows that could contain traces of medieval Welsh rebellion. / Voditelj Rik Edvards i rečni istraživač Bo Ouimet su u severnom Velsu gde istražuju rečne tokove koji bi mogli sadržati tragove srednjovekovne velške pobune.

programme.title: Warriors / Ratnici
programme.desc: A member of the Green Berets Teri Shepert reveals the origin of his American warrior culture, Special Forces of the United States: These are Alamo Scouts, an elite reconnaissance unit that seemed behind enemy lines in the Second World War. / Pripadnik Zelenih beretki Teri Šepert otkriva poreklo svoje kulture američkog ratnika, Specijalne snage SAD: to su Izviđači Alamoa, elitna izviđačka jedinica koja je delovala iza neprijateljskih linija u Drugom svetskom ratu.

programme.title: The secret of the history of people / Tajna istorija ljudi
programme.desc: 15,000 years ago, the man and the wolf folded the Association that shaped the future of humanity. programme.title: Titan conflict / Sukob titana
programme.desc: At the end of June 1944, as soon as the Allied forces disembarked in Normandy, the Allies embarked on a determined attack. However, for the Overlord surgery to be successful, another very important task should have been fulfilled: to occupy the port of Cherbourg, so that food and army equipment in Western Europe could be sent to France. However, Cherbourg was well determined and surrounded by bunkers with large navy cannons. They were to be silenced. The US military ship Texas, who participated in the campaign in North Africa and disembarking in Normandy, will come to aid. This veteran battalion ship, launched in 1912, had a huge fire power: 128 cannons and four torpedo pipes 533 mm in diameter. A bloody struggle with one of the strongest coastal battles on the Cotentin peninsula began. She had four 240 mm cannons with a range of 24 kilometers. They were a real nightmare for the Allied fleet. But the USS Texas, which will later fight in the Pacific, has solved the problem. The whole cherbourg trembled with detonations ... / Potkraj lipnja 1944., čim su se savezničke snage iskrcale u Normandiju, saveznici su krenuli u odlučan napad. Ipak, da bi operacija Overlord bila uspješna, trebalo je ispuniti još jedan vrlo važan zadatak: zauzeti luku Cherbourg, kako bi se hrana i oprema za vojsku u Zapadnoj Europi mogle slati u Francusku. Međutim, Cherbourg je bio dobro utvrđen i okružen bunkerima s velikim mornaričkim topovima. Trebalo ih je ušutkati. Američki vojni brod Texas, koji je sudjelovao u kampanji u Sjevernoj Africi i iskrcavanju u Normandiju, priskočit će u pomoć. Taj veteranski bojni brod, porinut 1912., imao je silnu vatrenu moć: 128 topova i četiri torpedne cijevi promjera 533 mm. Počela je krvava borba s jednom od najjačih obalnih bitnica na poluotoku Cotentin. Raspolagala je s četiri topa kalibra 240 mm s dometom od 24 kilometra. Bili su prava noćna mora za savezničku flotu. Ali USS Texas, koji će se poslije boriti i na Pacifiku, riješio je problem. Cijeli je Cherbourg podrhtavao od detonacija...

programme.title: Victory Day and Homeland Thanksgiving / Dan pobjede i domovinske zahvalnosti
programme.desc: On the occasion of the celebration of Victory and Homeland Thanksgiving, Croatian Veterans Day and the 30th anniversary of the VRO Storm, Croatian Television brings a special show that will be transmitted live from Knin on the first and fourth program of Croatian Television. The editor is Ana Jelinic, and Branko Nadjvinski as editor and presenter of the transmission will comment on the most important events from the military-police operation Storm and the Homeland War. The guests are Ph.D. Ante Nazor, Director of the Croatian Memorial and Documentation Center of the Homeland War, General Mirko Sundov, former Chief of General Staff of the CAF and Brigadier General Zdravko Jakop, from the University of Defense and Security Dr. Franjo Tudjman. Our reporters Borka Juras Slamic, Anamarija Skoric, Edi Skovrlj and Petar Vlahov will appear from Knin with the participants of Storm and the defenders. We will get involved live with three positions: Knin Fortress, the City Square of Ante Starcevic and the NK Dinara football stadium, where a central celebration will be held. We also bring the reports of our journalists about the days of Storm and the defenders who participated in it and a reminder of those who donated their own lives. / U povodu obilježavanja Dana pobjede i domovinske zahvalnosti, Dana hrvatskih branitelja te 30. obljetnice VRO Oluja, Hrvatska televizija donosi posebnu emisiju koja će se prenositi uživo iz Knina na Prvome i Četvrtome programu Hrvatske televizije. Urednica je Ana Jelinić, a Branko Nađvinski kao urednik i voditelj prijenosa s gostima će komentirati najvažnije događaje iz vojno-redarstvene operacije Oluja i Domovinskog rata. Gosti su dr. sc. Ante Nazor, ravnatelj Hrvatskog memorijalno-dokumentacijskog centra Domovinskog rata, general Mirko Šundov, bivši načelnik Glavnog stožera OSRH i brigadni general Zdravko Jakop, sa Sveučilišta obrane i sigurnosti dr. Franjo Tuđman. Naši reporteri Borka Juras Slamić, Anamarija Škorić, Edi Škovrlj i Petar Vlahov javljat će se iz Knina sa sudionicima Oluje i braniteljima. Uključit ćemo se uživo s tri pozicije: kninske tvrđave, gradskog Trga Ante Starčevića i nogometnog stadiona NK Dinara, gdje će se održati središnja proslava. Donosimo i reportaže naših novinara o danima Oluje i braniteljima koji su u njoj sudjelovali te podsjetnik na one koji su darovali vlastiti život.
