programme.title: Where your mother is waiting for you - lourdes / Tamo gdje te majka čeka - Lourdes
programme.desc: Many Croatian pilgrims say they are their favorite in Lourdes to come in May during an international military pilgrimage because the atmosphere is special then. Army from all over the world they enter the streets of the city. And our army appreciates our army for experience. Therefore, it is an honor to go with them in the procession towards the shrine ... This is the 65th international military pilgrimage and the 31st pilgrimage of the Croatian army, police and veterans. They were joined by pilgrims from Bosnia and Herzegovina, with Archbishop Tom Vukšić. Otherwise, we are always among the more numerous in Lourdes. About 900 pilgrims came this year. A military pilgrimage to Lourdes has traditionally begun to Holy Mass in front of the apparition cave. The ceremony of opening a military pilgrimage is a real spectacle. In the Basilica of St. Pius X, members of the Armed Forces from about forty countries were presented. There were 17,000 pilgrims from America, Africa, Europe. This year's motto is soldiers - pilgrims of hope. / Mnogi hrvatski hodočasnici kažu da im je najdraže u Lourdes doći u svibnju tijekom međunarodnog vojnog hodočašća jer atmosfera je tada posebna. Vojske iz cijeloga svijeta stupaju ulicama grada. A našu vojsku posebno cijene zbog iskustva. Stoga je čast s njima krenuti u povorci prema svetištu... Ovo je 65. međunarodno vojno hodočašće i 31. hodočašće hrvatske vojske, policije i branitelja. Pridružili su im se i hodočasnici iz Bosne i Hercegovine, s nadbiskupom Tomom Vukšićem. Inače, mi smo uvijek među brojnijima u Lourdesu. Ove godine došlo je oko 900 hodočasnika. Vojno hodočašće u Lourdes već tradicionalno počinje svetom misom ispred Špilje ukazanja. Svečana ceremonija otvaranja vojnog hodočašća pravi je spektakl. U bazilici svetog Pija X. predstavljeni su pripadnici oružanih snaga iz četrdesetak zemalja. Bilo je prisutno 17.000 hodočasnika iz Amerike, Afrike, Europe. Ove godine geslo je Vojnici - hodočasnici nade.

programme.title: Four summers, three winter / Četiri ljeta, tri zime
programme.desc: On August 4, 1995, at 5 a.m., the rocketry of the Celavac transmitter began with a military-police Operation Storm. The united forces of the Special Police of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Croatia, including members of the Zadar jumps, were moving at one of the main directions on Velebit, on the Mali Golic - Mali Alan - Mali stream - Male and Velika Žuljina - Ćelavac, where they were found in 1995 by Croatian Television. It is at this place that the story of the Zadar jump begins. For 25 years since the end of the Storm military-police action, Velebit re-combined members of the Special Police of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Croatia (SJP), Zadar Poskka. Formerly mostly young men in the early 20s, they recalled their Velebit days - from arriving at the strategically important Visovo Velebit to the final liberation action of Storm. The mountain that does not forgive, which inspires, which is loved and remembered, has been their second home for four summers and three winters. Through the abundance of archival material, private recordings and photographs, we follow the story of the coexistence of man and nature in the war days, months and years at one of the most beautiful but also the most festive Croatian mountains, which only those who respected her laws survived. On the one hand, the enemy, on the other, the harsh nature and the namesakes of the population. The whimsicality of the Velebit itself was a constant and lasting danger. Four summers, three winters are an inspirational story about the stay and survival of a generation of brave and bold. PRODUCTION: IMS HTV Cinemathers with a non-flying flight: Branko Drakulic, Duje Marin, Maks Drakulic / 4. kolovoza 1995., u 5 sati ujutro, raketiranjem odašiljača Ćelavac započela je vojno-redarstvena operacija Oluja. Združene snage Specijalne policije MUP-a RH, među kojima su bili i pripadnici zadarskih Poskoka, kretale su se na jednom od glavnih pravaca na Velebitu, na potezu Mali Golić - Mali Alan - Crveni Potoci - Male i Velike Žuljine - Ćelavac, gdje ih je te 1995. zatekla kamera Hrvatske televizije. Upravo na tom mjestu počinje priča zadarskih Poskoka. 25 godina od završetka vojno-redarstvene akcije Oluja Velebit je ponovno spojio pripadnike Specijalne policije MUP-a RH (SJP), zadarske Poskoke. Nekada mahom mladići u ranim 20-ima prisjetili su se svojih velebitskih dana - od dolaska na strateški važne visove Velebita do završne oslobodilačke akcije Oluja. Planina koja ne oprašta, koja inspirira, koju se voli i pamti, četiri je ljeta i tri zime bila njihov drugi dom. Kroz obilje arhivskog materijala, privatnih snimki i fotografija pratimo priču o suživotu čovjeka i prirode u ratnim danima, mjesecima i godinama na jednoj od najljepših ali i najsurovijih hrvatskih planina na kojoj su opstali samo oni koji su poštovali njezine zakone. S jedne strane neprijatelj, s druge surova priroda i imenjaci poskoci. Ćudljivost Velebita sama je po sebi bila stalna i trajna opasnost. Četiri ljeta, tri zime inspirativna je priča o ostanku i opstanku generacije hrabrih i odvažnih. Produkcija: IMS HTV-a Snimatelji bespilotnom letjelicom: Branko Drakulić, Duje Marin, Maks Drakulić

programme.title: 1995 Decision / 1995. godina odluke
programme.desc: What was crucial for a number of military operations that were a turning point for the fate of Croatia in the 95th? Of course, the emphasis is on the military-police action of Storms. programme.desc: Monty in Longmeadow begins with seasonal works. No onda otkriju da je Armanellova violina kopija. Je li ubojstvo povezano s violinom ili se François zbog ljubavi prema glazbi doveo u nemoguću situaciju?

programme.title: Inspektor George Gently / Inspektor George Gently
programme.desc: Gently is shocked when he gets a letter bacchus quit, but soon realizes that his sergeant has lost his confidence. Police in Newcastle arrested protesters to break up the poor neighborhood provided for demolition. This will turn into a case that will make both Gently and Bacchus wonder what it means to be a police officer at a time when the attitude towards the police is changing. They are no longer a reliable, close local berry in patrol. The cops are now viewing as state agents. / Gently je šokiran kad dobije pismo kojim Bacchus daje otkaz, ali ubrzo shvati da je njegov narednik izgubio samopouzdanje. Kako bi mu pomogao da ga ponovno stekne, Gently inzistira da mu Bacchus tijekom otkaznog roka pomaže istražiti smrt pritvorenika. Policija u Newcastleu uhitila je prosvjednike kako bi raščistila sirotinjsku četvrt predviđenu za rušenje. Sljedeće jutro policajka Rachel Coles (Lisa McGrillis) otkriva da jedan od prosvjednika leži mrtav u ćeliji. To će se pretvoriti u slučaj zbog kojeg će se i Gently i Bacchus zapitati što znači biti policajac u vrijeme kad se odnos prema policiji mijenja. Više nisu pouzdani, bliski lokalni bobiji u patroli. Policajce sad gledaju kao državne agente.

programme.title: Big stories, little people / Velike priče, mali ljudi
programme.desc: Just somehow before the worldwide pandemic is exploded, Ani has been diagnosed with breast cancer. Four times four inches big malignant clumps in the right breast turned her life. Months of chemotherapy, surgery, coronage, emotional ups and downs ... She did not even get to think about what he was going through. In her mind, she was just a desire to win. Three years later, Ana is no longer cancer. And all those thoughts she had put under the rug in those three years now pulled out, on the way of thanks for her life. The moment when doctors gave the green light, she put on Gojzerica, saved the hiking backpack and headed for Via Adriatica Trail, from the far south of Croatia, Prevlaka, to the Istrian Cape Kamenjak. 1100 kilometers. On foot. 50 days. Sam and determined on a cathartic path that will change her life once more. / Baš nekako prije nego što će diljem svijeta eksplodirati COVID pandemija, Ani je dijagnosticiran rak dojke. Četiri puta četiri centimetara velika zloćudna nakupina u desnoj dojci izokrenula je njezin život. Mjeseci i mjeseci kemoterapija, operacija, korone, emocionalnih uspona i padova... od brzine zbivanja nije stigla ni razmisliti kroz što prolazi. U mislima joj je bila samo želja za pobjedom. Tri godine poslije Ana je više nema rak. A sve one misli koje je u te tri godine stavljala pod tepih izvukla je sada van, na putu zahvale za svoj život. Onoga trena kad su liječnici dali zeleno svjetlo, navukla je gojzerice, spremila planinarski ruksak i uputila se na Via Adriatica Trail, od krajnjeg juga Hrvatske, Prevlake, pa do istarskog Rta Kamenjak. 1100 kilometara. Pješice. 50 dana. Sama i odlučna na katarzičnoj stazi koja će joj još jednom promijeniti život.

programme.title: Graffiti / Grafiti
programme.desc: The first episode explores what we really think when we think of graffiti. Although they form the scene of everyday life of most cities, most citizens are so accustomed to graffiti that they no longer pay attention to them. However, when someone's signing in the spray appears on a pure facade, the graffiti suddenly become a major city problem. We started our research inside the circles of people who draw. Graffiti enthusiast Antonija Bacic introduces us to never before, the inner world of the subculture of graffiti. In order to better understand the topic we are talking about, learning and drawing graffiti. Fine artist Mane Mei at a graffiti drawing workshop shows us the basic elements needed for artistic expression on the street. Marin Remic introduces us to the term street art. We learn to work with it and glue stickers, small stickers we often see on public areas of cities. The professional analysis of everything learned is given to us by the culturalist Dr. Sc. Eric Ušić, an expert in artistic expression in the public in Istria. In Zagreb, we have done a never -see interview with a graffiti that draws exclusively illegally ... leaves its signatures on facades. We ask him all the important questions, most importantly: do you color so in your facade? In Tokyo, we visit the exhibition of Marina Mesar around, our internationally recognized artist who had her artistic beginning by drawing the street art on the walls of Zagreb streets. With her we comment on the difference between graffiti and street art, how much is, where and when acceptable and what is not. Japanese collective art and Clean we help clean up / Prva epizoda istražuje što zapravo mislimo kada pomislimo na grafite. Iako tvore kulisu svakodnevice većine gradova, većina građana toliko je naviknuta na grafite da na njih više ni ne obraća pozornost. Ipak, kad se na čistoj fasadi pojavi nečiji potpis u spreju, odjednom grafiti postaju glavni gradski problem. Naše istraživanje smo započeli unutar krugova ljudi koji crtaju. Grafiti entuzijastkinja Antonija Bačić uvodi nas u nikad prije viđeni, unutarnji svijet supkulture grafita. Kako bismo što bolje razumjeli temu o kojoj govorimo, učimo i crtati grafite. Likovni umjetnik Mane Mei na radionici crtanja grafita pokazuje nam osnovne elemente potrebne za likovno izražavanje na ulici. Marin Remić upoznaje nas s pojmom street art. S njim učimo raditi i lijepiti stickere, male naljepnice koje često vidimo na javnim površinama gradova. Stručnu analizu svega naučenog daje nam kulturolog dr. sc. Eric Ušić, stručnjak za likovno izražavanje u javnosti u Istri. U Zagrebu radimo dosad nikad viđeni intervju s grafiterom koji crta isključivo ilegalno... ostavlja svoje potpise na fasadama. Pitamo ga sva važna pitanja, od kojih je najvažnije: Šaraš li tako i po svojoj fasadi? U Tokyju posjećujemo izložbu Marine Mesar OKO, naše međunarodno priznate likovne umjetnice koja je svoj umjetnički početak imala upravo crtajući street art na zidovima zagrebačkih ulica. S njom komentiramo razliku između grafita i street arta, koliko je što, gdje i kada prihvatljivo, a što nije. Japanskom kolektivu Art and Clean pomažemo čistiti

programme.title: The Golden Clock rule / Pravilo zlatnog sata
programme.desc: A documentary about military medical medical medical medical medical medical medical, during the Homeland War wounded the wounded from the front line of the front line. The doctors organized the paths of evacuation and accepting the wounded within the time limit, which the profession calls the rule of the gold clock. Special surgical-adsesiological teams of volunteers were formed to improvise the reception units on the front line of the front line. They exhibited their lives of danger because they acted on the battlefield, in the range of enemy artillery. Like soldiers in the fight, they often looked death in the eyes, which is why they are equally responsible for defending the Republic of Croatia and proudly carry the status of veterans. Today, many of these doctors and doctors, nurses and nurses and nurses and drivers from the first line of battlefields continue to save human lives in their hospitals, help with psychosomatic traumas caused by war and contribute to their selfless example of the development of society as a whole. / Dokumentarni film o vojnom medicinskom sanitetu koji je tijekom Domovinskog rata zbrinjavao ranjenike s prve crte bojišnice. Liječnici su organizirali puteve evakuacije i prihvata ranjenika u roku koji struka naziva pravilo zlatnog sata. Formirane su posebne kirurško-anesteziološke ekipe dobrovoljaca koji su improvizirali prihvatne jedinice na prvoj crti bojišnice. Izložili su svoje živote opasnosti jer su djelovali na ratištu, u dometu neprijateljske artiljerije. Poput vojnika u borbi i oni su nerijetko gledali smrti u oči, zato su podjednako zaslužni za obranu Republike Hrvatske i ponosno nose status branitelja. Danas mnogi od tih liječnica i liječnika, medicinskih sestara i medicinskih tehničara i vozača s prve crte ratišta i dalje u svojim bolnicama spašavaju ljudske živote, pomažu kod psihosomatskih traumi prouzročenih ratom i pridonose svojim nesebičnim primjerom razvoju društva u cjelini.

programme.title: Tandem / Tandem
programme.desc: Isabelle Priux, a sports climbing trainer, was found dead at the foot of the cliff hortus. The investigation quickly determines that it is not an accident - someone has sabotaged her equipment. Why would anyone kill a seemingly ordinary girl who, after five years of breath, only recently returned to her native land? Is her former departure - encouraged by the random death of her helper on the same cliff - associated with the murder? Isabelle changed significantly during the outburst: once prone to risky climbing without insurance, returned as an advocate of security and education. Did she stand on the trip to Dan Tulak, an extreme climber who did not want anyone to disturb him? Investigators soon reveal: Isabelle tried to forget the past, but on her return she was greeted by someone who accidentally discovered her long -suppressed secret. / Isabelle Prioux, trenerica sportskog penjanja, pronađena je mrtva podno litice Hortus. Istragom se brzo utvrđuje da nije riječ o nesreći - netko je sabotirao njezinu opremu.Zašto bi itko ubio naizgled običnu djevojku koja se, nakon pet godina izbivanja, tek nedavno vratila u rodni kraj? Je li njezin nekadašnji odlazak - potaknut slučajnom pogibijom njezina pomagača na istoj toj litici - povezan s ubojstvom?Isabelle se tijekom izbivanja znatno promijenila: nekad sklona rizičnom penjanju bez osiguranja, vratila se kao zagovornica sigurnosti i edukacije. Je li time stala na put Danu Tulaku, ekstremnom penjaču koji nije želio da ga itko ometa?Istražitelji uskoro otkrivaju: Isabelle je pokušala zaboraviti prošlost, ali ju je po povratku dočekao netko tko je slučajno otkrio njezinu davno potisnutu tajnu.

Ne mogu premjestiti novac zbog straha da ih ne razotkriju.

programme.title: Classics to the people / Klasici narodu
programme.desc: From Pera Jonathan Swift comes one of the most popular satirical-fantastic stories about Naval Gulliver and his trips. The story full of uncertainty and interesting descriptions that read in one, up to two breaths. programme.title: The mouth of the river / Ušća rijeka
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Neretva it becomes a wide, almost plain river, the apparel they brought from the far, deposited here, creating here among the karst hills of muddy and earthen plains. There are also the first traces of powerful cities like Narona in mind. But in addition to archaeological monuments, the underground also preserves numerous sources, caves and other karst phenomena. U jednoj od njih smo pronašli jedinog slatkovodnog podzemnog školjkaša na svijetu. Taj živi fosil endem je naših kraških krajeva. Neretva se ovdje širi u veliku deltu. programme.title: On the edge of science / Na rubu znanosti
programme.desc: In the last ten years, more and more attention has been attracted to ancient megalithic monuments - stećak tombstones. More and more books are written about them, more and more people think about them or go on their way to the remote mountainous parts in search of some perhaps -chopped necropolis. We also witness a gradual change in viewing the question of their age, which has never been devoid of controversy. Today we will head towards Ploče, where the demolished stećak tombstones are raised on the fuel enthusiasm or looking for and finding those mentioned in historical documents ... / U posljednjih desetak godine sve više pažnje privlače drevni megalitski spomenici - stećci. Sve više knjiga se o njima piše, sve više ljudi o njima razmišlja ili pak i sami krenu na put do udaljenih planinskih dijelova u potragu za nekim možda zaboravljenim nekropolama. Svjedočimo i postupnoj promjeni gledanja na pitanje njihove starosti, koje nikad nije bilo lišeno kontroverzi. Danas ćemo se uputiti prema Pločama, gdje se na gorivu entuzijazma podižu srušeni stećci ili traži i nalazi one spomenute u povijesnim dokumentima...

programme.title: New Egypt between luxury and repression / Novi Egipat između raskoši i represije
programme.desc: Egypt, a country of multi -fat civilization that boasts a rich archeological heritage and an unusual beauty of the Nile River, was once a favorite tourist destination. But behind the view as a postcard hides an unprecedented repression, exposed to its 110 million inhabitants. Hope in change and freedom, born in protests at Tahrir Square in 2011, was quickly suffocated. At the head of the state is Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, a retired military official who has been ruling an egypt steel hand for eight years. He wants to turn Egypt into another Dubai and attract investors and rich tourists with luxury villas, imposing business buildings and huge shopping malls that are coming everywhere. His latest project is the new capital in the middle of the desert, six times larger than Paris, whose construction will cost almost 50 billion euros. But not all benefits from Sisi's vision of modern Egypt. About 30% of the population lives with less than two dollars a day - to survive, some even live in cemeteries like El -Araf in the Cairo capital. In this necropolis, hundreds of thousands of people sleep among the graves of ancestors. It's a real city in the city - there are shops and even school. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi is a terrifying opponent and ignoring the poor. One of the symbols of this oppression is Alaa Abd El-Fattah, the leader of the rebellion in Tahrir Square. The 40 -year -old blogger has spent most of the eight years behind bars. We met with his mother, Lail Soueif, activist for human rights, and his sister Sana, a refugee who lives in London and does everything to turn / Egipat, zemlja višetisućljetne civilizacije koja se diči bogatom arheološkom baštinom i nesvakidašnjom ljepotom rijeke Nil, nekada je bio omiljeno turističko odredište. No iza vizura kao s razglednica krije se neviđena represija kojoj je izloženo njegovih 110 milijuna stanovnika. Nada u promjene i slobodu, rođena u prosvjedima na trgu Tahrir 2011. godine, brzo je ugušena. Na čelu države je Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, umirovljeni vojni dužnosnik koji vlada Egiptom čeličnom rukom već osam godina. On želi Egipat pretvoriti u drugi Dubai te privući investitore i bogate turiste luksuznim vilama, impozantnim poslovnim zgradama i golemim trgovačkim centrima koji niču posvuda. Njegov je najnoviji projekt novi glavni grad usred pustinje, šest puta veći od Pariza, čija će izgradnja stajati gotovo 50 milijardi eura. No nemaju svi koristi od Sisijeve vizije modernog Egipta. Oko 30% stanovništva živi s manje od dva dolara dnevno - da bi preživjeli, neki čak žive na grobljima poput El-Arafa u glavnom gradu Kairu. U ovoj nekropoli stotine tisuća ljudi spava među grobovima predaka. To je pravi grad u gradu - ima trgovine pa čak i školu. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi vlada zastrašujući oponente i ignorirajući siromašne. Jedan od simbola ovog ugnjetavanja je Alaa Abd el-Fattah, vođa pobune na trgu Tahrir. 40 godišnji bloger proteklih je osam godina većinom proveo iza rešetaka. Sastali smo se s njegovom majkom, Lailom Soueif, aktivisticom za ljudska prava te njegovom sestrom Sanaom, izbjeglicom koja živi u Londonu i čini sve da skrene

programme.title: Retrospective Alain Delona: Rocco and his brothers / Retrospektiva Alaina Delona: Rocco i njegova braća
programme.desc: Drama. Four brothers from Sicily, Simone (R. Salvatore), Rocco (A. Delon), Ciro (M. Cartier) and Luca, come with his mother Rosario (K. Paxinou) in the suburbs of Milan and try to adapt to a new life, in which their oldest brother Vincenzo (S. Focas) has already been successful. Simone becomes a successful boxer and begins a love affair with a prostitute Nadiom (A. Girardot), but due to irresponsibility, he soon begins to waste strength and money and leave him. The younger brother Rocco also shows boxing talent and himself begins a relationship with the Nadiom. Still, because of the sense of responsibility for his brother, he interrupts the relationship. While Rocco triumphs as a boxer, Simone, completely failed, rapes Nadi ... Rocco and his brothers is an impressive Italian social drama that, through the gloomy story of a new life, shows a misery and all the fate of such people in Milan. The film was directed by the famous Italian director Luchino Visconti (Death in Venice, Gepard), who entrusted the main roles with famous actors A. Delon, A. Girardot, C. Cardinale and others. Filmed in the tradition of Italian neorealistic films, with a pronounced emphasis on the social state of the protagonist, a film is a cult accomplishment that still impresses with master directing, great music (Nino Rota) and an excellent script. The exceptionality of the film was immediately recognized: the film won a silver lion at the 1961 Venetian Festival, the FiPrensca award and numerous others. / Drama. Četvorica braće sa Sicilije, Simone (R. Salvatore), Rocco (A. Delon), Ciro (M. Cartier) i Luca, dolaze zajedno s majkom Rosariom (K. Paxinou) u predgrađe Milana te se pokušavaju prilagoditi novom životu, u čemu je njihov najstariji brat Vincenzo (S. Focas) već djelomice uspio. Simone postaje uspješan boksač i započinje ljubavnu vezu s prostitutkom Nadiom (A. Girardot), ali zbog neodgovornosti ubrzo počinje rasipati snagu i novac te ga ona ostavi. Mlađi brat Rocco također pokazuje boksačku nadarenost i sam započinje vezu s Nadiom. Ipak, zbog osjećaja odgovornosti prema bratu, prekida vezu. Dok Rocco trijumfira kao boksač, Simone, potpuno propao, siluje Nadiu... Rocco i njegova braća dojmljiva je talijanska socijalna drama koja kroz tmurnu priču o novom životu osiromašene sicilijanske obitelji pokazuje bijedu i svakakve sudbine takvih ljudi pristiglih u Milano. Film je režirao slavni talijanski redatelj Luchino Visconti (Smrt u Veneciji, Gepard), koji je glavne uloge povjerio slavnim glumcima A. Delonu, A. Girardot, C. Cardinale i ostalima. Snimljen u tradiciji talijanskih neorealističnih filmova, s izrazitim naglaskom na socijalno stanje protagonista, film je kultno ostvarenje koje i danas zadivljuje majstorskom režijom, sjajnom glazbom (Nino Rota) i odličnim scenarijem. Izuzetnost filma bila je odmah prepoznata: film je osvojio Srebrnog lava na venecijanskom festivalu 1961. godine, FIPRESCI nagradu te brojne druge.

programme.title: Generation y / Generacija Y
programme.desc: Often, each of us gets caught up in the fact that he has tiny rituals, unusual interventions, strange habits and other little madness. Several young people from the Generation Y talk about these small bizarreness and what they mean to them, when they became aware of them, are they aware of them at all ... / Nerijetko se svatko od nas uhvati u tome kako ima sitne rituale, neobične zahvate, čudne navike i druge male ludosti. Nekoliko mladih iz Generacije Y progovara upravo o tim sitnim bizarnostima i što im one znače, kad su ih postali svjesni, jesu li ih uopće svjesni...

programme.title: Garage / Garaža
programme.desc: Guitar Virtuoz Damir Halilic Hal recorded four albums that praised criticism. Compositions from the double debut album Gemini found themselves in the American, Australian and European top charts, followed by foreign tour. Ocean Hal's second album was recorded in Bologna, the production was signed by Franco Moron, one of the biggest names of contemporary acoustic guitar. From the third album, Infinity composition Speak that won me over Porin for the best women's interpretation (Meri Trošelj). The fourth, three -time trilogy Hal album has recorded around the world (USA, Europe) with big names Blues and jazz scene. The long -awaited fifth album Mare Nostrum was recorded in London in September 2012. With the help of producer B. J. Cole (who collaborated with musicians such as Elton John, R.E.M., Depeche Mode, Roger Waters, Sting ...) and tone cameraman Steve Honest (collaborated with performers such as Ry Cooder, Oasis, Oasis Heep ...). The hall is enough to say that his albums, in his shop on his own website, included the world -class music virtuoso Tommy Emmanuel. Hal is also the organizer of the HALS ALL STAR Guitar Festival, which is being held in Rijeka and performing the most important guitarists of today, is the artistic director of the Kastav Blues Festival and together with Deni Sesnić, the Baška International Guitar Festival program regulates. Enjoy the garage with songs: Mare Nostrum, Circus, Rose, Bura, Tender Wagon Song and Mosquito. / Gitaristički virtuoz Damir Halilić Hal snimio je četiri albuma koja je kritika hvalila. Skladbe s dvostrukog albuma prvijenca Gemini našle su se na američkim, australskim i europskim top ljestvicama nakon čega su uslijedile inozemne turneje. Drugi album Ocean Hal je snimio u Bologni, produkciju je potpisao Franco Morone, jedno od najvećih imena suvremene akustične gitare. S trećeg albuma Infinity skladba Speak To Me osvojila je Porin za najbolju žensku interpretaciju (Meri Trošelj). Četvrti, trostruki album Trilogy Hal je snimio diljem svijeta (SAD, Europa) s velikim imenima blues i jazz scene. Dugoočekivani peti album Mare nostrum sniman je u Londonu u rujnu 2012. uz pomoć producenta B. J. Colea (koji je surađivao s glazbenicima kao što su Elton John, R.E.M., Depeche Mode, Roger Waters, Sting...) i tonskog snimatelja Stevea Honesta (surađivao s izvođačima kao što su Ry Cooder, Oasis, Uriah Heep...). O Halu dovoljno govori podatak da je njegove albume, u svoj shop na vlastitoj web stranici, uvrstio glazbeni virtuoz svjetskoga glasa Tommy Emmanuel. Hal je ujedno i organizator Hals All Star Guitar Festivala koji se održava u Rijeci i na kojem nastupaju najvažniji gitaristi današnjice, umjetnički je ravnatelj Kastav Blues Festivala te zajedno s Denijem Šesnićem uređuje program Baška International Guitar Festivala. U Garaži uživajte uz pjesme: Mare nostrum, Cirkus, Ruža, Bura, Tender Wagon Song i Mosquito.

programme.title: Victory for heroes, in honor of a storm - a concert recording / Pobjeda za heroje, u čast Oluji - snimka koncerta

With congratulations to the Homeland and Emigrant Croatia, the singers were from different parts of our country, relying on the great musicians: the orchestra and the Klapa Sveti Juraj HRM with Maestro Tonči Tonči Ćićerić and the Tamburitza Orchestra of HRT with Maestrro Sinisha Leopold. / Bio je to povijesni, do tada neviđen događaj u čast Oluji, održan 5. kolovoza 2016. na stadionu NK Dinara u Kninu. Uz čestitke domovinske i iseljene Hrvatske, pjevači su bili iz različitih krajeva naše zemlje, oslanjajući se na sjajne glazbenike: Orkestar i klapu Sveti Juraj HRM-a uz maestra Tončija Ćićerića i Tamburaški orkestar HRT-a s maestrom Sinišom Leopoldom.

programme.title: Shark plow / Orao protiv morskog psa
programme.desc: Lilly is a shy and somewhat unusual waitress. He falls in love with Jarrod, a video game maher. After getting closer at a party on the topic of his favorite animal, Lilly follows Jarroda to his hometown, where he wants to face a former school abuser. During this trip, both discover their own insecurity and what it means to accept yourself and others. / Lilly je sramežljiva i pomalo neobična konobarica. Zaljubljuje se u Jarroda, mahera za videoigre. Nakon što se zbliže na zabavi na temu omiljene životinje, Lilly prati Jarroda u njegov rodni grad, gdje se on želi suočiti s nekadašnjim školskim zlostavljačem. Tijekom tog putovanja oboje otkrivaju vlastite nesigurnosti i što znači prihvatiti sebe i druge.

programme.title: Old black house / Stara crna kuća
programme.desc: Film director Frankenstein. A group of passengers of intentional finds an unusual old house, where he finds himself in the mercy of a very eccentric and perhaps dangerous Femm family. In this thriller of a dark atmosphere with an excellent acting line -up, Boris Karloff played the lead role in his first horror in the role of a large, distorted butler. / Film redatelja Frankensteina. Skupina putnika namjernika nailazi na neobičnu staru kuću, gdje se nađe prepuštena na milost i nemilost vrlo ekscentrične i možda opasne obitelji Femm. U ovom trileru mračne atmosfere s izvrsnom glumačkom postavom glavnu ulogu u svom prvom hororu odglumio je Boris Karloff u ulozi krupnog, izobličenog batlera.

programme.title: Seven peaks / Sedam vrhova
programme.desc: The tops of the snow -covered snow serve as a training session for later climbs in the Alps. The ascent of Biokovo reveals to us the almost undiscovered beauty of this coastal mountain. From Biokov, the author takes us to the climbing Lourdes, the town of Chamonix, which is below the highest European Mount Mont Blanc. Chamonix is a cradle of alpinism, and the ups of Mont Blanc are only the predecessor of the later golden period of the Alpinism. Through the steep alpine rock, we follow one of the usual leaders of the rise that may seem scary. The ease by which the author tells of an ascent of the icy alpine thousand -metar walls of viewers brings in doubt: Why? Because it's about life and death. / Vrhovi snijegom pokrivenoga Biokova izvrsno služe kao trening za kasnije uspone u Alpama. Uspon na Biokovo otkriva nam gotovo neotkrivene ljepote ove primorske planine. S Biokova nas autor vodi do penjačkog Lourdesa, gradića Chamonixa, koji se nalazi ispod najviše europske planine Mont Blanca. Chamonix je kolijevka alpinizma, a usponi na Mont Blanc samo su prethodnica kasnijemu zlatnom razdoblju alpinizma. Kroz strmu alpsku stijenu slijedimo jedan od uobičajenih voditeljevih uspona koji nepenjaču može izgledati zastrašujuće. Lakoća kojom autor priča o usponu po zaleđenim alpskim tisućumetarskim zidovima gledatelja dovodi u nedoumicu: zašto? Jer, radi se o životu i smrti.

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: In the first episode, we dive on our protruding island of Palagruza. Although in solitude, it has a rich history from ancient times. We will see a liter filled with lobsters, but also an equally large and unusual cancer name with grandmother. There are also a plaque star - a sea without arms, and the night was offered to us, among other things, a dance of an unusual resident of Rebras - a transparent animal with its own light effects. We walked into a cave where a sea bear used to live. / U prvoj epizodi ronimo na našem izbočenijem otoku Palagruži. Iako na osami, ima bogatu povijest od pradavnih vremena. Vidjet ćemo liticu ispunjenu jastozima, ali i jednako velikog i neobičnog raka imenom baba. Tu su još pločasta zvjezdača - morska zvijezda bez krakova, a noć nam je između ostaloga ponudila ples neobičnog stanovnika rebraša - prozirnu životinjicu s vlastitim svjetlosnim efektima. Ušli smo u špilju u kojoj je nekad obitavala i morska medvjedica.

Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Vrtuljići / Vrtuljići
programme.desc: The Vrtuljići are a family of cute beings like birds living in a red boat, and they came from afar to meet our world. The carousels are curious and cheerful. They like to hide, imitate and discover new things. Wherever you find themselves, whether on their boat or real world, they are looking for adventures through which they learn. This animated series is intended for preschool age, and the cute Vrtuljići, just like the children of that age, learn through the fun the basic terms such as below, up and down, full and empty, etc. As the carousels are often clumsy, in a new world that children know more than them, their attempts and mistakes will make their children and the children. older) and learn something. / Vrtuljići su obitelj simpatičnih bića nalik na ptice, koja žive u crvenom brodiću, a došli su izdaleka kako bi upoznali naš svijet. Vrtuljići su znatiželjni i veseli. Vole se skrivati, oponašati i otkrivati nove stvari. Gdje god se našli, bilo na svom brodiću ili i stvarnom svijetu, u potrazi su za pustolovinama kroz koje uče. Ova animirana serija namijenjena je predškolskom uzrastu, a simpatični Vrtuljići, baš kao i djeca tog uzrasta, kroz zabavu uče osnovne pojmove kao što su ispod i iznad, gore i dolje, pun i prazan i sl. Kako su Vrtuljići često nespretni, u novom svijetu o kojem djeca znaju više od njih, njihovi će pokušaji i pogreške djecu nasmijati, a kroz zabavu će i sama (ili tijekom gledanja serije uz roditelje i starije) ponešto i naučiti.

programme.title: Pussy and puppy / Maca i Psić
programme.desc: Maca and a puppy play with cardboard boxes of various shapes, but whenever they send them to each other, the tower collapses. What are they doing wrong? Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Mali Malabar / Mali Malabar
programme.desc: While the little Malabar and the frog are playing in the ocean on an inflatable mattress, they will find out that the big invisible waves that spread by space are sometimes tickled by planets and stars. That's why the two of them will discover where these waves come from! When the two stars of the high weight of the foot, huge gravitational waves, which spread through the universe, form. / Dok se mali Malabar i žaba budu igrali u oceanu na madracu na napuhavanje, doznat će da veliki nevidljivi valovi koji se šire svemirom katkad škakljaju planete i zvijezde. Zato će njih dvoje otkriti odakle potječu ti valovi! Kad se dvije zvijezde velike težine stope, nastanu golemi gravitacijski valovi, koji se šire svemirom.

programme.title: Miso and Robin / Mišo i Robin
programme.desc: The main characters are the cat Miso and the red Robin with which children discover the world and learn about values, the rules of beautiful behavior and more through simple and humorous situations. / Glavni junaci su mačak Mišo i crvendać Robin uz koje djeca otkrivaju svijet i uče o vrijednostima, pravilima lijepog ponašanja i još mnogo toga kroz jednostavne i šaljive situacije.

Zapjevajte s njima o omiljenim igračkama, godišnjim dobima, letenju, plesanju, zdravlju, prijateljstvu i ostalim najvažnijim stvarima na svijetu.

programme.title: Oggy Oggy / Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: OGGY OGGY is a computer animated series for the preschool age of the author Jean Cayrol and Cedrica Gunerry, the series follows a kitten Ogya who embarks on an adventure with friends of Mallow and Sporty into the world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: Numeric cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The dice series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines which number they carry. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Peppa Praščić / Peppa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Praščić is a British animated TV series for preschool children. This long -standing series for children is accompanied by the events and accidents of Peppe and her friends, her brother George, their parents and other animal families living in their city. / Peppa Praščić je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon is a cute little rabbit that bursts with the vitality of childhood. Children can take Simon for an example of occupation for themselves, they can learn from him and from his disobedience, from situations in which Simon should be released in their insistence and spoilage, and always remain decent and humorous. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit.

programme.title: 123 numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Prince Amil thinks the market is too boring. So he adds ten camels, ten flying rows, ten lizards and ten strips with ice cream to make everything more exciting! But soon, chaos arose. So he calls the numeric that help him find a way to make the market more fun, but without additional confusion! / Princ Amil misli da je tržnica previše dosadna. Zato joj dodaje deset deva, deset letećih sagova, deset guštera i deset štandova sa sladoledom kako bi sve bilo uzbudljivije! Ali ubrzo nastane kaos. Zato zove Brojčiće da mu pomognu pronaći način kako da tržnica bude zabavnija, ali bez dodatne zbrke!

programme.title: My Pyško rhyme / Pjesmica Moj pliško
programme.desc: Plisian teddy bear is always ready to play and fun. In this fun song, a cheerful little girl and her favorite Plisian - Medisko are a real team. Together they experience the most charming adventures. Pliško is much more than the favorite toy - everything is a game with him and there is never worry. Sing and dance with our new song My Plisko. / Pliško je plišani medvjedić uvijek spreman za igru i zabavu. U ovoj zabavnoj pjesmici jedna vesela djevojčica i njezin omiljeni pliško - mediško pravi su tim. Zajedno doživljavaju najšašavije pustolovine. Pliško je puno više od najdraže igračke - s njim sve je igra i nikad nema briga. Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz našu novu pjesmicu Moj pliško.

programme.title: Love monster / Ljubavno čudovište

programme.title: Seven peaks / Sedam vrhova
programme.desc: The tops of the snow -covered snow serve as a training session for later climbs in the Alps. The ascent of Biokovo reveals to us the almost undiscovered beauty of this coastal mountain. From Biokov, the author takes us to the climbing Lourdes, the town of Chamonix, which is below the highest European Mount Mont Blanc. Chamonix is a cradle of alpinism, and the ups of Mont Blanc are only the predecessor of the later golden period of the Alpinism. Through the steep alpine rock, we follow one of the usual leaders of the rise that may seem scary. The ease by which the author tells of an ascent of the icy alpine thousand -metar walls of viewers brings in doubt: Why? Because it's about life and death. / Vrhovi snijegom pokrivenoga Biokova izvrsno služe kao trening za kasnije uspone u Alpama. Uspon na Biokovo otkriva nam gotovo neotkrivene ljepote ove primorske planine. S Biokova nas autor vodi do penjačkog Lourdesa, gradića Chamonixa, koji se nalazi ispod najviše europske planine Mont Blanca. Chamonix je kolijevka alpinizma, a usponi na Mont Blanc samo su prethodnica kasnijemu zlatnom razdoblju alpinizma. Kroz strmu alpsku stijenu slijedimo jedan od uobičajenih voditeljevih uspona koji nepenjaču može izgledati zastrašujuće. Lakoća kojom autor priča o usponu po zaleđenim alpskim tisućumetarskim zidovima gledatelja dovodi u nedoumicu: zašto? Jer, radi se o životu i smrti.

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: In the first episode, we dive on our protruding island of Palagruza. Although in solitude, it has a rich history from ancient times. There are also a plaque star - a sea without arms, and the night was offered to us, among other things, a dance of an unusual resident of Rebras - a transparent animal with its own light effects. We walked into a cave where a sea bear used to live. / U prvoj epizodi ronimo na našem izbočenijem otoku Palagruži. Iako na osami, ima bogatu povijest od pradavnih vremena. Vidjet ćemo liticu ispunjenu jastozima, ali i jednako velikog i neobičnog raka imenom baba. Tu su još pločasta zvjezdača - morska zvijezda bez krakova, a noć nam je između ostaloga ponudila ples neobičnog stanovnika rebraša - prozirnu životinjicu s vlastitim svjetlosnim efektima. Ušli smo u špilju u kojoj je nekad obitavala i morska medvjedica.

programme.title: Adventure / Avantura
programme.desc: The movie's action talks about a woman who disappears while traveling by boat, and her husband and best friend fall in love while looking for her. / Radnja filma govori o ženi koja nestaje tijekom putovanja brodom, a njezin muž i najbolja prijateljica zaljubljuju se dok je traže.

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Painter Milan Steiner in 1918 stands in front of canvas and oil paints and creates a gloomy presentation of everyday life. Like a man without an umbrella in the rain, who is almost hidden behind two female characters, as if he wanted to tell his life story full of remembrance, pain and suffering. Just a few weeks after painting the rain, that masterpiece of Croatian expressionism, Steiner dies at the age of 24. An exhibition in the dream of Steiner reveals the wider public not well known to the oeuvre of the artist who marked the Croatian art of modernity. We talk about Milan Steiner, but also about the purchase of his whole collection, in the studio with the curator of the exhibition and the director of the City Gallery Striegl Alma Trauber. Luka Filipovic, the grandson of Josip Vanište, who has kept Steiner's legacy, Sven Sorić, author of the visual identity of the exhibition, and Kristina Ikić Baniček, Mayor of Sisak, also speak on the show. / Slikar Milan Steiner 1918. stoji pred platnom i uljanim bojama i stvara sumoran prikaz svakodnevice. Poput čovjeka bez kišobrana na kiši, koji je gotovo skriven iza dva ženska lika, kao da je želio ispričati i svoju životnu priču punu sjete, boli i patnje. Samo nekoliko tjedana nakon što je naslikao Kišu, to remek-djelo hrvatskog ekspresionizma, Steiner umire u 24. godini. Izložba U snu Steiner otkriva široj javnosti nedovoljno poznat opus umjetnika koji je obilježio hrvatsku likovnost moderne. O Milanu Steineru, ali i o otkupu njegove cjelovite zbirke, u studiju razgovaramo s kustosicom izložbe i ravnateljicom Gradske galerije Striegl Almom Trauber. U emisiji govore i Luka Filipović, unuk Josipa Vanište koji je desetljećima čuvao Steinerovu ostavštinu, Sven Sorić, autor vizualnog identiteta izložbe, i Kristina Ikić Baniček, gradonačelnica Siska.

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: The independent circumstances of Enver culprit the book is completely unusual, incomparable with another published in our region, but that is why rich in heterogeneous influences of American underground comics, Art Bruto, Dada, and, most importantly, is inspired, playful, smart and humorous. The Enver culprit envisioned her as 4 issues of newspapers merged to Art Book. In addition to comics and illustrations, there are also stories that mark the curve's tendency to experiment. Stripokok 2 Davor Schunka is full of social connotations even though they are the main characters of an animal with a human character. Unlike wise animals in all known fables, these Schunk's strive to live and build social relationships just like human. / Osamotne okolnosti Envera Krivca knjiga je posve neobična, neusporediva i s jednom drugom objavljenom u našim krajevima ali zato bogata heterogenim utjecajima američkih underground stripova, art bruta, dade i, što je najvažnije, nadahnuta je, zaigrana, pametna i duhovita. Enver Krivac zamislio ju je kao 4 broja novina spojena u art book. Uz stripove i ilustracije u njoj su i priče koje obilježava Krivčeva sklonost eksperimentu. Stripokok 2 Davora Schunka pun je društvenih konotacija iako su u njemu glavni likovi životinje s ljudskim karakterom. Za razliku od mudrih životinja u svima znanim basnama, ove Schunkove nastoje živjeti i izgraditi društvene odnose baš poput ljudskih.

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: We dedicate the show to the new production of the Opera Mila Gojsalic Jakov Gotovac, which premiered this May at the Croatian National Theater in Split. It is the third Croatian national opera of heroic character after Zajc's Zrinjski and Lisinski Porin, created according to the legend of a young Poljicanka who saved her people from the entrance of the Turks. She tucked into the tent Mehmed Topan-pasha and in the style of biblical Judite used her attraction to kill the enemy. In doing so, she threw a burning torch in a gunpowder stock and was killed in the explosion that followed. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Ilica project organizers: QART - In their attempt to revive the forgotten city shops, desolate streets, squares and neglected yards - they reached for jazz, because there is probably no music that more and better than Jazz spreads positive energy, which provoked, asks for action and reaction, both musicians and audiences. And the audience is - the citizens themselves, random passers -by or rare intentional. In three days, the whole neighborhood revived, British Square and part of Ilica from Kacic to Medulic. Waiters, and traders, players and performers also came out on the street. In addition to the performance of singer Maja Rivic in British Square, the birthday of the Academy of Fine Arts celebrated, at which Davor Križić Experiment performed. From the evening to the evening there were various performers, and the Quartet of guitarist Pavel Miljenović premiered the materials from the newly recorded new album. The gig on the street is common to all major cities of the world, many musicians first proved themselves in front of ruthless street passers -by that only good music can make them stop. That pausing is the meaning of what is called Community Art. Artists go out to the street, refine space, and in direct communication with citizens in some ways, and they themselves work for some kind of artists - artists in survival. In addition to the project musicians and the authors of the project, look at the show on the streets on the streets, writers Josip Novakovich and Damir Karakas. / Organizatori projekta Ilica: Qart - u svom pokušaju oživljavanja zaboravljenih gradskih trgovina, pustih ulica, trgova i zapuštenih dvorišta - posegnuli su za jazzom, jer vjerojatno nema glazbe koja više i bolje od jazza širi pozitivnu energiju, koja provocira, traži i akciju i reakciju, kako muzičara tako i publike. A publika su - sami građani, slučajni prolaznici ili rijetki namjernici. U tri dana cijeli je kvart oživio, Britanski trg i dio Ilice od Kačićeve do Medulićeve. Na ulicu su izašli i konobari, i trgovci, i svirači i performeri. Uz nastup trija pjevačice Maje Rivić na Britanskom trgu, slavio se rođendan Akademije likovnih umjetnosti, na kojem je nastupio Davor Križić eksperiment. Iz večeri u večer izmjenjivali su se razni izvođači, a kvartet gitarista Pavla Miljenovića premijerno je izveo materijale s tek snimljenog novog albuma. Svirka na ulici zajednička je svim velikim gradovima svijeta, mnogi su se glazbenici prvo dokazivali pred nemilosrdnim uličnim prolaznicima koje samo dobra glazba može natjerati da zastanu. To zastajkivanje i jest smisao onoga što se naziva Community Art. Umjetnici izlaze na ulicu, oplemenjuju prostor, i u izravnoj komunikaciji s građanima na neki način i od njih samih rade svojevrsne umjetnike - umjetnike u preživljavanju. Uz glazbenike i autore projekta, u emisiji pogledajte što o svom iskustvu sviranja na ulicama govore književnici Josip Novakovich i Damir Karakaš.

programme.title: New Egypt between luxury and repression / Novi Egipat između raskoši i represije
programme.desc: Egypt, a country of multi -fat civilization that boasts a rich archeological heritage and an unusual beauty of the Nile River, was once a favorite tourist destination. But behind the view as a postcard hides an unprecedented repression, exposed to its 110 million inhabitants. Hope in change and freedom, born in protests at Tahrir Square in 2011, was quickly suffocated. At the head of the state is Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, a retired military official who has been ruling an egypt steel hand for eight years. He wants to turn Egypt into another Dubai and attract investors and rich tourists with luxury villas, imposing business buildings and huge shopping malls that are coming everywhere. His latest project is the new capital in the middle of the desert, six times larger than Paris, whose construction will cost almost 50 billion euros. But not all benefits from Sisi's vision of modern Egypt. About 30% of the population lives with less than two dollars a day - to survive, some even live in cemeteries like El -Araf in the Cairo capital. In this necropolis, hundreds of thousands of people sleep among the graves of ancestors. It's a real city in the city - there are shops and even school. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi is a terrifying opponent and ignoring the poor. One of the symbols of this oppression is Alaa Abd El-Fattah, the leader of the rebellion in Tahrir Square. The 40 -year -old blogger has spent most of the eight years behind bars. We met with his mother, Lail Soueif, activist for human rights, and his sister Sana, a refugee who lives in London and does everything to turn / Egipat, zemlja višetisućljetne civilizacije koja se diči bogatom arheološkom baštinom i nesvakidašnjom ljepotom rijeke Nil, nekada je bio omiljeno turističko odredište. No iza vizura kao s razglednica krije se neviđena represija kojoj je izloženo njegovih 110 milijuna stanovnika. Nada u promjene i slobodu, rođena u prosvjedima na trgu Tahrir 2011. godine, brzo je ugušena. Na čelu države je Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi, umirovljeni vojni dužnosnik koji vlada Egiptom čeličnom rukom već osam godina. On želi Egipat pretvoriti u drugi Dubai te privući investitore i bogate turiste luksuznim vilama, impozantnim poslovnim zgradama i golemim trgovačkim centrima koji niču posvuda. Njegov je najnoviji projekt novi glavni grad usred pustinje, šest puta veći od Pariza, čija će izgradnja stajati gotovo 50 milijardi eura. No nemaju svi koristi od Sisijeve vizije modernog Egipta. Oko 30% stanovništva živi s manje od dva dolara dnevno - da bi preživjeli, neki čak žive na grobljima poput El-Arafa u glavnom gradu Kairu. U ovoj nekropoli stotine tisuća ljudi spava među grobovima predaka. To je pravi grad u gradu - ima trgovine pa čak i školu. Abdul-Fattah as-Sisi vlada zastrašujući oponente i ignorirajući siromašne. Jedan od simbola ovog ugnjetavanja je Alaa Abd el-Fattah, vođa pobune na trgu Tahrir. 40 godišnji bloger proteklih je osam godina većinom proveo iza rešetaka. Sastali smo se s njegovom majkom, Lailom Soueif, aktivisticom za ljudska prava te njegovom sestrom Sanaom, izbjeglicom koja živi u Londonu i čini sve da skrene

programme.title: Does Indonesia sink into your own downfall? / Tone li Indonezija u vlastitu propast?
programme.desc: Indonesia is obsessed with uncontrolled exploitation of its natural resources. Because of this, it sinks into an environmental failure from which they may no longer be able to recover. On the islands that used to be biodiversity, mines and factories replaced the forests. Local fishermen can catch almost nothing, and the sea is black for pollution. Industrials destroy the jungle and do not pay attention to the environment. This also threatens the survival of a tribe that has not had any contact with civilization so far. Indonesia is also one of the first countries to hit global warming. The capital Jakarti is threatened with an increase in sea level. The city is slowly sinking, and residents are struggling with floods. The government decided to build a new capital on the island of Bornea from the ground up. The huge construction venture has already begun. They tear down forests and displace the whole villages. We will get to know the gift, an activist who has been fighting plastic contamination for 15 years, which many factories have been used as fuel. Plastic micro -host not only contaminate air but also food. Although the import of plastic is banned in 2019, thousands of tons of that waste continue illegally arriving from Europe, South Korea and Canada. / Indonezija je opsjednuta nekontroliranim iskorištavanjem svojih prirodnih resursa. Zbog toga tone u ekološku propast od koje se više možda neće moći oporaviti. Na otocima koji su nekoć bili oaze bioraznolikosti, rudnici i tvornice zamijenili su šume. Mjesni ribari ne mogu uloviti gotovo ništa, a more je crno zbog onečišćenja. Industrijalci uništavaju džunglu i pri tome se ne obaziru na okoliš. Time ugrožavaju i preživljavanje plemena koja do sada nisu imala nikakav dodir s civilizacijom. Indonezija je i jedna od prvih zemalja koje je pogodilo globalno zatopljenje. Glavnom gradu Jakarti prijeti porast razine mora. Grad polako tone, a stanovnici se bore s poplavama. Vlada je odlučila iz temelja sagraditi novi glavni grad na otoku Borneu. Golemi građevinski pothvat već je počeo. Ruše šume i raseljavaju cijela sela. Upoznat ćemo Daru, aktivisticu koja se već 15 godina bori protiv onečišćenja plastikom, koju mnoge tvornice rabe kao gorivo. Mikročestice plastike ne onečišćuju samo zrak, nego i hranu. Iako je uvoz plastike zabranjen 2019., tisuće tona tog otpada i dalje ilegalno pristižu iz Europe, Južne Koreje i Kanade.

programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: Where the helmets are not angry, the house is not tight, the old proverb and everyday life of the Dulic family from Vojvodina hamlet Djurdjin not far from Subotica. Behind the clear and Zdenka is 16 years of harmonious marriage, admittedly full of renunciation, because they were to be placed on their feet of their eight children. The modest, hardworking, organized mom and dad Dulici live day by day, but find time for themselves. Darko's Novi Sadjani imagines his hometown as a place where people will bind to identity - equally spatial and emotional. He imagines him as an environment where he cares for the rich legacy of the ancestors harmoniously slammed into modern life -threatening. Darko is an architect and urbanist and knows every corner of the new one now that he prefers to visit. I call the Claudius a Vojvodian celebrity, and when you hear it, you will understand why. Mother of the three teenagers, wife, entrepreneur, graduate pedagogue ... There are a number of interests of this stood of Petrovaradin who proudly emphasize her Croatian roots. Music also came up with childhood Darko number two from our story. Parents thought that she would live from the piano playing, but she won the love of another kind of art. Darko is designing and designing posters, collaborating with theaters in Croatia, and at the Novi Sad Academy of Fine Arts, he teaches some new kids that Pannonian sailor Djordje Balasevic sang about. The editor of the series: Silvija Trnčević / Gdje čeljad nije bijesna, ni kuća nije tijesna, stara je poslovica i svakodnevica obitelji Dulić iz vojvođanskog zaseoka Đurđina nedaleko od Subotice. Iza Jasne i Zdenka 16 je godina skladnoga braka, doduše punog odricanja, jer trebalo je postaviti na noge njihovo osmero djece. Skromni, radišni, organizirani mama i tata Dulići žive dan po dan, ali nalaze vremena samo za sebe. Novosađanin Darko zamišlja svoj rodni grad kao mjesto gdje će se ljudi vezati za identitet - podjednako prostorni i emocionalni. Zamišlja ga kao sredinu gdje se mari za bogatu ostavštinu predaka skladno ušuškanu u moderne životne tekovine. Darko je arhitekt i urbanist i dobro poznaje svaki kutak Novoga Sada koji najradije obilazi biciklom. Klaudiju nazivaju vojvođanskim slavujem, a kada ju čujete, bit će vam jasno zašto. Majka troje tinejdžera, supruga, poduzetnica, diplomirana pedagoginja... poduži je niz interesa ove stasite Petrovaradinke koja ponosno ističe svoje hrvatske korijene. Glazba se provlačila i djetinjstvom Darka broj dva iz naše priče. Mislili su roditelji da će živjeti od sviranja klavira no pobijedila je ljubav prema drugoj vrsti umjetnosti. Darko osmišljava i dizajnira plakate, surađuje s kazalištima u Hrvatskoj, a na novosadskoj Likovnoj akademiji predaje nekim novim klincima o kojima je pjevao panonski mornar Đorđe Balašević. programme.title: My way / Moj put
programme.desc: Where the helmets are not angry, the house is not tight, the old proverb and everyday life of the Dulic family from Vojvodina hamlet Djurdjin not far from Subotica. Behind the clear and Zdenka is 16 years of harmonious marriage, admittedly full of renunciation, because they were to be placed on their feet of their eight children. The modest, hardworking, organized mom and dad Dulici live day by day, but find time for themselves. Darko's Novi Sadjani imagines his hometown as a place where people will bind to identity - equally spatial and emotional. He imagines him as an environment where he cares for the rich legacy of the ancestors harmoniously slammed into modern life -threatening. Darko is an architect and urbanist and knows every corner of the new one now that he prefers to visit. I call the Claudius a Vojvodian celebrity, and when you hear it, you will understand why. Mother of the three teenagers, wife, entrepreneur, graduate pedagogue ... There are a number of interests of this stood of Petrovaradin who proudly emphasize her Croatian roots. Music also came up with childhood Darko number two from our story. Parents thought that she would live from the piano playing, but she won the love of another kind of art. Darko is designing and designing posters, collaborating with theaters in Croatia, and at the Novi Sad Academy of Fine Arts, he teaches some new kids that Pannonian sailor Djordje Balasevic sang about. The editor of the series: Silvija Trnčević / Gdje čeljad nije bijesna, ni kuća nije tijesna, stara je poslovica i svakodnevica obitelji Dulić iz vojvođanskog zaseoka Đurđina nedaleko od Subotice. Iza Jasne i Zdenka 16 je godina skladnoga braka, doduše punog odricanja, jer trebalo je postaviti na noge njihovo osmero djece. Skromni, radišni, organizirani mama i tata Dulići žive dan po dan, ali nalaze vremena samo za sebe. Novosađanin Darko zamišlja svoj rodni grad kao mjesto gdje će se ljudi vezati za identitet - podjednako prostorni i emocionalni. Zamišlja ga kao sredinu gdje se mari za bogatu ostavštinu predaka skladno ušuškanu u moderne životne tekovine. Darko je arhitekt i urbanist i dobro poznaje svaki kutak Novoga Sada koji najradije obilazi biciklom. Klaudiju nazivaju vojvođanskim slavujem, a kada ju čujete, bit će vam jasno zašto. Majka troje tinejdžera, supruga, poduzetnica, diplomirana pedagoginja... poduži je niz interesa ove stasite Petrovaradinke koja ponosno ističe svoje hrvatske korijene. Glazba se provlačila i djetinjstvom Darka broj dva iz naše priče. Mislili su roditelji da će živjeti od sviranja klavira no pobijedila je ljubav prema drugoj vrsti umjetnosti. Darko osmišljava i dizajnira plakate, surađuje s kazalištima u Hrvatskoj, a na novosadskoj Likovnoj akademiji predaje nekim novim klincima o kojima je pjevao panonski mornar Đorđe Balašević. Urednica serije: Silvija Trnčević

programme.title: Victory Day and Homeland Thanksgiving / Dan pobjede i domovinske zahvalnosti
programme.desc: On the occasion of the celebration of Victory and Homeland Thanksgiving, Croatian Veterans Day and the 30th anniversary of the VRO Storm, Croatian Television brings a special show that will be transmitted live from Knin on the first and fourth program of Croatian Television. The editor is Ana Jelinic, and Branko Nadjvinski as editor and presenter of the transmission will comment on the most important events from the military-police operation Storm and the Homeland War. The guests are Ph.D. Ante Nazor, Director of the Croatian Memorial and Documentation Center of the Homeland War, General Mirko Sundov, former Chief of General Staff of the CAF and Brigadier General Zdravko Jakop, from the University of Defense and Security Dr. Franjo Tudjman. Our reporters Borka Juras Slamic, Anamarija Skoric, Edi Skovrlj and Petar Vlahov will appear from Knin with the participants of Storm and the defenders. We will get involved live with three positions: Knin Fortress, the City Square of Ante Starcevic and the NK Dinara football stadium, where a central celebration will be held. We also bring the reports of our journalists about the days of Storm and the defenders who participated in it and a reminder of those who donated their own lives. / U povodu obilježavanja Dana pobjede i domovinske zahvalnosti, Dana hrvatskih branitelja te 30. obljetnice VRO Oluja, Hrvatska televizija donosi posebnu emisiju koja će se prenositi uživo iz Knina na Prvome i Četvrtome programu Hrvatske televizije. Urednica je Ana Jelinić, a Branko Nađvinski kao urednik i voditelj prijenosa s gostima će komentirati najvažnije događaje iz vojno-redarstvene operacije Oluja i Domovinskog rata. Gosti su dr. sc. Ante Nazor, ravnatelj Hrvatskog memorijalno-dokumentacijskog centra Domovinskog rata, general Mirko Šundov, bivši načelnik Glavnog stožera OSRH i brigadni general Zdravko Jakop, sa Sveučilišta obrane i sigurnosti dr. Franjo Tuđman. Naši reporteri Borka Juras Slamić, Anamarija Škorić, Edi Škovrlj i Petar Vlahov javljat će se iz Knina sa sudionicima Oluje i braniteljima. Uključit ćemo se uživo s tri pozicije: kninske tvrđave, gradskog Trga Ante Starčevića i nogometnog stadiona NK Dinara, gdje će se održati središnja proslava. Donosimo i reportaže naših novinara o danima Oluje i braniteljima koji su u njoj sudjelovali te podsjetnik na one koji su darovali vlastiti život.

programme.title: Studio 4: Area 360 / Studio 4: Zona 360
programme.desc: We will talk about the Association of Persons with Physical Disability of Tomes from Trogir. The association was founded in 1988 and has since been promoted to many projects with the quality of life of people with disabilities as well as their families. There are currently 78 employees, 262 members and 16 volunteers. Representatives of the Association, President of Ivica Bašić and Project Manager Zvonka Gulišija will talk about the meaning of social entrepreneurship, the Center for Social Inclusion, a half -day stay and a personal assistance, a home assistance project, an orthopedic aids, physical and sensory therapy. There will also talk about humanitarian actions and volunteer projects. In the last 20 years, my light for Vukovar has been raised about 100,000 euros for the families of the City of Vukovar. / Govorit ćemo o Udruzi osoba s tjelesnim invaliditetom TOMS iz Trogira. Udruga je osnovana 1988. godine i otada brojnim projektima unapređuje kvalitetu života osoba s invaliditetom, kao i njihovih obitelji. Trenutačno ima 78 zaposlenika, 262 člana i 16 volontera. Predstavnici udruge, predsjednik Ivica Bašić i voditeljica projekata Zvonka Gulišija govorit će o značenjuju socijalnog poduzetništva, o Centru za socijalnu inkluziju, poludnevnom boravku i osobnoj asistenciji, projektu pomoći u kući, posudionici ortopedskih pomagala, fizikalnoj i senzornoj terapiji. Bit će riječi i o humanitarnim akcijama i volonterskim projektima. Akcijom Moje svjetlo za Vukovar u posljednjih 20 godina prikupljeno je oko 100.000 eura za obitelji grada Vukovara.

programme.title: Romano Bolkovic - 1 on 1 / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1
programme.desc: Kresimir Dolencic in Zagreb graduated from Pavao Markovac High School of Music and Classical High School and graduated from the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb in 1988. The theater began to be involved in high school, and together with several colleagues, today very distinguished actors, on the first year of the Academy of the Academy of Lift (lying and fantastic theater). Istaknuli su se hit predstavom Držićeva Dunda Maroja na Dubrovačkim ljetnim igrama. After his studies, he directs in numerous theaters, at the Dubrovnik Summer Games, Split Summer, Rijeka Summer Nights, Histrical Summer and many theater festivals. Do sada je postavio više od šezdeset dramskih predstava na tekstove domaćih i svjetskih dramatičara. Some of his greatest success are plays in various dialects (Kajkavian, Chakavian, Dubrovnik, Hvar, Krka, Vlach, Međimurje ...). Posebno ga zanima i inspirira hrvatski kajkavski jezik. He laid over sixty music and stage works of Verdi, Puccinni, Mozart, Offenbach, Stravinsky, Donizetti, Gotovac, Zajc, Tijardovic, Bradic, Berse and many others in Croatia, Slovenia, England, England, America and China. Kazalištem se počinje baviti još u gimnaziji, a zajedno s još nekoliko kolega, danas vrlo uglednih glumaca, na prvoj godini Akademije osniva kazališnu družinu LIFT (Lažljivi i fantastični teatar). Istaknuli su se hit predstavom Držićeva Dunda Maroja na Dubrovačkim ljetnim igrama. Nakon studiranja režira u mnogobrojnim kazalištima, na Dubrovačkim ljetnim igrama, Splitskom ljetu, Riječkim ljetnim noćima, Histrionskom ljetu i mnogim kazališnim festivalima. Do sada je postavio više od šezdeset dramskih predstava na tekstove domaćih i svjetskih dramatičara. Neki od njegovih najvećih uspjeha su predstave na raznim dijalektima (kajkavski, čakavski, dubrovački, jezik Hvara, Krka, vlaški, međimurski...). Posebno ga zanima i inspirira hrvatski kajkavski jezik. Kao Fulbrightov stipendist predavao je glumu studentima pjevanja i diplomantima na uglednom Rice Universityju u Houstonu, na Trinity College of Music u Londonu, kao i na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu, gdje je i postavio suvremenu Kuljerićevu operu Animal Farm u čast 100. godišnjice te ustanove. Representatives of the Association, President of Ivica Bašić and Project Manager Zvonka Gulišija will talk about the meaning of social entrepreneurship, the Center for Social Inclusion, a half -day stay and a personal assistance, a home assistance project, an orthopedic aids, physical and sensory therapy. There will also talk about humanitarian actions and volunteer projects. In the last 20 years, my light for Vukovar has been raised about 100,000 euros for the families of the City of Vukovar. / Govorit ćemo o Udruzi osoba s tjelesnim invaliditetom TOMS iz Trogira. Udruga je osnovana 1988. godine i otada brojnim projektima unapređuje kvalitetu života osoba s invaliditetom, kao i njihovih obitelji. Trenutačno ima 78 zaposlenika, 262 člana i 16 volontera. Predstavnici udruge, predsjednik Ivica Bašić i voditeljica projekata Zvonka Gulišija govorit će o značenjuju socijalnog poduzetništva, o Centru za socijalnu inkluziju, poludnevnom boravku i osobnoj asistenciji, projektu pomoći u kući, posudionici ortopedskih pomagala, fizikalnoj i senzornoj terapiji. Bit će riječi i o humanitarnim akcijama i volonterskim projektima. Akcijom Moje svjetlo za Vukovar u posljednjih 20 godina prikupljeno je oko 100.000 eura za obitelji grada Vukovara.

Kad, nakon zajedničke večere, Saša konačno napiše poražavajuću recenziju za skorojevićevski restoran, pokrenut će lavinu događaja koji će ga natjerati da se konačno suoči sa samim sobom i barem pokuša zaštititi ono do čega mu je najviše stalo...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Marko Polo and the traditional Moreška dance made Korcula world famous. Its history can be monitored for 20,000 years, and we have found evidence in the Vela Cave. There are also those large flooded caves that were safely on the dry age. We start to discover the secrets of the Korcula underwater. In the south itself, from Lumbarda, we are looking for a cantari who spawn on the Cape Razhnic. The town of Korcula is a small island Dubrovnik. Full of history, stone towers, walls, churches and villas. The islets, the most famous of which is Badija with the monastery, but also a quarry with a quarry that was an important place of the island economy, when it was built with stone. The diversity and wealth of submarine habitats and life forms lead us to an unusual dive in which we study the movement of animals. The unexpected movement when shells swim, the fish walk, the octopus crawls to all eight arms. Animals you thought were not moving at all can be surprised to be fast. Expert associates: prof. Ivan Jardas, Ph.D. Leon Grubišić, mr. Petar Kružić and Flora Expert Ph.D. Nenad Jasprica Chief Diver: Drazen Ćurković Divers: Miljenko Marukić, Denis Teković, Mijo Knezović, Ivo Srsen, Pavica Sršen, Zorana Andrić, Vlado Brozović / Marko Polo i tradicionalni ples moreška učinili su Korčulu svjetski poznatom. Njezina povijest može se pratiti već 20.000 godina, a dokaze tomu pronašli smo u Veloj špilji. Ima i onih velikih potopljenih špilja koje su sigurno za ledenog doba bile na suhom. Od njih krećemo u otkrivanje tajni korčulanskog podmorja. Na samom jugu, iz Lumbarde, krećemo u potragu za kantarima koji se mrijeste na rtu Ražnjić. Grad Korčula je mali otočki Dubrovnik. Prepun povijesti, kamenih kula, zidina, crkava i vila. Do njega su otočići, od kojih je najpoznatija Badija sa samostanom, ali i Vrnik s kamenolomom koji je bio važno mjesto otočkog gospodarstva, kad se gradilo kamenom. Raznolikost i bogatstvo podmorskih staništa i životnih oblika vodi nas u neobičan zaron u kojem proučavamo kretanje životinja. Ono neočekivano kretanje kad školjke plivaju, ribe hodaju, hobotnica puže na svih osam krakova. Životinje za koje ste mislili da se uopće ne kreću znaju biti iznenađujeće brze. Stručni suradnici: prof. dr. Ivan Jardas, dr. sc. Leon Grubišić, mr. Petar Kružić te stručnjak za floru dr. sc. Nenad Jasprica Glavni ronilac: Dražen Ćurković Ronioci: Miljenko Marukić, Denis Teković, Mijo Knezović, Ivo Sršen, Pavica Sršen, Zorana Andrić, Vlado Brozović

programme.desc: The stone cliffs of the tanks of the tank on the island of Krk are overgrown with not only corals, but also to one of the most beautiful sponges in the Adriatic. Haliclon Mediterranea is reminiscent of a group of sponge funnels and unlike a transparent mantle that lives here attached to the stone bottom, it does not reveal its inner structure. / Kamene litice pličine Tenki na otoku Krku obrasle su ne samo koraljima, već i jednom od najljepših spužvi u Jadranu. programme.title: Stani in Zagorje / Stani v Zagorju
programme.desc: Kumrovec, the most famous village in the world. Formerly a modern tourist place and an elite educational center, today left to collapse, but still a favorite destination for Chinese tourists. Which is not surprising if we look at the mockery of the Apollo Space Station in Tito's villa, which he received as a gift from NASA just a few months after descending the moon. His architectural legacy has been decaying for years, while anecdotes live in the memories of the inhabitants. / Kumrovec, najpoznatije selo na svijetu. Nekad suvremeno turističko mjesto i elitni obrazovni centar, danas prepušteno propadanju, no i dalje omiljena destinacija kineskih turista. Što i ne čudi ako pogledamo maketu svemirske postaje Apollo u Titovoj vili koju je dobio na dar od NASA-e samo nekoliko mjeseci nakon spuštanja na Mjesec. Njegova arhitektonska ostavština godinama propada, dok anegdote žive u sjećanjima stanovnika.

programme.title: The sunny side of Prisavlje / Sunčana strana Prisavlja

programme.title: Positively / Pozitivno

programme.title: Let's meet Croatia - dive with us / Upoznajmo Hrvatsku - Zaronite s nama
programme.desc: The fishing ship ended, not too long ago, his trip near Gradac. In order to reach his wreck and recognize the fodder, the commanding bridge and bow of the ship, we dived into blue to a depth of 40 meters. / Ribarski brod okončao je, ne tako davno, svoje putovanje u blizini Gradca. Da bismo došli do njegove olupine i raspoznali krmu, zapovjedni most i pramac broda, zaronili smo u plavo do dubine od 40 metara.

programme.title: Mamutica / Mamutica
programme.desc: Fine lady Magdalena and director Hrvoje are older in love with a couple who lives together in harmony and happiness. Idila interrupts Suddenly Magdalena's suicide. Former Inspector Bozo learns that Magdalen's son -in -law is in tight business relationships with the current owner of Magdalen's villa in Opatija, nationalized after World War II. Who will go out as a life winner? Does the accident bring anyone happiness? / Prsten sudbine je drama o dve sestre, Anji i Jani, čije živote iz korena menja teška saobraćajna nesreća. programme.title: Black rose / Crna ruža

programme.title: Indie Intro / Indie Intro
programme.desc: Beneath the sweet cream of AAA games, giant marketing budgets and titles for which your parents heard, and maybe play them, the right sea of creativity, originality and pure spirit of video. programme.title: Pets Klub / Pets klub
programme.desc: Nina was founded by the Pets Club with Oscar, Team and the dog Marlu. This secret club asked himself the task of finding all the lost animals: furry, crumbs, even those who just sniffle and sneak around, and return them to their neouthest young owners. Our young heroes need to juggle with school life, extracurricular activities (those who consider parents very fun, such as piano and ballet classes) and conducting the investment of the Pets Club. You certainly realize that to become an expert for something when you only have seven or eight years old is not the easiest thing in the world. But our four young heroes are methodical in their investigations and together have skills to always find that lost pet. / Nina je osnovala Pets klub sa Oskarom, Timom i psom Marluom. Ovaj tajni klub postavio je sebi zadatak da nađe sve izgubljene životinje: krznene, čupave, čak i one koje samo njuškaju i šunjaju se okolo, i vrati ih njihovim neutešnim mladim vlasnicima. Naši mladi heroji moraju da žongliraju školskim životom, vannastavnim aktivnostima (onim koje roditelji smatraju vrlo zabavnim, poput časova klavira i baleta) i vođenjem istrage Pets kluba. Sigurno shvatate da postati stručnjak za nešto kada imate samo sedam ili osam godina nije najlakša stvar na svetu. Ali naša četiri mlada heroja su metodična u svojim istragama i zajedno imaju veštine da uvek nađu tog izgubljenog ljubimca.

programme.title: The streets of the puzzle / Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Strange things happen in London. Only one animal is capable of confronting these enigms bordering with supernatural: hamster detective named Klever. It is endowed with an extraordinary sense of observation and logical conclusion that leave ordinary animals without words. But sometimes things don't go according to plan ... then he can count on his temperamental little brother Bro, who is always ready to take the risk and attack opponents much greater than himself. Will they manage to solve these cases that continue to confuse Scotland Jard? / Čudne stvari se dešavaju u Londonu. Samo jedna životinja je sposobna da se suoči s tim enigmama koje se graniče sa natprirodnim: hrčak detektivka po imenu Klever. Ona je obdarena izvanrednim smislom za posmatranje i logičko zaključivanje koji ostavljaju obične životinje bez reči. Ali ponekad stvari ne idu po planu... Tada može da računa na svog temperamentnog malog brata Broa, koji je uvek spreman da preuzme rizik i napadne protivnike mnogo veće od sebe. Da li će uspeti da reše ove slučajeve koji i dalje zbunjuju Skotland Jard?

programme.title: Chatty cat Tom and friends / Brbljivi Mačak Tom i Prijatelji
programme.desc: There are big changes in the lives of Tom and Angel when they finally decide to be together! But will Romans spoil everything and his friends? Even if that doesn't happen, they seem to be certainly in trouble, because the director decided to have a lot of their startup in his garage ... and now he intended to destroy them! The risk is getting greater, and the action is all tense as Tom goes to town to save their company and keep their friends. / Dolaze velike promene u živote Toma i Anđele kada napokon odluče da budu zajedno! programme.title: Sisters / Sestre
programme.desc: Two sisters. Two explosive personalities. Under one roof. The sister's comedy about the daily life of two sisters, one of which has 7 and the second 13 years. Marin is still a child, while her older sister Vendi enters the teenage years. Both are temperamental, very different personalities and adore! Marin is naive, cute, very hyperactive and very attack. She always thinks crazy ideas to attract their sister's attention, while the Vendi is more difficult to live an adult. This comedy of the character is about the brotherhood / nursing. / Dve sestre. Dve eksplozivne ličnosti. Pod jednim krovom. Sestre je komedija o svakodnevnom životu dve sestre, od kojih jedna ima 7, a druga 13 godina. Marin je i dalje dete, dok njena starija sestra Vendi ulazi u tinejdžerske godine. Obe su temperamentne, veoma različite ličnosti i obožavaju se! Marin je naivna, simpatična, veoma hiperaktivna i veoma napadna. Ona uvek smišlja lude ideje da bi privukla pažnju svoje sestre, dok Vendi više teži životu odrasle osobe. Ova komedija karaktera govori o bratstvu/sestrinstvu.

programme.title: Jeronim Stilton / Džeronimo Stilton
programme.desc: Jaronimo is Mr. Mouse, who, in addition to loving his job and his family, adores collecting old cheese crust from the eighteenth century. He hates traveling because every trip, whether by boat, car or plane, causes nausea ... programme.title: The streets of the puzzle / Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Strange things happen in London. Only one animal is capable of confronting these enigms bordering with supernatural: hamster detective named Klever. It is endowed with an extraordinary sense of observation and logical conclusion that leave ordinary animals without words. But sometimes things don't go according to plan ... then he can count on his temperamental little brother Bro, who is always ready to take the risk and attack opponents much greater than himself. Will they manage to solve these cases that continue to confuse Scotland Jard? / Čudne stvari se dešavaju u Londonu. Ona je obdarena izvanrednim smislom za posmatranje i logičko zaključivanje koji ostavljaju obične životinje bez reči. Ali ponekad stvari ne idu po planu... Da li će uspeti da reše ove slučajeve koji i dalje zbunjuju Skotland Jard?
