Sukob generacija, klasne i seksualne razlike, neuređeni životi i fantastične replike čine ovu seriju fantastičnom...

programme.title: The voice of the heart / Glas srca
programme.desc: Young teacher Elizabeth Tacher (Erin Krakow), used to living in a high society, go to work in Koal Valej, a town in Western Canada, in which most citizens live from the work in the coal mine. Although the lifetime is simple, it is still full of challenges. When Elizabeth Her husband suddenly dies, charming, now a single mother, the school teacher Elizabeth must go through life itself. Very quickly, she fostered almost all the locals, by the Assistant Sheriff, who believes that Tacher's father's father guilty what he stuck in town, just to protect his daughter, who must learn to live in the Canadian Prairia Provincial town. The town still adapts to a new time, fast changes and the temp of living that modern life brings. Elizabina is the best friend and mentor is Abigeil Stanton, Mayor and Painting Cafes. Abigail is also a widow and a single mother, which went through hard times and became a favorite person in the spot. The city lives and always employed by Rozmari Kalter, for which everyone in jokes say he has a theatrical performance such as a shoutrl with Broadway, and her patient husband, a reputable businessman Leland Culture. The sheriff Bill Averi is working hard on the city protection and strengthening its position as the largest authority. The Lekar town is dr. Karson Šepard, who passes through personal challenges in life and love, while new inhabitants are Mountie Natan Grant and the mysterious gambler Lukas Boušard. And while Elizabeth teaches children in Hope Vali Many will try to seduce her, but she remains focused on his child. / Mlada učiteljica Elizabet Tačer (Erin Krakov), navikla na život u visokom društvu, odlazi raditi u Koal Valej, gradić u zapadnoj Kanadi, u kojem većina građana živi od rada u rudniku uglja. Iako je život meštana jednostavan, ipak je pun izazova. Kada Elizabetin suprug iznenada pogine, šarmantna, sada samohrana majka, školska učiteljica Elizabeta mora sama ići kroz život. Vrlo brzo ona očara gotovo sve meštane, osim pomoćnika šerifa, Džeka Torntona (Daniel Lising), koji veruje da je Tačerin bogati otac kriv šta je on zapeo u gradiću, samo da bi štitio njegovu kćerku, koja mora naučiti živeti u provincijskom gradiću kanadske prerije. Gradić se ipak prilagođava novom vremenu, brzim promenama i tempu življenja koje moderni život donosi. Elizabetina najbolja prijateljica i mentorica je Abigejl Stanton, gradonačelnica i vlasnica kafića. Abigejl je također udovica i samohrana majka, koja je prošla kroz teška vremena i postala omiljena osoba u mestu. U gradu živi i uvek zaposlena Rozmari Kulter, za koju svi u šali kažu da ima teatralni nastup poput neke šougrl sa Brodveja, te njezin strpljivi suprug, ugledni biznismen Leland Kulter. Šerif Bil Averi naporno radi na zaštiti grada i učvršćivanju svoje pozicije kao najvećeg autoriteta. Lekar gradića je dr. Karson Šepard, koji prolazi kroz lične izazove u životu i ljubavi, dok su novi stanovnici Mountie Natan Grant i tajanstveni kockar Lukas Boušard. I dok Elizabeta podučava decu u Hope Valiju mnogi će je pokušati zavesti, no ona ostaje usredotočena na svoje dete.

programme.title: Killer from the lake / Ubica s jezera
programme.desc: Cops Lisa and Klovic met three years ago near the lake, while researching the disappearance of a young teenager. Their job took them somewhere else, on the banks of the second lake: Anesy, where they face a challenge of a new family life with his nine-month son Tom. While the couple takes over a demanding new investigation, Klovis gets secret calls and scary visions - and begins to discover the dark side. On top of everything, the corpses of two women were found, one after the other. Lisa and Klovis don't doubt: It's the work of the serial killer. This is again a painful memories for Lisa, which must face its past while Klovis faces its own demons. But the two of them will have to join and work as a team if they want to succeed in finding a killer ... / Policajci Lisa i Klovis upoznali su se pre tri godine u blizini jezera, dok su istraživali nestanak mladog tinejdžera. Njihov posao ih je odveo negde drugde, na obale drugog jezera: Anesi, gde se suočavaju s izazovom novog porodičnog života sa svojim devetomesečnim sinom Tomom. Dok par preuzima zahtevnu novu istragu, Klovis dobiva tajne pozive i zastrašujuće vizije - i počinje otkrivati mračnu stranu. Povrh svega, upravo su pronađeni leševi dve žene, jedan za drugim. Lisa i Klovis ne sumnjaju: to je delo serijskog ubice. Ovo ponovo budi bolna sećanja za Lise, koja se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću dok se Klovis suočava sa sopstvenim demonima. Ali njih dvoje će se morati udružiti i raditi kao tim ako žele uspeti pronaći ubicu...

programme.title: Four venues and funerals / Četiri venčanja i sahrana
programme.desc: Maja, boss communication Senator campaign in New York, gets a call for a wedding from a college friend who now lives in London. May leave his business and private life in New York to travel to England and connected with old friends, but there are their personal life crises. The links are established and terminated, political scandals are exposed, social life in London is ridiculed, love relationships flourish and vein, and of course, there are four weddings ... and funeral. / Maja, šefica komunikacija senatorske kampanje u Njujorku, dobija poziv za venčanje od prijateljice sa koledža koja sada živi u Londonu. Maja ostavlja svoj poslovni i privatni život u Njujorku da bi otputovala u Englesku i povezala se sa starim prijateljima, ali tamo je dočekaju njihove lične životne krize. Veze se uspostavljaju i raskidaju, politički skandali se razotkrivaju, društveni život u Londonu se ismeva, ljubavne veze cvetaju i venu, a naravno, pred njima su četiri venčanja... i sahrana.

programme.title: Better call the salt pans / Bolje pozovite Sola
programme.desc: The story is located six years ago before Sol Gudman (Bob Odenkirk) met Vilter Vajt. When we meet him, the man who will become salt is now known as Jimmy McGil, an unsuccessful lawyer looking for his destiny, and using tiny scams surviving. In addition to Jimmy, he is Mike Ermantraut, in charge of solving problems, so he is often in conflict with Jimmy. / Priča je smeštena šest godina pre nego je Sol Gudman (Bob Odenkirk) upoznao Voltera Vajta. Kada ga upoznajemo, čovek koji će postati Sol sada je poznat kao Džimi MekGil, neuspešni advokat koji traži svoju sudbinu, i pomoću sitnih prevara preživljava. Uz Džimija se nalazi i Majk Ermantraut (Jonathan Banks), zadužen za rešavanje problema, pa je često u sukobu sa Džimijem.

programme.title: Family Borgia / Porodica Bordžija
programme.desc: Located in Italy for the 15th century, at the time of the peak of Renaissance, the bodies of the corrupt patriarch of Rodrigo Bordžija (Jeremy Irons), during which he commits almost every possible sin to blew and retain power, influence and huge wealth for himself and his family. Rome 1492, the center of Hršćanski sveta and the headquarters of the Papacy. The Pope had the power to crown and overthrow the king and change the course of the empire. Pope Inanocent VIII is on the deathbed, the Church is imbued with corruption, and the series begins when Rodrigo (Irons) becomes a pope, his two macchillistic sons of Cesarea and Juan, as well as the scandalous beautiful daughter of Lucrezia, to the most powerful and the most powerful family of Renaissance Italy. The series is located in one of the most important periods of history: the Renaissance Age and the discoveries of the New World. Bordzia's family was controversial and heretic, not just because they did things that were unheard of at their time, but because they were better than their enemies. He decided to put it urgently from New York to California to try to detect a virus drug in the only remaining laboratory. Although antibodies from that man are the only hope for the medicine, he hides a dark secret that could jeopardize them. / Nekoliko godina otkako je zastrašujući zombi virus poharao SAD, tim ljudi pronašao je čoveka koji je preživeo virus. Odluče ga hitno prebaciti iz Njujorka u Kaliforniju kako bi u jedinoj preostaloj laboratoriji pokušali otkriti lek za virus. Iako su antitela iz tog čoveka jedina nada za lek, on krije mračnu tajnu koja bi ih sve mogla ugroziti.

programme.title: Missing / Nestali
programme.desc: The police unit known as a group of 2 missing persons, under the leadership of the Main Inspector of Santiago Abd deals with cases of missing persons. The unit joins the Sonia Ledesma inspector. In addition to the work of the police, we also monitor police cooperation with the NGO for assistance in cases of missing persons Assistance to the missing, led by the Carmen Fuentes director. / Policijska jedinica poznata pod imenom Grupa 2 nestalih osoba, pod vođstvom glavnog inspektora Santiaga Abada bavi se slučajevima nestalih osoba. Jedinici se pridružuje inspektorica Sonia Ledesma. Osim samog rada policije, pratimo i policijsku saradnju s nevladinom organizacijom za pomoć u slučajevima nestalih osoba Pomoć nestalima, na čelu s direktoricom Carmen Fuentes.

programme.title: The voice of the heart / Glas srca
programme.desc: Young teacher Elizabeth Tacher (Erin Krakow), used to living in a high society, go to work in Koal Valej, a town in Western Canada, in which most citizens live from the work in the coal mine. Although the lifetime is simple, it is still full of challenges. When Elizabeth Her husband suddenly dies, charming, now a single mother, the school teacher Elizabeth must go through life itself. Very quickly, she fostered almost all the locals, by the Assistant Sheriff, who believes that Tacher's father's father guilty what he stuck in town, just to protect his daughter, who must learn to live in the Canadian Prairia Provincial town. The town still adapts to a new time, fast changes and the temp of living that modern life brings. Elizabina is the best friend and mentor is Abigeil Stanton, Mayor and Painting Cafes. Abigail is also a widow and a single mother, which went through hard times and became a favorite person in the spot. The city lives and always employed by Rozmari Kalter, for which everyone in jokes say he has a theatrical performance such as a shoutrl with Broadway, and her patient husband, a reputable businessman Leland Culture. The sheriff Bill Averi is working hard on the city protection and strengthening its position as the largest authority. The Lekar town is dr. Karson Šepard, who passes through personal challenges in life and love, while new inhabitants are Mountie Natan Grant and the mysterious gambler Lukas Boušard. And while Elizabeth teaches children in Hope Vali Many will try to seduce her, but she remains focused on his child. / Mlada učiteljica Elizabet Tačer (Erin Krakov), navikla na život u visokom društvu, odlazi raditi u Koal Valej, gradić u zapadnoj Kanadi, u kojem većina građana živi od rada u rudniku uglja. Iako je život meštana jednostavan, ipak je pun izazova. Kada Elizabetin suprug iznenada pogine, šarmantna, sada samohrana majka, školska učiteljica Elizabeta mora sama ići kroz život. Vrlo brzo ona očara gotovo sve meštane, osim pomoćnika šerifa, Džeka Torntona (Daniel Lising), koji veruje da je Tačerin bogati otac kriv šta je on zapeo u gradiću, samo da bi štitio njegovu kćerku, koja mora naučiti živeti u provincijskom gradiću kanadske prerije. Gradić se ipak prilagođava novom vremenu, brzim promenama i tempu življenja koje moderni život donosi. Elizabetina najbolja prijateljica i mentorica je Abigejl Stanton, gradonačelnica i vlasnica kafića. Abigejl je također udovica i samohrana majka, koja je prošla kroz teška vremena i postala omiljena osoba u mestu. U gradu živi i uvek zaposlena Rozmari Kulter, za koju svi u šali kažu da ima teatralni nastup poput neke šougrl sa Brodveja, te njezin strpljivi suprug, ugledni biznismen Leland Kulter. Šerif Bil Averi naporno radi na zaštiti grada i učvršćivanju svoje pozicije kao najvećeg autoriteta. Lekar gradića je dr. Karson Šepard, koji prolazi kroz lične izazove u životu i ljubavi, dok su novi stanovnici Mountie Natan Grant i tajanstveni kockar Lukas Boušard. I dok Elizabeta podučava decu u Hope Valiju mnogi će je pokušati zavesti, no ona ostaje usredotočena na svoje dete.

programme.title: Killer from the lake / Ubica s jezera
programme.desc: Cops Lisa and Klovic met three years ago near the lake, while researching the disappearance of a young teenager. Their job took them somewhere else, on the banks of the second lake: Anesy, where they face a challenge of a new family life with his nine-month son Tom. While the couple takes over a demanding new investigation, Klovis gets secret calls and scary visions - and begins to discover the dark side. On top of everything, the corpses of two women were found, one after the other. Lisa and Klovis don't doubt: It's the work of the serial killer. This is again a painful memories for Lisa, which must face its past while Klovis faces its own demons. But the two of them will have to join and work as a team if they want to succeed in finding a killer ... / Policajci Lisa i Klovis upoznali su se pre tri godine u blizini jezera, dok su istraživali nestanak mladog tinejdžera. Njihov posao ih je odveo negde drugde, na obale drugog jezera: Anesi, gde se suočavaju s izazovom novog porodičnog života sa svojim devetomesečnim sinom Tomom. Dok par preuzima zahtevnu novu istragu, Klovis dobiva tajne pozive i zastrašujuće vizije - i počinje otkrivati mračnu stranu. Povrh svega, upravo su pronađeni leševi dve žene, jedan za drugim. Lisa i Klovis ne sumnjaju: to je delo serijskog ubice. Ovo ponovo budi bolna sećanja za Lise, koja se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću dok se Klovis suočava sa sopstvenim demonima. Ali njih dvoje će se morati udružiti i raditi kao tim ako žele uspeti pronaći ubicu...

programme.title: Four venues and funerals / Četiri venčanja i sahrana
programme.desc: Maja, boss communication Senator campaign in New York, gets a call for a wedding from a college friend who now lives in London. May leave his business and private life in New York to travel to England and connected with old friends, but there are their personal life crises. The links are established and terminated, political scandals are exposed, social life in London is ridiculed, love relationships flourish and vein, and of course, there are four weddings ... and funeral. / Maja, šefica komunikacija senatorske kampanje u Njujorku, dobija poziv za venčanje od prijateljice sa koledža koja sada živi u Londonu. Maja ostavlja svoj poslovni i privatni život u Njujorku da bi otputovala u Englesku i povezala se sa starim prijateljima, ali tamo je dočekaju njihove lične životne krize. Veze se uspostavljaju i raskidaju, politički skandali se razotkrivaju, društveni život u Londonu se ismeva, ljubavne veze cvetaju i venu, a naravno, pred njima su četiri venčanja... i sahrana.

programme.title: Jerusalem / Jerusalim
programme.desc: Amir is a police officer in the Cosmopolitan district of Jerusalem, deals with daily conflicts between different confessions in order to maintain the CVO status. But when two holy days in the Muslim and Jewish calendar fall on the same day, it seems that, for some, this could be the perfect time to encourage the war. / Amir je policajac u kosmopolitskoj četvrti starog grada Jerusalima, bavi se svakodnevnim sukobima između različitih konfesija kako bi održao privid statusa kvo. Ali, kada dva sveta dana u muslimanskom i jevrejskom kalendaru padaju na isti dan, čini se da bi, za neke, ovo moglo biti savršeno vreme za podsticanje rata.

programme.title: Better call the salt pans / Bolje pozovite Sola
programme.desc: The story is located six years ago before Sol Gudman (Bob Odenkirk) met Vilter Vajt. When we meet him, the man who will become salt is now known as Jimmy McGil, an unsuccessful lawyer looking for his destiny, and using tiny scams surviving. In addition to Jimmy, he is Mike Ermantraut, in charge of solving problems, so he is often in conflict with Jimmy. / Priča je smeštena šest godina pre nego je Sol Gudman (Bob Odenkirk) upoznao Voltera Vajta. Kada ga upoznajemo, čovek koji će postati Sol sada je poznat kao Džimi MekGil, neuspešni advokat koji traži svoju sudbinu, i pomoću sitnih prevara preživljava. Uz Džimija se nalazi i Majk Ermantraut (Jonathan Banks), zadužen za rešavanje problema, pa je često u sukobu sa Džimijem.

programme.title: Family Borgia / Porodica Bordžija
programme.desc: Located in Italy for the 15th century, at the time of the peak of Renaissance, the bodies of the corrupt patriarch of Rodrigo Bordžija (Jeremy Irons), during which he commits almost every possible sin to blew and retain power, influence and huge wealth for himself and his family. Rome 1492, the center of Hršćanski sveta and the headquarters of the Papacy. The Pope had the power to crown and overthrow the king and change the course of the empire. Pope Inanocent VIII is on the deathbed, the Church is imbued with corruption, and the series begins when Rodrigo (Irons) becomes a pope, his two macchillistic sons of Cesarea and Juan, as well as the scandalous beautiful daughter of Lucrezia, to the most powerful and the most powerful family of Renaissance Italy. The series is located in one of the most important periods of history: the Renaissance Age and the discoveries of the New World. Bordzia's family was controversial and heretic, not just because they did things that were unheard of at their time, but because they were better than their enemies. On his way to the set goals of the Borgia families, they will be a literal of each of the seven deaths, and will also think of several own. / Smeštena u Italiju 15-tog veka, u vreme vrhunca renesanse, serija Bordžije govori o usponu korumpiranog patrijarha Rodriga Bordžije (Jeremy Irons) do papinstva, tokom kojeg on počini gotovo svaki mogući greh kako bi zgrnuo i zadržao moć, uticaj i ogromno bogatstvo za sebe i svoju porodicu. Rim 1492., centar hršćanskog sveta i sedište papinstva. Papa je imao moć da okruni i svrgne kraljeve i promeni tok carstva. Papa Inocent VIII je na samrti, crkva je prožeta korupcijom, a papinsko je prestolje ono što svi priželjkuju… Serija započinje kada Rodrigo (Irons) postaje Papa Aleksandar VI, što pretvara njega, njegovo dvoje makijavelističkih sinova Cesarea i Juana, kao i skandalozno prelepu kći Lucreziju, u najmoćniju i najuticajniju porodicu renesansne Italije. Serija je smeštena u jedno od najznačajnijih razdoblja istorije: doba renesanse i otkrića Novog sveta. Porodica Bordžia bila je kontraverzna i heretička, ne samo zbog toga što su radili stvari koje su u njihovo vreme bile nečuvene, već zato što su u tome bili bolji od svojih neprijatelja. Na svom putu do zacrtanih ciljeva porodica Bordžia počiniće doslovno svaki od sedam smrtnih grehova, a i smisliće nekoliko vlastitih.

Njihov posao ih je odveo negde drugde, na obale drugog jezera: Anesi, gde se suočavaju s izazovom novog porodičnog života sa svojim devetomesečnim sinom Tomom. Dok par preuzima zahtevnu novu istragu, Klovis dobiva tajne pozive i zastrašujuće vizije - i počinje otkrivati mračnu stranu. Povrh svega, upravo su pronađeni leševi dve žene, jedan za drugim. Lisa i Klovis ne sumnjaju: to je delo serijskog ubice. Ovo ponovo budi bolna sećanja za Lise, koja se mora suočiti sa svojom prošlošću dok se Klovis suočava sa sopstvenim demonima. Ali njih dvoje će se morati udružiti i raditi kao tim ako žele uspeti pronaći ubicu...

programme.title: Four venues and funerals / Četiri venčanja i sahrana
programme.desc: Maja, boss communication Senator campaign in New York, gets a call for a wedding from a college friend who now lives in London. May leave his business and private life in New York to travel to England and connected with old friends, but there are their personal life crises. The links are established and terminated, political scandals are exposed, social life in London is ridiculed, love relationships flourish and vein, and of course, there are four weddings ... and funeral. / Maja, šefica komunikacija senatorske kampanje u Njujorku, dobija poziv za venčanje od prijateljice sa koledža koja sada živi u Londonu. Maja ostavlja svoj poslovni i privatni život u Njujorku da bi otputovala u Englesku i povezala se sa starim prijateljima, ali tamo je dočekaju njihove lične životne krize. Veze se uspostavljaju i raskidaju, politički skandali se razotkrivaju, društveni život u Londonu se ismeva, ljubavne veze cvetaju i venu, a naravno, pred njima su četiri venčanja... i sahrana.

At the end of the story, the pilot is saved and everything has a happy ending. / Pad u raj je priča o bizarnom srpskom ludaku (Lazar Ristovski) koji je oborio Avaks sa krova svoje kuće - jer ga je navodno nerviralo što njegova sestra (Branka Katić) pozira pilotima neprijateljskog aviona. Ljubiša odlučuje poduzeti nešto te uz pomoć rumunskog krijumčarskog lanca nabavlja rusku raketu kojom uspeva srušiti američki avion Avaks. Zarobljava pilota koji pokušava pobeći što mu nikako ne uspeva. Neverovatno, ali istinito, to je tek početak zapleta do čijeg vrhunca dolaza kada pilotu Ljubiši ponudi pet miliona dolara ukoliko mu pomogne uhvatiti Slobodana Miloševića. On otima pilota (Sajmon Lindon) i ne zna šta bi s njim. Pilot pokušava da pobegne na različite načine, ali ne uspeva. Na kraju priče, pilot se spasava i sve ima srećan kraj.

programme.title: Leeches / Pijavice
programme.desc: The small Hebrew story from the end of the 20th century, in the trusted area of the Balkans, in Serbia. The main hero, the famous writer Petar Mirić, who was part of the secret service for patriotic reasons, wants to return to normal life. It is an impossible mission, because everyone who is in his environment belong to someone. Escape, no matter how far, is not possible. / Mala hebrejska priča s kraja 20. veka, na trustnom području Balkana, u Srbiji. Glavni junak, poznati književnik Petar Mirić, koji je iz patriotskih razloga bio deo tajne službe, želi da se vrati normalnom životu. To je nemoguća misija, jer svi koji su u njegovom okruženju pripadaju nekome. Bekstvo, ma koliko daleko, nije moguće.

programme.title: Waking rats / Buđenje pacova
programme.desc: Failed to try one loner to edit your gray and meaningless life. Asking for work and money, it falls in love with an unknown girl who he believes he represents a turning point in his former life. And just when his illusion about happiness reaches the climax, unknown Krisha goes to his, from acquaintances with money, leaving him disappointed and cheated where he was before this match. / Neuspeli pokušaj jednog usamljenika da izmeni svoj sivi i besmisleni život. Tragajući za poslom i novcem, zaljubljuje se u nepoznatu devojku za koju veruje da predstavlja prekretnicu u njegovom dotadašnjem življenju. I baš kada njegova iluzija o sreći dostigne vrhunac, nepoznata krišom odlazi sa njegovim, od poznanika dobijenim novcem, ostavljajući ga razočaranog i prevarenog tamo gde je bio pre ovog susreta.

programme.title: Zona of the Dead / Zona mrtvih
programme.desc: In the entire Serbia, large military exercises take place, and Pancevo becomes a city under siege. At the railway station of this industrial city, due to the unfortunate arrival of circumstances, there is a discharge of an experimental and very dangerous biochemical poison in the air. Although his purpose is unknown, it seems that the poison of infected people turn into the mindless beings of eager blood. At the same time, Interpol Agents in cooperation with our forces, implement the transport of prisoners from Vršac for Belgrade. In transport, only one is the only prisoner, mysterious past, and look very dangerous to appearance. On the other end of the city, ambitious, foreign journalist, with a group of local friends, moves the road railway station, where poison gas and released, in order to make an exclusive report. They soon encounter first infected residents, and realize that the escape from the city is the only way out. The poison soon spreads Pančevo, raring the inhabitants, and looks like the end is holy on the horizon. Interpol transport encounters infected Pančevces, and the appearance of the routine task becomes a hellish fight for life and death. Agent Interpol, Mortimer Rejes realizes that the only chance for survival, lies in association forces with a dangerous prisoner, which is somewhat, associated with events that take place around them. All the story lines will be connected at the local police station, where Igents of Interpol, a prisoner, a foreign journalist and his friends will be found. Although the look is safe behind the thick walls of the police station, waiting for reinforcements, heroes do not realize that the real danger is there, among them, and that their / U celoj Srbiji se odvijaju velike vojne vežbe, i Pančevo postaje grad pod opsadom. Na železničkoj stanici ovog industrijskog grada, usled nesrećnog sticaja okolnosti, dolazi do ispuštanja eksperimentalnog i veoma opasnog biohemijskog otrova u vazduh. Iako mu je namena nepoznata, izgleda da otrov zaražene ljude pretvara u bezumna bića željna krvi. U isto vreme, agenti Interpola u saradnji sa našim snagama, sprovode transport zatvorenika iz Vršca za Beograd. U transportu je samo jedan jedini zatvorenik, misteriozne prošlosti, i na izgled veoma opasan. Na drugom kraju grada, ambiciozni, strani novinar, sa grupom lokalnih prijatelja, kreće put železničke stanice, gde je otrovni gas i pušten, kako bi o tome napravio ekskluzivnu reportažu. Ubrzo nailaze na prve zaražene stanovnike, i shvataju da je bekstvo iz grada jedini izlaz. Otrov se uskoro širi Pančevom, trujući stanovnike, i izgleda kao da je smak sveta na pomolu. Interpolov transport nailazi na zaražene Pančevce, i na izgled rutinski zadatak postaje paklena borba na život i smrt. Agent Interpola, Mortimer Rejes shvata da jedina šansa za opstanak, leži u udruživanju snaga sa opasnim zatvorenikom, koji je nekako, povezan sa događajima koji se odigravaju oko njih. Sve linije priče će se povezati u lokalnoj policijskoj stanici, gde će se naći agenti Interpola, zatvorenik, strani novinar i njegovi prijatelji. Iako na izgled sigurni iza debelih zidova policijske stanice, čekajući pojačanje, junaci ne shvataju da je prava opasnost tu, među njima, i da će njihova

programme.title: Peace Peace Season / Sezona mira u Parizu
programme.desc: In Paris, who did not lose anything from his former poetically, but in another way, the Young Yugoslav and Frenchman, the ambience of the authentic events of our time, and which is increasingly recognizable in modern contemporaries ... The anxiety and intolerance of this time is revealed. / U Parizu, koji nije ništa izgubio od svoje nekadašnje poetičnosti, ali je na jedan drugi način doživeo promenu, zaljubljeni par, mladi Jugosloven i Francuskinja, žive svoje nade i strepnje u ambijentu autentičnih događaja našeg vremena i vremena za koje se veruje da je prošlost, a koje je sve češće prepoznatljivo u svojevrsnim scenama savremenosti... Iza ove ljubavne priče otkriva se uznemirenost i netolerantnost ovoga vremena...

programme.title: I am poor but I am insane / Siroma sam al sam besan
programme.desc: In the center of Events, young Berberin Sava, which comes to the little Vojvodina village from somewhere and it opens the male salon there. Editing the peasants and cooperatives, he gradually introduces them, with them, and becomes a short important person who allows himself even to engage in the realization of the plans around the construction of a new slaughterhouse. With that social life, there is also that private in which there are a lot of tragicomic scenes. Because, he is not just a flirting with Kafan singer Milk, but with two young Hungarians, Earžik and Marik. / U centru zbivanja je mladi berberin Sava, koji odnekud dolazi u malo vojvođansko selo i tu otvara muški salon. Uređujući seljake i zadrugare, on ih postepeno upoznaje, s njima se sprijateljuje i postaje ubrzo važna licnost koja sebi dozvoljava čak i to da se upušta u realizaciju planova oko izgradnje nove klanice. Uz taj njegov društveni život postoji i onaj privatni u kome ima dosta tragikomičnih prizora. Jer, nije mu dovoljan samo flert sa kafanskom pevačicom Milkom, već i sa dvema mladim Mađaricama, Eržikom i Marikom.

programme.title: Gypsy magic / Ciganska magija
programme.desc: A romantic story of a poor Gypsy family, which is struggling for survival wandering on the periphery of Skopje. Their story reflects the fate of discarded and forgotten street heroes, who appear in the news only in the case of robbery or murder. They dream big dreams, which sometimes seem funny, but who give meaning to their lives and chances to escape the cruel reality. The center of attention is Chergar and the tiny singer Taip. When his mother dies, Taip takes state money for the funeral, but then his mother is suddenly reviving. The distress that occur, allow Taip to meet the girl of his life, but the path to true love is not a little easy ... / Romantična priča o siromašnoj ciganskoj porodici, koja se bori za opstanak lutajući po periferiji Skoplja. Njihova priča oslikava sudbinu odbačenih i zaboravljenih uličnih heroja, koji se u vestima pojavljuju samo u slučaju pljačke ili ubistva. Oni sanjaju velike snove, koji se ponekad čine smešnim, ali koji daju smisao njihovim životima i šansu da pobegnu iz surove stvarnosti. U centru pažnje je čergar i sitni pevarat Taip. Kada mu majka umre, Taip uzima državni novac za sahranu, ali potom majka iznenada oživljava. Nevolje koje nastaju, omogućavaju Taipu da upozna devojku svog života, ali put do prave ljubavi nije ni malo lak…

programme.title: Erogenous Zona / Erogena zona
programme.desc: The Momcilo Momcilo Stojisavljević served a military service and returned home. Problems that are already waiting for them are employment, parents, old love, apartment. He also comes a girl from military days that remained in the second state. Power works in a plant that produces eggs and chickens. It is impressed with modern technology and shod by automatic and cybernetics. Open senses pass through all phases of work and all the risks, exposing their erogenous zones of life and his temptations. / Moca-Momčilo Stojisavljević odslužio je vojni rok i vraća se kući. Problemi koji ga već čekaju su zaposlenje, roditelji, stara ljubav, stan. Dolazi mu i devojka iz vojničkih dana koja je ostala u drugom stanju. Moca radi u kombinatu koji proizvodi jaja i piliće. Impresioniran je modernom tehnologijom i zgranut automatizmom i kibernetikom. Otvorenih čula prolazi kroz sve faze rada i sve rizike, izlažući svoje erogene zone životu i njegovim iskušenjima.

programme.title: Enclave / Enklava
programme.desc: The film deals with the topic of the Serbian community that remained in Kosovo to live in small isolated communities - enclaves. Forced to such a life, limited to live on a cramped space, Serbs who have remained living in Kosovo and Metohija live their lives in a very difficult way. What happens when someone passes in the enclave, and the cemetery is out of it, on the enemy territory? In this story, with a lot of peripetia, one eight-year old man will, however, thanks to his grandson, a ten-year-old boy who dared to do something impossible for both communities in Kosovo, and Serbian and Albanian and gain friends on the opposite side. / Film obrađuje temu srpske zajednice koja je ostala na Kosovu da živi u malim izolovanim zajednicama - enklavama. Primorani na ovakav život, ograničeni da žive na skučenom prostoru, Srbi koji su ostali da žive na Kosovu i Metohiji žive svoje živote na veoma težak način. Šta se dešava kad neko premine u enklavi, a groblje se nalazi van nje, na neprijateljskoj teritoriji? U ovoj priči, uz mnogo peripetija, jedan osamdesetogodišnji starac će, ipak, biti sahranjen zahvaljujući svom unuku, desetogodišnjem dečaku koji se usudio da učini nešto nemoguće za obe zajednice na Kosovu, i srpsku i albansku: da zavoli i stekne prijatelja na suprotnoj strani.

programme.title: Bet / Opklada
programme.desc: In a mill separated from rural houses and far from life, in a desert and raw environment, a living man with a young woman live. He is apparently well, devoted to him as a manager, supervises several workers, sweat, strives and believes that he also creates a pleasant ambience for his family happiness. The woman doesn't think so, and he feels less. Everything is foreign to her, she is absent and a full of unconstructive longing. Everyone who comes here think that she is unhappy or at least dissatisfied, trying to get close to her and move from that dead dead ... / U mlinu izdvojenom od seoskih kuća i daleko od života, u pustom i sirovom ambijentu, živi stariji čovek sa mladom ženom. Njemu je naizgled dobro, predano radi kao poslovođa, nadzire nekoliko radnika, znoji se, trudi i veruje da tako stvara i ugodan ambijent za svoju porodičnu sreću. Žena ne misli tako, a jos manje oseća. Sve joj je strano, odsutna je i puna neodrđene čežnje. Svi koji tu dolaze misle da je nesrećna ili bar nezadovoljna, pokušavaju da joj se približe i da je pokrenu iz tog njenog mrtvila...

programme.title: Petrijin Venac / Petrijin venac
programme.desc: The film is taking place in the small mining scene of Serbia and the time coverage of the pre-war, war and post-war period ... It is a tragic life path illiterate women from the village, about her life with three men who loved. Her life path, torn between reality and sleep, the life of suffering, loneliness, disappointments, hopes and love grew into the indestructibility and symbol of man's victory. / Radnja filma se odvija u malom rudarskom mestu Srbije i vremenski obuhvata predratni, ratni i posleratni period... To je priča o tragičnom životnom putu nepismene žene sa sela, o njenom životu sa tri čoveka koja je volela. Njen životni put, rastrzan između stvarnosti i sna, život trpljenja, samoće, razočarenja, nadanja i ljubavi prerasta u neuništivost i simbol pobede čoveka.

programme.title: Out of step / U raskoraku
programme.desc: The activist, in the years of construction, saving the cooperative car, breaks the spine, becomes a disabled and forced to fight for bare survival. Instead of a decision on disability allowance, the eye is sued, the decoration is obtained and becomes the main hero of a television show, which brings a number of far-reaching consequences for the author of the emission and the main character. / Aktivista, u godinama izgradnje, spasavajući zadružna kola, lomi kičmu, postaje invalid i prisiljen je da se bori za goli opstanak. Umesto rešenja o invalidnini, oko koje se uporno tuži, dobija odlikovanje i postaje glavni junak jedne televizijske emisije, koja donosi niz dalekosežnih posledica za autora emisije i glavnog junaka.

programme.title: Ambush / Zaseda
programme.desc: Liberation ... People, got out of the war, fighting for the renewal of the country. The young man, Dalmatian, to whom the Italians killed his father, is studying in Serbia near relatives. He all works as an activist thinking that he uses higher goals. In order to fully put himself in the service of the revolution, he is involved in the ranks of Ozna, but later, disappointed because of the careerism of individuals, he leaves the job. Confusing, kicking from a rural militia. / Oslobođenje... Ljudi, izašli iz rata, bore se za obnovu zemlje. Mladić, Dalmatinac, kome su Italijani ubili oca, školuje se u Srbiji kod rođaka. Svesrdno radi kao aktivista misleći da koristi višim ciljevima. Da bi se potpuno stavio u službu revolucije, uključuje se u redove OZNE, ali kasnije, razočaran zbog karijerizma pojedinaca, napušta posao. Zabunom, gine od seoske milicije.

programme.title: Time of miracles / Vreme čuda
programme.desc: Immediately after the end of World War II, the new revolutionary government begins the fight against the founded folk probing, the process of execution of God begins. In a small shield, the local church turn to school. All residents participate in the repainting of frescoes. But behold wonders! In the middle of the school class, under the layer of lime, the frescoes again erupt ... from the conflict of two dogmas, an unsecured man, will be born that every dogma is always facing man and his needs for freedom. / Neposredno po završetku II svetskog rata, nova revolucionarna vlast započinje borbu protiv utemeljenog narodnog verovanja, počinje proces isterivanja Boga. U malom zabitom mestu lokalnu crkvu pretvaraju u školu. Svi stanovnici učestvuju u prefarbavanju fresaka. Ali gle čuda! Usred školskog časa, ispod sloja kreča, freske ponovo izbijaju... Iz sukoba dve dogme čija je žrtva običan, nezaštićeni čovek, rodiće se saznanje da je svaka dogma uvek okrenuta protiv čoveka i njegove potrebe za slobodom.

programme.title: Promeni Me / Promeni me
programme.desc: A reputable Belgrade dentist lives in a harmonious marriage. His friends with puberty syndrome in checkout, as some call the crisis male year when they intend to try to stay young, causing contempt and anger in our hero. He was realized and satisfied man. But his love happens, when he didn't expect her, when he thought he was completely immune to such a sensation. And he wants to change, would not overcome the emotional and erotic challenge. He gives up on himself to not become someone else. / Ugledni beogradski stomatolog živi u skladnom braku. Njegovi drugari sa sindromom puberteta u odjavi, kako neki nazivaju krizne muške godine kada se inteziviraju pokušaju da se ostane mlad, kod našeg junaka izazivaju prezir i ljutnju. On je ostvaren i zadovoljan čovek. Ali dogodi mu se ljubav, kad je nije očekivao, kad je mislio da je potpuno imun na takvu senzaciju. I on hoće da se promeni, ne bi li savladao emotivni i erotski izazov. Odustaje od sebe samog ne bi li postao neko drugi.

programme.title: Cooking / Virdžina
programme.desc: In the abomination of karst in the premises of the Knin Krajina, a family without male offspring were considered haunted and sentenced to failure. To save the curses, those families have declared one of the women's children by Virgin, ie. a man, hiding the truth as a family secret. In one such family who knows only for karst, guduras, sheep and Sv. Djurdja, his protector, the greatest treasure is the son that they never win. That is why the last, just born girl will be sacrificed to become male despite the pain of the mother, so that the house will receive the favor of the Protector - Saint. Convicted to undo all the female in themselves, to fight with his own nature and feelings, the moment he falls in love with another, he begins to rebellion to all beings against the dares. What the father is more efforted to carry a burden for both men, believing that everything can be covered in front of the world and in front of the saint, and is increasingly being lost and falling. Virginia, with the help of a young man who reveals a secret, breaking up with old life and moves, as many from that area, on the road to America. / U zabitom kršu na prostorima Kninske krajine, porodice bez muškog potomstva smatrane su ukletim i osuđenim na propast. Da bi se spasle prokletstva, te porodice su jedno od ženske dece proglašavale virdžinom, tj. muškarcem, skrivajući istinu kao porodičnu tajnu. U jednoj takvoj porodici koja zna samo za krš, gudure, ovce i sv. Đurđa, svoga zaštitnika, najveće blago je sin koje nikako da dobiju. Zato će poslednja, tek rođena devojčica biti žrtvovana da postane muško uprkos bolu majke, kako bi kuća ponovo dobila naklonost zaštitnika - sveca. Osuđena da poništi sve žensko u sebi, da se bori sa sopstvenom prirodom i osećanjima, u trenutku kad se zaljubi u druga, počinje da se buni svim bićem protiv usuda. Što se otac više trudi da nosi breme za oba muškarca, verujući da se sve može prikriti i pred svetom i pred svecom, sve se više gubi i pada. Virdžina, uz pomoć mladića kojem otkriva tajnu, raskida sa starim životom i kreće, kao mnogi iz tog kraja, na put u Ameriku.

programme.title: Vilov Potok / Vilov potok
programme.desc: The young couple travels to the Croik fairy, a place that has become known for its American urban legend, so -called Bigfut or Sakvoc ... getting to know the customs of the locals and seeing how much the place occupied with the family about this creature, the couple set off for the depths of the forest, to investigate if there was really that big hairy man… / Mladi par putuje u Vilou Krik, mesto koje je postalo poznato po američkoj urbanoj legendi, takozvanom Bigfutu ili Saskvoču… Upoznajući se s običajima lokalnog stanovništva i uvidevši koliko je mesto okupirano famom o ovom stvorenju, par se zaputi u dubinu šume, da bi istražio postoji li zaista taj veliki dlakavi čovek…

programme.title: Gargoylova osveta / Gargojlova osveta
programme.desc: The two CIA agents were invited to Bucharest in order to solve the case of abduction of an important and very famous person as faster and without raising unnecessary media pompa as possible. However, when they arrive in Romania, she will realize that they don't have work with ordinary kidnappers, but with dangerous, monstrous force. Abuse, which was thought to have been exiled forever, is the eager for revenge back? / Dvoje agenata CIA pozvano je u Bukurešt kako bi što brže i bez dizanja nepotrebne medijske pompe rešili slučaj otmice važne i jako poznate osobe. Međutim, kada stignu u Rumuniju, shvatiće kako nemaju posla s običnim otmičarima, nego s opasnom, čudovišnom silom. Zloduh, za kojeg se mislilo da je zauvek prognan, vraća se željan osvete?

programme.title: Cold heads / Hladne glave
programme.desc: Lieutenant John Barton was sent to a special mission to deliver a special vaccine to a remote mining colony. He broke out what he found, a blind passenger in his spacecraft. Barton has only fuel enough to bring himself and his precious load, and her extra weight ensures that it will crash if she stays on board. They went too far to return, and Barton's superiors clearly put it to knowledge: the mission has an advantage and should be thrown into space. But she won't go just like that, quietly. / Poručnik Džon Barton je poslat u specijalnu misiju da isporuči specijalnu vakcinu u udaljenu rudarsku koloniju. Razbesneo je što je pronašao Li, slepu putnicu u njegovoj letelici. Barton ima samo dovoljno goriva da ponese sebe i svoj dragoceni teret, a njena dodatna težina osigurava da će se srušiti, ako ona ostane na brodu. Otišli su predaleko da bi se vratili, a Bartonovi nadređeni jasno stavljaju do znanja: misija ima prednost i Li mora biti bačena u svemir. Ali ona neće otići tek tako i tiho.

programme.title: Angelija Ballerina / Anđelija Balerina
programme.desc: Angelina is a small mouse that likes to play and want to become a famous ballerina. In his pink dress, irresistible and fun, with his friends William and Alice, and with the help of Miss Lily Ballet, Andjelina wants to achieve his goal and become famous. Inspired by the popular children's book, the cartoon about Angelina is the inspiration for all children to achieve their wishes and dreams. / Anđelina je mali miš koji voli da igra i želi da postane poznata balerina. U svojoj roze haljinici, neodoljiva i zabavna, sa svojim prijateljima Vilijamom i Alisom, i uz pomoć nastavnice baleta Mis Lili, Anđelina želi da ostvari svoj cilj i postane slavna. Inspirisan popularnom dečjom knjigom, crtani film o Anđelini je inspiracija za svu decu da ostvare svoje želje i snove.

programme.title: Animalia / Animalija
programme.desc: Follow 11-year-old Zoe and Alex into a fascinating and exciting world. Their great adventure adventure begins when in the library due to a series of strange events, suddenly find themselves in the country of the animals that speak. Zoe and Alex soon discover that something is wrong in the once so peaceful kingdom. Their arrival is closely linked to strange events that increasingly weaken this unusual civilization and the heart of Animali, mag. Our main heroes with the help of a sharp intellect and creativity GBUBU and Iguane Igi try to find the solution to these mysterious events and re-establish order and harmony in the country of Animalija. / Pratite 11-godišnju Zoe i Aleksa u fascinantan i uzbudljiv svet. Njihova velika životna avantura započinje kada se u biblioteci usled niza čudnih događaja, odjedanput nađu u zemlji životinja koje govore. Zoe i Aleks ubrzo otkrivaju da nešto nije u redu u nekada tako mirnom kraljevstvu. Njihov dolazak usko je povezan sa čudnim događajima koji sve više slabe ovu neuobičajenu civilizaciju i srce Animalije, Mag. Naši glavni junaci uz pomoć oštrog intelekta i kreativnosti gorile GBubu i iguane Igi pokušavaju pronaći rešenje ovih misterioznih događaja i ponovo uspostaviti red i harmoniju u zemlji Animaliji.

programme.title: The groom's sister / Mladoženjine sestre
programme.desc: Sara started dealing with cooking and has a new job, and that is catering, which creates a pretty noise that botheres Jason, who lives below it. He has his problems, because he has to make an appointment to his brother, whom their sisters have found their future young. The wedding is in sight, and Sara must promote their new job ... Solution? / Sara je počela da se bavi kuvanjem i ima novi posao, a to je ketering, što stvara priličnu buku koja smeta Džejsonu, koji živi ispod nje. On ima svojih problema, jer mora zakazati venčanje svom bratu, kome su njihove sestre našle buduću mladu. Svadba je na vidiku, a Sara mora promovisati svoj novi posao... Rešenje?

programme.title: The first bastard of Serbia / Prvi kuvar Srbije
programme.desc: The real treat for all lovers of the Gastronomic show program will be the new TV PINK format, which is the title of the first chef of Serbia. In order for everything even more for the project that the project produced that decided to enter exclusively VIP personalities and even 20. You will be able to follow their cooking skills every week without one of the competitors. The decision to leave this interesting and tense bidding will bring a cooking jury to do the top people of this craft, carefully selected for this show. The series of the first chefs of Serbia will last more than three months, and during it we will get to know certain VIP personalities better, which will now be exposed to a particular torture and pressure work. / Prava poslastica za sve ljubitelje gastronomskih šou programa biće novi format TV Pink-a, koji nosi naslov Prvi kuvar Srbije. Da bi sve bilo još više zabibereno potrudili su se producenti projekta koji su odlučili da u ovaj kulinarski ring uđu isključivo VIP ličnosti i to čak njih 20. Svakog dana moći ćete da pratite njihove veštine kuvanja, a svake nedelje ostajaćemo bez jednog od takmičara. Odluku ko će napuštati ovo zanimljivo i napeto nadmetanje donosiće kuvarski žiri kojeg će činiti vrhunski ljudi ovog zanata, pažljivo odabrani upravo za ovu emisiju. Serijal Prvi kuvar Srbije trajaće više od tri meseca, a tokom njega ćemo bolje upoznati određene VIP ličnosti koje će sada biti izložene određenoj torturi i radu pod pritiskom.

programme.title: The kitchen of our ancestors / Kuhinja naših predaka

programme.title: Field of lost shoes / Polje izgubljenih cipela
programme.desc: Based on a true story from the American Civil War, which culminates in the battle in Novi Market, 15. May 1864. programme.title: Take / Oteta
programme.desc: The story of the Orhun, who wants to revenge his sister, and hiri, which is a prisoner of his conscience ... Orhun is a successful businessman who grew up in a rich family without love with his sister by Nursah and his cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan went to work voluntarily as a doctor in Eritrea, but it was unable to contact, and her family was worried about her. As he seeks his sister, he encounters a hira, a poor girl who lives as a prisoner in the hands of people. When they learn that Nihan has poisoned and killed a local gang, Orhun breaks. When it turns out that Hira was actually the one who poisoned his sister, Orhun bitches the evil plan for revenge: he will take the hira home with him and make her worse. In the meantime, Afife, their mother, secretly held Orhun's father away from his childhood. Orhun decides to marry a hiree of revenge. Afife hates people of lower status and is obsessed with clean blood. Will this marriage close afife, or will a couple find redemption after paying all your obligations? / Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savjesti... Orhun je uspješan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao ljekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu djevojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog djetinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsjednuta je čistom krvlju. Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: A trap of love / Klopka ljubavi
programme.desc: The dark curse hangs over the rich family Develoglula. Her successor must be a boy, but for jihan, the successor of the family empire, children are just an unfulfilled desire. He doesn't believe in love. He married a marriage by arrangement and believes that it is simply impossible to be successful in business and in love. Love is a weakness for him. His mother Mukader, a ruthless guardian of the family tradition and the future, is ready to ensure his son of the heir. It offers Bayy, Jihan's infertile woman, dangerous agreement: Divorce for Jigan's offspring, with the promise to return after his son's birth. Otherwise, Bays is also from a wealthy Turkish family. On the other hand, in the poor neighborhood, Istanbul, a young hancer who struggles with life in poverty. He lives with a sick brother, his wife and a brother. Hancher gets an offer that will change her fate: marriage with the jihan. Of course, the condition is that it is fertile and obedient, as well as agree to marriage without emotions. Although her heart is looking for true love, the sick brother is tered on the victim. Jihan and Hancher are neither aware of making a grant step. Life will be filled with intrigues and secrets, nothing will be the same again. Jihan's ex-wife Bayy will not disappear from their lives. The sharp and powerful mucader will do everything that marriage is only a deal and that Hancer is resolved after the birth of the heir. Hancher just dreams of helping his unhappy family, while Jihan is looking for a woman exclusively for hereditary. Will love still find the way in the world where everyone strives for better? / Mračna kletva visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice. Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu. Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika. Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Three sisters / Tri sestre
programme.desc: The action of the series will follow the story of the destinies of three sisters. One of them is known for its beauty, second by means of a longitude, third by rebel, and all three loyal are each other. As they dream simple dreams like their pork, the shadow of the past will not leave them alone, nor will happiness will be on their side. All three sisters led a happy life with his parents, until the marriage of one of them, Turkan. Then the dark clouds will begin over the family, and nothing will be like before. As Turkan tries to cover his misfortune in the "Fairy Trap in which she stuck, Donian life will reverse a great secret from the past, and Derja will step without returning. Dok sanjaju jednostavne snove kao njihove vršnjakinje, sjenka prošlosti ih neće ostaviti na miru, niti će sreća biti na njihovoj strani. Sve tri sestre vodile su srećan život sa roditeljima, sve do braka jedne od njih, Turkan. Tada će nad porodicom početi da se nadvijaju tamni oblaci, i ništa više neće biti kao pre. Dok Turkan pokušava da prikrije svoju nesreću u ,,zamku iz bajke u kojem je zaglavila, Donenin život preokrenuće velika tajna iz prošlosti, a Derja će zakoračiti putem bez povratka. Sadik i Nesrin će, s druge strane, doći do tačke da izgube ponekad sebe, a ponekad jedno drugo, kako bi svoju ćerku izvukli sa ivice litice.

programme.title: Take / Oteta
programme.desc: The story of the Orhun, who wants to revenge his sister, and hiri, which is a prisoner of his conscience ... Orhun is a successful businessman who grew up in a rich family without love with his sister by Nursah and his cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan went to work voluntarily as a doctor in Eritrea, but it was unable to contact, and her family was worried about her. As he seeks his sister, he encounters a hira, a poor girl who lives as a prisoner in the hands of people. When they learn that Nihan has poisoned and killed a local gang, Orhun breaks. When it turns out that Hira was actually the one who poisoned his sister, Orhun bitches the evil plan for revenge: he will take the hira home with him and make her worse. In the meantime, Afife, their mother, secretly held Orhun's father away from his childhood. Orhun decides to marry a hiree of revenge. Afife hates people of lower status and is obsessed with clean blood. Will this marriage close afife, or will a couple find redemption after paying all your obligations? / Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savjesti... Orhun je uspješan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao ljekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu djevojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog djetinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsjednuta je čistom krvlju. Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: A trap of love / Klopka ljubavi
programme.desc: The dark curse hangs over the rich family Develoglula. Her successor must be a boy, but for jihan, the successor of the family empire, children are just an unfulfilled desire. He doesn't believe in love. He married a marriage by arrangement and believes that it is simply impossible to be successful in business and in love. Love is a weakness for him. His mother Mukader, a ruthless guardian of the family tradition and the future, is ready to ensure his son of the heir. It offers Bayy, Jihan's infertile woman, dangerous agreement: Divorce for Jigan's offspring, with the promise to return after his son's birth. Otherwise, Bays is also from a wealthy Turkish family. On the other hand, in the poor neighborhood, Istanbul, a young hancer who struggles with life in poverty. He lives with a sick brother, his wife and a brother. Hancher gets an offer that will change her fate: marriage with the jihan. Of course, the condition is that it is fertile and obedient, as well as agree to marriage without emotions. Although her heart is looking for true love, the sick brother is tered on the victim. Jihan and Hancher are neither aware of making a grant step. Life will be filled with intrigues and secrets, nothing will be the same again. Jihan's ex-wife Bayy will not disappear from their lives. The sharp and powerful mucader will do everything that marriage is only a deal and that Hancer is resolved after the birth of the heir. Hancher just dreams of helping his unhappy family, while Jihan is looking for a woman exclusively for hereditary. Will love still find the way in the world where everyone strives for better? / Mračna kletva visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice. Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu. Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika. Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

Sadik i Nesrin će, s druge strane, doći do tačke da izgube ponekad sebe, a ponekad jedno drugo, kako bi svoju ćerku izvukli sa ivice litice.

programme.title: SNUP DOG: Streets of Violence / Snup Dog: Ulice nasilja
programme.desc: Weather - March 1991. Years. Rodney King attacked police officers Los Angeles. Consequences - Amateur video becomes a gold mine for television networks (and cameramen). LAPD Cops Stace Kun and Lawrence Powel were released in April 1992. For any weeks of King and a few hours of dismissal, they randomly pull out of the vehicle and beating the Robbers robber and TV cameras show their stolen goods. A curfew is introduced, a national guard calls and shortly before the images of black and white turn into shades of blood red and gray smoke. Balance - 55 dead, 2,000 injured and over $ 1 billion of material damage. This film in a satirical way shows all these events. / Vreme - mart 1991. godine. Rodni King je napao policajce Los Anđelesa. Posledice - amaterski video postaje zlatni rudnik za televizijske mreže (i snimatelje). Policajci LAPD-a Stejsi Kun i Lorens Pauel oslobođeni su u aprilu 1992. za bilo kakva nedela u hapšenju i prebijanju Kinga i nekoliko sati od objave oslobađajuće presude, LA je zahvatio plamen nereda, ljude nasumično izvlače iz vozila i tuku na sred raskrsnica, pljačkaši pljačkaju i TV kamerama pokazuju svoju ukradenu robu. Uveden je policijski čas, poziva se Nacionalna garda i nedugo pre nego što se slike crno-belog pretvaraju u nijanse krvavo crvenog i sivog dima. Bilans - 55 mrtvih, 2.000 povređenih i preko milijardu dolara materijalne štete. Ovaj film na satiričan način prikazuje sve ove događaje.

programme.title: Evil Death: Awakening / Zla smrt: Buđenje
programme.desc: Cult horror Franchise Sema Raimi is returning to the violent edition on the Great Canvas! The premise of the entire series revolves around the ancient Sumerian text of the Necronomicon of Ex-Mortis, ie the version of the dead that serves as a portal that leads to the dimension of full demons. The twisted story of two alienated sisters moves when Bet visits his older sister Elie who hikes his three children in a small apartment in Los Angeles. Their re-gathering will break the discovery of mysterious books deep inside the eliene building that will allow awakening of frightening demons and force beta in the survival battle while facing the most awful version of the maternity that anyone can imagine. / Kultna horor franšiza Sema Raimija vraća se u najkrvavijem izdanju na velika platna! Premisa čitavog serijala vrti se oko drevnog sumeranskog teksta Nekronomikon Eks-Mortisa, odnosno verzije Knjige mrtvih koja služi kao portal koji vodi u dimenziju punu demona. Uvrnuta priča o dve otuđene sestre kreće kada Bet poseti svoju stariju sestru Elie koja sama odgaja troje dece u malom stanu u Los Anđelesu. Njihovo ponovno okupljanje prekinuće otkriće tajanstvene knjige duboko u unutrašnjosti Eliene zgrade koja će omogućiti buđenje zastrašujućih demona i naterati Bet u bitku za preživljavanje dok je suočena s najstrašnijom verzijom majčinstva koju bilo ko može da zamisli.

programme.title: Catch Smart / Uhvati Smarta
programme.desc: The evoic genius in Kaos was awarded the devilish plan on how to dominate every living man, wife and child on the planet, and their conspiracy begins with success, when attacking the headquarters of the American spy agency control. As a result of the attack, the identity of all agents working for control is compromised. Understanding that the only way to jeopardize the Evo's voluntary, but inexperienced Maksel Smart (Karel) analyst, the head of the agency (Alan Arkin) is a super-spy veteran whose beauty is the only thing that transcends its murderiness. Without any field experience, without talking about anything other than enthusiasm and piles of fancy spyholders, Maksel Smart and his new partner, Agent Stamp) and the Loyal Army of the Subant to Him in a determined battle that will decide the fate of the free The world. / Zli geniji u KAOS-u su smislili đavolski plan kako da dominiraju svakim živim čovekom, ženom i detetom na planeti, a njihova zavera počinje uspehom, kada napadnu glavni štab američke špijunske agencije Kontrola. Kao rezultat napada, kompromitovan je identitet svih agenata koji rade za Kontrolu. Shvatajući da je jedini način da se ugrozi zli plan KAOS-a da se voljni, ali neiskusni analitičar Kontrole Maksel Smart (Karel) promoviše u specijalnog agenta, šef agencije (Alan Arkin) nevoljno uparuje Smarta sa Agentom 99 (En Hetvej) super-špijunom veteranom čija je lepota jedina stvar koja prevazilazi njenu ubojitost. Bez ikakvog terenskog iskustva, a da i ne govorimo o ničemu drugom osim entuzijazma i gomile fensi špijunskih uređaja koji će mu pomoći na njegovoj smrtonosnoj misiji, Maksel Smart i njegov novi partner, Agent 99 će biti prinuđeni da se suoče sa zlim vođom KAOS-a (Terens Stemp) i njemu lojalnom armijom podanika u odlučnoj bici koja će odlučiti o sudbini slobodnog sveta.

programme.title: Serial testers / Serijski testeri
programme.desc: In a garage, which for the purposes of this project has been converted to the laboratory, group enthusiasts conduct various experiments trying to confirm numerous scientific theories. Every step in the experiment is carefully planned, and the trio of eager science at the end of each topic provides detailed explanations. / U garaži koja je za potrebe ovog projekta pretvorena u laboratoriju, grupa entuzijasta sprovodi različite eksperimente pokušavajući da potvrdi brojne naučne teorije. Svaki korak u eksperimentu je pažljivo isplaniran, a trio željan nauke na kraju svake teme daje detaljna objašnjenja.

programme.title: To the religious monuments / Verski spomenici
programme.desc: The documentary series religious monuments brings views of artistic and architectural achievements that are woven into temples and churches around the world. / Dokumentarni serijal Verski spomenici donosi pogled na umetnička i arhitektonska dostignuća koja su utkana u hramove i crkve širom sveta.

programme.title: Great personality / Velike ličnosti
programme.desc: Through this series, get to know the most significant figures that have marked our engraving. / Kroz ovaj serijal upoznajte najznačajnije ličnosti koje su obeležile našu cvilizaciju.

programme.title: The doctor's brain / Doktor mozak
programme.desc: Poljak Miroslav Zabek brought the right revolution into the world of neurosurgery! This documentary series talks about patients who came to healing thanks to his work. / Poljak Miroslav Zabek je u svet neurohirurgije doneo pravu revoluciju! Ovaj dokumentarni serijal govori o pacijentima koji su zahvaljujući njegovom radu došli do izlečenja.

programme.title: Futurmag / Futurmag
programme.desc: The latest achievements concerning man, our planets, but also the development of technology speak scientists from different parts of the world. / O najnovijim dostignućima koja se tiču čoveka, naše planete, ali i razvoja tehnologije govore naučnici iz različitih delova sveta.

programme.title: Our planets on two points / Naša planeta na dva točka
programme.desc: Go to the exciting bike trip and discover the amazing landscapes and the ends where everyone lives in harmony with nature. / Pođite na uzbudljivo putovanje biciklom i otkrijte neverovatne pejzaže i krajeve u kojima svi žive u skladu sa prirodom.

programme.title: Nobel prize / Nobelova nagrada
programme.desc: The Nobel Prize is an international award, which granted Swedish and Norwegian institutions annually, as a sign of recognition for academic, cultural, and / or scientific achievements. / Nobelova nagrada je internacionalna nagrada, koju godišnje dodeljuju švedske i norveške institucije, kao znak priznanja za akademska, kulturna, i/ili naučna dostignuća.

programme.title: Wonderful nature / Čudesna priroda
programme.desc: Documentary series that gives you the opportunity to go on an exciting journey and get to know the numerous miracles of nature! Visit the different ends of the world and get to know the plant and animal species you have not known before. / Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

programme.title: Holy Heritage / Svetska baština
programme.desc: The documentary series Svetjska heritage deals with the most famous Holy painters, their parts and the stories that are hiding behind them. / Dokumentarni serijal Svetska baština bavi se najpoznatijim svetskim slikarima, njihovim delima i pričama koje se kriju iza njih.

programme.title: Famous Holy Writers / Poznati svetski pisci

programme.title: Daydreams of a networked holy / Sanjarenja umreženog sveta
programme.desc: Director Verner Hercog reconstructs the virtual world, starting to the end of its range, exploring the digital background with the same curiosity and creativity he approached different terrestrial areas, such as Amazon, Sahara, South Pole and abandoned areas of Australia. The Hercog viewer leads to a single journey, through a number of provocative talks that reveal how the world has transformed the way in which the real world works - from trade to education to health, all the way to the central issue of human behavior in society. / Reditelj Verner Hercog rekonstruiše virtuelni svet, počev od njegovog postanka, sve do krajnjih dometa, istražujući digitalnu pozadinu sa istom radoznalošću i kreativnošću kojima je pristupao različitim zemaljskim predelima, poput Amazona, Sahare, Južnog pola i napuštenih predela Australije. Hercog gledaoce vodi na jedinstveno putovanje, kroz niz provokativnih razgovora koji otkrivaju kako je onlajn svet transformisao način na koji realni svet funkcioniše - od trgovine do obrazovanja, od putovanja u svemir do zdravstva, sve do središnjeg pitanja ljudskog ponašanja u društvu.

programme.title: Why do I jump / Zašto skačem
programme.desc: Based on the bestseller of Higašide, the reason why I jump is ... is a filmmaking and researching our neurological difference through experiences of muric and autistic people around the world. The film is a combination of hyguisids of personal experiences of autism, written when he was only 13 years old, with the intimate portraits of five extraordinary young people. He opens us the door of the sensual universe, powerful and comprehensive, often joyful. Thoroughly monitored moments from life of each of the five characters are connected by motifs and paragraphs from the book. The film is following the Japanese boy who travels through the epic landscape gradually revealing what his autism represents, how his world's notion differs, and why he behaves in the way he behaves, and after all: why they jump. The film winced all these elements in a sensually rich visual story that leads us to the core of the glasses: if someone can't talk, doesn't mean there's nothing to say. / Baziran na bestseleru Naokija Higašide, Razlog zbog kog skačem je... je filmsko uranjanje i istraživanje naše neurološke različitosti kroz iskustva nemih i autističnih ljudi širom sveta. Film je spoj Higašidinih ličnih doživljaja autizma, napisanih kada je imao samo 13 godina, sa intimnim portretima petoro izvanrednih mladih ljudi. Otvara nam vrata čulnog univerzuma, moćnog i sveobuhvatnog, često i radosnog. Temeljno praćeni momenti iz života svakog od pet likova povezani su motivima i odlomcima iz knjige. Film prati japanskog dečaka koji putuje kroz epski pejzaž postepeno otkrivajući šta njegov autizam predstavlja, kako se njegovo poimanje sveta razlikuje, i zašto se ponaša na način na koji se ponaša, i na kraju krajeva: zašto skače. Film je sve ove elemente utkao u čulno bogatu vizuelnu priču koja nas vodi do srži Naokijeve poruke: Ako neko ne ume da priča, ne znači da nema šta i da kaže.

programme.title: Green tourism / Zeleni turizam
programme.desc: Whether they are in the heart of the desert, placed on trees or in the middle of the ocean, enter the door of these guest houses, whose comfort and environmentally responsible design are just as good, if not better than those in the biggest palaces. Connecting architecture and escapism, green tourism leads you to various ends of our planet and reveals the most beautiful ecological houses in the world. It is fantastic estates, whose ecological design and beautiful natural environment attract more and more tourists eager greener, authentic and more reasonable experiences. / Bilo da su u srcu pustinje, smeštene na drveću ili usred okeana, uđite kroz vrata ovih kuća za goste, čija su udobnost i ekološki odgovoran dizajn jednako dobri, ako ne i bolji od onih u najvećim palatama. programme.title: Daydreams of a networked holy / Sanjarenja umreženog sveta
programme.desc: Director Verner Hercog reconstructs the virtual world, starting to the end of its range, exploring the digital background with the same curiosity and creativity he approached different terrestrial areas, such as Amazon, Sahara, South Pole and abandoned areas of Australia. The Hercog viewer leads to a single journey, through a number of provocative talks that reveal how the world has transformed the way in which the real world works - from trade to education to health, all the way to the central issue of human behavior in society. / Reditelj Verner Hercog rekonstruiše virtuelni svet, počev od njegovog postanka, sve do krajnjih dometa, istražujući digitalnu pozadinu sa istom radoznalošću i kreativnošću kojima je pristupao različitim zemaljskim predelima, poput Amazona, Sahare, Južnog pola i napuštenih predela Australije. Hercog gledaoce vodi na jedinstveno putovanje, kroz niz provokativnih razgovora koji otkrivaju kako je onlajn svet transformisao način na koji realni svet funkcioniše - od trgovine do obrazovanja, od putovanja u svemir do zdravstva, sve do središnjeg pitanja ljudskog ponašanja u društvu.

programme.title: Why do I jump / Zašto skačem
programme.desc: Based on the bestseller of Higašide, the reason why I jump is ... is a filmmaking and researching our neurological difference through experiences of muric and autistic people around the world. The film is a combination of hyguisids of personal experiences of autism, written when he was only 13 years old, with the intimate portraits of five extraordinary young people. He opens us the door of the sensual universe, powerful and comprehensive, often joyful. Thoroughly monitored moments from life of each of the five characters are connected by motifs and paragraphs from the book. The film is following the Japanese boy who travels through the epic landscape gradually revealing what his autism represents, how his world's notion differs, and why he behaves in the way he behaves, and after all: why they jump. The film winced all these elements in a sensually rich visual story that leads us to the core of the glasses: if someone can't talk, doesn't mean there's nothing to say. / Baziran na bestseleru Naokija Higašide, Razlog zbog kog skačem je... je filmsko uranjanje i istraživanje naše neurološke različitosti kroz iskustva nemih i autističnih ljudi širom sveta. Film je spoj Higašidinih ličnih doživljaja autizma, napisanih kada je imao samo 13 godina, sa intimnim portretima petoro izvanrednih mladih ljudi. Otvara nam vrata čulnog univerzuma, moćnog i sveobuhvatnog, često i radosnog. Temeljno praćeni momenti iz života svakog od pet likova povezani su motivima i odlomcima iz knjige. Film prati japanskog dečaka koji putuje kroz epski pejzaž postepeno otkrivajući šta njegov autizam predstavlja, kako se njegovo poimanje sveta razlikuje, i zašto se ponaša na način na koji se ponaša, i na kraju krajeva: zašto skače. Film je sve ove elemente utkao u čulno bogatu vizuelnu priču koja nas vodi do srži Naokijeve poruke: Ako neko ne ume da priča, ne znači da nema šta i da kaže.

programme.title: Pope's prophecy / Proročanstvo papa
programme.desc: Thousands of years of people across the ancient world claimed to have the power of predictions. In 1143. The prophecy of the Pope was created - in which the future attributes of the 112 Pontifix are given to inherit St. Peter. This prophecy forgoted that the Benedict KSVI would be 111. Pope, if that is true, the current Papa Konklava will bring the end of the world. / Hiljadama godina ljudi širom drevnog sveta su tvrdili da imaju moć predviđanja. Godine 1143. nastalo je Proročanstvo papa - u kojem se navode budući atributi 112 pontifeksa koji će naslediti Svetog Petra. Ovo proročanstvo staro 900 godina predviđalo je da će Benedikt KSVI biti 111. papa, pa će, ako je tačno, aktuelna papska konklava doneti smak sveta.

programme.title: A woman in war / Žena u ratu
programme.desc: When Rio Tinto threatens to destroy Iceland with his excavations, the Hal activist decides to take the matter into his own hands. She sabotages the transmission lines, directly by stopping the work of the smelter and this company, but the consequences of her underwear do not stop. This action is responsible for breaking cooperation between China and Iceland, which is why Icelandic authorities must interfere with the fingers in the entire situation. When he does not lead the ecological war, the hall led by the local choir. As the opposite of this elderly citizen choir, there is a three-member band that form pianists, drummer and saxophonists, which later joins the trio of Ukrainian folk singers. Namely, the hall is located at the age of milestone, after a four-year process of adoption and fulfillment, over a hundred foreign paperwork, it gets the news to approve the adoption of a Ukrainian girl. The question arises: Does the hall can continue to continue with your activism and be a caring mother to your child? / Kada Rio Tinto zapreti da uništi Island svojim iskopavanjima, aktivistkinja Hala odlučuje da stvar uzme u svoje ruke. Ona sabotira dalekovode, direktno zaustavivši rad topionice i ove kompanije, ali posledice njenog podviga tu ne staju. Ova akcija zaslužna je za prekid saradnje između Kine i Islanda, zbog čega islandske vlasti moraju da umešaju prste u celu situaciju. Kada ne vodi ekološki rat, Hala predvodi lokalni hor. Kao suprotnost ovom horu starijih građana nalazi se tročlani bend koji čine pijanista, bubnjar i saksofonista, kojima se kasnije pridružuje i trio ukrajinskih narodnih pevača. Naime, Hala se nalazi na životnoj prekretnici kada, nakon četvorogodišnjeg procesa usvajanja i ispunjavanja preko stotinu strana papirologije, dobija vest da joj je odobreno usvajanje jedne ukrajinske devojčice. Postavlja se pitanje: da li Hala može istovremeno da nastavi sa svojim aktivizmom i bude brižna majka svom detetu?
