programme.desc: Some better people are a family series whose main heroes are represented by members of the Urošević family and Graovac. The drama action is initiated by events that lead to the situation in situations through which their personal interests and ambitions will be expressed, striving for strong mutual emotions. Three generations under one roof, in the neighbor's apartments Graovac and Urošević, represent the ideal terrain for the conflicts of generations and the value systems, but also a fine humor. Đuro and his wife Jovanka belong to the post-war, Baby Bum generation, worked and educated children in the socialist spirit. Dragan and Marija are representatives of the Generation X, which spent the best years of his life during the 1990s last century. And while Mary managed to be highly positioned in the business hierarchy, Dragan accepted the role of housewives in the house. Nikola, Sarah and Filip are children of a new millennium, a generation that life on the net is equally important as reality. However, when they catch up with the original urges, as love, they will be forced to turn to themselves and face feelings. Then they slowly begin to realize that you can't hide in the virtual world from reality. The Graovac family - Urošević is under constant pressure with which it can be seen in and can, and rather often neither knows, nor can it. Children press the challenges and temptations of growing up, parents' expectations and parents themselves; Parents are pressed by marital problems and children, and grandparents - family and existential problems. How our heroes will be worn with them and whether they will become some after all / Neki bolji ljudi porodična je serija čije glavne junake predstavljaju članovi porodice Urošević i Graovac. Dramsku radnju pokreću događaji koji protagoniste dovode u situacije kroz koje će se ispoljiti njihovi lični interesi i ambicije, prožeti jakim međusobnim emocijama. Tri generacije pod jednim krovom, u komšijskim stanovima Graovac i Urošević, predstavljaju idealan teren za sukobe generacija i sistema vrednosti ali i fini humor. Dragan i Marija su predstavnici generacije X koja je najbolje godine svog života potrošila tokom devedesetih godina 20 veka prošlog veka. Nikola, Sara i Filip su deca novog milenijuma, generacija kojoj je život na mreži podjednako važan kao i realnost. programme.title: Application / Aplikacija
programme.desc: The life of one of the world's most famous hackers is in danger after developing an application that can hack any social networking order and get any information using only the phone number. / Život jednog od najpoznatijih svetskih hakera je u opasnosti nakon što je razvio aplikaciju koja može da hakuje bilo koji nalog na društvenim mrežama i dobije bilo koje informacije koristeći samo broj telefona.

programme.title: Hostel 2 / Hostel 2
programme.desc: In the production of Quentina Tarantina and directed by Elija Rota, Hostel 2 is a shocking and frightening of the underground organization where the rich people pay and kill the innocent victims. Girls accept and come to Slovakia where they are placed in a fatal hostel. It will soon become innocent victims put on auction. / U produkciji Kventina Tarantina i režiji Elija Rota,Hostel 2 je šokantan i zastrašujući nastavak o podzemnoj organizacije gde bogataši plaćaju da bi mučili i ubijali nevine žrtve.Tri mlade Amerikanke koje studiraju u Rimu, bivaju pozvane na egzotičan vikend-odmor sa ciljem uživanja. Devojke prihvataju i dolaze u Slovačku gde se smeštaju u kobni Hostel. Uskoro će postati nevine žrtve stavljene na aukciju.

programme.title: Path to the center of the earth / Put u središte zemlje
programme.desc: During the scientific expedition in Iceland, the scientist and visionary Trevor Anderson, his Bratan Sean and their Guide Hannah, remain trapped in the cave from which the only way out leads even and deeper into the depths of the earth. Traveling throughout unprecedented worlds, they face supernatural and unimaginable creatures - including plants of cannibals, giant flying piran, birds that bright and terrifying dinosaurs from ancient times. Adventurists soon notice that volcanic activity is growing around them and conclude that they have to find the way to the Earth before it becomes too late. / Tokom naučne ekspedicije na Islandu, naučnik i vizionar Trevor Anderson, njegov bratanac Šon i njihov vodič Hana, neočekivano ostaju zarobljeni u pećini iz koje jedini izlaz vodi sve dublje i dublje u dubine Zemlje. Putujući kroz do sada neviđene svetove, oni se suočavaju sa natprirodnim i nezamislivim stvorenjima — uključujući biljke ljudožderke, džinvosku leteću piranu, ptice koje svetle i užasavajuće dinosauruse iz davnih vremena. Avanturisti uskoro primećuju da vulkanska aktivnost raste oko njih i zaključuju da moraju da nađu put do zemljine površine pre nego postane prekasno.

Sve će se promeniti kada se budu upleli u veliku operaciju krijumčarenja droge, i ispostavi se da je Kits zapravo policajac.

programme.title: Jumandzi: Welcome to the jungle / Džumandži: Dobro došli u džunglu
programme.desc: Four high school students reveal an old video game that they have never heard before. From that moment, it will be drawn into the fun world of Jungle and become the avatars of your own choice: the Spencer will become a nerd, athletes, the real Einstein will turn into a middle-aged professor, and the fragile marta will become a fearless warrant. However, the party will soon turn into something else, when they find that Jumandians are not played - already survives. To win and return to the real world, they must go to the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discovering what Alan Paris left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or will remain in the game forever. / Četvoro srednjoškolaca otkrivaju staru video igru za koju nikad ranije nisu čuli. Od tog trenutka biće uvučeni u zabavan svet džungle i postati avatari prema sopstvenom izboru: Spenser će tako postati štreberski istraživač, sportista Fridž će postati pravi Ajnštajn, popularna devojka Betani će se pretvoriti u sredovečnog profesora, a krhka Marta postaće neustrašiva ratnica. Međutim, zabava će se uskoro pretvoriti u nešto drugo, kada otkriju da se Džumandži ne igra - već preživljava. Da bi pobedili i vratili se u stvaran svet, moraju da odu u najopasniju avanturu njihovih života, otkriju šta je Alan Pariš ostavio pre 20 godina, i promene način na koji razmišljaju o sebi - ili će zauvek ostati u igrici.

programme.title: Being of blood / Biće krvi
programme.desc: Daniel persistently looking for oil and continues to buy a country in cheap that has such potential. When he gets information about the important site on the possession of the Sandej family, Daniel goes to the registration negotiations. He manages to redeem the Earth, but in turn, he will have to ensure a great donation to a young elije, who wants to become the main preacher of the area. / Danijel uporno traži naftu i nastavlja da jeftino kupuje zemlju koja ima takvog potencijala. Kada dobije informaciju o važnom nalazištu na posedu porodice Sandej, Danijel odlazi na pregovore o otkupu. On uspeva da otkupi zemlju, ali će zauzvrat morati da osigurati veliku donaciju mladom Eliju, koji želi postati glavni propovednik oblasti.

programme.title: Who survives talking / Ko preživi pričaće
programme.desc: The action of this hilarious comedy takes place in 1882. in Arizona, Albert, a farmer without self-confidence, loses his beloved girl withdrawing from the duel. He soon lucky to the enchanting Anna, so he reveals his courage and full potential when Anna's husband, a famous criminal, announce his arrival. / Radnja ove urnebesne komedije odvija se 1882. godine u Arizoni, Albert, farmer bez samopouzdanja, gubi svoju voljenu devojku povlačenjem iz dvoboja. Ubrzo sreće zanosnu Anu, pa otkriva svoju hrabrost i puni potencijal kada Anin muž, poznati kriminalac, najavi svoj dolazak.

programme.title: Pentecost executives / Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: When ghosts start obsessing New York, the four scientists first understand what is happening. To try to stop them, they create special weapons and form a unit that will fight ghosts. / Kada duhovi počnu opsedati Njujork, četiri naučnice prve shvate šta se događa. Kako bi ih pokušale zaustaviti, one kreiraju posebna oružja i oformljuju jedinicu koja će se boriti protiv duhova.

programme.title: Meteorologist / Meteorolog
programme.desc: Dave Spric has a commendable career as a meteorologist in Chicago. People love him and hate him. His private life is in chaos, his father dies, his children are not exactly the best children in the world, and his wife doesn't really worship him. Trying to deal with all problems, he wants his father to be proud of him before he dies, he wants to help children become better people and wants to return his wife, but it's not exactly such an easy task. / Dejv Spric ima pohvalnu karijeru kao meteorolog u Čikagu. Ljudi ga i vole i mrze. Njegov privatni život je u haosu, otac mu umire, njegova deca nisu baš najbolja deca na svetu, a žena ga baš i ne obožava. Pokušavajući da se nosi sa svim problemima, on želi da se njegov otac ponosi njime pre nego što umre, želi da pomogne deci da postanu bolji ljudi i želi da vrati svoju ženu, ali to i nije baš tako lak zadatak.

programme.title: A week horse / Nedeljni konj
programme.desc: After the almost fatal accident, which experts thought that it was nothing special, a determined rider defies all the possibilities to achieve his dreams about victory at the National Jumps Championship. / Posle skoro fatalne nesreće na konju koji su stručnjaci smatrali da nije ništa posebno, odlučna jahačica prkosi svim mogućnostima da ostvari svoje snove o pobedi na nacionalnom prvenstvu u skokovima.

programme.title: Hostel 3 / Hostel 3
programme.desc: Two sexy girls named four friends who are at the guy's dinner in Las Vegas, to join them on a private party away from the city center. Upon arrival there, guys are appalled when they realize that they are part of the perverted game of torture. A few days before he marries Amy, Scott goes to the guy evening in Las Vegas with his friends with a jastelin, mother and the Master. They go to the striptease - a club where they meet two girls dealing with business escort, Niki and Angel, which invite four friends to a private party in the suburbs of Las Vegas. The next morning Scott, Mike and Carter realize that Mike, who is married and has two children, disappeared. They soon learn that Niki has disappeared and the angels are joined in search of two missing. They then draw a group of men and they realize that they will be subjected to a sadistic torture to meet members of the elite hunting society. They are later surprised to see who is one of the members of that ill gambling team. / Dve seksi devojke namame četvoricu prijatelja koji su na momačkoj večeri u Las Vegasu, da im se pridruže na privatnoj žurci daleko od centra grada. Po dolasku tamo, momci su zgroženi kad shvate da su deo perverzne igre mučenja. Nekoliko dana pre nego što će se oženiti Ejmi, Skot odlazi na momačko veče u Las Vegas sa svojim prijateljima Džastinom, Majkom i Karterom. Oni odlaze u striptiz - klub gde upoznaju dve devojke koje se bave poslovnom pratnjom, Niki i Anđelu, koje pozivaju četvoricu prijatelja na privatnu žurku u predgrađu Las Vegasa. Sledećeg jutra Skot, Majk i Karter shvataju da je Majk, koji je oženjen i ima dvoje dece, nestao. Uskoro saznaju da je i Niki nestala i pridružuju se Anđeli u potrazi za dvoje nestalih. Njih zatim otima grupa muškaraca i oni shvataju da će biti podvrgnuti sadističkom mučenju kako bi se zadovoljili članovi Elitnog lovačkog društva. Oni se kasnije iznenade kada vide ko je jedan od članova te bolesne kockarske ekipe.

Ipak kada se njegov sin prijavi u vojsku da bi branio njihovu novu naseobinu Ameriku on se vraća starom životu kako bi zaštitio sina.

programme.title: Detachment of death / Odred smrti
programme.desc: The aliens race achieved secret contact with the USA. During these negotiations, governments and aliens have reached an agreement on the exchange. Arriving on Earth, aliens soon shows what the price was the achievement achieved. Namely, they go collect human DNA. He became aware of his mistake, members of the Government invite the main special agent of Marshal Lavson and ordered him to resolve the threat. Using all their skills, the agent starts a task that makes it difficult for him that the fact that the public must not know about the existence of aliens. / Rasa vanzemaljaca ostvarila je tajni kontakt sa SAD-om. Tokom tih pregovora vlada i vanzemaljci su postigli dogovor o razmeni. Stigavši na Zemlju, vanzemaljci ubrzo pokazuju koja je cena postignutog dogovora. Naime, oni krenu skupljati ljudski DNK. Postavši svesni svoje greške, članovi vlade pozivaju glavnog specijalnog agenta Maršala Lavsona i narede mu da se reši pretnje. Koristeći sve svoje veštine, agent započinje zadatak koji mu otežava i činjenica da javnost ne sme znati za postojanje vanzemaljaca.

programme.title: What do I want more / Šta želim više
programme.desc: Ana has become everything that was expected from her: It has a modest, but a stable job, it is close to family, friends and partner Alesija, which is planning a child. Maybe the only thing that is missing is her courage to take responsibility for their future. When her life suddenly entered Domeniko, married with Miriam, the father of two children, for the first time all the boundaries in Ana's life are deleted. However, love has a firmly set boundaries. / Ana je postala sve što se od nje očekivalo: ima skroman, ali stabilan posao, bliska je s porodicom, prijateljima i partnerom Alesijem, s kojim planira dete. Možda jedino što joj nedostaje jeste hrabrost da preuzme odgovornost za svoju budućnost. Kad u njen život iznenada uđe Domeniko, oženjen s Miriam, otac dvoje dece, po prvi put sve granice u Aninom životu se brišu. Međutim, i ljubav ima čvrsto postavljene granice.

programme.title: Last kiss / Poslednji poljubac
programme.desc: Majkl had just learned that his girlfriend was pregnant and now he could see the rest of his life horrified. Although he is aware that Jenna is perfect for such a venture, he will panic and think more and more about the young who openly seizes him. The temptation to make life is unpredictable again is great, and his friends are in front of his, no less important life decisions. / Majkl je upravo saznao da mu je devojka Džena trudna i sada može da vidi ostatak života što ga užasava. Iako je svestan toga da je Džena savršena za takav poduhvat, on će da se uspaniči i sve više razmišlja o mladoj Kim koja ga otvoreno zavodi. Iskušenje da opet učini život nepredvidljivim je velik, a njegovi prijatelji se nalaze pred svojim, ništa manje važnim životnim odlukama.

programme.title: The path of love / Put ljubavi
programme.desc: When bris and julie, second grade students, they first meet, Julie knows it's love. Brice is not so sure. For the next six years, young bris will do whatever it takes to keep the distance from your unsolicited girl - what is not so easy, given that they go to the same school and live one across from another. Smart, independent and willing to take place for their views, Julie is different from everyone who knows. After all, what does the boy need to do when his girlfriend tells him his hair smells like a watermelon or when he wants to sit next to her on a tree and observe the spectacular sunset? Although disappointed that bris does not want to observe things like her or at least those things he finds the most important, Julie continues to believe in them until one day doubts do not accumulate. Maybe she was wrong about him. And at the same time bris begins to think that he may have been wrong about her. But is it too late? / Kada se Brajs i Džuli, učenici drugog razreda, prvi put upoznaju, Džuli zna da je to ljubav. Brajs nije tako siguran. Narednih šest godina, mladi Brajs će raditi sve što je potrebno kako bi se držao na distanci od svoje nesuđene devojke - što i nije tako lako, s obzirom da idu u istu školu i žive jedno preko puta drugog. Pametna, samostalna i voljna da se zauzme za svoje stavove, Džuli je drugačija od svih koje poznaje. Uostalom, šta dečak treba da uradi kada mu devojčica kaže da mu kosa miriše na lubenicu ili kada želi da sedne pored nje na drvetu i posmatra spektakularan zalazak sunca? Iako razočarana što Brajs ne želi da posmatra stvari kao ona ili bar one stvari koje smatra najvažnijim, Džuli nastavlja da veruje u njih sve dok se jednog dana sumnje ne nagomilaju. Možda je ipak pogrešila u vezi njega. A u isto vreme Brajs počinje da misli da je možda ipak pogrešio u vezi nje. Ali, da li je prekasno?

programme.title: Baby in sight / Beba na vidiku
programme.desc: The two of them are in a romantic relationship full of love - until the unexpected angel's pregnancy takes them to nine-month ride. Through a joint trip, they must face jealousy ... suspicion, Andjelina, too late by the boss, but also the entire drama of their happy married best friends Danny and Silvie. / Njih dvoje su u romantičnoj vezi punoj ljubavi - sve dok ih neočekivana Andjelina trudnoća ne odvede na devetomesečnu vožnju. Kroz zajedničko putovanje moraju da se suočiti s ljubomorom... sumnjom, Andjelinom prezahtevnom šeficom, ali i čitavom dramom njihovih srećno venčanih najboljih prijatelja Denija i Silvije.

programme.title: Return to the blue lagoon / Povratak u plavu lagunu
programme.desc: Salvation looked for in a small, isolated island in the middle of the ocean. They stay alone in the wild, supported by each other, revealing his love. While they seemed to be perfect, one day things were beginning to change. / Spas su potražili na malom, izolovanom ostrvu usred okeana. Ostaju sami u divljini, oslonjeni jedno na drugo, otkrivajući svoju ljubav. Iako im se činilo da je život savršen, jednog dana stvari počinju da se menjaju.

programme.title: Locked / Zaključani
programme.desc: Linda is a successful director of marketing, which, because of their new duties at work, is disappointed by the corporate world, while Pakston, a criminal criminal past, remains without work. In addition to poetry and generous amounts of wine, as they try to live together in peace, they are an old life zeal in them and they become municipalized in a sudden opportunity to participate in the great looting jewelry. / Linda je uspešna direktorka marketinga koja se, zbog svojih novih zaduženja na poslu, razočarava korporativnim svetom, dok Pakston, kreativac sa kriminalnom prošlošću, ostaje bez posla. Uz poeziju i izdašne količine vina, dok pokušavaju da žive zajedno u miru, u njima se budi stari životni žar i oni postaju opčinjeni iznenadnom prilikom da učestvuju u velikoj pljački nakita.

programme.title: Love drink number 9 / Ljubavni napitak broj 9
programme.desc: The sex is awkward in relations with a better pole and therefore will go to the vracar that has a solution for him. A love potion to make every girl fall in love with him. / Pol je nespretan u odnosima sa lepšim polom i zato će otići kod vračare koja ima rešenje za njega. Ljubavni napitak koji će učiniti da se svaka devojka zaljubi u njega.

programme.title: Henri i Džun / Henri i Džun
programme.desc: A deep sensual and erotic movie about love in Paris. The main actors are writers Anais Nin and Henry Miller, as well as their partners Hugo and Jun. / Duboko senzualan i erotičan film o ljubavi u Parizu. Glavni akteri su pisci Anais Nin i Henri Miler, kao i njihovi partneri Hugo i Džun.

programme.title: A lot of noise on nothing / Mnogo buke ni oko čega
programme.desc: Hiro and Claudio young people are lovers, who eagerly expect a wedding. To kill time, those with help Don Pedra try to make a love trap for benedict, arrogant and seemingly eternal unwanting, and beatrice, a girl of a fire temperament and sharp tongue. Meanwhile, the evil Don John tries to prevent the wedding by spreading the floor stories about Hira. / Hiro i Klaudio mladi su ljubavnici, koji željno očekuju venčanje. Kako bi ubili vreme, oni uz pomoć Don Pedra pokušavaju napraviti ljubavnu zamku za Benedikta, arogantnog i naizgled večnog neženju, i Beatriče, devojku vatrenog temperamenta i oštrog jezika. U međuvremenu, zli Don Džon pokušava sprečiti venčanje šireći podle priče o Hiru.

programme.title: Judy / Džudi
programme.desc: The biographical story of the actresses and singers of Judy Garland and its last year before reaching the end of the concerts in London, on the fifth of marriage, alcoholism, childhood and the studio with all unimaginable restrictions, which left the trail in her life. / Biografska priča o glumici i pevačici Džudi Garland i njenoj poslednjoj godini života pre nego što je došla do kraja, o rasprodatim koncertima u Londonu, o petom braku, alkoholizmu, detinjstvu i o tome kako ju je studio iskorišćavao sa svim nezamislivim ograničenjima, koja su ostavlila trag u njenom životu.

programme.title: Rhyme with love / Rimu s ljubavlju
programme.desc: We are in magical rhyme. Meet the worker who wakes up as a big star, architect who lived in a young man, a young couple on the honeymoon, a frustrated director of his daughter and accidentally reveals an incredibly talented singer who actually never performed. / U čarobnom smo Rimu. Upoznajte radnika koji se budi kao velika zvezda, arhitekta koji se vraća u mladost i ulicu u kojoj je živeo kao student, mladi par na medenom mesecu, frustriranog režisera opere koji dolazi upoznati verenika svoje kćeri i slučajno otkriva neverovatno talentovanog pevača koji zapravo nikad nije nastupao.

programme.desc: The life of a female family in a small place in the south of America, they gain meaning in the beauty salon holding one of them. Taj salon predstavlja njihov tajni hram u kome nalaze utehu za svoje poraze i radost prijateljstva u svojim pobedama.

programme.title: Love and literature / Ljubav i književnost
programme.desc: The writer of the novel Michael must agree with his new boss, come, so that he would not lose his job in the publishing house, and their relationship threatens to jeopardize the preparation of her wedding. / Pisac romana Majkl mora se složiti sa svojom novom šeficom, Dori, kako ne bi izgubio posao u izdavačkoj kući, a njihov odnos preti da ugrozi pripreme njenog venčanja.

programme.title: Purge / Pročišćenje
programme.desc: In America, flooded crime and overcrowded prisons, the government has introduced 12-hour, annual period in which all criminal actions become legal. You can't call the police. Hospitals do not provide help. That is one night where citizens can do whatever wants to and will not be punished for that. This night full of crime epidemic, one family will fight with a decision who will become when their foreigner is nailed to the door. / U Americi, preplavljenoj kriminalom i pretrpanim zatvorima, vlada je uvela 12-časovni, godišnji period u kome sve kriminalne radnje postaju legalne. Policiju ne možete zvati. Bolnice ne pružaju pomoć. To je jedna noć u kojoj građani mogu da rade šta god hoće i za to neće biti kažnjeni. Ove noći prepune nasilja i epidemije kriminala, jedna porodica će se boriti sa odlukom ko će postati kad im stranac zakuca na vrata.

programme.title: A snake horror / Zmijoglavi užas
programme.desc: A small town in the American crush, which is still recovering from a difficult economic situation, is in front of a new danger when a kind of local fish survives chemical poisoning and mutations in aggressive carnivores. The transformation in the predators was made when the human growth hormones were inserted into the lake, in order to improve the results of the local fishing industry. In contact with these hormones, fish grow to giant sizes, so they adopt the ability to move and feed and dry. When food disappears in the lake, they move towards the town. / Mali grad u američkoj zabiti, koji se još uvek oporavlja od teške ekonomske situacije, nađe se pred novom opasnošću kada jedna vrsta lokalnih riba preživi hemijsko trovanje i mutira u agresivne mesoždere. Transformacija u predatore izvršena je kada su ljudski hormoni rasta ubačeni u jezero, kako bi se poboljšali rezultati lokalne ribarske industrije. U dodiru s tim hormonima, ribe rastu do gigantskih veličina, pa usvajaju sposobnost kretanja i hranjenja i na suvom. Kada u jezeru nestane hrane, kreću prema gradiću.

programme.desc: Teenagers eager for celebrations become stars of the following internet sensations. But they do it - not your will! Film parts relate to: a disappointed illusionist finding a magical subject of huge power, an inventor of the machine that opens the door to a parallel world, teenage skepto that become the Mexican sect sect, and the secret organization that accompanies the serial killer. / Tinejdžeri željni slave postaju zvezde sledeće internet-senzacije. Jedan od retkih filmova koji uspešno spaja smeh i stravu. Majkl Dž. Foks tumači lik Frenka Banistera, isterivača duhova iz male varoši, udruženog sa duhovima koje bi trebalo da istera. programme.title: Birth / Rađanje
programme.desc: As a very young Ana, she remained without her husband who passed away in New York Park. It is difficult to bear with the loss of the loved one, Ana after the full decade of grief, however, decides further after agreeing to marry the long-standing Joseph's suitor. Due to Ana's decisions, her sister Laura, the best friend of Clara and mother Elenor, where the birthday celebration arrives. It is a ten-year-old boy, which is beginning Ana to convince that the reincarnation of her deceased husband is. At first without attaching any attention to his words, Anna little and a little start disturbing the boy's warnings not to marry Joseph. / Kao veoma mlada Ana je ostala bez supruga koji je preminuo u njujorškom parku. Teško se noseći s gubitkom voljene osobe, Ana nakon pune decenije tugovanja ipak odluči krenuti dalje nakon što pristane udati se za dugogodišnjeg udvarača Jozefa. Zbog Anine odluke posebno su srećne njena sestra Laura, najbolja prijateljica Klara i majka Elenor na čiju proslavu rođendana stigne neobični gost. To je desetogodišnji dečak Šon koji Anu počne uveravati da je reinkarnacija njenog preminulog supruga. Isprva ne pridajući nikakvu pažnju njegovim rečima, Anu malo-pomalo počnu uznemiravati dečakova upozorenja da se ne udaje za Jozefa.

programme.title: King Scorpio 2 / Kralj škorpija 2
programme.desc: In the ancient city of Akkad, Matajas grows up in the Proud Son of Ashur, the captain of the Military Unit of Black Scorpions. When I despite the opposition of the Father, she wants to become a member of the detachment, a tragedy that changes Matajas' life is happening ... / U drevnom gradu Akkad, Matajas odrasta u ponosnog sina Ašura, kapetana vojne jedinice Crnih Škorpiona. Kada sam uprkos protivljenju oca poželi postati član odreda, dešava se tragedija koja menja Matajasov život...

programme.title: Hidden / Skriveni
programme.desc: Ray, Claire and their seven-year-old daughter Zoe for 301 days live in his shelter after they avoided a disaster that changed everything. Three hundred days managed to avoid a danger that lurks from the surface, but that came to the end - their safe refuge is no longer that safe and unknown danger comes for them. / Rej, Kler i njihova sedmogodišnja kći Zoi već 301 dan žive u svom skloništu nakon što su izbegli katastrofu koja je sve promenila. Svoje podzemno sklonište su pretvorili u dom, ali svejedno se nadaju da će jednom vratiti svoj stari život. Trista dana uspeli su izbegavati opasnost koja vreba s površine, ali tome je došao kraj - njihovo sigurno utočište više nije toliko sigurno i nepoznata opasnost dolazi po njih.

programme.title: The trap of time / Zamka vremena
programme.desc: Professor of Archeology goes in search of his father who has long disappeared in search of the source of eternal life. He informs about that group of his students, and insists not to follow him, because he wants to go alone to give them no danger. He leaves, disappears and the group moves in search of him, but they don't answer anyone about their mission. From the point of view of the external world, they disappear. What's going on? Since the professor told a group where he was going, the group went there and revealed the ground hallway network and cave. The plot is that time in the cave is completely different from time out of time. / Profesor arheologije kreće u potragu za svojim ocem koji je davno nestao u potrazi za izvorom večnog života. Obaveštava o tome grupu svojih studenata, i insistira da ga ne prate, jer želi da ide sam da njih ne dovede u opasnost. Odlazi, nestaje i grupa kreće u potragu za njim, ali nikome ne javljaju o svojoj misiji. Sa gledišta spoljašnjeg sveta, nestaju i oni. Šta se dešava? Pošto je profesor rekao grupi gde ide, grupa je otišla tamo i otkrila mrežu podzemnih hodnika i pećina. Zaplet je u tome što vreme u pećini skroz drugačije teče nego vreme van nje.

programme.title: Purification: Anarchy / Pročišćenje: Anarhija
programme.desc: The US government, which have now reorganized America's new founders, approved the annual twelve purification to ensure that the level of crimes remain below one percent. While police and hospitals deny help, it is the night that citizens are regulated only without thinking of punishment or fear of retaliation. It is the time when anarchy government is on the streets. The new story follows an unexpected group of five citizens who, during that night, are exactly how to go to protect themselves and finally, each other while fighting to survive the night full of impossible decisions. / Američka vlada, koju su sada reorganizovali Novi osnivači Amerike, odobrila je godišnje dvanaestosatno Pročišćenje kako bi se pobrinula da nivo zločina ostane ispod jedan posto. Dok policija i bolnice uskraćuju pomoć, to je noć kada se građanstvo reguliše samo bez pomisli na kaznu ili straha od odmazde. To je vreme kada na ulicama vlada anarhija. Nova priča prati neočekivanu grupu od pet građana koji, tokom te noći, otkriju tačno dokle su spremni ići da zaštite sebe i na kraju, jedni druge dok se bore da prežive noć punu nemogućih odluka.

programme.title: Library - The search for a spear of fate / Bibliotekar - Potraga za Kopljem sudbine
programme.desc: Flin is a new employee in the Bookstore Metropolitan Paurnik. It soon reveals that his job and is not so simple. He actually becomes a guardian of the great world treasure, hidden in the infinite corridors of the building. When members of mysterious fraternity steal one of three holy relics that enables them to manage the fate of the world, the librarian Flyls go to Amazon, to prevent them from stealing and the other two. / Flin je novi zaposleni u knjižari Metropoliten Pablik. Ubrzo otkriva da njegov posao i nije baš tako jednostavan. On u stvari postaje čuvar velikog svetskog blaga, sakrivenog u beskrajnim hodnicima zgrade. Kada članovi misterioznog bratstva ukradu jednu od tri svete relikvije koja im omogućava da upravljaju sudbinom sveta, bibliotekar Flin odlazi u Amazon, da bi ih sprečio da ukradu i ostale dve.

programme.title: The beautiful trucks / Čudovišni kamioni
programme.desc: Trip is a high school student talented to make a truck that comes to an amazing discovery - finds a creature of a crunch that swallows gasoline. To protect his mischievous friend, Trip hides him under the hood of his latest invention, turning the truck into the right alive monster. This unusual duo that loves speed goes wild and unforgettable travel with the aim of connecting the crisis with his family. / Trip je srednjoškolac talentovan za pravljenje kamiona koji dolazi do neverovatnog otkrića - pronalazi stvora Kriča koji guta benzin. Da bi zaštitio svog nestašnog prijatelja, Trip ga sakriva ispod haube svog najnovijeg izuma, pretvarajući kamion u pravo živo čudovište. Ovaj neobični dvojac koji obožava brzinu odlazi na divlje i nezaboravno putovanje sa ciljem da spoje Kriča sa njegovom porodicom.

programme.title: E. T. Vanzemaljac / E. T. vanzemaljac
programme.desc: During the visit, the Earth's Group is accidentally discovered by the country. In that panic, the newcomers escape into their ship and leave the country, but, they forgot about a small alien, which was then found quite alone, left, on him an unknown planet, away from his house. Fortunately, he soon finds a friend and a soul mate in the 10-year-old Eliot, who accidentally discovered him looking for food. / Za vreme posete Zemlji grupa vanzemaljaca bude slučajno otkrivena od strane ljudi. U toj panici, pridošlice na Zemlju pobegnu u svoj brod i napuste Zemlju, ali, zaboravili su na malenog vanzemaljca, koji se tada nađe posve sam, ostavljen, na njemu nepoznatoj planeti, daleko od svoje kuće. Na svu sreću, on ubrzo nađe prijatelja i srodnu dušu u 10-ogodišnjem Eliotu, koji ga je slučajno otkrio tražeći hranu.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: The series will definitely follow the tradition of the best domestic series that abound in humor, which stems from the nature and character of the protagonist. In the center of attention, Sitka is the life of the Life are members of the Savković family. The mother of the gross, proud owner of the florists, her children and daughters. GroZdin younger son Ljubisa is a teacher of mathematics permanently unhappy in love. Her daughter Silvana is a misunderstood, whose experience of life actually understands only married men. The older son of Siniš, by occupation of the shoemaker, is drawn to beer, weak on women, and somewhat on it. However, the main obstacle to the Sinišine Love Adventures is the fact that a married temperative person from whose farting character is all a little closer. Katarina has completed management in management at the Faculty of Management and seek work in the profession in vain. Her mother Radmila persistently persuades her to divorce the shoes and marrying for the Lufthanza pilot. However, Katarina cannot without sinning, and the secret of their marriage will be revealed in one of the episodes. The biggest friend of the family Savković is a dam, the owner of the cafe to which all Savkovići is happy to stop by. The dam loves to serve his guests, but more than that likes to transport them. It's often stronger than him. The truth for the will, knows and help when he affects. / Serija će svakako slediti i tradiciju najboljih domaćih serija koje obiluju humorom, koji proističe iz naravi i karaktera protagonista. U centru pažnje sitkoma Nek ide život su članovi porodice Savković. Majka Grozda, ponosna vlasnica cvećare, njena deca i snaja. Grozdin mlađi sin Ljubiša je nastavnik matematike permanentno nesrećan u ljubavi. Njena ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica , čiji doživljaj života zapravo shvataju jedino oženjeni muškarci. Stariji sin Siniša, po zanimanju obućar, navučen je na pivo, slab na žene, a pomalo i one na njega. Ipak, glavna prepreka za Sinišine ljubavne avanture jeste činjenica da je oženjen temperamentnom osobom od čijeg prgavog karaktera svi pomalo zaziru. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. A Miki, Johnny, Cherry, Sunčica, Marun, Maja and Caslav, are not capable of succeeding in new circumstances like the Father of their friend Gagges. The reasons for this is neither upbring, nor the 1990s, neither communism (so soothed communists are very easily successful capitalists). On his way to success, they bother their big heart and a weak stomach. All their ventures are sad to laugh, because every rupture between the overcome feeling of community and desire for personal success. However, when the crucified dreamer Johnny appears in their lives, a strange family begins to create that, they all want to, or not, they make much stronger connections than those relatives. And along the way they get a much more valuable prize than the time to chase. / Pare ili život je dramska, komična TV serija koja prati nekoliko različitih karaktera u sudaru s našom svakodnevnicom. Dramski realizam ove serije nekad se graniči s apsurdom, ali oslobođen je humora po svaku cenu i radije problematizuje neke socijalne fenomene. U društvu koje priželjkuje da je tranzicija već gotova, a ona tek što je počela, javljaju se brojne zamke za sve one koji se nisu snašli. A Miki, Džoni, Višnja, Sunčica, Marun, Maja i Časlav, nisu sposobni da u novim okolnostima uspeju poput oca njihovog prijatelja Gagija. Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: Our little editorial staff / Naša mala redakcija
programme.desc: What does a work day look like in one newsroom? Employees and accidents of employees in the news editorial office of Panorama. / Kako izgleda radni dan u jednoj novinskoj redakciji? Zgode i nezgode zaposlenih u novinskoj redakciji Panorama.

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Ideal relationships / Idealne veze
programme.desc: For the first time in our series, we will peek behind the scenes of one artistic marriage. He is a large acting star, celebrated and sought in all directions, eager that at least she finds the necessary peace at her own house. She is a young and attractive actress, eager excitement, always ready for action ... / Prvi put u našim serijama zavirićemo iza kulisa jednog umetničkog braka. On je velika glumačka zvezda, slavljen i tražen na sve strane, željan da bar u sopstvenoj kući nađe neophodan mir. Ona je mlada i atraktivna glumica, željna uzbuđenja, uvek spremna na akciju...

programme.title: Our little editorial staff / Naša mala redakcija
programme.desc: What does a work day look like in one newsroom? Employees and accidents of employees in the news editorial office of Panorama. / Kako izgleda radni dan u jednoj novinskoj redakciji? Zgode i nezgode zaposlenih u novinskoj redakciji Panorama.

programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: The series will definitely follow the tradition of the best domestic series that abound in humor, which stems from the nature and character of the protagonist. In the center of attention, Sitka is the life of the Life are members of the Savković family. The mother of the gross, proud owner of the florists, her children and daughters. GroZdin younger son Ljubisa is a teacher of mathematics permanently unhappy in love. Her daughter Silvana is a misunderstood, whose experience of life actually understands only married men. The older son of Siniš, by occupation of the shoemaker, is drawn to beer, weak on women, and somewhat on it. However, the main obstacle to the Sinišine Love Adventures is the fact that a married temperative person from whose farting character is all a little closer. Katarina has completed management in management at the Faculty of Management and seek work in the profession in vain. Her mother Radmila persistently persuades her to divorce the shoes and marrying for the Lufthanza pilot. However, Katarina cannot without sinning, and the secret of their marriage will be revealed in one of the episodes. The biggest friend of the family Savković is a dam, the owner of the cafe to which all Savkovići is happy to stop by. The dam loves to serve his guests, but more than that likes to transport them. It's often stronger than him. The truth for the will, knows and help when he affects. / Serija će svakako slediti i tradiciju najboljih domaćih serija koje obiluju humorom, koji proističe iz naravi i karaktera protagonista. U centru pažnje sitkoma Nek ide život su članovi porodice Savković. Majka Grozda, ponosna vlasnica cvećare, njena deca i snaja. Grozdin mlađi sin Ljubiša je nastavnik matematike permanentno nesrećan u ljubavi. Njena ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica , čiji doživljaj života zapravo shvataju jedino oženjeni muškarci. Stariji sin Siniša, po zanimanju obućar, navučen je na pivo, slab na žene, a pomalo i one na njega. Ipak, glavna prepreka za Sinišine ljubavne avanture jeste činjenica da je oženjen temperamentnom osobom od čijeg prgavog karaktera svi pomalo zaziru. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. Katarina je, završila menadžment u menadžmentu na fakultetu za menadžment i uzaludno traži posao u struci. Njena majka Radmila je uporno nagovara da se razvede od obućara i uda za pilota Lufthanze. Ipak, Katarina ne može bez Siniše, a tajna njihovog braka će biti otkrivena u jednoj od epizoda. Najveći prijatelj porodice Savković je Brana, vlasnik kafane u koju svi Savkovići rado svraćaju. Brana voli da usluži svoje goste, ali više od toga voli da ih prevesla. To je često jače od njega. Istini za volju, zna i da pomogne kada prigusti.

programme.title: Love, habit, panic / Ljubav, navika, panika
programme.desc: Marriage is when two people solve the problems they would never have together ... they are constantly arguing ... they are divided into arguing, amazing in neurosis for their or other people's behavior ... when love becomes a habit, whether everything becomes a panic. / Brak je kada dvoje ljudi zajedno rešavaju probleme koje nikad ne bi imali da nisu zajedno... oni se stalno svađaju, ali ne bi valjalo da je drugačije... oni su razdvojeni, ali žive u istom stanu... oni su srećni u svađama, neverovatni u neurozi i nemoćni da smisle argument za svoje ili tuđe ponašanje... kada ljubav postane navika, da li sve postaje panika.

programme.title: Steam or life / Pare ili život
programme.desc: Pare or life is a dramatic, comic TV series that accompanies several different characters in a collision with our everyday life. The dramatic realism of this series is sometimes bordered by the absurd, but is exempt from humor at all costs and prefer to problematize some social phenomena. In a society that desires that the transition is already over, and she has just begun, numerous traps for all those who did not work. A Miki, Johnny, Cherry, Sunčica, Marun, Maja and Caslav, are not capable of succeeding in new circumstances like the Father of their friend Gagges. The reasons for this is neither upbring, nor the 1990s, neither communism (so soothed communists are very easily successful capitalists). On his way to success, they bother their big heart and a weak stomach. All their ventures are sad to laugh, because every rupture between the overcome feeling of community and desire for personal success. However, when the crucified dreamer Johnny appears in their lives, a strange family begins to create that, they all want to, or not, they make much stronger connections than those relatives. And along the way they get a much more valuable prize than the time to chase. / Pare ili život je dramska, komična TV serija koja prati nekoliko različitih karaktera u sudaru s našom svakodnevnicom. Dramski realizam ove serije nekad se graniči s apsurdom, ali oslobođen je humora po svaku cenu i radije problematizuje neke socijalne fenomene. U društvu koje priželjkuje da je tranzicija već gotova, a ona tek što je počela, javljaju se brojne zamke za sve one koji se nisu snašli. A Miki, Džoni, Višnja, Sunčica, Marun, Maja i Časlav, nisu sposobni da u novim okolnostima uspeju poput oca njihovog prijatelja Gagija. Razlozi za to nisu ni vaspitanje, ni devedesete, ni komunizam (pa toliki zakleti komunisti veoma lako su postali uspešni kapitalisti). Na putu do uspeha smetaju im veliko srce i slab stomak. Svi njihovi poduhvati tužni su do smeha, jer je svako raspet između prevaziđenog osećanja zajedništva i želje za ličnim uspehom. Ipak, kad se u njihovim životima pojavi raspevani sanjar Džoni, počinje da se stvara jedna čudna porodica gde svi oni, hteli to ili ne, ostvaruju mnogo jače veze od onih rodbinskih. I usput dobijaju možda mnogo vredniju nagradu od one za kojom sve vreme jure.

programme.title: To survive Belgrade / Preživeti Beograd
programme.desc: Survivors Belgrade is the story of young people who come to Belgrade to study, their wishes, love, as well as ambitions to succeed in life. In parallel there is a story about their parents who come from different social miles. Their contrasts are represented, the arrival of people from the small middle in the big city. Survivors Belgrade is an honest, dynamic series that deals with optimism, ambitions and emotions, and thus younger generation, but also offers their parents good content. / Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u veliki grad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Ideal relationships / Idealne veze
programme.desc: For the first time in our series, we will peek behind the scenes of one artistic marriage. He is a large acting star, celebrated and sought in all directions, eager that at least she finds the necessary peace at her own house. She is a young and attractive actress, eager excitement, always ready for action ... / Prvi put u našim serijama zavirićemo iza kulisa jednog umetničkog braka. programme.title: You ask / Vi pitate
programme.desc: The viewers ask questions in the form of a survey, the questions will be without censorship, of course, provided that they are not indecent and not insult the guest. The questions will also be an introduction to some different conversation than those we are used to. Famous personalities also have the opportunity to present themselves to the audience in a unique way, placing themselves completely available for all issues that are interested in viewers, and are related to them. In the studio, therefore, one central guest, who is questioned by the audience and a variety of topics, and a journalist from the print media will be present, how and in what way they have experienced it as eccentric and the like. / Gledaoci postavljaju pitanja u formi ankete, pitanja će biti bez cenzure, naravno pod uslovom da nisu nepristojna i da ne vređaju gosta. Pitanja će ujedno biti i uvod u neki drugačiji razgovor od onih na koje smo navikli. Poznate ličnosti, takođe, imaju priliku da se predstave publici na jedinstven način stavljajući se potpuno na raspolaganje za sva pitanja koja gledaoce interesuju, a da su vezana za njih. U studiju je, dakle, jedan centralni gost, koga propituje publika i voditeljka, i to na neke razne teme, a biće prisutan i po jedan novinar iz štampanih medija koji će komentarisati karijeru gosta, kako i na koji način su ga doživeli u medijima, u kojim momentima su ga videli kao ekscentričnog i slično.

programme.title: House from the heart / Kuća od srca
programme.desc: From creative cuisine production houses Shadow Production comes the new season of the most humane TV series House from the heart. The most dramatic season so far brings strong stories about people who have found themselves on the edge of existence. They have no home they deserve, and due to inadequate conditions that threaten to endanger the lives and health of the family, the most suffer children. Due to the meeting with the harsh shocks of life, children can lose their childhood right. The collapsed ceilings and the walls full of moisture testify that these hair families have avoided death. Their destinies are uncertain, and the earthset confessions will leave viewers without breath. / Iz kreativne kuhinje produkcijske kuće Shadow production dolazi nova sezona najhumanijeg TV serijala Kuća od srca. Najdramatičnija sezona do sada donosi snažne priče o ljudima koji su se našli na ivici egzistencije. Oni nemaju dom kakav zaslužuju, a zbog neadekvatnih uslova koji prete da ugroze živote i zdravlje porodice, najviše ispaštaju deca. Usled susreta sa surovim udarcima života deca mogu da izgube pravo na svoje detinjstvo. Urušeni plafoni i zidovi puni vlage svedoče o tome da su ove porodice za dlaku izbegle smrt. Njihove sudbine su neizvesne, a potresne ispovesti ostaviće gledaoce bez daha.

programme.title: When is on top? / Ko je na vrhu?
programme.desc: The quiz is designed so that three famous figures answer questions from the capsules that can climb up to as many as five floors above the ground - if they give accurate answers. So other than the knowledge, they will also need the courage to try out on the study rollerchester. Competitors will in a quiz who is on top? Pass through the rounds - in the first can win 50,000, in the second 100,000, in the third 150,000, in the fourth 200,000, and in the last, fifth, 300,000 dinars. As the competitors of the famous personality are, instead of increasing their wealth for the won the amount, each of them will choose who will grant the money won. With each achieved amount, the questions become increasingly difficult - every correct answer leads up, and only one wrong answer is enough to have a competitor to go all the way down. In the end, only one candidate remains to fight for the main prize! / Kviz je osmišljen tako da tri poznate ličnosti odgovaraju na pitanja iz kapsula koje mogu da ih popnu do čak pet spratova iznad zemlje - ukoliko daju tačne odgovore. Dakle, osim znanja, biće im potrebna I hrabrost da se oprobaju na studijskom rolerkosteru. Takmičari će u kvizu Ko je na vrhu? prolaziti kroz runde - u prvoj mogu osvojiti 50.000, u drugoj 100.000, u trećoj 150.000, u četvrtoj 200.000, i u poslednjoj, petoj, 300.000 dinara. Kako su takmičari poznate ličnosti, umesto da uvećaju svoje bogatstvo za osvojenu sumu, svaki od njih će izabrati kome će dodetliti osvojeni novac. Sa svakim dostignutim iznosom, pitanja postaju sve teža - svaki tačan odgovor vodi gore, a samo jedan pogrešan odgovor dovoljan je da takmičar ode skroz dole. Na kraju ostaje samo jedan kandidat koji će se boriti za glavnu nagradu!

programme.desc: The greater the greater part of the assets after the Second War, but they did not remain poor. They live in a good Zagreb neighborhood. programme.desc: The series follows the hands and accidents of the rich Belgrade family Lazarević. No one has overwhelmed the death of the mother, which was a pillar of the family. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista Jutarnja Zvezda, kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista Jutarnja Zvezda, kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, she learns that she is on her brink of bankruptcy and that he has set her a reputable commodity home for the Dame of Poro, who has managed to open an elegant and modern department store, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to be aimed to be an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon falls in love with Sicilia, but her father promised the Mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva ... / Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, verenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao.Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, posle rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva devojka koja ubrzo stiče poverenje kolega.Devojka se na kraju ludo zaljubljuje u Pijetra Morija, ali mora da se vrati na Siciliju jer je njen otac obećao gradonačelniku Kastelbuonoa da će se Tereza udati za njegovog sina Salva...

programme.title: The pride of Ratko's / Ponos Ratkajevih
programme.desc: The series of action takes place in the most turbulent period of Croatia and Yugoslav History, in the period from 1938. until 1948, followed by a noble Croatian family, due to the change of national arrangement and the decay of the change of all the established social values. / Radnja serije se odvija u najturbulentnijem razdoblju hrvatske i jugoslavenske istorije, u periodu od 1938. do 1948. godine, a prati život jedne plemićke hrvatske porodice od njenog predratnog uspona, pa sve do posle Drugog svetskog rata, usled koga je došlo do promene državnog uređenja, propadanja plemstva i korenite promene svih do tada ustaljenih društvenih vrednosti.

programme.title: Intermarriage / M(j)ešoviti brak
programme.desc: Series M (J) The ešoviti marriage was recorded on the basis of the same name to the theater play which is among the most viewed in recent years. Of course, new characters have been added, the story was expanded, and the Gastarirska family Čađenovic returned to a new state, Serbia and Montenegro. They heard about the changes, so they decided that after many years to stay in Lucerne, in Switzerland, hardly earned foreign currency investments in the business in Belgrade. Quite by accident, the first staff of this series were recorded in the country called Yugoslavia, and the first episode was completed in the state, which is like this mixed marriage of Montenegrin and Serbian, Montenegro. / Serija M(j)ešoviti brak snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Vila Mary / Vila Marija
programme.desc: The greater the greater part of the assets after the Second War, but they did not remain poor. They live in a good Zagreb neighborhood. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) is a fifty -year -old, runs a family business that includes a restaurant chain and a hotel downtown, which he started building in socialism in the time of socialism, but has taken over it during the privatization of the nineties of his aunt Mitzy. His wife Ana Jurak (Ksenija Pajic), in the early forties, gave birth to two december and Dora. Ana left her studies of rights when she met him and dedicated herself to care for the family and with the help of a housekeeper, caring for herself-shopping, pool and gossip, her favorite obligations. Anyway, it is the foundation of the family in any case. Dor (Jelena February) is 20 years old and studies economics. The father adores her and does not accept the fact that she has long since come to the year that she has a boyfriend and her intimacy. Spoiled Dad's daughter. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) works with his father in the company. A handsome Zagreb boyfriend, a twenty -five -year -old, but irresponsible, prone to vice, in short, a bad character of a nice face. On the other hand, there is a family of banker Maks Lovrek (Ante Cedo Martinic), who gives Jurak's company a large loan to take over the retail chain. He and Tomislav Jurak (not) have been friends since Falultet days. In addition to work, Jurakovi and Lovrekovi are also related to private, and the period of apparent friendship from the beginning of the story soon grows into rivalry. Max Lovrek is married to Vesna Lovrek (Barbara Vickovic), a woman suspicious / Porodici Jurak nacionalizovan je veći deo imovine nakon Drugog svetskog rata, ali svejedno nisu ostali siromašni. Stanuju u dobrom zagrebačkom kvartu. Tomislav Jurak (Žarko Radić) je pedesetogodišnjak, vodi porodični biznis koji uključuje lanac restorana i hotel u centru grada, koji je počeo da gradi još u vreme socijalizma, ali ga je u vlasništvo preuzeo tokom privatizacije devedesetih novcem svoje tete Mitzy. Njegova žena Ana Jurak (Ksenija Pajić), u ranim četrdesetim, rodila mu je dvoje dece- Ivana i Doru. Ana je napustila studije prava kad ga je upoznala i posvetila se brizi o porodici i uz pomoć kućne pomoćnice, brizi o samoj sebi-shopping, bazen i tračanje, omiljene su joj obaveze. Kako god bilo, ona je u svakom slučaju temelj familije. Ćerka Dora (Jelena Veljača) ima 20 godina i studira ekonomiju. Otac je obožava i ne prihvata činjenicu da je već odavno došla u godine da ima dečka i svoju intimu. Razmažena tatina kćer. Ivan (Mislav Čavajda) radi s ocem u firmi. Zgodan zagrebački dečko, dvadesetpetogodišnjak, ali neodgovoran, sklon porocima, ukratko, loš karakter lepog lica. S druge strane, nalazi se porodica bankara Maksa Lovreka (Ante Čedo Martinić), koji Jurakovoj firmi daje veliki kredit za preuzimanje malotrgovinskog lanca. On i Tomislav Jurak (ne)prijatelji su još od falultetskih dana. Uz posao, Jurakovi i Lovrekovi povezani su i privatno, a razdoblje prividnog prijateljstva s početka priče ubrzo prerasta u suparništvo. Max Lovrek oženjen je Vesnom Lovrek (Barbara Vicković), ženom sumnjivog

programme.title: Shoulder strap / Bandolera
programme.desc: Sara Rejes is a student literature on Oxford during the 19th century. As a great respector of Spanish literature, the opera and culture Sara will escape the Andalusia in the desire for adventure, true love and family. Andalusia will enchant Sarah and she will find his home in a small Andalusian village, where she will be done to finally fulfill his life's dream and write his first novel. Everything will take place at her will until her uncle returns to the intention to return to England one day. Sara will become an outlawful of Robin Hud, who will dedicate life to help people in trouble. This series will enchant your hearts as you meet the protagonist, her character, virtue and flaws. You will fall in love with her love and beautiful pictures of Andalusia that boots you and leave you breathless. / Sara Rejes je studentkinja književnosti na Oksfordu tokom XIX veka. Kao veliki poštovalac španske književnosti, opere i kulture Sara će pobeći u Andaluziju u želji za avanturom, pravom ljubavi i porodicom. Andaluzija će očarati Saru i ona će pronaći svoj dom u malom andaluzijskom selu, gde će joj se učiniti da će konačno ispuniti svoj živoni san i napisati svoj prvi roman. Sve će se odvijati po njenoj volji dok se jednog dana ne vrati njen ujak u nameri da je vrati u Englesku. Sara će postati odmetnik nalik Robin Hudu, koji će posvetiti život da pomogne ljudima u nevolji. Ova serija će očarati vaša srca dok upoznajete protagonistu, njen karakter, vrline i mane. Zaljubićete se u njenu ljubav i prelepe slike Andaluzije koje vas plene i ostavljaju bez daha.

programme.title: Nobody 2: Little Brother Great Narrow / Niko 2: Mali brat velika nevolja
programme.desc: So he is very surprised when his mom tells him that she has met a completely ordinary but good room called Luke and who has little son Vinka. The following news is that Luke and Vinko come to live with Nika and his mom. Nika's world is demolished: he will never be the only one and the memore again, he will have to live with a younger half -brother and be careful about it, which will not be an easy task when it comes to a small, sweet and naughty Vinko ... / Zato se jako iznenadi kada mu njegova mama kaže da je upoznala jednog potpuno običnog, ali dobrog soba koji se zove Luka i koji ima malog sina Vinka. Sledeća vest je da Luka i Vinko dolaze živjti s Nikom i njegovom mamom. Nikin svet se ruši: on nikada više neće biti jedinac i mezimac, moraće živeti s mlađim polubratom i još k tome ga i paziti, što nikako neće biti lagan zadatak kad je u pitanju mali, slatki i nestašni Vinko...

programme.title: Superman / Superman
programme.desc: Faster than the bullet! Powerful than locomotive! Fly more than a plane! This amazing alien from the Planet Krypton Steel Man Superman leads an endless strain for truth and justice, disguised in the refined journalist Clark Kent ... / Brži od metka! Snažniji od lokomotive! Leti više od aviona! Ovaj neverovatni vanzemaljac sa planete Kripton čelični čovek Superman sa svojom izvanrednom fizičkom snagom vodi beskrajnu borbu za istinu i pravdu, prerušen u prefinjenog novinara Klarka Kenta...

programme.title: The world to say / Svet Reči
programme.desc: There are various worlds, and in this animated series, the words become the main characters. / Postoje razni svetovi, a u ovom animiranom serijalu, reči postaju glavni junaci.

programme.title: Beti BUP / Beti Bup
programme.desc: Betty Bup is an animated cartoon character created by Max Fleischer. Her character is inspired by the famous singer and acre Helen Kane. At first the character was conceived as a French poodle, but over time, her creator was added to her by the 1932. The character we know today was finalized, and instead of a small bitch, the frosty little nose. / Beti Bup je animirani lik iz crtanog filma koji je stvorio Max Fleischer. Njen lik je inspirisan poznatom pevačicom i glumicom Helen Kejn. U početku je lik bio zamišljen kao francuska pudlica, ali sa vremenom, njen kreator joj je dodavao ljudska obeležja i 1932. lik Beti Bup kakav znamo danas je finalizovan, pa je umesto šlampavih ušiju dobila minđuše a umesto malog kučećeg nosa, prćasti mali nos.

programme.title: Animalia / Animalija
programme.desc: Follow 11-year-old Zoe and Alex into a fascinating and exciting world. Their great adventure adventure begins when in the library due to a series of strange events, suddenly find themselves in the country of the animals that speak. Zoe and Alex soon discover that something is wrong in the once so peaceful kingdom. Their arrival is closely linked to strange events that increasingly weaken this unusual civilization and the heart of Animali, mag. Our main heroes with the help of a sharp intellect and creativity GBUBU and Iguane Igi try to find the solution to these mysterious events and re-establish order and harmony in the country of Animalija. / Pratite 11-godišnju Zoe i Aleksa u fascinantan i uzbudljiv svet. Njihova velika životna avantura započinje kada se u biblioteci usled niza čudnih događaja, odjedanput nađu u zemlji životinja koje govore. Zoe i Aleks ubrzo otkrivaju da nešto nije u redu u nekada tako mirnom kraljevstvu. Njihov dolazak usko je povezan sa čudnim događajima koji sve više slabe ovu neuobičajenu civilizaciju i srce Animalije, Mag. Naši glavni junaci uz pomoć oštrog intelekta i kreativnosti gorile GBubu i iguane Igi pokušavaju pronaći rešenje ovih misterioznih događaja i ponovo uspostaviti red i harmoniju u zemlji Animaliji.

programme.title: Bobi i bil / Bobi i Bil
programme.desc: Do you want to see the sweetest comradest in the world? The adventure of the young boy Bobby, his funny house and Karolina, a turtle driving a skate, will surely be a lot of fun to watch. Laugh with them every day! / Da li želiš da vidiš najslađe drugarstvo na svetu? Avanture mladog dečaka Bobija, njegovog smešnog kučeta Bila i Karoline, kornjače koja vozi skejt, sigurno će celoj porodici biti jako zabavne za gledanje. Smej se sa njima svakog dana!

programme.title: Mumuhag / Mumuhag
programme.desc: The cartoon series follows the Avatnure Mumuhag, a small dolphin that lives on the island of Muava. Mumuhag is always cheerful and in the mood and meet new friends every day. / Crtani serijal prati avatnure Mumuhaga, malog delfina koji živi na ostrvu Muava. Mumuhag je uvek veseo i raspoložen i svakodnevno upoznaje nove prijatelje.

programme.title: Legend of being / Legenda o Enju
programme.desc: On an exotic and exciting background of fantastic prehistoric beasts and shamanism, smart and talented 12-year-old boy Enjo lead us to the spectacular journey of fantasy, fun and wild adventures. / Na egzotičnoj i uzbudljivoj pozadini fantastičnih praistorijskih zveri i šamanizma, pametni i talentovani 12-godišnji dečak Enjo vodi nas na spektakularno putovanje fantazije, zabave i divlje avanture.

programme.title: K3 / K3
programme.desc: French-Belgian animated series about Kim, Kate and Kyles, which are three ordinary girls, top teenage stars on a glamorous global tour full of unexpected trades that lead them to fun stories. / Francusko-belgijska animirana serija o Kim, Kejt i Kajli koje su tri obične devojke, vrhunske tinejdžerske pop zvezde na glamuroznoj globalnoj turneji punoj neočekivanih obrta koji ih dovode do zabavnih priča.

programme.title: Old Tom / Stari Tom
programme.desc: Adventures of the angel of Trogmorton and her benevolent but lazy cat named Old Tom. An angel is obsessed with good and fine behavior, but the old Tom is a restless joker who breaks her harmony and order. / Pustolovine Anđele Trogmorton i njenog dobrodušnog, ali lenjog mačka po imenu Stari Tom. Anđela je opsednuta dobrim i finim ponašanjem, ali Stari Tom je nemirni šaljivdžija koji razbija njen sklad i red.

programme.title: Five aliens / Pet vanzemaljac
programme.desc: Five naughty spaces come to Earth and decide to settle at 12-year-old Tommy Kadlija. They soon realize that Tommy is not the most popular among his peers, so they decide to help him in their own specific way. The lively aliens do not realize that the life of the adolescent itself is not very easy, and their interference will literally turn things up ancient. / Petorica nestašnih svemiraca dolaze na Zemlju i odluče se nastaniti kod 12-godišnjeg Tomija Kadlija. programme.desc: French-Belgian animated series about Kim, Kate and Kyles, which are three ordinary girls, top teenage stars on a glamorous global tour full of unexpected trades that lead them to fun stories. / Francusko-belgijska animirana serija o Kim, Kejt i Kajli koje su tri obične devojke, vrhunske tinejdžerske pop zvezde na glamuroznoj globalnoj turneji punoj neočekivanih obrta koji ih dovode do zabavnih priča.

programme.title: Old Tom / Stari Tom
programme.desc: Adventures of the angel of Trogmorton and her benevolent but lazy cat named Old Tom. An angel is obsessed with good and fine behavior, but the old Tom is a restless joker who breaks her harmony and order. / Pustolovine Anđele Trogmorton i njenog dobrodušnog, ali lenjog mačka po imenu Stari Tom. Anđela je opsednuta dobrim i finim ponašanjem, ali Stari Tom je nemirni šaljivdžija koji razbija njen sklad i red.

programme.title: Five aliens / Pet vanzemaljac
programme.desc: Five naughty spaces come to Earth and decide to settle at 12-year-old Tommy Kadlija. They soon realize that Tommy is not the most popular among his peers, so they decide to help him in their own specific way. The lively aliens do not realize that the life of the adolescent itself is not very easy, and their interference will literally turn things up ancient. / Petorica nestašnih svemiraca dolaze na Zemlju i odluče se nastaniti kod 12-godišnjeg Tomija Kadlija. Ubrzo shvate da Tomi nije baš najpopularniji među svojim vršnjacima, pa mu odluče pomoći na svoj specifičan način. Živahni vanzemaljci ne shvataju da život adolescenta sam po sebi nije baš lak, a njihovo uplitanje doslovce će stvari okrenuti naglavačke.

programme.title: Polo / Polo
programme.desc: Polo lives in the world of dreams. He has his island, where his home is in a tree. It's free like a bird. He lives alone, but his friends are always around. You can travel through the body of a whale in the Polo's world, snowblows can revive and you can safely drop down the crater of the volcano! This peaceful world that Polo loves and wants to protect, is full of fantasies. Because Polo is a vigilant and friendly guardian of the world that represents the child's imagination ... / Polo živi u svetu snova. On ima svoje ostrvo, gde je njegov dom u drvetu. Slobodan je kao ptica. Živi sam, ali njegovi prijatelji su uvek u blizini. U Poloovom svetu možete putovati kroz telo kita, Sneško Belići može oživeti i možete se sigurno spustiti niz krater vulkana! Ovaj miran svet koji Polo voli i želi zaštititi, pun je fantazije. Jer Polo je budan i prijateljski čuvar sveta koji predstavlja dečju maštu...
