programme.title: Inkubus / Inkubus
programme.desc: The police station does the last shift only with the most perpetrator staff because it will soon be demolished. When a demon incubus quietly walked into the station by carrying a wedding head of the murdered girl, the night moves a strange course. It allows him to keep and question him, and he admits all his crimes. Why? It has a debt that needs to be resolved with one of the detectives that almost took care of it thirteen years ago. The cops soon become toys in the arms of incubus. / Policijska stanica radi poslednju smenu samo sa najnužnijim osobljem jer će uskoro biti srušena. Kada se demon Inkubus mirno ušeta u stanicu noseći odrubljenu glavu ubijene devojke, noć krene čudnim tokom. Dopušta da ga zadrže i ispituju, i on priznaje sve svoje zločine. Zašto? Ima dug koji treba razrešiti sa jednim od detektiva koji ga je zamalo sredio pre trinaest godina. Policajci ubrzo postaju igračke u rukama Inkubusa.

programme.title: Ruthless 3 / Nemilosrdni 3
programme.desc: SEM DIC, a relentless police detective, returns to Los Angeles from a self-motion exile to help the police resolve another series of brutal killers committed by another cunning serial killer whose target is the last love. / Sem Dic, neumoljivi policijski detektiv, vraća se u Los Anđeles iz samonametnutog egzila kako bi pomogao policiji u rešavanju još jednog niza brutalnih ubistava koje je počinio još jedan lukavi serijski ubica čija je meta Dicova poslednja ljubav.

programme.title: Pobuna Na Brodu Baunti / Pobuna na brodu Baunti
programme.desc: Captain Grimmed and Admiral Hood examine Captain William Blajz at the trial in which he tries to explain what events led to the loss of the command on the Baunte ship. Captain Blajz gathered the crew and headed for the ship by boat towards Tahiti. He is also his friend, young and ambitious Christian Fletcher on board. In order to obtain time, the Bluj decides to sail around the cape horn, a route that is insecure and unknown. The crew barely survives that endeavor, which only increases the tension and dissatisfaction due to its extremely cruel imposition of discipline. When they finally arrive on the island, the paradise atmosphere deletes memory of all conflicts and problems. Fletcher falls in love and engages in a passionate love relationship with the Tahičan Princess, which is even more destroyed by discipline and destroys the friendship between him and the Captain. The time of return and the crew is reluctant to leave the island, and the conflicts on board continue. When the captain ordered a return to the same dangerous road, the Fletcher brings a fateful decision and takes over the ship. / Kapetan Gritam i admiral Hud ispituju kapetana Vilijama Blajdža na suđenju u kojem on pokušava da objasni koji su događaji doveli do gubitka komande na brodu Baunti. Kapetan Blajdž okupio je posadu i krenuo na putovanje brodom prema Tahitiju. Na brodu je i njegov prijatelj, mladi i ambiciozni Kristjian Flečer. Kako bi dobio na vremenu, Blajdž odlučuje da otplovi oko Rta Horna, rutom koja je nesigurna i nepoznata. Posada jedva preživljava taj poduhvat, što samo povećava napetost i nezadovoljstvo zbog njegovog izuzetno okrutnog nametanja discipline. Kada napokon stignu na ostrvo, rajska atmosfera briše sećanje na sve sukobe i probleme. Flečer se zaljubljuje i upušta u strastvenu ljubavnu vezu s tahićanskom princezom, što još više uništava disciplinu i razara prijateljstvo između njega i kapetana. Vreme je povratka i posada nerado napušta ostrvo, a sukobi na brodu se nastavljaju. Kad kapetan bude naredio povratak istim opasnim putem, Flečer donosi sudbonosnu odluku i preuzima brod.

programme.title: A calculation in the little Tokyo / Obračun u malom Tokiju
programme.desc: The action takes place in Los Angeles. Cop Kris Kener works in Mali Tokyo, Japanese district Los Angeles, and fights organized crime as best. He grew up in Japan, Chris's parents died from the Hand of Jakuza Killer, and he will remember the appearance of the criminal who broke into their house forever. One day, the authorities are sent by the Kenar of the new partner, Johnny Murat. Johnny, although the semi-Japanese himself, lived in the United States from his childhood and was educated in the spirit of American culture. Initially, Murato and Kenar is not easy to cooperate with each other, but the joint investigation and cold-blooded bills help partners find a common language. The murder of the dancer in the nightclub and the spread of the new drug metamphetamine in that area puts the police on the trail of the Klanu Jakuza and their leaders, relentless Jošida. Seeing Josid, Kener recognizes the killer of his parents, and the investigation turns into revenge ... / Radnja se odvija u Los Anđelesu. Policajac Kris Kener radi u Malom Tokiju, japanskom okrugu Los Anđelesa, i bori se protiv organizovanog kriminala najbolje što može. Odrastao u Japanu, Krisovi roditelji su umrli od ruke ubice jakuze, a on će zauvek pamtiti izgled kriminalca koji je provalio u njihovu kuću. Jednog dana, vlasti šalju Keneru novog partnera, Džonija Muratu. Džoni, iako i sam polu-Japanac, od detinjstva je živeo u Sjedinjenim Državama i vaspitavan je u duhu američke kulture. Muratu i Keneru u početku nije lako da sarađuju jedan sa drugim, ali zajednička istraga i hladnokrvni obračuni pomažu partnerima da pronađu zajednički jezik. Ubistvo plesačice u noćnom klubu i širenje nove droge metamfetamina u toj oblasti stavlja policiju na trag klanu jakuza i njihovom vođi, nemilosrdnom Jošidi. Videvši Jošidu, Kener prepoznaje ubicu svojih roditelja, a istraga se pretvara u osvetu...

programme.title: Resurrection / Uskrsnuće
programme.desc: Keyfly, a powerful Roman military tribun, and his assistant Lucius, get the mstand to resolve Jesus on Sundays after the crucifixion, to deny rumors about the Easter Messiah, and prevented the Uprising in Jerusalem. / Klavijus, moćni rimski vojni tribun, i njegov pomoćnik Lucijus, dobijaju zadatak da reše misteriju šta se desilo sa Isusom u nedeljama posle raspeća, da bi opovrgli glasine o uskrslom Mesiji, i sprečili ustanak u Jerusalimu.

programme.title: Brick / Cigla
programme.desc: High school brendan Frye is intelligent and withdrawn. An eternal outsider is astonished with a sudden disappearance of his ex-girlfriend Emily, according to which he still grows deep emotions. On his way to her finding the luck of numerous unusual people, who will open his eyes and do the search for an unforgettable life experience .. / Srednjoškolac Brendan Frye inteligentan je i povučen. Večni autsajder zaprepašćen je iznenadnim nestankom svoje bivše devojke Emily prema kojoj još gaji duboke emocije. Na putu do njenog pronalaska srešće brojne neobične ljude, koji će mu otvoriti oči i učiniti potragu nezaboravnim životnim iskustvom..

programme.title: Octagon / Oktagon
programme.desc: Scott Jams (even noris) remains without the best friend and meets the circle of mobsters known as octagon. By entering their society, she realizes that maybe one of them is the killer of his friend. How will the truth come? / Skot Džems (Čak Noris) ostaje bez najboljeg prijatelja i upoznaje krug mafijaša poznat kao Oktagon. Ulazeći u njihovo društvo, shvata da je možda jedan od njih ubica njegovog prijatelja. Kako će doći do istine?

programme.title: Cobra / Kobra
programme.desc: A gang of NeoPhashist criminals, led by self-proclaimed sections, breaks into the houses and cars, killing people without any occasion. When one of the members of the gang tries to orobi to the small store, whose customers, whose hostages, is invited by an uncompromising police officer Cobrita who resolving the case occurs. Later that night, another murder occurs, which is witnessed by young Ingrid. Ingrid begins to get numerous threats, and the only one who can protect her is just a cobra. / Banda neofašističkih kriminalaca, predvođena samoproglašenim Slešerom, provaljuje u kuće i automobile, ubijajući ljude bez ikakvog povoda. Kada jedan od pripadnika bande pokuša da orobi maleni dućan, čije mušterije uzima kao taoce, na mesto zločina je pozvan beskompromisni policajac Kobreti koji rešivši slučaj dolazi do korisnih informacija o Slešeru. Kasnije te noći, dolazi do još jednog ubistva, o kojem svedoči mlada Ingrid. Ingrid počinje da dobija brojne pretnje, a jedini koji može da je zaštiti upravo je Kobra.

programme.title: Panic escape / Panično bekstvo
programme.desc: During the failed drug resale, Joi Gazel, the mobster from the Italian clan, comes into possession of a gun that was killed by a police officer. Instead of being solved, aware that this is proof of murder of the corrupt police officer, Joey decides to keep him. He could also blackmail his employer if he needs to. One day the gun accidentally finds Oleg, a shy boy, a friend of Joey's son. It will be wounded by his father who abuses him and his mother, Russian immigrantissum. The thing will be complicated when Joe realizes that Oleg's stepfather is associated with a large Russian clan who is in conflict with his. / Prilikom neuspele preprodaje droge Džoi Gazel, mafijaš iz italijanskog klana, dolazi u posed pištolja kojim je ubijen policajac. Umesto da ga se reši, svestan da je to dokaz ubistva korumpiranog policajca, Džoi odlučuje da ga zadrži. Time bi mogao i ucenjivati svog poslodavca ako mu zatreba. Jednog dana pištolj slučajno pronalazi Oleg, sramežljivi dečak, prijatelj Džoijevog sina. Njime će raniti svog očuha koji zlostavlja njega i njegovu majku, rusku imigrantikinju. Stvar će se zakomplikovati kada Džoi bude shvatio da je Olegov očuh povezan sa velikim ruskim klanom koji je u sukobu sa njegovim.

programme.title: Born for a race / Rođeni za trku
programme.desc: The story of the rebellious young man who cannot control his temperament. Another big problem is his obsession with street racing. Since he is caught during an illegal street race, his mother sends him to live with his father, former professional driver. / Priča o buntovnom mladiću koji ne može da kontroliše svoj temperament. Još jedan veliki problem je njegova opsesija uličnim trkama. Pošto biva uhvaćen prilikom jedne ilegalne ulične trke, njegova majka ga šalje da živi sa ocem, bivšim profesionalnim vozačem.

programme.title: Little little / Kis Kis
programme.desc: Four budding moves to a luxurious time and tasting expensive wines, not server that they will soon fight for their own lives ... / Četvoro prijatelja kreće na luksuzan provod i degustaciju skupih vina ne sluteći da će se tamo uskoro boriti za sopstvene živote...

programme.title: In the blood / U krvi
programme.desc: The Ava is a trained fighter with a dark past. When her husband disappears during their honeymoon in the Caribbean, she reveals a violent underworld in conspiracy with an island paradise. Armed with deadly skills, Ava moves in the discovery of the truth and killing anyone who thinks he is responsible for kidnapping her husband. / Ava je trenirani borac sa mračnom prošlošću. Kada njen muž nestane tokom njihovog medenog meseca na Karibima, ona otkriva nasilno podzemlje u zaveri sa ostrvskim rajem. Naoružana sa smrtonosnim veštinama, Ava kreće u otkrivanje istine i ubijanje svakoga za koga ona misli da je odgovoran za otmicu njenog muža.

programme.title: Texas Ranger MekVejd / Teksaški rendžer Mekvejd
programme.desc: Texas Ranger J. J. MekVejd (Even NORIS), a firm and persistent fighter for justice that is conducted by their own methods. He received the task that he must explore the case of military trucks of military trucks that are full of weapons. Together with a friend and colleague, Kaja (Robert Beltran) follows the trail that leads them to the enchanting Lole Richardson and her partner Raulije Vilks (David Karadin). Among Mekva and Lola, a love relationship is developing, which is interrupted at the time when Kajo and Mekvejd discover that Lola is behind the truck hijacking. Realizing that there is no more thing to lose, Vilks kidnapped Mekcadd's daughter and drains it, along with Lol, in his Mexican fortress. / Teksaški rendžer Dž. Dž. Mekvejd (Čak Noris), čvrst i ustrajan borac za pravdu koji se vodi vlastitim metodama. On dobija zadatak da mora istražiti slučaj otmice vojnih kamiona koji su puni oružja. Zajedno sa prijateljem i kolegom Kajom (Robert Beltran) prati trag koji ih vodi do zanosne Lole Ričardson (Barbara Karera) i njenog partnera Raulija Vilksa (Dejvid Karadin). Među Mekvejdom i Lolom razvija se ljubavna veza koja se prekida u trenutku kada Kajo i Mekvejd otkriju da Lola stoji iza otmice kamiona. Shvativši da više nema šta izgubiti, Vilks otima Mekvejdovu kći i odvodi je, zajedno sa Lolom, u svoju meksičku tvrđavu.

programme.title: Twin / Blizanac
programme.desc: Vil Smith is playing Henry Brogan, an elite killer, which suddenly becomes a target of mysterious young operative, who seemingly can predict every move. / Vil Smit glumi Henrija Brogana, elitnog ubicu, koji iznenada postaje meta tajanstvenog mladog operativca, koji naizgled može predvideti svaki njegov potez.

programme.title: Arizona / Arizona
programme.desc: 1860. Years. The infinite convoy moved to the west. All families, old and young people, people with dreams, rushed to the West to the new country. Indian attacks, mountains and deserts, hunger and thirst, could not stop them. These were people who determined the fate of the great new territory. A woman doctor stops in a small town and decides to start the practice there. Feb (J. Arthur), although a strong and pioneering woman, becomes extremely feminine when he falls in love with Peter (V. Holden). However, Peter will not give up on the plan of capturing the vessels of Jefferson Karteret (V. Viliam) and Lazarus Word (P. Hal), but in that case he will have to leave Feb. Will she last see him? / 1860. godina. Beskonačni konvoj kretao se ka zapadu. Čitave porodice, stari i mladi, ljudi sa snovima, hrlili su na zapad ka novoj zemlji. Napadi Indijanaca, planine i pustinja, glad i žeđ, nisu mogli da ih zaustave. Bili su to ljudi koji su određivali sudbinu velike nove teritorije. Žena lekar zaustavlja se u malom gradu i odlučuje da tamo započne praksu. Feb (Dž. Artur), iako snažna i pionirska žena, postaje izrazito ženstvena kada se zaljubi u Pitera (V. Holden). Ipak, Piter neće odustati od plana hvatanja zlikovaca Džefersona Kartereta (V. Viliam) i Lazarusa Vorda (P. Hal), ali će u tom slučaju morati da ostavi Feb. Da li će ga ona poslednji put videti?

programme.title: Three hours to kill / Tri sata za ubijanje
programme.desc: Jim Gatri was falsely accused of murder, and from the accusation and the persecution barely escaped and pulled out a living head. The next three years he spends himself as a wanted fugitive, but returned to the city to find the right murderer and the one who placed him, because he is tired of running away and injustice. / Džim Gatri je lažno optužen za ubistvo, a od optužbe i progona je jedva pobegao i izvukao živu glavu. Sledeće tri godine provede kao traženi begunac, ali se vrati u grad pronaći pravog ubicu i onog ko mu je smestio, jer je umoran od bežanja i nepravde.

programme.title: Cizum / Čizum
programme.desc: John Boots is the old king of the cattle breeding, which decides to defend his empire from the greenhouse. Vejon's personality perfectly suits this reconstruction of the event in Novi Mexico in 1878. known as the Lincoln War of the District. / Džon Čizm je stari kralj stočara, koji odlučuje da brani svoje carstvo od zelenaša u usponu. Vejnova ličnost savršeno odgovara ovoj rekonstrukciji događaja u Novom Meksiku 1878. poznatoj kao Linkolnov Rat Okruga.

programme.title: Nice day to hang / Lep dan za vešanje
programme.desc: As very young Eddi, he came to the city with a gang to rob a bank, but was caught and convicted. The sheriff, Marshall Ben helps him and he is in charge, and he becomes a honorable citizen. Many years later, that same gang returned to the city to reboot the bank. At their escape, they kill Marshall. Edi is the only one who can identify the killer - but he is in great doubt whether to be loyal to new friends or his old friend. / Još kao veoma mlad Edi je došao u grad sa bandom da opljačka banku, ali je uhvaćen i osuđen. Šerif, Maršal Ben mu pomaže i prevaspitava ga, i on postaje častan građanin. Mnogo godina kasnije, ta ista banda se vraća u grad da ponovo opljačka banku. Pri njihovom bekstvu oni ubijaju Maršala. Edi je jedini koji može da identifikuje ubicu - ali on je u velikoj nedoumici da li da bude lojalan novim prijateljima ili pak svojoj staroj družini.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and Indians / Bafalo Bil i Indijanci
programme.desc: Colonel Viliam Kodi, better known as the Bufalo Bil, is looking for fame and money traveling to America with his circus show made on the basis of a myth created by a writer Ned Bantlajn. The play encounters a standing ovation of audiences who buy tickets massively. The well -established color is broken by a chief who engulfs a greater dose of authenticity, which in turn will not like Bil. Namely, he is important to him exclusively. / Pukovnik Viliam Kodi, poznatiji kao Bufalo Bil, u potrazi za slavom i novcem putuje Amerikom sa svojom cirkuskom predstavom napravljenoj na osnovu mita koji je o njemu stvorio pisac Ned Bantlajn. Predstava nailazi na ovacije publike koja masovno kupuje ulaznice. Uhodanu kolotečinu razbija poglavica koji zahteva veću dozu autentičnosti što se pak neće svideti Bilu. Njemu je, naime, važan isključivo novac.

programme.title: Seventh cavalry / Sedma konjica
programme.desc: Returning to Fort Lincoln, Captain Benson finds out about Kaster's defeat at Litl Big Horn. At the hearing of Kaster's officers to blame the defeat kaster, while Benson defends him. However, the caster was indeed absent during the battle and that is why the army now despises it. Benson se prijavljuje za opasnu misiju vraćanja tela poginulih sa indijanske teritorije gde se bitka odigrala.

programme.title: Cowboys / Kauboji
programme.desc: American West, in the second half of 19. century. The old livestock Vil Andersen prepares large transportation cattle, but due to the discovery of gold in the area, suddenly remain without already engaged assistants, who leaves him hoping for better and easier earnings. Andersen's old friend Ans Petersen suggested he hires boys from a nearby school. Andersen seems to be stupid at first, but without the second solution, in the end of discounts and decide to convert guille guys into cowboys. The task is not at all simple, but the group of boys led by the old man goes on the road soon. To keep things up, Andersen, Boys and Black Kuvar, Jedediahu Najtlinger for heels are robbers led by Cruel Eyes Vats, who would be happy to grab a livestock. / Američki zapad, u drugoj polovini 19. veka. Ostareli stočar Vil Andersen priprema veliki transport stoke, no zbog otkrića zlata u okolici iznenada ostane bez već angažovanih pomoćnika, koji ga napuste nadajući se boljoj i lakšoj zaradi. Andersenov stari prijatelj Ans Petersen predloži mu da angažuje dečake iz obližnje škole. Andersenu se ideja isprva učini glupom, no nemajući drugog rješenja, na koncu popusti i odluči pretvoriti golobrade dečke u kauboje. Zadatak nije nimalo jednostavan, no skupina dečaka predvođena starcem uskoro krene na put. Da stvari budu gore, Andersenu, dečacima i crnom kuvaru Jedediahu Najtlindžeru za petama su razbojnici predvođeni okrutnim Ejsom Vatsom, koji bi se rado dočepali stoke.

programme.title: From noon to three / Od podne do tri
programme.desc: On his way to committing a bank robbery, the gang stops on a lonely property that leads the young widow of Amanda (J. Irelend), in order to bring the graham dorsay (K. Bronson) to a new horse. Pretending to have a horse not, Graham prefers to stay with Amanda on the property than he can weigh in robbery. The two of them spend three passionate hours. As the robbery goes wrong, Dorsej goes to save his companions, actually himself, so that he would not be caught. Through a happy travel dealer, then replace clothes with him. The seller was killed, and the Dorsey ended up in prison. When the seller's body show Amanda, she concludes for the clothes that it is about the Dorsey. / Na putu da počini pljačku banke, banda se zaustavi na usamljenom imanju koje vodi mlada udovica Amanda (Dž. Irelend), kako bi Graham Dorsej (K. Bronson) došao do novog konja. Pretvarajući se da konja nema, Graham radije ostane s Amandom na imanju nego li da odjaše u pljačku. Njih dvoje provedu tri strastvena sata. Kako pljačka pođe po zlu, Dorsej odlazi spasiti svoje drugove, zapravo sebe, da ne bi bio uhvaćen. Putem sretne putujućeg prodavca, pa s njim zameni odeću. Prodavac je ubijen, a Dorsej završi u zatvoru. Kada telo prodavca pokažu Amandi, ona po odeći zaključi da je reč o Dorseju.

programme.title: SEVERERO Western police / Severo zapadna policija
programme.desc: The Texas Ranger Dasti Rivers has been sent to Canada during the 1880s to find an external Žak Korbo. It comes during the rebellion and meets the Ejpril Logan's nurse, and soon falls in love with it. However, she was already about the sergeant Jim Brit. To whom ejpril will remain faithful. At the same time, ejprilin brother, Roni Logan, who is also Maunti, is in love with Korb's daughter, Louges. Luvet Loves Dry, but he wants to protect his father. When the calculation between Dasti, Maunti and Korbo's outlaws became a certain. / Teksaški rendžer Dasti Rivers je poslat u Kanadu tokom 1880-ih godina da pronađe odmetnika Žaka Korboa. Dolazi u toku pobune i upoznaje medicinsku sestru Ejpril Logan, a ubrzo se zaljubi u nju. Međutim, ona je već bila u vezi sa narednikom Džimom Britom. Kome će Ejpril ostati verna. U isto vreme, Ejprilin brat, Roni Logan, koji je takođe Maunti, zaljubljen je u Korbovu ćerku, Luvet. Luvet voli Ronija, ali želi i da zaštiti oca. Kada je obračun između Dastija, Mauntija i odmetnika Korboa postao izvestan.

programme.title: Maverik / Maverik
programme.desc: Maverik is a gambler who likes to cheat, but he runs away from the conflict. It aims to perform on a large poker tournament that begins in a few days, but he lacks three thousand dollars for participation. He is associated with a beautiful, cunning and greedy gambler Anabel, who must never the end believe ... nor she him. / Maverik je kockar koji voli varati, ali beži od sukoba. Cilj mu je nastupiti na velikom pokeraškom turniru koji počinje za nekoliko dana, ali mu za učestvovanje nedostaje tri hiljade dolara. Udružuje se sa lepom, lukavom i pohlepnom kockarkom Anabelom, kojoj nikad ne sme do kraja verovati... kao ni ona njemu.

programme.title: Dead man / Mrtav čovek
programme.desc: The story follows a young man who is forced to revenge the death of this father, protect the Stanica tribe, which he loved and regain land and gold that is rightly with their. / Priča prati mladića koji je prisiljen osvetiti smrt ovog oca, zaštiti pleme Apača koje je zavoleo i povratiti zemlju i zlato koje je s pravom njihovo.

programme.title: Tensioneer / Sudija za vešanje
programme.desc: In a small town in West Texas, Roj bin is a tyrannical and self-proclaimed judge whose scary tactics the rest of the population lives in fear. The inhabitants of the town finally manage to bind the bin behind the horse and drag him into the desert, from where he saved him a girl named Marija. He returns to the city, kills everything he found himself in the saloon and declares himself again for the only person responsible for maintaining order and peace. Strangers passing through the city being either killed or looted. But when Maria dies, the local population that is already plenty of everything begin to oppose the bin and tries to regain their city. / U malom gradu u Zapadnom Teksasu, Roj Bin je tiranski i samoproklamovani sudija zbog čije taktike zastrašivanja ostatak stanovništva živi u strahu. Stanovnici gradića konačno uspevaju da vežu Bina za leđa konja i odvuku ga u pustinju, odakle ga je spasila devojka po imenu Marija. On se vraća u grad, ubija sve koje je zatekao u salunu i ponovo proglašava sebe za jedinu osobu nadležnu za održavanje reda i mira. Stranci koji prolaze kroz grad bivaju ili ubijeni ili opljačkani. Ali kada Marija umre, lokalno stanovništvo kojem je već dosta svega počinje da se suprostavlja Binu i pokušava da povrati svoj grad.

programme.title: Query / Hauha
programme.desc: Remote military station in Patagonia, 1882. Captain Gunar Develen came from Denmark with a 15-year-old daughter, to accept engineering work in the Argentine Army. Ingeborg is the only female in the field, which attracts the attention of men. She and falls in love with a young soldier, then run together. When her father realizes what happened, he decides to go to the enemy territory in search of a young couple. / Udaljena vojna stanica u Patagoniji, 1882. Kapetan Gunar Dinesen došao je iz Danske sa 15-godišnjom ćerkom, da bi prihvatio inženjerski posao u argentinskoj vojsci. Ingeborg je jedino žensko u oblasti, što privlači pažnju muškaraca. Ona se i zaljubljuje u jednog mladog vojnika, pa jedne noći zajedno beže. Kada joj otac shvati šta se desilo, odlučuje da ode na neprijateljsku teritoriju u potragu za mladim parom.

programme.title: Service / Kadrovska služba
programme.desc: Frank is a young Parisian student who returns to the hometown because he got the opportunity to internship in the factory in which his father was employed by his almost entire service life. Employers accept it very well, so it gets the task to carry out a survey on the reduction of working hours. The trade union in the factory are very distrustful according to that idea, because they serve that superiors actually want to increase their intensity of work. Naive Frank still believes his bosses, although their ultimate goal is to release a few workers and those who have been retirement left, including Frank's father. / Frank je mladi pariski student koji se vraća u rodni gradić jer je dobio priliku stažirati u fabrici u kojoj je njegov otac zaposlen svoj gotovo čitav radni vek. Poslodavci ga vrlo dobro prihvataju, pa dobija zadatak provesti anketu o smanjenju radnih sati. Sindikalci u fabrici su jako nepoverljivi prema toj ideji, jer slute da nadređeni zapravo žele povećati njihov intenzitet rada. Naivni Frank ipak veruje svojim šefovima, iako je njihov krajnji cilj otpustiti nekolicinu radnika i to baš one kojima je ostalo malo do penzije, među kojima je i Frankov otac.

programme.title: Red as the sky / Crveno kao nebo
programme.desc: A film based on a true story about Mincaći Menkaci, who blinded into the accident when he was ten, and today he is one of the most brilliant film director. That fat afternoon, while playing with his grandfather, the old partisan rifle exploded right in his face. As the time in Tuscany blind children could not attend the school with the other normal children, Mirko sent to the Institute of Blind in Genoa. However, he never stopped nurturing his passion for film. Once accidentally finds the old tape recorder, it starts shooting sounds immediately and edit them into stories. The teachers try to discourage him, because they want to spare him disappointments. However, he does not stop following his dream, even when that is why they throw him out of school, so he loses the only chance to school. / Film zasnovan na istinitoj priči o Mirku Menkaćiu, koji je oslepeo u nesreći kad je imao deset godina, a danas je jedan od najbriljantnijih filmskih reditelja zvuka. Tog kobnog poslepodneva, dok se igrao sa svojim dedom, stara partizanska puška mu je eksplodirala pravo u lice. Kako u to vreme u Toskani slepa deca nisu mogla pohađati školu sa ostalom normalnom decom, Mirko je poslat u institut za slepe u Đenovi. Međutim, on nikad nije prestao negovati svoju strast prema filmu. Kad jednom slučajno pronađe stari magnetofon, odmah počinje snimati zvukove i uređivati ih u priče. Učitelji ga pokušavaju obeshrabriti, jer ga žele poštediti razočaranja. Međutim, on ne prestaje slediti svoj san, čak ni kad ga zato izbacuju iz škole, te tako izgubi jedinu priliku za školovanje.

programme.title: Too personally / Previše lično
programme.desc: The film is about three women who know each other or get to know each other. He unites them friendship, a man and a small five-year-old girl. Simona renews his life after being divorced and her son decides to live with his father. Natalia Love is located in the widower with a daughter and a dedicated grandmother. And Eva, although the retirement, finds out that her love includes that partner, not just love for his grandchildren. / Film govori o tri žene koje se poznaju ili upoznaju. Ujedinjuje ih prijateljstvo, muškarac i mala petogodišnja devojčica. Simona obnavlja svoj život nakon što se razvede i njen sin odluči da živi s ocem. Natalija ljubav nalazi u udovcu s ćerkicom i predanom bakom. A Eva, iako penzionerka, saznaje da njena ljubav uključuje i onu partnersku, a ne samo ljubav prema unuci.

programme.title: Go back and get back / Otići i vratiti se
programme.desc: The reputable doctor Simon is happily married, he has friends doctors and live an idyllic life until it started talking about war. With the arrival of Germans, Gestapo Haps and takes him to jail. Many years later, his daughter of Salome traces who discovered Gestapo that he was a Jew and offers a great sum of money for the answer ... / Ugledni lekar Simon srećno je oženjen, ima prijatelje lekare i živi idiličnim životom sve dok nije počelo da se govori o ratu. Dolaskom Nemaca, Gestapo ga hapsi i odvodi u zatvor. Mnogo godina kasnije, njegova ćerka Salome traga ko je otkrio Gestapou da je on Jevrej i nudi veliku sumu novca za odgovor...

programme.title: Gusarem Verenica / Gusareva verenica
programme.desc: The oppressed and exploited young woman begins to charge his sexual services and completely disrupts the self-sufficient patriarchal capitalist society from the village of Telier. / Potlačena i iskorišćavana mlada žena počinje naplaćivati svoje seksualne usluge i potpuno remeti samozadovoljno patrijarhalno kapitalističko društvo iz sela Telier.

programme.title: A reasonable man / Razuman čovek
programme.desc: The story of the lawyer goes to South Africa to defend the boy from Zulu tribes who killed a baby believing that he killed the evil spirit, better known as Tokolosh. Dark secrets that lie buried deep in the lawyer, will connect him with the boy. He takes the case and enters the world of African wizardery and mystic, and by discovering the truth about the murder, the discovery of the truth about himself ... / Priča o advokatu koji odlazi u Južnu Afriku da brani dečaka iz Zulu plemena koji je ubio bebu verujući da je ubio zlog duha, poznatijeg kao Tokoloshe. Mračne tajne koje leže zakopane duboko u advokatu, spojiće ga sa dečakom. On uzima slučaj i ulazi u svet afričkog čarobnjaštva i mistike, a otkrivanjem istine o ubistvu, otkriće istinu o sebi samom...

programme.title: Roman crime / Krimi roman
programme.desc: In Rome in the 1960s, three young offenders decide to enter the world of organized crime. Lebanese is the cold-blooded leader of the minor delinquent - loyal fring and the power of hungry Diand. Since they kidnapped and killed Baron, Deliskvents manage to make friends with local gangsters, corrupt police officers and members of the secret organization. Lebanese is especially emphasized in that he solved firmly to obey the Roman underworld. To achieve this, it must form a larger group of well-organized cold-blooded killers. / U Rimu šezdesetih godina, troje mladih prestupnika odlučuje da uđe u svet organizovanog kriminala. Libaneze je hladnokrvni predvodnik maloletnih delikvenata - lojalnog Freda i moći gladnog Dandija. Pošto su kidnapovali i ubili barona, delikventi uspevaju da se sprijatelje sa lokalnim gangsterima, korumpiranim policajcima i pripadnicima tajne organizacije. Libaneze se posebno ističe po tome što je čvrsto rešio da pokori rimsko podzemlje. Da bi to ostvario, mora da formira veću grupu dobro organizovanih hladnokrvnih ubica.

programme.title: Icy heart / Ledeno srce
programme.desc: The Lepa violinist Kamil has two obsessions: the music of Ravel and her husband's friend who makes violins. But his heart seems to be cold. / Lepa violinistkinja Kamil ima dve opsesije: muziku Ravela i prijatelja njenog muža koji pravi violine. Ali, čini se da je njegovo srce hladno.

programme.title: Hana / Hana
programme.desc: Through the intimate portrait, we follow one woman how he struggles with reality and imaginary, while trying to accept her husband's departure to prison. / Kroz intimni portret pratimo jednu ženu kako se bori sa stvarnošću i imaginarnim, dok pokušava prihvatiti odlazak njenog muža u zatvor.

programme.title: The day I died / Dan kad sam umrla
programme.desc: The se-jin disappears in a dark and stormy night leaving shoes on a cliff and a farewell letter behind. Kim Hiun-Soo is in charge of investigating the case. Due to the bad weather, the body was not found, so the case cannot be closed. Local detectives simply reject it as suicide. Hyeon-Soo must find the truth about a suspicious disappearance of a teenager ... / Se-jin nestaje u mračnoj i olujnoj noći ostavljajući cipele na litici i oproštajno pismo iza sebe. Kim Hiun-soo je zadužena za istragu slučaja. Zbog lošeg vremena telo nije pronađeno, pa slučaj ne može biti zatvoren. Lokalni detektivi to jednostavno odbacuju kao samoubistvo. Hyeon-soo mora pronaći istinu o sumnjivom nestanku tinejdžerke...

programme.title: Hamilton 1: In the interest of the people / Hamilton 1: U interesu naroda
programme.desc: An interesting story about the Special Agent Hamilton, which goes to a secret task and contacts the members of the Russian mafia, in charge of weapons smuggling, mainly terrorists in Scandinavia. They suddenly attack them an unknown group of armed people, who kill everyone, except Hamilton and take his weapons. But who are they? Who are they working for? Hamilton begins to chase them around the world. / Zanimljiva priča o specijalnom agentu Hamiltonu, koji ide na tajni zadatak i stupa u kontakt sa članovima ruske mafije, zaduženim za šverc oružjem, uglavnom teroristima u Skandinaviji. Odjednom ih napada nepoznata grupa naoružanih ljudi, koji ubijaju svakoga, osim Hamiltona i uzimaju mu oružje. Ali, ko su oni? Za koga rade? Hamilton počinje da ih juri po svetu.

programme.title: A reasonable man / Razuman čovek
programme.desc: The story of the lawyer goes to South Africa to defend the boy from Zulu tribes who killed a baby believing that he killed the evil spirit, better known as Tokolosh. Dark secrets that lie buried deep in the lawyer, will connect him with the boy. He takes the case and enters the world of African wizardery and mystic, and by discovering the truth about the murder, the discovery of the truth about himself ... / Priča o advokatu koji odlazi u Južnu Afriku da brani dečaka iz Zulu plemena koji je ubio bebu verujući da je ubio zlog duha, poznatijeg kao Tokoloshe. Mračne tajne koje leže zakopane duboko u advokatu, spojiće ga sa dečakom. On uzima slučaj i ulazi u svet afričkog čarobnjaštva i mistike, a otkrivanjem istine o ubistvu, otkriće istinu o sebi samom...

programme.title: Roman crime / Krimi roman
programme.desc: In Rome in the 1960s, three young offenders decide to enter the world of organized crime. Lebanese is the cold-blooded leader of the minor delinquent - loyal fring and the power of hungry Diand. Since they kidnapped and killed Baron, Deliskvents manage to make friends with local gangsters, corrupt police officers and members of the secret organization. Lebanese is especially emphasized in that he solved firmly to obey the Roman underworld. To achieve this, it must form a larger group of well-organized cold-blooded killers. / U Rimu šezdesetih godina, troje mladih prestupnika odlučuje da uđe u svet organizovanog kriminala. Libaneze je hladnokrvni predvodnik maloletnih delikvenata - lojalnog Freda i moći gladnog Dandija. Pošto su kidnapovali i ubili barona, delikventi uspevaju da se sprijatelje sa lokalnim gangsterima, korumpiranim policajcima i pripadnicima tajne organizacije. Libaneze se posebno ističe po tome što je čvrsto rešio da pokori rimsko podzemlje. Da bi to ostvario, mora da formira veću grupu dobro organizovanih hladnokrvnih ubica.

programme.title: French women / Francuskinje
programme.desc: Paris. The first twenty-eight days of spring. Eleven women. Mothers, business women, girls, mistresses, wife. Everything is the face of today's wife: complexity, joy, explosiveness, audacity, unpredictability. In short, paradoxity, complete disorientation, definitely a lot of life, simply - woman! / Pariz. Prvih dvadeset osam dana proleća. Jedanaest žena. Majke, poslovne žene, devojke, ljubavnice, supruge. Sve predstavljaju lice današnje žene: kompleksnost, radost, eksplozivnost, drskost, nepredvidivost. Ukratko, paradoksalnost, potpunu dezorijentisanost, definitivno puno života, jednostavno - ženu!

programme.title: prepare / Preparator
programme.desc: Pepino is a preparator that is constantly making fun of the fact that he is a dwarf growth. He meets Valeria, a handsome young man who was fascinated by Pepin's job. Pepino, in turn, Valeria offers a great salary to come as his assistant. But when Valerio meets the debor, their romance endangers the oddly jealous pepin. / Pepino je preparator kojeg stalno ismevaju zbog toga što je patuljastog rasta. Upoznaje Valeria, zgodnog mladog čoveka koji je fasciniran Pepinovim poslom. Pepino, zauzvrat, Valeriju nudi veliku platu da dođe kao njegov asistent. Ali kada Valerio sretne Deboru, njihova romansa ugrožava neobično ljubomornog Pepina.

programme.title: A city of fear / Grad straha
programme.desc: Odile Derej is an attaché for printing the film Red is Dead, in which the serial killer uses a hammer and sickle as his weapons for killing. He was invited to the Kan Film Festival, where he faces a unanimous opinion that the film is extremely bad. However, the Red Is Dead soon attracts public attention when all the projectionists who played film, are killed, in the way killer in the film Red is Dead kills. / Odile Derej je ataše za štampu filma Red is Dead, u kojem serijski ubica koristi čekić i srp kao svoje oružje za ubijanje. Pozvana je na filmski festival u Kanu, gde se suočava s jednoglasnim mišljenjem da je film izuzetno loš. Međutim, Red is Dead uskoro privlači pažnju javnosti kada svi projekcionisti koji su puštali film, bivaju ubijeni, na način kako ubica u filmu Red is Dead ubija.

programme.title: Come to drink with me / Dođi da piješ sa mnom
programme.desc: A group of bandits overjoyed caravan and otme young Zango, the son of the governor who consider guilty for capturing teachers, gang leaders. In the absence of the teacher, the Band led cruel deputy, a tiger with a face made of jade. Zanga hide in the temple, demanding prisoners. Zanga sister, gold swallow, the excellent master Kung-Fu, moves in search for his brother, and he himself conflicts with a number of gang. Despite amazing agility and martial art, the gold swallow is wounded by a poison arrow. Then a mysterious beggar is coming to her, also a great fighter called drunk cat because of his preference to drink. / Grupa bandita presretne karavan i otme mladog Zanga, sina guvernera kojeg smatraju krivim zbog zarobljavanja učitelja, vođe bande. U odsustvu učitelja bandu predvodi okrutni zamenik, Tigar s licem od žada. Zanga sakrivaju u hram, zahtevajući razmenu zarobljenika. Zangova sestra, Zlatna Lastavica, vrsna majstorica kung-fua, kreće u potragu za bratom, pa se i sama sukobljava s brojnom bandom. Usprkos neverovatnoj okretnosti i borilačkom umeću, Zlatna Lastavica je ranjena otrovnom strelicom. Tada joj u pomoć stiže tajanstveni prosjak, takođe vrstan borac zvan Pijani Mačak zbog svoje sklonosti ka piću.

programme.title: A land of oblivion / Zemlja zaborava
programme.desc: The film deals with a tragedy of one person who is in the heart of the disaster in Chernobil. Alja remains a widow on his wedding day 26. April 1986. years, the day when it was 4. The reactor in Chernobyl exploded. She must now collect all his strength to continue their life .. / Film se bavi tragedijom jedne osobe koja se nalazi u srcu katastrofe u Černobilju. Alja ostaje udovica na dan svoje svadbe 26. aprila 1986. godine, dana kada je 4. reaktor u Černobilju eksplodirao. Ona sad mora da sakupi svu svoju snagu kako bi nastavila život..

programme.title: I have a talent / Ja imam talenat

programme.title: Košarka - NBA League: Oklahoma City - Atlanta / Košarka - NBA liga: Oklahoma City - Atlanta
programme.desc: The sixth day of June of June 1946. years will change the basketball game forever. On that day in New York, the most elite world basketball competition, the NBA league was founded. 29 Teams from the US and one from Canada Each autumn begins the hunt for the legendary ring intended for the Champions of the NBA league. The teams are divided into an east and western conference and through 82 regular season, the regular season hunting one of the eight playoff positions. Conference champions are entering the large NBA final where in a series of a maximum of seven games decide on the new champion. The NBA final is one of the most accurate sports events of the year that delights all basketball lovers. / Šesti dan juna meseca davne 1946. godine zauvek će promeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gde u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. NBA finale je jedno od najpraćenijih sportskih događaja godine koje oduševljava sve košarkaške zaljubljenike.

programme.title: Stopwatch / Štoperica
programme.desc: The stopwatch quiz consists of two rounds, whereby the answer time is measured by the stopwatch. In the first round competitors respond to three questions, and for each response they have 10 seconds each. If exactly the answers, they conquer the guaranteed amount. In another round waiting for six questions, with 20 seconds for each answer. Depending on the speed and accuracy of the answers they give, they can conquer up to 15,000 dinars. / Kviz Štoperica se sastoji iz dve runde, pri čemu se vreme za odgovaranje meri štopericom. U prvoj rundi takmičari odgovaraju na tri pitanja, a za svaki odgovor imaju na raspolaganju po 10 sekundi. Ukoliko tačno odgovore, osvajaju zagarantovanu sumu. U drugoj rundi ih čeka šest pitanja, sa po 20 sekundi za svaki odgovor. U zavisnosti od brzine i tačnosti odgovora koje daju, mogu da osvoje i do 15.000 dinara.

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out to freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: You won't believe / Nećete verovati
programme.desc: One of the most famous and favorite correspondents of the first television is certainly Gvozden Nikolić. Its recognizable voice and emphasis won the sympathies of a large number of spectators, and his stories do not leave anyone indifferent. It is this simple approach to life as well as the ability to listen to the ordinary man, authentic attachments have made multimillion inspections on social networks, and all this has long led to the logical step - you will not trust the authorial emission. / Jedan od najpoznatijih i omiljenih dopisnika Prve televizije svakako jeste Gvozden Nikolić. Njegov prepoznatljiv glas i akcenat osvojio je simpatije velikog broja gledalaca, a njegove priče nikoga ne ostavljaju ravnodušnim. Upravo taj jednostavan pristup životu kao i sposobnost da sasluša običnog čoveka, donele su autentične priloge koje imaju višemilionske preglede na društvenim mrežama, a sve to je dalje vodilo logičnom koraku - pokretanju autorske emisije Nećete verovati.

programme.title: Three out of five / Tri od pet
programme.desc: Quiz 3 of the 5 is a dynamic and fun format that exudes obsession and spontaneity, and participants are accidental passers-by. This quiz provides the opportunity to participants to - almost by the way, while on the street and preoccupied with everyday life - fun, they test their knowledge and maybe something. Each episode is specific to the choice of competitors. It used to be men with a mustache, the competitors who are lasting Petrović, women of blue hair ... in each circle participates in two candidates, and the winner of the previous round is answered by or duplicated by the amount won. The leaders of the quiz are an actress Slavica Ljujić and the actor Uroš Milojević. / Kviz 3 od 5 dinamičan je i zabavan format koji odiše nepretencioznošću i spontanošću, a učesnici su slučajni prolaznici. Ovaj kviz pruža priliku učesnicima da se - gotovo usput, dok su na ulici i zaokupljeni svakodnevicom - zabave, testiraju svoje znanje i možda nešto zarade. Svaka epizoda je specifična po izboru takmičara. Nekada su to muškarci sa brkovima, takmičari koji se na primer prezivaju Petrović, žene plave kose… U u svakom krugu učestvuje dva kandidata, a pobednik iz prethodnog kruga odgovara na pitanje koje mu ili duplira osvojeni iznos ili oduzima ceo iznos osvojene nagrade. Voditelji kviza su glumica Slavica Ljujić i glumac Uroš Milojević.

programme.title: Three men and aunt / Tri muškarca i tetka
programme.desc: We follow a family of one family in which the main word leads a rich Aunt Milka, the old party staff from the 1990s, and in various comic situations, its brotherhoods are: charming, but an irresponsible woman's ljuba and a rolled, but responsible programmer Jovis. In unsuccessful attempts to become independent and rich, they fall into various peripeties, intrigues, love and business traps, and all this takes place or experienced in Milka's bourgeois house. / Pratimo život jedne porodice u kojoj glavnu reč vodi bogata tetka Milka, stari partijski kadar iz devedesetih, a u razne komične situacije upadaju njeni bratanci: šarmantan, ali neodgovoran ženskaroš Ljuba i smotani, ali odgovoran programer Joviša. U neuspešnim pokušajima da se osamostale i obogate, oni upadaju u razne peripetije, spletke, ljubavne i poslovne zamke, a sve se to odvija ili proživljava u Milkinoj buržujskoj kući.

programme.title: Explosive / Exploziv
programme.desc: Stories of forgotten heroes, customs, the most famous prophecies, miraculous love, gurus and unusual people. New, the twelfth season of one of your favorite emissions explosive. As in previous years, the editorial and journalistic team worked with full steam during the summer. In search of good, interesting and life stories, we traveled through Serbia but also the region. We went the trails of Kovid Tourists in Greece, Albania and Montenegro and checked that the summer of masks conducted passengers but also hosts. Who had a good time, who earned, and who lost, we will find out in the series ready, notes the editor of the Mary Prebeg Emission. / Priče o zaboravljenim herojima, običajima, najpoznatijoj proročici, čudesnim ljubavima, guruima i neobičnim ljudima. Počinje nova, dvanaesta sezona jedne od omiljenih emisija EXploziv. Kao i prethodnih godina, urednički i novinarski tim radio je punom parom tokom leta. U potrazi za dobrim, zanimljivim i životnim pričama putovali smo kroz Srbiju ali i region. Išli smo stazama kovid turista u Grčku, Albaniju i Crnu Goru i proveravali kako su leto pod maskama proveli putnici ali i domaćini. Ko se dobro proveo, ko je zaradio, a ko izgubio saznaćemo u serijalu koji je spreman, napominje urednica emisije Marija Prebeg.

programme.title: Exclusive / Exkluziv
programme.desc: We reveal the picanteries about domestic and foreign stars, we present exclusive attachments. Find out all about the famous ones - what they do, where they go out, where they are coming, where we travel ... I discover everything about their lives, terminants ... The editor-in-law, Ilic, will still be the first and in the right place with the proven exclusive information. / Otkrivamo pikanterije o domaćim i inostranim zvezdama, prikazujemo ekskluzivne priloge. Saznajte baš sve o poznatima - šta rade, gde izlaze, šta spremaju, gde putuju... Otkrivamo sve o njihovim ljubavima, raskidima... Ekipa Exkluziv, pod vođstvom urednice Isidore Ilić, i dalje će biti prva i na pravom mestu sa proverenim ekskluzivnim informacijama.

programme.title: Free arrows / Slobodni strelci
programme.desc: The son of the Killed New York Police officer plugged into the police, where he invades the team with his father's former partner and the team of Bright Gotam police officers. His new chief of Sarkone will see if he has everything it takes to be a concentrated police officer through a series of loyalty, trust and respect. However, when the truth of his father's death came out, the desire for revenge is predominantly and he will not stop until justice is satisfied. / Sin ubijenog njujorškog policajca priključuje se policiji, gde upada u ekipu sa bivšim partnerom svog oca i ekipu pritajenih Gotam policajaca. Njegov novi šef Sarkone će videti da li on ima sve što je potrebno da bi bio pritajeni policajac kroz niz testova odanosti, poverenja i poštovanja. Međutim, kada na videlo izađe istina o smrti njegovog oca, u njemu preovladava želja za osvetom i on neće stati sve dok pravda ne bude zadovoljena.

programme.title: TV Čorba / TV Čorba
programme.desc: The show is processed by daily occurrences from another angle, with subtle irony impurities. programme.title: Wrong man / Pogrešan čovek
programme.desc: We follow the story of the mother's sixteen-year-old, who must overcome his greatest fear and trauma to face a long-forgotten father of his daughter, a man he believed to rape her 16 years ago. He is now the only one who can save the life to her child. Zoe is a teenager, rebel, full of life, is mortally ill and she needs a transplant. From pregnancy and zone, her mother Lea did not tell anyone who was actually Zoin father. All these years, she was trying to forget her greatest trauma and a man who was responsible for that and who attacked her 16 years ago. Her hatred of him is deep and honest, she never fully recovered from that night but this time no choice, he is the only one who can donate an organ and save a sick girl. But as life always writes unpredictable stories, so Leina's search for the child's father show that every story has two sides ... / Pratimo priču majke šesnaestogodišnje tinejdžerke, koja mora da savlada svoj najveći strah i traumu da bi se suočila sa davno zaboravljenim ocem svoje ćerke, čovekom za kojeg veruje da ju je silovao pre 16 godina. On je sada jedini koji može da spase život njenom detetu. Zoe je tinejdžerka, buntovnica, puna života, smrtno je bolesna i potrebna joj je transplantacija. Od trudnoće i Zoinog rađanja, njena majka Lea nikome nije rekla ko je zapravo Zoin otac. Svih ovih godina pokušavala je da zaboravi svoju najveću traumu i čoveka koji je odgovoran za to i koji ju je napastvovao pre 16 godina. Njena mržnja prema njemu je duboka i iskrena, nikada se nije potpuno oporavila od te noći ali ovaj put nema izbora, on je jedini koji može da donira organ i spasi bolesnu devojčicu. Ali, kako život uvek piše nepredvidlve priče, tako će i Leina potraga za ocem deteta pokazati da svaka priča ima dve strane...

programme.title: Wrong man / Pogrešan čovek
programme.desc: We follow the story of the mother's sixteen-year-old, who must overcome his greatest fear and trauma to face a long-forgotten father of his daughter, a man he believed to rape her 16 years ago. He is now the only one who can save the life to her child. Zoe is a teenager, rebel, full of life, is mortally ill and she needs a transplant. From pregnancy and zone, her mother Lea did not tell anyone who was actually Zoin father. All these years, she was trying to forget her greatest trauma and a man who was responsible for that and who attacked her 16 years ago. Her hatred of him is deep and honest, she never fully recovered from that night but this time no choice, he is the only one who can donate an organ and save a sick girl. But as life always writes unpredictable stories, so Leina's search for the child's father show that every story has two sides ... / Pratimo priču majke šesnaestogodišnje tinejdžerke, koja mora da savlada svoj najveći strah i traumu da bi se suočila sa davno zaboravljenim ocem svoje ćerke, čovekom za kojeg veruje da ju je silovao pre 16 godina. On je sada jedini koji može da spase život njenom detetu. Zoe je tinejdžerka, buntovnica, puna života, smrtno je bolesna i potrebna joj je transplantacija. Od trudnoće i Zoinog rađanja, njena majka Lea nikome nije rekla ko je zapravo Zoin otac. Svih ovih godina pokušavala je da zaboravi svoju najveću traumu i čoveka koji je odgovoran za to i koji ju je napastvovao pre 16 godina. Njena mržnja prema njemu je duboka i iskrena, nikada se nije potpuno oporavila od te noći ali ovaj put nema izbora, on je jedini koji može da donira organ i spasi bolesnu devojčicu. Ali, kako život uvek piše nepredvidlve priče, tako će i Leina potraga za ocem deteta pokazati da svaka priča ima dve strane...

programme.title: TV Čorba / TV Čorba
programme.desc: We return ready for new tastes and ignorant ones without which we would not be our soup. As before, the head of Stefan Buzurović and the team will approach the current topics, extrades and urban videos from the Internet: The co-created team has prepared many new surprises for all the viewers who follow us and need a clearance. It is important to remember that we do not make fun of me, we laugh with you and for you. We share with you the most interesting moments from the TV program and the life of those who were those happiness or accident to catch some lens, says Stefan. / Vraćamo se spremni za nove ukuse i neukuse bez kojih ne bi bilo naše čorbe. Kao i do sada, voditelj Stefan Buzurović i ekipa će na šaljiv način prilaziti aktuelnim temama, estradi i urnebesnim video klipovima sa interneta: Uigrani tim je pripremio mnogo novih iznenađenja za sve gledaoce koji nas prate i kojima je potrebna razbibriga. Važno je zapamtiti da se mi ne podsmevamo, mi se smejemo sa vama i zbog vas. Delimo sa vama najinteresantnije momente iz TV programa i života onih koji su bili te sreće ili nesreće da ih uhvati neki objektiv, kaže Stefan.

programme.title: Little wife / Mala supruga
programme.desc: Telenovela Little wife, inspired by the motifs of the Romanes of the same name of our celebrated writer Milica Jakovljević Mir - Jam, is located today as strong melodrams with the elements of thrillers and Noara, which is allocated from all existing telenoveles. / Telenovela Mala supruga, inspirisana motivima istoimenog romana naše proslavljene spisateljice Milice Jakovljević Mir - Jam, smeštena je u današnje vreme kao snažna melodrama sa elementima trilera i noara, što je izdvaja od svih postojećih telenovela u ponudi.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: In addition to vivid and authentic figures with the viewers will be easily identified, the series is full of exciting and unexpected crafts and comic situations, intriguing kinds of trillage plots, intrigue, deception and betrayals in the world of business, but also the most attractive Emotion, love and friendship, and shows that with real friends and family any obstacle, no matter how insurmountable, can be overcome. Like that, that true love does not know about borders. / Pored živopisnih i autentičnih likova sa čijim svakodnevnim dogodovštinama će se gledaoci lako identifikovati, serija je prepuna uzbudljivih i neočekivanih obrta, urnebesnog humora i komičnih situacija, porodičnih tajni, intrigantnih ljubavnih afera i skandala, napetih trilerskih zapleta, spletki, obmana i izdaja u svetu šou biznisa, ali i najiskrenijih emocija, ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokazuje da uz prave prijatelje i porodicu svaka prepreka, ma koliko delovala nepremostiva, može da se prevaziđe. Kao i to, da prava ljubav ne zna za granice.

programme.title: Work action / Radna akcija
programme.desc: First Serbian humanitarian rial show! Rial emissions Work action has a humanitarian mission - to help families living in the difficult living conditions. Each episode has a family faced with some kind of adversity, the difficult life of the family, illness of a member of the same or some other disaster. The show begins with the arrival of the head of Tamara Grujić to visit the elected family. She tells them that their house will be restored. The entire job is done in 5 days, while the family stays with relatives or friends. During this time, a large number of masters and volunteers are ready to change the conditions of housing completely, which involves complete renovation of interiors and exteriors, as well as all necessary repairs and improvements. / Prva srpska humanitarna rijaliti emisija! Rijaliti emisija Radna akcija ima humanitarnu misiju - da pomogne porodicama koje žive u teškim uslovima života. Svaka epizoda ima porodicu suočenu sa nekom vrstom nedaće, teški život porodice, bolest nekog člana iste ili neka druga katastrofa. Emisija počinje dolaskom voditeljke Tamare Grujić u posetu izabranoj porodici. Ona im saopštava da će njihova kuća biti restaurirana. Celokupan posao se obavlja za 5 dana, dok porodica odseda kod rodbine ili prijatelja. Za to vreme, veliki broj majstora i volontera spreman je da tim porodicama u potpunosti promeni uslove stanovanja što podrazumeva kompletno renoviranje enterijera i eksterijera, kao i sve potrebne popravke i poboljšanja.

programme.title: Truths and lies / Istine i laži
programme.desc: It all starts from one prom night ... That night connects Paul and Marina, the most popular teens in the school, with Nikola, Kristina and Slobom, the most famous school outsiders. That night, filled with excitements, loud music and alcohol, will remain them with everyone in memory as an end of one era, and the beginning of a new phase in their lives. Twenty years later, their lives crossed again. Pavle and Marina are in not such happy marriage, and Nikola, Kristina and Sloba live lives as if nothing has changed in those twenty years ago, they would never have a steady job, nor a serious relationship, no family ... / Sve počinje od jedne maturske večeri... To veče spaja Pavla i Marinu, najpopularnije tinejdžere u školi, sa Nikolom, Kristinom i Slobom, najpoznatijim autsajderima škole. Ta noć, ispunjena uzbuđenjima, glasnom muzikom i alkoholom, ostaće im svima u sećanju kao kraj jedne ere, i početak nove faze u njihovim životima. Dvadesetak godina kasnije, njihovi životi se ponovo ukrštaju. Pavle i Marina su u ne tako srećnom braku, imaju sina koji je i sam tinejdžer, a Nikola, Kristina i Sloba žive živote kao da se u tih dvadeset godina ništa nije promenilo - i dalje poštujući zakletvu koju su položili pre mnogo vremena, da nikada neće imati stalan posao, ni ozbiljnu vezu, ni porodicu...

programme.title: Waiting for the handke / Čekajući Handkea
programme.desc: When he learned that Peter Handke received the Nobel Prize, Srdjan Petrovic, Vinar from Velika, has placed a plate with the relief figure of the famous writer, who had repeatedly stayed in his winery. His intention to place the plate in front of the winery, becomes a sizifsky hard work in a large hoist, where the majority of the population consists of Albanians, and points to the drama with which the remaining Serbs in Kosovo and Metohija are facing. / Kada je saznao da je Peter Handke dobio Nobelovu nagradu, Srđan Petrović, vinar iz Velike Hoče sa Kosova, postavio je ploču sa reljefnim likom slavnog pisca, koji je više puta boravio u njegovoj vinariji. Njegova namera da ploču postavi ispred vinarije, postaje sizifovski težak posao u Velikoj Hoči, gde većinu stanovništva čine Albanci, te upućuje na dramu sa kojom se suočavaju preostali Srbi na Kosovu i Metohiji.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: In addition to vivid and authentic figures with the viewers will be easily identified, the series is full of exciting and unexpected crafts and comic situations, intriguing kinds of trillage plots, intrigue, deception and betrayals in the world of business, but also the most attractive Emotion, love and friendship, and shows that with real friends and family any obstacle, no matter how insurmountable, can be overcome. Like that, that true love does not know about borders. / Pored živopisnih i autentičnih likova sa čijim svakodnevnim dogodovštinama će se gledaoci lako identifikovati, serija je prepuna uzbudljivih i neočekivanih obrta, urnebesnog humora i komičnih situacija, porodičnih tajni, intrigantnih ljubavnih afera i skandala, napetih trilerskih zapleta, spletki, obmana i izdaja u svetu šou biznisa, ali i najiskrenijih emocija, ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokazuje da uz prave prijatelje i porodicu svaka prepreka, ma koliko delovala nepremostiva, može da se prevaziđe. Kao i to, da prava ljubav ne zna za granice.

programme.title: Little wife / Mala supruga
programme.desc: Telenovela Little wife, inspired by the motifs of the Romanes of the same name of our celebrated writer Milica Jakovljević Mir - Jam, is located today as strong melodrams with the elements of thrillers and Noara, which is allocated from all existing telenoveles. / Telenovela Mala supruga, inspirisana motivima istoimenog romana naše proslavljene spisateljice Milice Jakovljević Mir - Jam, smeštena je u današnje vreme kao snažna melodrama sa elementima trilera i noara, što je izdvaja od svih postojećih telenovela u ponudi.

programme.title: Endless love / Beskrajna ljubav
programme.desc: Many years ago, Zeka admitted in exchange for a large amount of money that he had committed the murder, although he was innocent. He soon learns that he was deceived and that money he needs to help his mother in treatment never reached her. The bunny time in prison is used to educate and prepare for all the challenges waiting for him. When he finally finishes the sentence, he goes out to freedom ready to prove that he is innocent, not to serve that he would soon meet the love of his life. / Pre mnogo godina, Zeka je u zamenu za veliku količinu novca priznao da je izvršio ubistvo, iako je nevin. Ubrzo saznaje da je prevaren i da novac koji treba da pomogne njegovoj majci u lečenju nikada nije stigao do nje. Zeka vreme u zatvoru koristi kako bi se obrazovao i pripremio za sve izazove koji ga čekaju na slobodi. Kada konačno završi sa služenjem kazne, on izlazi na slobodu spreman da dokaže da je nevin, ne sluteći da će uskoro upoznati ljubav svog života.

programme.title: Truths and lies / Istine i laži
programme.desc: It all starts from one prom night ... That night connects Paul and Marina, the most popular teens in the school, with Nikola, Kristina and Slobom, the most famous school outsiders. That night, filled with excitements, loud music and alcohol, will remain them with everyone in memory as an end of one era, and the beginning of a new phase in their lives. Twenty years later, their lives crossed again. Pavle and Marina are in not such happy marriage, and Nikola, Kristina and Sloba live lives as if nothing has changed in those twenty years ago, they would never have a steady job, nor a serious relationship, no family ... / Sve počinje od jedne maturske večeri... To veče spaja Pavla i Marinu, najpopularnije tinejdžere u školi, sa Nikolom, Kristinom i Slobom, najpoznatijim autsajderima škole. Ta noć, ispunjena uzbuđenjima, glasnom muzikom i alkoholom, ostaće im svima u sećanju kao kraj jedne ere, i početak nove faze u njihovim životima. Dvadesetak godina kasnije, njihovi životi se ponovo ukrštaju. Pavle i Marina su u ne tako srećnom braku, imaju sina koji je i sam tinejdžer, a Nikola, Kristina i Sloba žive živote kao da se u tih dvadeset godina ništa nije promenilo - i dalje poštujući zakletvu koju su položili pre mnogo vremena, da nikada neće imati stalan posao, ni ozbiljnu vezu, ni porodicu...

programme.title: Work action / Radna akcija
programme.desc: First Serbian humanitarian rial show! Rial emissions Work action has a humanitarian mission - to help families living in the difficult living conditions. Each episode has a family faced with some kind of adversity, the difficult life of the family, illness of a member of the same or some other disaster. The show begins with the arrival of the head of Tamara Grujić to visit the elected family. She tells them that their house will be restored. The entire job is done in 5 days, while the family stays with relatives or friends. During this time, a large number of masters and volunteers are ready to change the conditions of housing completely, which involves complete renovation of interiors and exteriors, as well as all necessary repairs and improvements. / Prva srpska humanitarna rijaliti emisija! Rijaliti emisija Radna akcija ima humanitarnu misiju - da pomogne porodicama koje žive u teškim uslovima života. Svaka epizoda ima porodicu suočenu sa nekom vrstom nedaće, teški život porodice, bolest nekog člana iste ili neka druga katastrofa. Emisija počinje dolaskom voditeljke Tamare Grujić u posetu izabranoj porodici. Ona im saopštava da će njihova kuća biti restaurirana. Celokupan posao se obavlja za 5 dana, dok porodica odseda kod rodbine ili prijatelja. Za to vreme, veliki broj majstora i volontera spreman je da tim porodicama u potpunosti promeni uslove stanovanja što podrazumeva kompletno renoviranje enterijera i eksterijera, kao i sve potrebne popravke i poboljšanja.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: In the background of social events in Italy, just before the outbreak of the First World War, the series follows two passionate love stories and one story about the Great Victim. We will follow the main heroes of this series through their life and class struggles, all the way to the most horrified corners of their soul. / U pozadini društvenih događaja u Italiji, neposredno pre izbijanja Prvog svetskog rata, serija prati dve strastvene ljubavne priče i jednu priču o velikoj žrtvi. Pratićemo glavne junake ove serije kroz njihove životne i klasne borbe, sve do najskrivenijih kutaka njihove duše.

programme.title: Little wife / Mala supruga
programme.desc: Telenovela Little wife, inspired by the motifs of the Romanes of the same name of our celebrated writer Milica Jakovljević Mir - Jam, is located today as strong melodrams with the elements of thrillers and Noara, which is allocated from all existing telenoveles. The main heroine is Đurđica, eliminating and beautiful girl adult in Germany, who now lives in a small town in Vojvodina, in his magnificent house with a swimming pool. Her life takes place in the monotony of estates and villages, as long as the Branko unexpectedly is in the local health center, which is at the very long problem of its older brother SIM: a huge long than a hundred thousand euros, borrowed from the local greener. Branko wants to help brother back on each price to return the debt, but it does not work, until the Đurđica offers his money. Branko fits, returns his brother's debt, but at that time an unknown but dangerous Miodrag Hadži Orlović - a man who conditiones Branka to marry a lily-led money. Branko fits that reluctantly. The decision to give birth to the Đurđica, hopes, a fatal girl with which he is in a long-term secret relationship. Thus, an exciting series about two women and a man in crucified in a love triangle begins, full of passions, excitement and betrayed expectations. Simultaneously with love stories, secret events from the past two families are also developed, which explain the sudden arrival of mysterious Hadža Orlović near Djurdjicina Majke / Telenovela Mala supruga, inspirisana motivima istoimenog romana naše proslavljene spisateljice Milice Jakovljević Mir - Jam, smeštena je u današnje vreme kao snažna melodrama sa elementima trilera i noara, što je izdvaja od svih postojećih telenovela u ponudi. Glavna junakinja je Đurđica, otmena i lepa devojka odrasla u Nemačkoj, koja sada sa svojom majkom Marom živi u jednom malom mestu u Vojvodini, u svoj velelepnoj kući sa bazenom koju je sagradio njen pokojni otac. Njen život se odvija u monotoniji imanja i sela, sve dok se neočekivano ne zaljubi u Branka, doktora u lokalnom domu zdravlja, koji se baš u tom trenutku suočava sa velikim problemom svog starijeg brata Sime: ogromnim dugom od stotinu hiljada evra, pozajmljenim od lokalnog zelenaša. Branko po svaku cenu želi da pomogne bratu da vrati dug, ali u tome ne uspeva, sve dok mu Đurđica ne ponudi svoj novac. Branko na to pristaje, vraća bratov dug, ali se u tom trenutku pojavljuje nepoznati ali opasni Miodrag Hadži Orlović - čovek koji uslovljava Branka da se zbog pozajmljenog novca oženi zaljubljenom Đurđicom. Branko na to nevoljno pristaje. Odluku da oženi Đurđicu saopštava Nadi, fatalnoj devojci sa kojom je u dugogodišnjoj tajnoj vezi. Tako započinje uzbuljiva serija o dve žene i muškarcu raspetom u ljubavnom trouglu, prepuna strasti, uzbuđenja i izneverenih očekivanja. Istovremeno sa ljubavnim pričama, razvijaju se i tajni događaji iz prošlosti dve porodice, koji objašnjavaju iznenadni dolazak misterioznog Hadži Orlovića kod Đurđicine majke

programme.desc: Telenovela Little wife, inspired by the motifs of the Romanes of the same name of our celebrated writer Milica Jakovljević Mir - Jam, is located today as strong melodrams with the elements of thrillers and Noara, which is allocated from all existing telenoveles. The main heroine is Đurđica, eliminating and beautiful girl adult in Germany, who now lives in a small town in Vojvodina, in his magnificent house with a swimming pool. Her life takes place in the monotony of estates and villages, as long as the Branko unexpectedly is in the local health center, which is at the very long problem of its older brother SIM: a huge long than a hundred thousand euros, borrowed from the local greener. Branko wants to help brother back on each price to return the debt, but it does not work, until the Đurđica offers his money. Branko fits, returns his brother's debt, but at that time an unknown but dangerous Miodrag Hadži Orlović - a man who conditiones Branka to marry a lily-led money. Branko fits that reluctantly. The decision to give birth to the Đurđica, hopes, a fatal girl with which he is in a long-term secret relationship. Thus, an exciting series about two women and a man in crucified in a love triangle begins, full of passions, excitement and betrayed expectations. Simultaneously with love stories, secret events from the past two families are also developed, which explain the sudden arrival of mysterious Hadža Orlović near Djurdjicina Majke / Telenovela Mala supruga, inspirisana motivima istoimenog romana naše proslavljene spisateljice Milice Jakovljević Mir - Jam, smeštena je u današnje vreme kao snažna melodrama sa elementima trilera i noara, što je izdvaja od svih postojećih telenovela u ponudi. Glavna junakinja je Đurđica, otmena i lepa devojka odrasla u Nemačkoj, koja sada sa svojom majkom Marom živi u jednom malom mestu u Vojvodini, u svoj velelepnoj kući sa bazenom koju je sagradio njen pokojni otac. Branko po svaku cenu želi da pomogne bratu da vrati dug, ali u tome ne uspeva, sve dok mu Đurđica ne ponudi svoj novac. Branko na to pristaje, vraća bratov dug, ali se u tom trenutku pojavljuje nepoznati ali opasni Miodrag Hadži Orlović - čovek koji uslovljava Branka da se zbog pozajmljenog novca oženi zaljubljenom Đurđicom. Branko na to nevoljno pristaje. Odluku da oženi Đurđicu saopštava Nadi, fatalnoj devojci sa kojom je u dugogodišnjoj tajnoj vezi. Tako započinje uzbuljiva serija o dve žene i muškarcu raspetom u ljubavnom trouglu, prepuna strasti, uzbuđenja i izneverenih očekivanja. Istovremeno sa ljubavnim pričama, razvijaju se i tajni događaji iz prošlosti dve porodice, koji objašnjavaju iznenadni dolazak misterioznog Hadži Orlovića kod Đurđicine majke

programme.title: The passions / Strasti Toskane
programme.desc: The death of the genuine winemaker of Luka Monforte and the conviction of the young girl for his murder, they shook the life of the inhabitants of Vilalb. Aurora is a modern heroine that fights against those who conspired against her and closed behind bars. In the background, everything is a ruthless struggle for home, old hostility of opposing families, secrets, two brother's fight for the love of a woman. The seemingly idyllic Tuscany hides many secrets, and the intrigues and intrigues of her inhabitants will pinpect the viewers for small screens! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) was only 18 years old when she was charged with the murder of his boyfriend Alesandra Monforte (Roberto Farnesi). After years spent in prison, Aurora returns to the freedom much stronger than before and more determined to spare a bar from his name. He still loves Alesandra who renounced after his father's death. He is aimed at building a family empire, but it still fights their feelings towards Aurora especially when he saw him after eight years. Still broke because of his father's death he does not want to believe in Aurora's innocence, but he still wants. Alessandro has a younger edo-lady brothers launching a competition with an older brother, and Matthew who thinks there is nothing in common with them. There is also a sister Elena who never managed to be independent. Their mother of Livia accepts the death of his husband Luka Monforte in unbearable ease. Tesa Taviani intends to return to recalls after her sister's outright in prison to sound the richest and most powerful man in Vilalba, Ruđera chamber. / Smrt uglednog vinara Luke Monfortea i osuđivanje mlade devojke za njegovo ubistvo, uzdrmali su život stanovnika mesta Vilalba. Aurora je moderna junakinja koja se za svoju slobodu bori protiv onih koji su se urotili protiv nje i zatvorili je iza rešetaka. U pozadini svega stoji nemilosrdna borba za dom, staro neprijateljstvo suprotstavljenih porodica, tajne, borba dva brata za ljubav jedne žene. Naizgled idilična Toskana krije mnoge tajne, a spletke i intrige njenih stanovnika prikovaće gledaoce za male ekrane! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) je imala samo 18 godina kada je optužena za ubistvo oca svog dečka Alesandra Monfortea (Roberto Farnesi). Nakon godina provedenih u zatvoru, Aurora se vraća na slobodu mnogo jača nego pre i odlučnija u nameri da spere ljagu sa svog imena. I dalje voli Alesandra koji je se odrekao nakon očeve smrti. On je usmeren na izgradnju porodičnog carstva ali se i dalje se bori protiv svojih osećanja prema Aurori pogotovu kad je ugleda nakon osam godina. Još uvek slomljen zbog očeve smrti ne želi da veruje u Aurorinu nevinost, ali i dalje je želi. Alesandro ima mlađu braću Edoarda kojeg pokreće takmičenje sa starijim bratom, i Mateja koji smatra da nema ništa zajedničko s njima. Tu je i sestra Elena koja nikada nije uspela da se osamostali. Njihova majka Livia nepodnošljivom lakoćom prihvata smrt svog supruga Luke Monfortea. Tesa Taviani namerava da se vrati u Primaluće nakon izlaska njene sestre iz zatvora kako bi zavela najbogatijeg i najmoćnijeg čoveka u Vilalbi, Ruđera Kamerana.

programme.title: Treason / Izdaja

Still, Turkish Telenovela betrayal would not be soapy that there is no one - but! Gizide is neither aware that the spirits of the past will be leaned over her perfect family and that all her loved ones are actually deceptive. Ojlum is preparing for America to study the modern dance there, the son of Osun invested recklessly in the crypto, and the Tario, nor less, no more, has a parallel family. Gizide will face the reality of a new life and try to keep the old findings from the remains of the old one who will live in peace. / Gizide Džanseroj je izuzetno cenjena sudinica u porodičnom sudu, koja živi u Istanbulu. Njen suprug Tarik je uspešni advokat, sin Ozan građevinski inženjer, a kći Ojlum na majčinu preporuku studira medicinu u Holandiji. Ipak, turska telenovela Izdaja ne bi bila sapunica da nema onog - ali! Gizide nije ni svesna da će se duhovi prošlosti nadviti nad njenu savršenu porodicu i da je zapravo svi njeni najmiliji obmanjuju. Gizide će se suočiti sa realnošću novog života i pokušati da od ostataka starog skroji neki novi koji će proživeti u miru.
