programme.title: The passions / Strasti Toskane
programme.desc: The death of the genuine winemaker of Luka Monforte and the conviction of the young girl for his murder, they shook the life of the inhabitants of Vilalb. Aurora is a modern heroine that fights against those who conspired against her and closed behind bars. In the background, everything is a ruthless struggle for home, old hostility of opposing families, secrets, two brother's fight for the love of a woman. The seemingly idyllic Tuscany hides many secrets, and the intrigues and intrigues of her inhabitants will pinpect the viewers for small screens! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) was only 18 years old when she was charged with the murder of his boyfriend Alesandra Monforte (Roberto Farnesi). After years spent in prison, Aurora returns to the freedom much stronger than before and more determined to spare a bar from his name. He still loves Alesandra who renounced after his father's death. He is aimed at building a family empire, but it still fights their feelings towards Aurora especially when he saw him after eight years. Still broke because of his father's death he does not want to believe in Aurora's innocence, but he still wants. Alessandro has a younger edo-lady brothers launching a competition with an older brother, and Matthew who thinks there is nothing in common with them. There is also a sister Elena who never managed to be independent. Their mother of Livia accepts the death of his husband Luka Monforte in unbearable ease. Tesa Taviani intends to return to recalls after her sister's outright in prison to sound the richest and most powerful man in Vilalba, Ruđera chamber. / Smrt uglednog vinara Luke Monfortea i osuđivanje mlade devojke za njegovo ubistvo, uzdrmali su život stanovnika mesta Vilalba. Aurora je moderna junakinja koja se za svoju slobodu bori protiv onih koji su se urotili protiv nje i zatvorili je iza rešetaka. U pozadini svega stoji nemilosrdna borba za dom, staro neprijateljstvo suprotstavljenih porodica, tajne, borba dva brata za ljubav jedne žene. Naizgled idilična Toskana krije mnoge tajne, a spletke i intrige njenih stanovnika prikovaće gledaoce za male ekrane! Aurora Taviani (Ana Safronček) je imala samo 18 godina kada je optužena za ubistvo oca svog dečka Alesandra Monfortea (Roberto Farnesi). Nakon godina provedenih u zatvoru, Aurora se vraća na slobodu mnogo jača nego pre i odlučnija u nameri da spere ljagu sa svog imena. I dalje voli Alesandra koji je se odrekao nakon očeve smrti. On je usmeren na izgradnju porodičnog carstva ali se i dalje se bori protiv svojih osećanja prema Aurori pogotovu kad je ugleda nakon osam godina. Još uvek slomljen zbog očeve smrti ne želi da veruje u Aurorinu nevinost, ali i dalje je želi. Alesandro ima mlađu braću Edoarda kojeg pokreće takmičenje sa starijim bratom, i Mateja koji smatra da nema ništa zajedničko s njima. Tu je i sestra Elena koja nikada nije uspela da se osamostali. Njihova majka Livia nepodnošljivom lakoćom prihvata smrt svog supruga Luke Monfortea. Tesa Taviani namerava da se vrati u Primaluće nakon izlaska njene sestre iz zatvora kako bi zavela najbogatijeg i najmoćnijeg čoveka u Vilalbi, Ruđera Kamerana.

programme.title: As time goes on / Kako vreme prolazi
programme.desc: Te 2010. years there was the most slow Turkish drama, but also the most successful Turkish production in the season. This epithet deserved the fact that it broke down all the previous ratings in all countries in which it was broadcast. Including both Serbia, where it was broadcast on the first television channel. Thanks to the success of this, but also other serial editions, the owner Tims Production Timura Savcija brought the status of the most successful production company in Turkey. Series How time passes You can watch again on the first one of this Monday at the time of 16.00 and remember the famous Moroplovac Ali! We will remind you briefly on the series store - the year is 1967. and the Captain on long vessels, but Akarsu spends a lot of time away from their family. In the meantime, his wife Jamile is worried about their four children. She takes on a role and father and mother while her husband is on a journey. One day, but he finally returns home from the trip ... All members of the family believe the head of the house returns, but they do not know that the lives will change after their return. His dark side appears, and his behavior is extremely unusual. Jamile in Ali's pocket finds a letter that will encourage a series of events deserving for large reversals in the lives of the Akarsi family. The letter will reveal his secret - a loving affair with the party. Will Jamile forgive the husband to betray? Who will but choose? A long-loved wife or a young mistress? / Te 2010. godine bila je najgledanjija turska drama, ali i najuspešnija turska produkcija u sezoni. Ovaj epitet zaslužila je činjenicom da je oborila sve dotadašnje rekorde gledanosti u svim zemljama u kojima je emitovana. Uključujići i Srbiju, gde je emitovana na kanalu Prve televizije. Zahvaljujući uspehu ove, ali i ostalih serijskih izdanja, vlasniku TIMS produkcije Timuru Savciju donelo je status najuspešnije produkcijske kuće u Turskoj. Seriju Kako vreme prolazi možete gledati ponovo na Prvoj od ovog ponedeljka u terminu od 16.00 i prisetiti se čuvenog moreplovca Alija! Podsetićemo vas ukratko na radnju serije - godina je 1967. i kapetan na dugim plovidbama, Ali Akarsu provodi dosta vremena daleko od svoje porodice. U međuvremenu se njegova supruga Džemile brine za njihovo četvero dece. Ona preuzima ulogu i oca i majke dok je njen muž na putovanju. Jednog dana se Ali konačno vraća kući sa putovanja... Svi članovi porodice veruju da se glava kuće vraća, ali ne znaju da će životi da im se promene nakon njegovog povratka. Pojavljuje se njegova mračna strana, i njegovo ponašanje je krajnje neobično. Džemile u Alijevom džepu pronalazi pismo koje će da podstakne niz događaja zaslužnih za velike preokrete u životima porodice Akarsu. Pismo će da otkrije njegovu tajnu – ljubavnu aferu sa strankinjom. Da li će Džemile da oprostiti mužu izdaju? Koga će Ali odabrati? Davno voljenu suprugu ili mladu ljubavnicu?

programme.title: I am prosecuting / ProKuvaj sa Bokijem
programme.desc: Go to a fantastic gastronomic journey with Bojan Stanimirović in the show, boil with Boki. You have already met under nickname, boil as a regular guest on Fridays in the show 150 minutes on the first television where the najinteresantia snacks. He is an unconventional Serbian cook, which combines traditional culinary arts with personal stories and authentic creativity. Through his stories and ingenious dishes, the show will bridge the gap between cooking and hearts. In addition to culinary demonstrations, we engage in the intimate world of cooking. Bojan strives to rise again passion in the kitchen, making every dish with love letter to the audience. Each episode and every dish prepare this unusual cook is dedicated to someone. / Pođite na fantastično gastronomsko putovanje sa Bojanom Stanimirovićem u emisiji Prokuvaj sa Bokijem. Bojana ste već upoznali pod nadimkom ProKuvaj kao redovnog gosta petkom u emisiji 150 minuta na Prvoj televiziji gde je spremao najinteresantije zalogaje. On je nekonvencionalni srpski kuvar, koji spaja tradicionalne kulinarske umetnosti sa ličnim pričama i autentičnom kreativnošću. Kroz njegove priče i genijalna jela emisija će premostiti jaz između kuvanja i srca. Osim kulinarskih demonstracija, upuštamo se u intimni svet kuvanja. Bojan nastoji da ponovo rasplamsa strast u kuhinji, čineći svako jelo ljubavnim pismom publici. Svaka epizoda i svako jelo koje spremi ovaj neobični kuvar posvećeno je nekome.

programme.title: The secrets of vines / Tajne vinove loze
programme.desc: The domestic series of the secret vines speaks of amazing, dramatic story, in which two seemingly unrelated fate, drama and struggle are intertwined. We meet the two Vineyard families Tomovć and Smiljanić, Vuka and Verj, one from Subotica, other than Negotins whose intimate sags are covered with secrets, lies and threats, tears, kisses and heavy bumps. No family without a secret ... And in wine, maybe, is true?! / Domaća serija Tajna vinove loze govori o neverovatnoj, dramatičnoj priči, u kojoj se prepliću dve naizgled nepovezane sudbine, drame i borbe. Upoznajemo dve vinogradarske porodice Tomovć i Smiljanić, Vuka i Veru, jedno iz Subotice, drugo iz Negotina čije su intimne sage obavijene tajnama, lažima i prećutkivanjima, suzama, poljupcima i teškim udarcima. Nema porodice bez tajne... A u vinu je, možda, istina?!

programme.title: As time goes on / Kako vreme prolazi
programme.desc: Te 2010. years there was the most slow Turkish drama, but also the most successful Turkish production in the season. This epithet deserved the fact that it broke down all the previous ratings in all countries in which it was broadcast. Including both Serbia, where it was broadcast on the first television channel. Thanks to the success of this, but also other serial editions, the owner Tims Production Timura Savcija brought the status of the most successful production company in Turkey. Series How time passes You can watch again on the first one of this Monday at the time of 16.00 and remember the famous Moroplovac Ali! We will remind you briefly on the series store - the year is 1967. and the Captain on long vessels, but Akarsu spends a lot of time away from their family. In the meantime, his wife Jamile is worried about their four children. She takes on a role and father and mother while her husband is on a journey. One day, but he finally returns home from the trip ... All members of the family believe the head of the house returns, but they do not know that the lives will change after their return. His dark side appears, and his behavior is extremely unusual. Jamile in Ali's pocket finds a letter that will encourage a series of events deserving for large reversals in the lives of the Akarsi family. The letter will reveal his secret - a loving affair with the party. Will Jamile forgive the husband to betray? Who will but choose? A long-loved wife or a young mistress? / Te 2010. godine bila je najgledanjija turska drama, ali i najuspešnija turska produkcija u sezoni. Ovaj epitet zaslužila je činjenicom da je oborila sve dotadašnje rekorde gledanosti u svim zemljama u kojima je emitovana. Uključujići i Srbiju, gde je emitovana na kanalu Prve televizije. Zahvaljujući uspehu ove, ali i ostalih serijskih izdanja, vlasniku TIMS produkcije Timuru Savciju donelo je status najuspešnije produkcijske kuće u Turskoj. Seriju Kako vreme prolazi možete gledati ponovo na Prvoj od ovog ponedeljka u terminu od 16.00 i prisetiti se čuvenog moreplovca Alija! Podsetićemo vas ukratko na radnju serije - godina je 1967. i kapetan na dugim plovidbama, Ali Akarsu provodi dosta vremena daleko od svoje porodice. U međuvremenu se njegova supruga Džemile brine za njihovo četvero dece. Ona preuzima ulogu i oca i majke dok je njen muž na putovanju. Jednog dana se Ali konačno vraća kući sa putovanja... Svi članovi porodice veruju da se glava kuće vraća, ali ne znaju da će životi da im se promene nakon njegovog povratka. Pojavljuje se njegova mračna strana, i njegovo ponašanje je krajnje neobično. Džemile u Alijevom džepu pronalazi pismo koje će da podstakne niz događaja zaslužnih za velike preokrete u životima porodice Akarsu. Pismo će da otkrije njegovu tajnu – ljubavnu aferu sa strankinjom. Da li će Džemile da oprostiti mužu izdaju? Koga će Ali odabrati? Davno voljenu suprugu ili mladu ljubavnicu?

programme.title: As time goes on / Kako vreme prolazi
programme.desc: Te 2010. years there was the most slow Turkish drama, but also the most successful Turkish production in the season. This epithet deserved the fact that it broke down all the previous ratings in all countries in which it was broadcast. Including both Serbia, where it was broadcast on the first television channel. Thanks to the success of this, but also other serial editions, the owner Tims Production Timura Savcija brought the status of the most successful production company in Turkey. Series How time passes You can watch again on the first one of this Monday at the time of 16.00 and remember the famous Moroplovac Ali! We will remind you briefly on the series store - the year is 1967. and the Captain on long vessels, but Akarsu spends a lot of time away from their family. In the meantime, his wife Jamile is worried about their four children. She takes on a role and father and mother while her husband is on a journey. One day, but he finally returns home from the trip ... All members of the family believe the head of the house returns, but they do not know that the lives will change after their return. His dark side appears, and his behavior is extremely unusual. Jamile in Ali's pocket finds a letter that will encourage a series of events deserving for large reversals in the lives of the Akarsi family. The letter will reveal his secret - a loving affair with the party. Will Jamile forgive the husband to betray? Who will but choose? A long-loved wife or a young mistress? / Te 2010. godine bila je najgledanjija turska drama, ali i najuspešnija turska produkcija u sezoni. Ovaj epitet zaslužila je činjenicom da je oborila sve dotadašnje rekorde gledanosti u svim zemljama u kojima je emitovana. Uključujići i Srbiju, gde je emitovana na kanalu Prve televizije. Zahvaljujući uspehu ove, ali i ostalih serijskih izdanja, vlasniku TIMS produkcije Timuru Savciju donelo je status najuspešnije produkcijske kuće u Turskoj. Seriju Kako vreme prolazi možete gledati ponovo na Prvoj od ovog ponedeljka u terminu od 16.00 i prisetiti se čuvenog moreplovca Alija! Podsetićemo vas ukratko na radnju serije - godina je 1967. i kapetan na dugim plovidbama, Ali Akarsu provodi dosta vremena daleko od svoje porodice. U međuvremenu se njegova supruga Džemile brine za njihovo četvero dece. Ona preuzima ulogu i oca i majke dok je njen muž na putovanju. Jednog dana se Ali konačno vraća kući sa putovanja... Svi članovi porodice veruju da se glava kuće vraća, ali ne znaju da će životi da im se promene nakon njegovog povratka. Pojavljuje se njegova mračna strana, i njegovo ponašanje je krajnje neobično. Džemile u Alijevom džepu pronalazi pismo koje će da podstakne niz događaja zaslužnih za velike preokrete u životima porodice Akarsu. Pismo će da otkrije njegovu tajnu – ljubavnu aferu sa strankinjom. Da li će Džemile da oprostiti mužu izdaju? Koga će Ali odabrati? Davno voljenu suprugu ili mladu ljubavnicu?

programme.title: At two bela pigeons / Kod dva bela goluba
programme.desc: Nikola Doksat de Mores was a builder of the Belgrade Fortress. In this form, what we see today, the fortress was built from 1723. until 1736. years and is one of the 600 fortresses raised on the banks of the Danube from the source to the mouth. A prominent fortifier in the long-term imperial majesty of the Austrian Emperor Carl VI, it was ordered that the existing Belgrade Fortress has made an insurmountable obstacle in front of the Turks, and the town of building. He joined the fundamental reorganization of the fortress because the existing represented only the sum of low weak walls, almost bumps and shallow trenches, completely unaccustomed with the development of weapons and assholes and attack on fortified cities. Then the Nebojsa Tower was rebuilt, with a floor more, a large well, better known as the Roman well, and the city of Karl VI, one of the most beautiful baroque gates, saved to this day. Docsat destroyed everything, so the remains of the Celtic Fortress and many remains of the Roman, Byzantine, Serbian and Turkish cultural and historical heritage. About how the Belgrade Fortress was built and what was the fate of her builder, we talk in tonight's show. / Nikola Doksat de Mores bio je graditelj Beogradske tvrđave. U ovom obliku, kakvu je mi danas vidimo, tvrđava je građena od 1723. do 1736. godine i jedna je od 600 tvrđava podignutih na obalama Dunava od izvora do ušća. Uglednom fortifikatoru u dugogodišnjoj službi carskog veličanstva austrijskog imperatora Karla VI, naređeno je da postojeću Beogradsku tvrđavu učini nesavladivom preprekom pred Turcima, a varoš da izgradi novom. On je pristupio temeljnom preuređenju tvrđave jer je postojeća predstavljala samo zbir niskih nejakih zidova, gotovo grudobrana i plitkih rovova, potpuno neprilagođenih tadašnjem razvoju oružja i oruđa za opsadu i napad na utvrđene gradove. Tada je ponovo sagrađena Kula Nebojša, sa spratom više, sazidan Veliki bunar, poznatiji kao Rimski bunar, a Donji grad je dobio kapiju Karla VI, jednu od najlepših baroknih kapija, sačuvanu do danas. Doksat je sve porušio, tako da su nestali ostaci keltske tvrđave i mnogi ostaci rimskog, vizantijskog, srpskog i turskog kulturno-istorijskog nasleđa. O tome kako je građena Beogradska tvrđava i kakva je bila sudbina njenog graditelja, govorimo u večerašnjoj emisiji.

programme.title: From the Archives of Radio Belgrade / Iz arhive Radio Beograda
programme.desc: We will dedicate two emissions to one of our most significant and longest conductors, Mladen Jagušto, who passed away in 101. years of life. This eminent artist and pedagogue was headed by the Hora and the Symphony Orchestra of Radio-Television Belgrade until retirement, 1984. Years. At his repertoire, there were works from all the epoch, whom he managed to breathe a new life every time. This conductor has held a conductor baton more than seven decades, becoming synonymous with the ethical norms of the profession, music erudition and performing perfection. / Dve emisije posvetićemo jednom od naših najznačajnijih i najdugovečnijih dirigenata, Mladenu Jaguštu, koji je preminuo u 101. godini života. Na njegovom repertoaru nalazila su se dela iz svih epoha, kojima je on svaki put uspevao da udahne novi život. Ovaj dirigent je više od sedam decenija držao dirigentsku palicu, postajući sinonim etičkih normi profesije, muzičke erudicije i izvođačke perfekcije.

Međutim, kada uzorna Rori svoje snove o upisu na Harvard zameni s ljubavnim, Lorelai se vraća 16 godina unazad pa se mora prisetiti kako je ona tada živela. Lorelai je oduvek radila stvari po svome. Od služavke postala je uspešna menadžerka u istorijskom Independence Inn-u koja mašta o pokretanju vlastitog posla sa svojom najboljom prijateljicom Suki Džejms, inače kulinarskom genijalkom.

Na dan poslednje utakmice u sezoni, Bili saznaje da se njenov klub prodaje, a da će nove gazde pokušati da ga razmene.

programme.title: Butterfly / Leptir
programme.desc: Film based according to the true story of Henry Harier known as a butterfly, who is wrongly accused of murder and sentenced for the rest of his life to French criminal institution in Guyana. The butterfly wants to escape from prison, but every attempt to escape ends with the arrest and even worse penalties. The touching story of his perseverance that despite very strict and martyrs, he continues to find his way to freedom. / Film baziran prema istinitoj priči Henrija Hariera poznatog kao Leptir, koji je krivo optužen za ubistvo i osuđen do kraja života na francusku kaznenu ustanovu u Gvajani. Leptir želi pobeći iz zatvora, ali svaki pokušaj bega završava se ponovnim hapšenjem i još gorim kaznama. Dirljiva priča o njegovoj istrajnosti da uprkos jako strogim i mučeničkim kaznama i dalje nastoji naći svoj put u slobodu.

programme.title: Voz Trezor / Voz trezor
programme.desc: Vesley Snajps and Woody Harelson interpret the characters two brothers working as traffic police officers. One of them is completely satisfied with life, while others, due to its need for a higher amount of money, ready for great risk-ending ventures. The moment he loses his job and when his brother runs out of the house, he comes to the idea of stealing the train treasury to come to the money. But when things go unplanned badly, he relies on the help of his brother. / Vesli Snajps i Vudi Harelson tumače likove dva brata koji rade kao saobraćajni policajci. Jedan od njih je u potpunosti zadovoljan životom, dok je drugi, zbog svoje potrebe za većom količinom novca, spreman za velike rizične poduhvate. U trenutku kada gubi posao i kada ga brat izbaci iz kuće, on dolazi na ideju da ukrade voz trezor kako bi došao do novca. Ali kada stvari krenu neplanirano loše, on se oslanja na pomoć svog brata.

programme.title: Peoples Problems / Peoples Problems
programme.desc: The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law. / The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law.

programme.title: Meeting with Nature / Meeting with Nature
programme.desc: If youre in tune with nature, RTD is the place for you! Our nature documentaries explore natural wonders, environmental issues and people called to preserve the beauty and diversity of our world.In our films, youll join a team of marine biologists as they replant Thailands endangered coral reefs and see how overfishing has made a once-fertile Arctic village look like the Sahara Desert. programme.title: Peoples Problems / Peoples Problems
programme.desc: The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law. / The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law.

programme.title: Peoples Problems / Peoples Problems
programme.desc: The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. The Ala kachuu, or grab and run custom has young men abducting girls and marrying them against their will. The traditional lifestyle in Kyrgyzstan makes the fight for equality and human rights for girls more complicated. Until recently, the penalty for kidnapping was less than for stealing cattle. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. Still, even when formal justice is served, the girls have to endure a lot of humiliation with their families, their social circle and even the authorities. Commonly the police dont take reports of Ala kachuu seriously; they laugh and joke about it. They know their negligence will not be punished. Religious elders dont condone the kidnapping. However, a mullah often makes a house call and weds the couple without asking the girls consent. According to the Kyrgyz Ministry of the Interior, domestic violence has increased 62% during the COVID lockdown. The Ministry cites over 8,000 cases a year. But human rights advocates claim the numbers are significantly higher — tens of thousands of cases. The best way to reduce these numbers is to educate both young men and women about their rights and that everyone is equal before the law. / The film Stolen Brides, Stolen Lives is a follow-up to the 2013 RT Documentary, which examined the phenomenon of girl abduction in Kyrgyzstan. However, human rights advocates managed to establish a ten-year sentence for kidnappers. New Life under the Sun: Traveling / Novi život pod suncem: Putovanje
programme.desc: The journey is a new version of the British franchise new life under the sun that leads viewers to beautiful European destinations where the British are trying to start new lives and start jobs from which they will live. In ten episodes, Fred Sirieix leader takes us to Spain, in Andalusia, where we get to know the couple who wants to plan and organize weddings and business gatherings. In the wine region of Bordeaux and Bergerac we meet winemakers, Sommelier and his wife, a cookbook launching Gîte, ie a holiday home and cooking school. / Putovanje je nova inačica britanske franšize Novi život pod suncem koja gledatelje vodi na prekrasne europske destinacije na kojima Britanci pokušavaju započeti nove živote i pokrenuti poslove od kojih će živjeti. U deset epizoda voditelj Fred Sirieix vodi nas u Španjolsku, u Andaluziju, gdje upoznajemo par koji želi planirati i organizirati vjenčanja, ali i poslovna druženja. U vinskoj regiji Bordeaux i Bergerac susrećemo vinare, sommeliera i njegovu suprugu kuharicu koji pokreću gîte, tj. kuću za odmor i školu kuhanja.

programme.title: Escape to the castle: his own master / Bijeg u dvorac: Sam svoj majstor
programme.desc: After buying and remodeling CHâteau de la Motte-Husson Castle with his wife in Martigne-sur-Mayenne, Dick Strawbridge gives advisable support to others. In the version of the documentary series Escape to the castle of the British Channel 4, which is called their own master, viewers will be able to meet British families who renew the castles in France or want to buy them. In the role of the narrator is Dick Strawbridge, who, along with her husband, Angel Adore, provides help with his experienced advice. / Nakon što je sa suprugom kupio i preuredio dvorac Château de la Motte-Husson iz 19. stoljeća u Martigne-sur-Mayenneu, Dick Strawbridge daje savjetodavnu podršku drugima. U inačici dokumentarne serije Bijeg u dvorac britanskog Channela 4, koja se zove Sam svoj majstor, gledatelji će moći upoznati britanske obitelji koje obnavljaju dvorce u Francuskoj ili ih žele kupiti. U ulozi naratora je Dick Strawbridge, koji zajedno sa suprugom Angel Adoree pruža pomoć svojim iskusnim savjetima.

programme.title: Secrets / Tajne
programme.desc: Joseph is inconsolable after Robert's escape. Brigita begs Damian for a chance to prove her innocence, while the suspicious Barbara is increasingly confident that her mom has killed her dad. Miro turns out to be violent before the cherry. But when an unexpected money arrives from Damian, Miro invites Lada for dinner. / Josipa je neutješna nakon Robertovog bijega. Brigita moli Damjana za šansu da dokaže nevinost, dok je sumnjičava Barbara sve sigurnija da joj je mama ubila tatu. Miro ispadne nasilan pred Višnjom. programme.title: Builds (she) / Gradi(ONA)
programme.desc: A new, fourth season of the show was coming (she). The popular show won the viewers during the three seasons of the display on RTL authentic display of the actual construction process - from the ground up to the last detail during interior decoration. This season building (it) brings a project to create a modern holiday home, located on Samobor hills. Through nine episodes, viewers will have the opportunity to follow the whole process. The new season also brings four new columns that will educate viewers about the process of building a dream home. / Stigla je nova, četvrta sezona emisije Gradi(ONA). Popularna emisija osvojila je gledatelje tijekom tri sezone prikazivanja na RTL-u autentičnim prikazom procesa stvarne gradnje - od temelja do posljednjeg detalja tijekom uređenja interijera. Ovosezonska Gradi(ONA) donosi projekt stvaranja moderne kuće za odmor, smještene na samoborskim brežuljcima. Kroz devet epizoda gledatelji će imati priliku pratiti cijeli proces. Nova sezona donosi i četiri nove rubrike koje će gledatelje educirati o procesu gradnje doma iz snova.

programme.title: Hidden in paradise / Skriveno u raju
programme.desc: What happens when tourists arrive in an idyllic Istrian camp, and each of them, with suitcases, also brings with them numerous desires, secrets, spirits of the past and hidden motives? Among others, the Steiner, surgeon Edward and his grandson Mark, a medical student, arrives on vacation. At first glance, Mark seems to have everything, a guaranteed successful career at the family clinic and a comfortable life, but behind his cynicism and inappropriateness, hides a tragic event from the past that has changed his life and priorities, which is why he is often conflict with his family members. There is also Mark's mother Julius, an entrepreneur and a doctor from Ljubljana, where he runs a family business, a clinic trying to make all the forces famous and successful. The camp also houses the Kovac family who has been visiting the resort for years. The camp is full of events and, although seemingly seems to be another carefree summer in front of them, a real drama is happening behind the scenes! / Što se dogodi kad turisti stignu u idilični istarski kamp, a svatko od njih, uz kofere, sa sobom donese i brojne želje, tajne, duhove prošlosti i skrivene motive? Između ostalih, na ljetovanje stiže obitelj Steiner, kirurg Edvard i njegov unuk Mark, student medicine. Na prvi pogled čini se da Mark ima sve, zajamčenu uspješnu karijeru u obiteljskoj klinici i lagodan život, ali iza njegovog cinizma i nepristupačnosti, krije se tragičan događaj iz prošlosti koji mu je promijenilo život i prioritete, zbog čega često dolazi u sukob s članovima svoje obitelji. Tu je i Markova majka Julija, poduzetnica i liječnica iz Ljubljane, gdje vodi obiteljski posao, kliniku koju se trudi svim silama učiniti poznatom i uspješnom. U kampu se nalazi i obitelj Kovač koja godinama posjećuje odmaralište. Kamp je prepun događanja te, iako se naizgled čini da je ispred njih još jedno bezbrižno ljeto, iza kulisa se zbiva prava drama!

programme.title: Poirot / Poirot
programme.desc: The British Criminal Drama Poirot is the most famous adaptation of the famous detective from Agatha Christie. The Poirot series, originally shown on ITV from 1989 to 2013, lasted impressive 13 seasons and became synonymous with a top criminal story. In the lead role, David Suchet is brilliant, chosen by the Agathe Christie family for the role of Hercule Poirot. Poirot was nominated for as many as 20 baft prizes, which confirms its quality and popularity. This cult series offers impeccable acting, intriguing plot and an unforgettable atmosphere, making it an indispensable classic of a criminal genre. / Britanska kriminalistička drama Poirot najpoznatija je ekranizacija slavnog detektiva iz djela Agathe Christie. Serija Poirot, koja se originalno prikazivala na ITV-u od 1989. do 2013., trajala je impresivnih 13 sezona i postala sinonim za vrhunsku kriminalističku priču. U glavnoj ulozi briljira David Suchet, kojeg je za ulogu Herculea Poirota odabrala sama obitelj Agathe Christie. Poirot je bio nominiran za čak 20 BAFTA nagrada, što potvrđuje njegovu kvalitetu i popularnost. Ova kultna serija nudi besprijekornu glumu, intrigantne zaplete i nezaboravnu atmosferu, čineći je nezaobilaznim klasikom kriminalističkog žanra.

programme.title: Inspector Rex / Inspektor Rex
programme.desc: After the previous owner was killed, Rex belonged to Richard Moser Inspector (Tobias Moretti), who grew natives natively. Inspectors are part of the Office of the Austrian Criminal Police Criminalpolize, ie. The murder department, which solves the most subsequent cases on the streets of Vienna. / Nakon što mu je dotadašnji vlasnik ubijen, Rex pripadne inspektoru Richardu Moseru (Tobias Moretti), koji se nadavno rastao. Rex je svestrani pas detektiv koji otkriva ubojstva, ali i njuši raznu krijumčarenu robu i narkotike pa on i Moser uspješno i neumorno odgonetavaju zločine, a pomaže im i inspektor Stockinger (Karl Markovics). programme.title: Option / Kosti
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) is a top forensic anthropologist, employed by the Premiest Institute of Jeffersonian, which police and other ranks are often called to assist those cases in which the standard methods of identifying victims are insufficient. Namely, the temperance special is its unusual ability to read traces in the victim's burnt, destroyed or heavier bones. Brennanan is most often cooperating with the Special Agent Seeley Booth (David Boreanaz), a member of the Special FBI Team for Teaching Team. / Doktorica Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) vrhunska je forenzična antropologinja, zaposlena u uglednom institutu Jeffersonian, koju policija i druge snage reda često zovu u pomoć pri onim slučajevima ubojstava u kojima su standardne metode identificiranja žrtava nedovoljne. Naime, Temperanceina specijalnost njezina je nesvakidašnja sposobnost čitanja tragova u žrtvinim izgorenim, uništenim ili teže oštećenim kostima. Brennanova najčešće surađuje sa specijalnim agentom Seeleyem Boothom (David Boreanaz), članom posebnog FBI-jeva tima za istraživanje ubojstava.

programme.title: Friends / Prijatelji
programme.desc: The series of the series follows six characters; Rachel (Jennifer Aniston), Monica (Courteney Cox), Phoebe (Lisa Kudrow), Joey (Matt Leblanc), Chandler (Matthew Perry) and Rossa (David Schwimmer), who want to make their dreams in the big city of New York and become friends for all their lives. programme.title: Hidden in paradise / Skriveno u raju
programme.desc: What happens when tourists arrive in an idyllic Istrian camp, and each of them, with suitcases, also brings with them numerous desires, secrets, spirits of the past and hidden motives? Among others, the Steiner, surgeon Edward and his grandson Mark, a medical student, arrives on vacation. At first glance, Mark seems to have everything, a guaranteed successful career at the family clinic and a comfortable life, but behind his cynicism and inappropriateness, hides a tragic event from the past that has changed his life and priorities, which is why he is often conflict with his family members. There is also Mark's mother Julius, an entrepreneur and a doctor from Ljubljana, where he runs a family business, a clinic trying to make all the forces famous and successful. The camp also houses the Kovac family who has been visiting the resort for years. The camp is full of events and, although seemingly seems to be another carefree summer in front of them, a real drama is happening behind the scenes! / Što se dogodi kad turisti stignu u idilični istarski kamp, a svatko od njih, uz kofere, sa sobom donese i brojne želje, tajne, duhove prošlosti i skrivene motive? Između ostalih, na ljetovanje stiže obitelj Steiner, kirurg Edvard i njegov unuk Mark, student medicine. Na prvi pogled čini se da Mark ima sve, zajamčenu uspješnu karijeru u obiteljskoj klinici i lagodan život, ali iza njegovog cinizma i nepristupačnosti, krije se tragičan događaj iz prošlosti koji mu je promijenilo život i prioritete, zbog čega često dolazi u sukob s članovima svoje obitelji. Tu je i Markova majka Julija, poduzetnica i liječnica iz Ljubljane, gdje vodi obiteljski posao, kliniku koju se trudi svim silama učiniti poznatom i uspješnom. U kampu se nalazi i obitelj Kovač koja godinama posjećuje odmaralište. programme.title: Option / Kosti
programme.desc: Dr. Temperance Brennan (Emily Deschanel) is a top forensic anthropologist, employed by the Premiest Institute of Jeffersonian, which police and other ranks are often called to assist those cases in which the standard methods of identifying victims are insufficient. programme.title: Dr. House / Dr. House
programme.desc: After injuring him in a new York car accident, House was placed in a hospital in bed to a patient who experienced a full body paralysis after a bicycle accident. programme.title: Friends / Prijatelji
programme.desc: The series of the series follows six characters; Rachel (Jennifer Aniston), Monica (Courteney Cox), Phoebe (Lisa Kudrow), Joey (Matt Leblanc), Chandler (Matthew Perry) and Rossa (David Schwimmer), who want to make their dreams in the big city of New York and become friends for all their lives. Rachel wants to deal with fashion, Monica dreams of a chef's career, Joey is doing his best to become a famous actor, Ross is a paleontologist who does not make happiness in love, Phoebe has really had a difficult life, but it does not prevent her from being one of the most positive people in the series, and Chandler works in a great corporation and has a sarcastic view of the world. / Radnja serije prati šest likova; Rachel (Jennifer Aniston), Monicu (Courteney Cox), Phoebe (Lisa Kudrow), Joeyja (Matt LeBlanc), Chandlera (Matthew Perry) i Rossa (David Schwimmer), koji žele ostvariti svoje snove u velikom gradu New Yorku i spontano postanu prijatelji za cijeli život. Rachel se želi baviti modom, Monica sanja o kuharskoj karijeri, Joey daje sve od sebe da postane slavni glumac, Ross je paleontolog koji nikako da ostvari sreću u ljubavi, Phoebe je uistinu imala težak život, no to je ne sprečava da bude jedna od najpozitivnijih osoba u seriji, a Chandler radi u velikoj korporaciji i ima sarkastičan pogled na svijet.

programme.title: Great Bang Theory / Teorija velikog praska
programme.desc: Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon (Jim Parsons) can tell you everything that interests you of quantum physics, but to deal with the simplest things from everyday life is a complete puzzle of two friends. They are brilliant physicists who can understand how the universe works, but how to communicate with people, especially girls, their complete mystery is. This begins to change when Penny (Kaley Cuoco) moved to their neighborhood. / Leonard (Johnny Galecki) i Sheldon (Jim Parsons) mogu vam ispričati sve što vas zanima o kvantnoj fizici, no rješavanje najjednostavnijih stvari iz svakodnevnog života potpuna je zagonetka dvojici prijatelja. With unforgettable characters, British humor and a warm story about family, the shakes have become a cult series, which still wins the hearts of viewers around the world today. / Britanska humoristična serija Mućke prati braću Trotter, Dereka Del Boya i Rodneyja, koji se na tržnici u londonskom predgrađu bave preprodajom robe sumnjive kvalitete i porijekla. programme.title: When we were small / Kad smo bili mali
programme.desc: When we were small, in the production of RTL dice, it is an opportunity to get to know your idols, people from public life, fashion icons, athletes, actors, king's social networks and find out what led them to their profession today. Open and without a delay about their childhood, they tell, for children, the most popular names of the Croatian media scene. Showing us old photos reveal the unknown parts of their life. In the guests, the already recognizable green sofa comes to us: Ivanka Mazurkijevic and Damir Martinovic Mrle, Kim Verson, Vanda Winter, Jan Kerekes, Filip Sertic, Jan Kovacic, Antonia Matkovic Seric, Marco Cuccurin and many others. Find out what games they loved as children, whether they were involved in sports, what their hobbies were, who their role models were ... and how they came to a career that gave them star status. / Kad smo bili mali, u produkciji RTL Kockice, prilika je da upoznate svoje idole, osobe iz javnog života, modne ikone, sportaše, glumce, kraljeve društvenih mreža i saznate što ih je dovelo do njihovog današnjeg zanimanja. Otvoreno i bez zadrške o svojem djetinjstvu pričaju, za djecu, najpopularnija imena hrvatske medijske scene. Pokazujući nam stare fotografije otkrivaju nepoznate dijelove svog života. U goste, na već prepoznatljivi zeleni kauč, nam dolaze: Ivanka Mazurkijević i Damir Martinović Mrle, Kim Verson, Vanda Winter, Jan Kerekeš, Filip Sertić, Jan Kovačić, Antonia Matković Šerić, Marco Cuccurin i mnogi drugi. Saznajte koje igre su voljeli kao djeca, jesu li se bavili sportom, koji su im bili hobiji, tko su im bili uzori…te kako su došli do karijere koja im je omogućila zvjezdani status.

programme.title: Skital - Pyryer / Skitalica - pitalica
programme.desc: The educational-entertaining show of the Skitanica-Pitalica is intended for anyone who constantly rethinks the world around them. As the name implies, in this show we will wander, ask, and eventually answer all your questions. If you are one of those who drive everything crazy about the popular word why, you must by no means miss this format. Find out why the sea is salty, how cities get names or why we cry when we are happy. Store your hunger for new knowledge. / Obrazovno-zabavna emisija Skitalica-pitalica namijenjena je svima koji neprestano preispituju svijet oko sebe. Kao što i samo ime kaže, u ovoj ćemo emisiji skitati, pitati i na kraju dati odgovor na sva vaša pitanja. Ako ste jedan od onih koji izluđuju sve oko sebe popularnom riječi zašto, ovaj format nikako ne smijete propustiti. Saznajte zašto je more slano, kako gradovi dobivaju imena ili, pak, zašto plačemo kada smo sretni. Utažite svoju glad za novim znanjima.

programme.title: Exclusive / Exkluziv
programme.desc: The Exkluziv0 magazine show is one of RTL's most recognizable brands in the form of magazine shows. He marked one television period, left remembered for exclusive interviews with world and domestic stars, followed by important social events, and was always ongoing with events that were interested in viewers. / Magazinska emisija Exkluziv0 jedan je od najprepoznatljivijih brendova RTL-a u formi magazinskih emisija. Obilježio je jedno televizijsko razdoblje, ostavši zapamćen po ekskluzivnim intervjuima sa svjetskim i domaćim zvijezdama, pratio je bitne društvene događaje, te uvijek bio u tijeku sa zbivanjima koji su zanimali gledatelje.

programme.title: Sanja / Sanja
programme.desc: Successful daily talk show Sanja, made in the production of Maxima film, shown on RTL from Monday to Friday in the afternoon from mid-2004 to the end of 2005 during its duration, was named the best talk show on the TV channels in Croatia, and Sanja Doležal became one of his favorite leaders and TV. / Uspješni dnevni talk show Sanja, nastao u produkciji Maxima filma, prikazivao se je na RTL-u od ponedjeljka do petka u poslijepodnevnom terminu od sredine 2004. do kraja 2005. Za vrijeme svog trajanja, proglašen je ponajboljim talk showom na TV kanalima u Hrvatskoj, a Sanja Doležal je postala jedna od omiljenih voditeljica i TV lica.

programme.title: Grandma tells the most beautiful stories / Baka priča najljepše priče
programme.desc: Grandma tells the most beautiful stories format is a domestic production, in which Grandma Stanka Silovic and Mirjana Tomasko Antic read the famous classic good night stories, such as Trnoruzica, Pinoki, Cat in Boots, Goldilots and many others ... / Baka priča najljepše priče format je domaće produkcije, u kojem bake Stanka Šilović i Mirjana Tomaško Antić čitaju poznate klasične priče za laku noć, poput Trnoružice, Pinokija, Mačka u čizmama, Zlatokose i brojnih drugih…

programme.title: Linguists / Jezikoslovci
programme.desc: After a very successful German school, a fun-educational format from the RTL Cube factory in new episodes will bring English closer to children. In every episode, small, but also large viewers, with the help of a teacher and her helpers, will learn one thematic area. You will see that it is quite easy and fun in just a few minutes to learn how to count in English, to describe what kind of time it is, to list days of the week, and to overcome the names of animals, fruits and vegetables. / Nakon vrlo uspješne školice njemačkog, zabavno-edukativni format iz tvornice RTL Kockice u novim će epizodama djeci približiti engleski jezik. U svakoj epizodi mali, ali i veliki gledatelji, uz pomoć učiteljice i njezinih pomagača, učit će po jedno tematsko područje. Vidjet ćete da je sasvim lako i zabavno za svega nekoliko minuta naučiti kako na engleskom jeziku brojati, opisati kakvo je vani vrijeme, nabrojati dane u tjednu te svladati nazive životinja, voća i povrća.

programme.title: Let's go to the zoo / Idemo u ZOO
programme.desc: Nove epizode emisije Idemo u ZOO i njezin voditelj Davor Balažin vode nas u tajne životinjskog carstva. The series aimed at learning children with various types of animals, educating them about them, their lifestyle and possible threat in nature, was created in collaboration with the Zoo Zagreb. Its educators will present to the children of the residents of the largest Croatian zoo. / Nove epizode emisije Idemo u ZOO i njezin voditelj Davor Balažin vode nas u tajne životinjskog carstva. Serijal kojem je cilj upoznati djecu s raznim vrstama životinja, educirati ih o njima, njihovom načinu života i eventualnoj ugroženosti u prirodi, nastao je u suradnji sa Zoološkim vrtom Zagreb. Njegovi edukatori predstavit će djeci stanovnike najvećeg hrvatskog zoološkog vrta.

programme.title: Cheerful classroom / Vesela učionica
programme.desc: The educational-entertainment series from the cheerful RTL Cube workshop is intended for preschool children and serves as a kind of preparation for the beginning of elementary education. A series that makes up 20 interesting, creative but also instructive episodes, is an opportunity for toddlers to learn numbers, letters or mental folders that will greatly facilitate their stay in school benches. / Edukativno-zabavni serijal iz vesele radionice RTL Kockice namijenjen je djeci predškolske dobi i služi kao svojevrsna priprema za početak osnovnoškolskog obrazovanja. Serijal koji čini 20 zanimljivih, kreativnih, ali i poučnih epizoda, prilika je da mališani nauče brojeve, slova ili izradu mentalnih mapa koje će im uvelike olakšati boravak u školskim klupama.

programme.title: The imagination draws everything / Mašta crta svašta
programme.desc: The imagination draws all sorts of RTL series where the youngest can create a magic on paper in just a few moves! During each show, we show the little ones what kind of interesting characters or things come from just one letter of alphabet and figure! We also learn how to use the basic geometric characters for a small masterpiece. Speaking to the children with a simple language, the imagination draws all sorts of format for all those who want to develop their artistic talent and encourage creativity. / Mašta crta svašta je RTL-ov serijal u kojem najmlađi mogu u samo nekoliko poteza stvoriti čaroliju na papiru! Tijekom svake emisije mališanima pokazujemo kakvi sve zanimljivi likovi ili stvari nastaju od samo jednog slova abecede i brojke! Također učimo i na koji način iskoristiti osnovne geometrijske likove za prava mala remek-djela. Obraćajući se djeci jednostavnim jezikom, Mašta crta svašta format je za sve one koji želi razviti svoj umjetnički talent i potaknuti kreativnost.

programme.desc: Japan has always been attracted to world travelers, adventurers and bonvivans. When Robert Knjaz decided to visit that megapolis everyone wondered what? programme.title: Blessed with us / Blago nama
programme.desc: Jadranko decides to report to her ex -girlfriend Daniel, and boast a little that he now works in the Government and lives in a big house with Jacuzzi, and she announces a recent visit to his husband Edi! As he now needs an empty house to boast about, he persuades Draga to take Boris and Anna to Paintball and teach them there war skills, but the ordinary game will be pleased to understand the crumb too seriously. / Jadranko se odluči javiti svojoj bivšoj djevojci Danijeli i pritom se malo pohvaliti kako sada radi u vladi i živi u velikoj kući s jacuzzijem, a ona mu najavi skori posjet sa svojim suprugom Edijem! Kako mu sad treba prazna kuća kojom bi se mogao hvaliti, nagovara Dragu da Borisa i Anu odvede na paintball i tamo ih pouči ratnim vještinama, no običnu igru Drago će shvatiti ipak mrvicu preozbiljno.

programme.title: Secrets / Tajne
programme.desc: Marina learns the reasons why she can't get Joseph - she is unemployed, she doesn't have her home, her father is unknown and her children have been taken away. programme.title: Bloody diamond / Krvavi dijamant
programme.desc: In order to achieve their goals, former Zimbabwery Danny Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) and a fisherman from Mende - Solomon Vandy (Djimon Hounsou) are joining during the Civil War, which engulfed Sierra Leone in the 1990s. They are both Africans, but they lead completely different lives until their fates are intertwined in a common search for a rare pink diamond. Solomon was abducted by family and forced to work in diamond mines and is aware that this expensive stone he found is of utmost importance for him and his family. On the other hand, Archer earns from diamond trading and buys weapons, and when he learns of Solomon's hidden gem, he realizes how valuable he is and that his exit from Africa, violence and corruption is drawn. / Kako bi ostvarili svoje ciljeve, bivši plaćenik iz Zimbabvea Danny Archer (Leonardo DiCaprio) i ribar iz naroda Mende - Solomon Vandy (Djimon Hounsou) udružuju se tijekom građanskog rata koji je 1990-ih zahvatio Sierru Leone. Obojica su Afrikanci, no vode potpuno različite živote sve dok im se sudbine ne isprepletu u zajedničkoj potrazi za rijetkim ružičastim dijamantom. Solomon je bio otet od obitelji i prisiljen raditi u rudnicima dijamanata i svjestan je kako je taj skupocjeni kamen koji je pronašao od iznimne važnosti za njega i njegovu obitelj. S druge strane, Archer zarađuje od trgovanja dijamantima i kupuje oružje, a kad dozna za Solomonov skriveni dragulj, uvidi koliko je dragocjen te da može biti njegov izlaz iz Afrike, nasilja i korupcije u što je uvučen.

Nakon što je prošli tjedan pobjedu odnijela Maida, ovaj tjedan za titulu najbolje kuharice natjecat će se novinarka Nina, glumice Milica i Selma, menadžerica prodaje Valentina i influencerica Vanja. programme.title: Farma / Farma
programme.desc: Nineteen candidates, 50 thousand euros, work, effort and coexistence of people who are just getting to know each other - Farm moves and shows how much life is rich, exciting and interesting. And the village and the city will talk about farming adventures located on 14 hectares of land. The candidates welcomed the adventure of life that will bring them a series of challenges - overcoming nature, caring for the farm and relationship with other competitors. The road to victory for them is constant proving whether it is worth remaining. The tense and uncertain game constantly wore new challenges before the candidates. Farmerice and farmers faced tasks inspired by the tradition of different parts of Croatia, and some of them were for the first time, they met with life in the countryside. Head of Nikolina Pisk was ready to jump into cowboy boots and entered RTL's farm and on an impressive property in the Dolenj region in Slovenia, leads candidates through the fight for a large cash prize. / Devetnaest kandidata, 50 tisuća eura, rad, trud i suživot ljudi koji se tek upoznaju - Farma kreće i pokazuje koliko je život na selu bogat, uzbudljiv i zanimljiv. I selo i grad pričat će o farmerskim avanturama smještenim na 14 hektara zemlje. Kandidate je dočekala avantura života koja će im donijeti niz izazova - savladavanje prirode, brigu o farmi i odnosu s ostalim natjecateljima. Put do pobjede za njih je stalno dokazivanje jesu li vrijedni ostanka. Napeta i neizvjesna igra stalno je pred kandidate nosila nove izazove. programme.title: Lucifer / Lucifer
programme.desc: The archangel Lucifer Morningstar (Tom Ellis) costs a persecution in paradise in paradise, waiting for him for millennia in hell and punishing the human race. But life in hell becomes boring, Lucifer is unhappy in his exile, renounces the throne and moves to Los Angeles, where he opens the nightclub. One day he finds himself in the midst of the murder investigation and meets Detective Chloe Decker (Lauren German), the first person immune to his charms. Of course, Lucifer wants to discover why this is so helping to expose the killer, using one of his powers - manipulation. Chloe is grateful and invites him to become a police counselor, solve cases together and meet with various supernatural phenomena and beings. / Arhanđela Lucifera Morningstara (Tom Ellis) pobuna u raju koštala je progona te su ga čekala tisućljeća u paklu i kažnjavanje ljudskog roda. programme.title: News. Local time / Vesti. Local time
Krajina guard / Čuvari Krajine
programme.desc: The documentary series of Karajina Karajina aims to present the rich cultural and historical heritage of Serbs from the area of Lika and Dalmatia, their historical rootness in these parts, but also all the few returnees today faces. Given the complexity of turbulent historical processes, Serbs from Lička and Dalmatian villages and cities have always been guards of national identity, and more than ten centuries are present on historic stage. At the first Split Parliament, held in 925. years, Serbs were mentioned as inhabitants of the Dalmatian hinterland. At the 14th century, the three most important and most common Serbian monastery - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) and Dragović (1395) were filed. The great names of Serbian history, spirituality and art are arguing out of these parts, and is enough to mention only some of them: Stojan Knežević, Vladan Knežević, Nikola Tesla ... The areas of Lika and northern Dalmatia were inhabited by the majority Orthodox population affected that today majority in just a few local communities. All this is enough for these parts, as well as the population that inhabits them today, dedicate media attention as they deserve, with the desire to not forget people and the ends enriched by the Serbian national and spiritual being. / Dokumentarni serijal Čuvari Krajine ima za cilj predstaviti bogato kulturno-istorijsko nasljeđe Srba sa područja Like i Dalmacije, njihovu istorijsku ukorijenjenost u ovim krajevima, ali i sve ono sa čim se malobrojno povratničko stanovništvo danas suočava. Imajući u vidu složenost burnih istorijskih procesa, Srbi iz ličkih i dalmatinskih sela i gradova oduvijek su bili čuvari nacionalnog identiteta, a na istorijskoj pozornici prisutni su više od deset vijekova. Na Prvom splitskom saboru, održanom 925. godine, pominju se Srbi kao stanovnici dalmatinskog zaleđa. U 14. vijeku podignuta su tri najznačajnija i najzapadnija srpska manastira - Krupa (1317), Krka (1345) i Dragović (1395). Velika imena srpske istorije, duhovnosti i umjetnosti potiču upravo iz ovih krajeva, a dovoljno je pomenuti samo neka od njih: Stojan Јanković, Vuk Mandušić, Simo Matavulj, Vladan Desnica, Nikodim Milaš, Stefan Knežević, Nikola Tesla... Područja Like i Sjeverne Dalmacije bila su vijekovima naseljena većinskim pravoslavnim stanovništvom, dok su posljednja ratna dešavanja uticala na to da su danas većinski u samo nekoliko lokalnih zajednica. Sve ovo dovoljan je razlog da se ovim krajevima, kao i stanovništvu koje ih danas nastanjuje, posveti medijska pažnja kakvu i zaslužuju, sa željom da se ne zaborave ljudi i krajevi koji su u mnogome obogatili srpsko nacionalno i duhovno biće.

programme.title: Stop to tell you / Stani da ti kažem
programme.desc: The show primarily aims to promote the freedom of expressing children as well as respecting their opinion. It wants to show that the child is able to shape a sophisticated attitude and that he has a full right to make him. Adults often experience children as people who only need protection, and very rarely people who have certain knowledge and attitudes that are well worth listening to because, in many cases, children have a rational approach to the solution of numerous situations without even being aware of this. Numerous situations and contributions shown through this TV show, open up various current life themes, learn things from general culture, exchange experiences, and through all this we strive for interacting between adults and children. We often know to tell our children that they will never be nicer than in their childhood, forgetting that they have their fears and their hopes, just like us, and that we owe them to their lives as a series of and beautiful and less beautiful moments that change independently of the age, interest and time in which we live. Every child is a man in a small, and every man is a great child, which creates a suitable climate for the development of one solid connection between the two individuals. Based on these views, the characters of the lucky all -known and Tamara were born. Both play a big and equal role in this series. With her way of expressing her way of expressing her way to her little friend, her way of expression, and she, with her childish wisdom, pure heart and firm attitude, wins his, but also the heart of the viewers. Tamara / Emisija prvenstveno ima za cilj promociju slobode izražavanja djece, kao i uvažavanja njihovog mišljenja. Njime se želi pokazati da je dijete sposobno oblikovati sopstveni stav i da ima puno pravo da ga iznese. Odrasli često djecu doživljavaju kao osobe kojima samo treba zaštita, a vrlo rijetko osobama koje imaju određena znanja i stavove koje itekako vrijedi saslušati jer, u velikom broju slučajeva, djeca imaju racionalan pristup rješenju brojnih situacija, a da odrasli toga nisu ni svjesni. Brojnim situacijama i prilozima prikazanim kroz ovu TV emisiju, otvaramo razne aktuelne životne teme, učimo stvari iz opšte kulture, razmjenjujemo iskustva i kroz sve to težimo interakciji između odraslih i djece. Često znamo reći svojoj djeci da im nikad neće biti ljepše nego u doba djetinjstva, pritom zaboravljajući da i oni imaju svoje strahove i svoja nadanja, baš kao i mi, te da smo dužni da im život predočimo kao niz i lijepih i manje lijepih trenutaka koji se smjenjuju nezavisno od uzrasta, zanimanja i vremena u kojem živimo. Svako dijete je čovjek u malom, a svaki čovjek veliko dijete, što i stvara pogodnu klimu za razvoj jedne čvrste veze između te dvije jedinke. Na temelju tih stavova, rodili su se likovi Srećka Sveznalice i Tamare. I jedno i drugo imaju veliku, a i podjednaku ulogu u ovom serijalu. Srećko Sveznalica se svojim načinom izražavanja i vedrim ponašanjem prilagođava svojoj maloj prijateljici, a ona svojom dječjom mudrošću, čistim srcem i čvrstim stavom osvaja njegovo, ali i srce gledalaca. programme.title: Morning program / Jutarnji program
programme.desc: The morning program is officially the most watched morning program in the Republika Srpska, and at the same time, one of the oldest emissions in the Republika Srpska Radio Television program! Every working morning, from 6 to 9 you can find out everything that is important to start the day: From time information, the condition of the roads, service information, the latest news in the entire Serbian and the region and the world! The hosts of the Morning RTRS program are famous persons, which will contribute to your good mood. Our Reporters from Trebinje, Eastern Sarajevo, Bijeljina, Brcko, Prijedor and other cities communicate the latest city and regional news and inform about the most interesting events from the previous day. / Јutarnji program zvanično je najgledaniji jutarnji program u Republici Srpskoj, a ujedno i jedna od najstarijih emisija u programu Radio-televizije Republike Srpske! Svakog radnog jutra, od 6 do 9 možete da saznate sve što je važno za početak dana: od informacija o vremenu, stanju na putevima, servisnih informacija, najnovijih vijesti, do najave važnih dešavanja u cijeloj Srpskoj, pa i regionu i svijetu! Domaćini Јutarnjeg programa RTRS-a su poznata lica, koja će doprinijeti vašem dobrom raspoloženju. Naši reporteri iz Trebinja, Istočnog Sarajeva, Bijeljine, Brčkog, Prijedora i drugih gradova u svakoj emisiji saopštavaju najnovije gradske i regionalne vijesti i informišu o najinteresantnijim događajima iz prethodnog dana.

Uključenja, gostovanja, analitički i istrazivački prilozi, najave i najnovije vijesti.

programme.title: Kitchen / Kuhinja
programme.desc: The witty series follows the young and enthusiastic Maxima "Max" lion's, whose great desire is to become a top chef. The ambitious Max got a job at the most expensive Cloud Monet restaurant in Moscow, owned by Dimitrij Nagiev, a well -known Russian actor. While Max, along with other employees in the kitchen, will prepare food for guests and fulfill other people's wishes, will fall into humorous and unforeseen situations. In addition to being a resourceful chef of the beginner, Max is also a charming conqueror of women's hearts, who is constantly opposed to the dangerous chief of the kitchen to Victor. Viktor often has unreasonable ideas and "unsalted jokes" that give the series a special tone, and his and Max's quarrels will make viewers laugh. / Duhovita serija prati mladog i entuzijastičnog Maxima "Maxa" Lavrova, kojemu je velika želja postati vrhunski kuhar. Ambiciozni Max zaposlio se u najskupljem restoranu Cloude Monet u Moskvi, čiji je vlasnik Dimitrij Nagiev, poznati ruski glumac. Dok će Max zajedno s ostalim zaposlenicima u kuhinji pripremati hranu za goste i ispunjavati tuđe želje, upadaće u šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Osim što je snalažljiv kuhar početnik, Max je ujedno i šarmantni osvajač ženskih srca, koji se stalno suprotstavlja opasnom šefu kuhinje Viktoru. Viktor često ima nerazumne ideje i "neslane šale", koje seriji daju poseban ton, a njegove i Maxove prepirke nasmijaće gledatelje.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The Italian television series came toward Roman Emil Zole near the female paradise from 1883. years, but the action was moved to Milan, 1956. years. The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, the faithful his father has chosen her, because the mayor's son, and he goes to Milan from Sicily. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, he learns that he is an uncle on the edge of bankruptcy and that he was accused of lighting the van of the reputable department stores for a paradise for the ladies that he loses his job. The owner of the department store is Petro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa is applying for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to hire and show that he is an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon acquires a colleague's trust. The girl in the end falls madly in love with RoeTere Moria, but he must return to Sicily because her father promised the mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva. / Italijanska televizijska serija nastala prema romanu Emila Zole Kod ženskog raja iz 1883. godine, ali radnja je premještena u Milano, 1956. godine. Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, vjerenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, poslije rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspjeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva djevojka koja ubrzo stiče povjerenje kolega. programme.title: My place / Moje Mjesto
programme.desc: In the show, we bring stories of individuals who, through their work, experience and knowledge, create a better life for themselves and their family in Republika Srpska and serve as an example of a narrow and wider community. They speak about their closest, friends, godparents, work colleagues. Is it a real success to be the master of your time and live on your own? Zašto nam odlaze ljekari, programeri, ekonomisti i svi drugi koji svoje diplome mukotrpno stečene mogu ljudski da naplate? Da li tuđina i nostalgija razaraju dušu? Moje mjesto vam donosi odgovore na sva ova pitanja. U prvim emisijama pričamo sa umjetnicima, doktorima nauka, profesorima, ljudima koji svojim primjerom promovišu opstanak u Republici Srpskoj. programme.desc: The documentary for ten years with Haja Majazaki through four episodes is the chronicle of the creative process of the legendary director and the founder of even legendiary studies Gibli. The wind rises from 2013, the documentary shows Meisaki as a passionate artist, but also a father who is in a creative conflict with his son. If there are Japanese directions with which the Western world is well acquainted, it is probably a dead race between Kurosava and Mihazaki. But if we talk about animation, there is no takers. Midazaki was quiet, a modest man largest part of his career, and was only the last few decades among his fans (especially those who do not speak Japanese) became a clear relationship between Meusaki with Gibli. It is a great part of the merit of the student of the Acera, which received the permission to enter the Studio Gibli and record part of the atmosphere during work on Mijazaki's film. Arakava still does not know why Midazaki allowed that from a short documentary film, such, a completely exclusive series. Through four episodes of fifty minutes, we follow how the cult characters and plots are created from the imagination of a miraculous mind. There are also memories of Mother, Childhood, Mijazaki's relationship with his son, and then the devastating earthquake that shook Japan, followed by a nuceal disaster in Fukushima. The series ends with another Mijazaki triumph, but also the topics of aging and meaning to the creation of animated films in these turbulent times. / Dokumentarni film Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem kroz četiri epizode predstavlja hroniku kreativnog procesa legendarnog reditelja i osnivača još legendarnijeg Studija Gibli. Pokrivajući period od rada na filmu Ponjo na litici kraj mora iz 2008. godine do Vetar se diže iz 2013., dokumentarac prikazuje Mijazakija kao strastvenog umetnika, nepokolebljivog tragaoca, ali i oca koji je u kreativnom sukobu sa sinom. Ukoliko postoje japanski reditelji sa kojima je zapadni svet dobro upoznat, verovatno je mrtva trka izmedju Kurosave i Mijazakija. Ali ako govorimo o animaciji, takmaca nema. Mijazaki je bio tih, skroman čovek najvećim delom svoje karijere, a tek je poslednjih par decenija medju svojim obožavaocima (naročito onim koji ne govore japanski) postao jasan odnos Mijazakija sa Giblijem. Velikim delom to je zasluga studenta Kaku Arakave, koji je dobio dozvolu da dodje u Studio Gibli i snimi deo atmosfere tokom rada na Mijazakijevom filmu. Arakava i dalje ne zna zbog čega je Mijazaki dozvolio da od kratkog dokumentarnog filma nastane ovakav, sasvim ekskluzivan serijal. Kroz četiri epizode od pedeset minuta pratimo kako se iz mašte jednog čudesnog uma stvaraju kultni likovi i zapleti. Tu su i sećanja na majku, detinjstvo, Mijazakijev odnos sa sinom, a potom i razorni zemljotres koji je potresao Japan, praćen nukearnom katastrofom u Fukušimi. Serijal završava još jednim Mijazakijevim trijumfom, ali i temama starenja i smisla stvaranja animiranih filmova u ovim turbulentnim vremenima.

programme.title: From plow to digital farm / Od Pluga do digitalne farme
programme.desc: The editorial office of the scientific program begins with the broadcast of a new series called the plow to the digital farm. We deal with the development of agriculture in modern Serbia where the periods of flourishing and stagnation are alternated from the middle of the XIX century. Great individuals appear, scientists and creators who move the boundaries by introducing the principles of modern agriculture, but their scientific and economic achievements are collapsing very quickly. The series includes the period of two centuries of statehood of Serbia and during that time, as in the vicious spiral, we always start from the beginning. The same matrix is recognized at the time of the establishment of a modern agriculture in the middle of the 19th century and in the modern race of today while trying to define what the opportunities are and what the goals of the agricultural development of the XXI century. / Redakcija naučnog programa počinje sa emitovanjem nove serije pod nazivom Od Pluga do digitalne farme. Bavimo se razvojem poljoprivrede u modernoj Srbiji gde se od polovine XIX veka do današnjih dana smenjuju periodi procvata i stagnacije. Pojavljuju se sjajni pojedinci, naučnici i stvaraoci koji pomeraju granice uvodeći principe moderne poljoprivrede ali se vrlo brzo njihova naučna i privredna dostignuća urušavaju. Serija obuhvata period dva veka državnosti Srbije a tokom tog vremenena, kao u začaranoj spirali, krećemo uvek iz početka. Ista matrica prepoznaje se u vreme uspostavljanja moderne poljoprivrede sredinom XIX veka i u savremenoj trci današnjice dok pokušavamo da definišemo šta su mogućnosti a šta ciljevi razvoja poljoprivrede XXI veka.

programme.title: Bitter revenge / Gorka osveta
programme.desc: Pain memories, desire for revenge, passion and love await us in one of the most watched Portuguese telenovels in the last few years, which 2018 was also received by the prestigious EMI Award. George Monforte is a Brazilian entrepreneur and the owner of the Auro Verde agricultural empire. After gaining a significant share in the company led by a rich and powerful portuguese family led by Miguel Fereiro de Fonsko, George becomes a member of the Board of Directors. The novelty is not well accepted in the De Fonsec family because they justifiably doubt the actual intentions of this foreigner. Namely, George Monforte is a new identity of Marie, for whom they all thought he was dead. Ze Maria returns to take revenge on the death of his family. Joao Magalhesa, Father Ze Marie, fifteen years ago, was the financial director at the time of great financial fraud and capital abuse in the company of the Faxes family. Joao was used as a sacrificial Capricorn and the firm accuses him of fraud. Joao threatens that the public will be presented by all dirty laundry company, if the charges do not withdraw. He and his family are killed, and the whole situation was expelled to look like murder and suicide. By playing the case, the only survivor is George. When he wakes up from which, Ze Maria is confused and at first he does not remember the event. He will look for Miguel, to help him find a job. On the same day he meets a girl in love with, not knowing that she is Miguel daughter. Over time, his memory is returned, and Miguela secret is no longer safe. / Bolne uspomene, želja za osvetom, strast i ljubav očekuju nas u jednoj od najgledanijih portugalskih telenovela u poslednjih nekoliko godina, koja je 2018. godine dobila i prestižnu nagradu Emi. Žorž Monforte je brazilski preduzetnik i vlasnik poljoprivrednog carstva Ouro verde. Nakon što stekne značajan udeo u kompaniji koju vodi bogata i moćna portugalska porodica na čelu sa Miguelom Fereirom de Fonsekom, Žorž postaje član Upravnog odbora. programme.title: Ten years with Haja Miazaki / Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem
programme.desc: The documentary for ten years with Haja Majazaki through four episodes is the chronicle of the creative process of the legendary director and the founder of even legendiary studies Gibli. Covering a period of work on the film on the cliff end of the 2008. The wind rises from 2013, the documentary shows Meisaki as a passionate artist, but also a father who is in a creative conflict with his son. If there are Japanese directions with which the Western world is well acquainted, it is probably a dead race between Kurosava and Mihazaki. But if we talk about animation, there is no takers. Midazaki was quiet, a modest man largest part of his career, and was only the last few decades among his fans (especially those who do not speak Japanese) became a clear relationship between Meusaki with Gibli. It is a great part of the merit of the student of the Acera, which received the permission to enter the Studio Gibli and record part of the atmosphere during work on Mijazaki's film. Arakava still does not know why Midazaki allowed that from a short documentary film, such, a completely exclusive series. Through four episodes of fifty minutes, we follow how the cult characters and plots are created from the imagination of a miraculous mind. There are also memories of Mother, Childhood, Mijazaki's relationship with his son, and then the devastating earthquake that shook Japan, followed by a nuceal disaster in Fukushima. The series ends with another Mijazaki triumph, but also the topics of aging and meaning to the creation of animated films in these turbulent times. / Dokumentarni film Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem kroz četiri epizode predstavlja hroniku kreativnog procesa legendarnog reditelja i osnivača još legendarnijeg Studija Gibli. Pokrivajući period od rada na filmu Ponjo na litici kraj mora iz 2008. godine do Vetar se diže iz 2013., dokumentarac prikazuje Mijazakija kao strastvenog umetnika, nepokolebljivog tragaoca, ali i oca koji je u kreativnom sukobu sa sinom. Ukoliko postoje japanski reditelji sa kojima je zapadni svet dobro upoznat, verovatno je mrtva trka izmedju Kurosave i Mijazakija. Ali ako govorimo o animaciji, takmaca nema. Mijazaki je bio tih, skroman čovek najvećim delom svoje karijere, a tek je poslednjih par decenija medju svojim obožavaocima (naročito onim koji ne govore japanski) postao jasan odnos Mijazakija sa Giblijem. Velikim delom to je zasluga studenta Kaku Arakave, koji je dobio dozvolu da dodje u Studio Gibli i snimi deo atmosfere tokom rada na Mijazakijevom filmu. Arakava i dalje ne zna zbog čega je Mijazaki dozvolio da od kratkog dokumentarnog filma nastane ovakav, sasvim ekskluzivan serijal. Kroz četiri epizode od pedeset minuta pratimo kako se iz mašte jednog čudesnog uma stvaraju kultni likovi i zapleti. Tu su i sećanja na majku, detinjstvo, Mijazakijev odnos sa sinom, a potom i razorni zemljotres koji je potresao Japan, praćen nukearnom katastrofom u Fukušimi. Serijal završava još jednim Mijazakijevim trijumfom, ali i temama starenja i smisla stvaranja animiranih filmova u ovim turbulentnim vremenima.

programme.title: From plow to digital farm / Od Pluga do digitalne farme
programme.desc: The editorial office of the scientific program begins with the broadcast of a new series called the plow to the digital farm. We deal with the development of agriculture in modern Serbia where the periods of flourishing and stagnation are alternated from the middle of the XIX century. Great individuals appear, scientists and creators who move the boundaries by introducing the principles of modern agriculture, but their scientific and economic achievements are collapsing very quickly. The series includes the period of two centuries of statehood of Serbia and during that time, as in the vicious spiral, we always start from the beginning. The same matrix is recognized at the time of the establishment of a modern agriculture in the middle of the 19th century and in the modern race of today while trying to define what the opportunities are and what the goals of the agricultural development of the XXI century. / Redakcija naučnog programa počinje sa emitovanjem nove serije pod nazivom Od Pluga do digitalne farme. Bavimo se razvojem poljoprivrede u modernoj Srbiji gde se od polovine XIX veka do današnjih dana smenjuju periodi procvata i stagnacije. Pojavljuju se sjajni pojedinci, naučnici i stvaraoci koji pomeraju granice uvodeći principe moderne poljoprivrede ali se vrlo brzo njihova naučna i privredna dostignuća urušavaju. Serija obuhvata period dva veka državnosti Srbije a tokom tog vremenena, kao u začaranoj spirali, krećemo uvek iz početka. Ista matrica prepoznaje se u vreme uspostavljanja moderne poljoprivrede sredinom XIX veka i u savremenoj trci današnjice dok pokušavamo da definišemo šta su mogućnosti a šta ciljevi razvoja poljoprivrede XXI veka.

Nikita je prošao dug put od angažovanog buntovnika devedesetih do reditelja koji u svojim delima razmatra univerzalne teme koje se tiču ljudskog postojanja. Značajan segment Milivojevićevog stvaralaštva predstavlja njegov grčki opus , u kojem odmah na početku jedna za drugom nastaje nekoliko izuzetnih ostvarenja.
