programme.title: Storm / Oluja
programme.desc: The story follows the ordinary man Ilija, whose only goal is to protect and preserve his family, the fireplace and the village he grew up with his friends who became comrades, whose life stories intertwine. In order to prevent further attacks on the village, where he almost lost his son Petar, Ilija forms a diversion unit, with the aim of destroying the hostile nest from where the village is attacked. In that battle for survival, our heroes of water and their personal battles, and their families are forced to leave their homes and seek salvation in an endless column that moves towards Matica, to Serbia. / Priča prati običnog čoveka Iliju, čiji je jedini cilj da zaštiti i sačuva svoju porodicu, ognjište i selo u kome je odrastao sa drugovima koji su mu silom prilika postali saborci, a čije se životne priče prepliću. U želji da spreči dalje napade na selo, gde je zamalo ostao bez sina Petra, Ilija formira diverzantsku jedinicu, sa ciljem da uništi neprijateljsko gnezdo odakle se napada selo. U toj bici za opstanak, naši junaci vode i svoje lične bitke, a njihove porodice bivaju primorane da napuste svoje domove i potraže spas u nepreglednoj koloni koja kreće ka matici, ka Srbiji.

programme.title: Bitter revenge / Gorka osveta
programme.desc: Pain memories, desire for revenge, passion and love await us in one of the most watched Portuguese telenovels in the last few years, which 2018 was also received by the prestigious EMI Award. George Monforte is a Brazilian entrepreneur and the owner of the Auro Verde agricultural empire. After gaining a significant share in the company led by a rich and powerful portuguese family led by Miguel Fereiro de Fonsko, George becomes a member of the Board of Directors. The novelty is not well accepted in the De Fonsec family because they justifiably doubt the actual intentions of this foreigner. Namely, George Monforte is a new identity of Marie, for whom they all thought he was dead. Ze Maria returns to take revenge on the death of his family. Joao Magalhesa, Father Ze Marie, fifteen years ago, was the financial director at the time of great financial fraud and capital abuse in the company of the Faxes family. Joao was used as a sacrificial Capricorn and the firm accuses him of fraud. Joao threatens that the public will be presented by all dirty laundry company, if the charges do not withdraw. He and his family are killed, and the whole situation was expelled to look like murder and suicide. By playing the case, the only survivor is George. When he wakes up from which, Ze Maria is confused and at first he does not remember the event. He will look for Miguel, to help him find a job. On the same day he meets a girl in love with, not knowing that she is Miguel daughter. Over time, his memory is returned, and Miguela secret is no longer safe. / Bolne uspomene, želja za osvetom, strast i ljubav očekuju nas u jednoj od najgledanijih portugalskih telenovela u poslednjih nekoliko godina, koja je 2018. godine dobila i prestižnu nagradu Emi. Žorž Monforte je brazilski preduzetnik i vlasnik poljoprivrednog carstva Ouro verde. Nakon što stekne značajan udeo u kompaniji koju vodi bogata i moćna portugalska porodica na čelu sa Miguelom Fereirom de Fonsekom, Žorž postaje član Upravnog odbora. Novost nije dobro prihvaćena u porodici De Fonseka jer opravdano sumnjaju u stvarne namere ovog stranca. Naime, Žorž Monforte je novi identitet Ze Marie, za koga su petnaest godina svi mislili da je mrtav. Ze Maria se vraća kako bi osvetio smrt svoje porodice. Žoao Magalhesa, otac Ze Marie, pre petnaest godina je bio finansijski direktor u vreme velike finansijske prevare i zloupotrebe kapitala u kompaniji porodice De Fonseka. Žoao je iskorišten kao žrtveni jarac i firma ga optužuje za prevaru. Žoao preti da će u javnost izneti sav prljavi veš kompanije, ukoliko se optužbe ne povuku. On i njegova porodica bivaju ubijeni, a cela situacija je izlažirana kako bi izgledala kao ubistvo i samoubistvo. Igrom slučaja, jedini preživeli je Žorž. Kada se probudi iz kome, Ze Maria je zbunjen i u početku se ne seća događaja. Potražiće Miguela, kako bi mu pomogao da pronađe posao. Istog dana upoznaje devojku u koju se zaljubljuje, ne znajući da je ona Miguelova kćerka. Vremenom mu se vraća sećanje, a Miguelova tajna više nije sigurna.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, he learns that he is an uncle on the edge of bankruptcy and that he was accused of lighting the van of the reputable department stores for a paradise for the ladies that he loses his job. The owner of the department store is PieTro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to hire and show that he is an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon acquires the trust of the colleagues. The girl in the end is madly falling in love with Roeiter Moria, but he must return to Sicilia because her father promised the mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva ... / Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, verenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, posle rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva devojka koja ubrzo stiče poverenje kolega. Devojka se na kraju ludo zaljubljuje u Pijetra Morija, ali mora da se vrati na Siciliju jer je njen otac obećao gradonačelniku Kastelbuonoa da će se Tereza udati za njegovog sina Salva...

programme.title: Right to tomorrow / Pravo na sutra
programme.desc: Property is not a matter of policy, but rights. At least it should be. But that the legal path is debt and curved tens of thousands of displaced people who cannot come to their possession in Kosovo and Metohija for years. The estates had to leave, and whoever prevents them from disposing of them, many of them testify in the new series of Radio-Television of Serbia, right to tomorrow. The Office for Kosovo and Metohija and Office of the Legal Teams of the Project free legal aid, which is implemented with the support of the European Union, are addressed in which interested citizens can seek help. In which cases, under what circumstances? How do these processes look like and what do the owners cover when they finally come to their property? Testimony, problems, hopes in justice and solutions, all in 6 emissions of series Right on tomorrow, realized in cooperation with the European Union project free legal aid and the Office for Kosovo and Metohija. / Imovina nije pitanje politike, već prava. Bar bi tako trebalo da bude. Ali da je taj pravni put dug i krivudav svedoče desetine hiljada raseljenih koji do svojih poseda na Kosovu i Metohiji ne mogu da dođu godinama. Imanja su morali da napuste, a ko ih i šta sprečava da ponovo njima raspolažu, mnogi od njih svedoče u novom serijalu Radio-televizije Srbije Pravo na sutra. Kancelarija za Kosovo i Metohiju i kancelarije pravnih timova projekta Besplatna pravna pomoć, koji se sprovodi uz podršku Evropske unije, adrese su na kojima zainteresovani građani mogu da potraže pomoć. U kojim slučajevima, pod kojim okolnostima? Kako ti procesi izgledaju i šta vlasnici zatiču kada konačno dođu do svoje imovine? programme.title: Bitter revenge / Gorka osveta
programme.desc: Pain memories, desire for revenge, passion and love await us in one of the most watched Portuguese telenovels in the last few years, which 2018 was also received by the prestigious EMI Award. George Monforte is a Brazilian entrepreneur and the owner of the Auro Verde agricultural empire. After gaining a significant share in the company led by a rich and powerful portuguese family led by Miguel Fereiro de Fonsko, George becomes a member of the Board of Directors. The novelty is not well accepted in the De Fonsec family because they justifiably doubt the actual intentions of this foreigner. Namely, George Monforte is a new identity of Marie, for whom they all thought he was dead. Ze Maria returns to take revenge on the death of his family. Joao Magalhesa, Father Ze Marie, fifteen years ago, was the financial director at the time of great financial fraud and capital abuse in the company of the Faxes family. Joao was used as a sacrificial Capricorn and the firm accuses him of fraud. Joao threatens that the public will be presented by all dirty laundry company, if the charges do not withdraw. He and his family are killed, and the whole situation was expelled to look like murder and suicide. By playing the case, the only survivor is George. When he wakes up from which, Ze Maria is confused and at first he does not remember the event. He will look for Miguel, to help him find a job. On the same day he meets a girl in love with, not knowing that she is Miguel daughter. Over time, his memory is returned, and Miguela secret is no longer safe. / Bolne uspomene, želja za osvetom, strast i ljubav očekuju nas u jednoj od najgledanijih portugalskih telenovela u poslednjih nekoliko godina, koja je 2018. godine dobila i prestižnu nagradu Emi. Žorž Monforte je brazilski preduzetnik i vlasnik poljoprivrednog carstva Ouro verde. Nakon što stekne značajan udeo u kompaniji koju vodi bogata i moćna portugalska porodica na čelu sa Miguelom Fereirom de Fonsekom, Žorž postaje član Upravnog odbora. Novost nije dobro prihvaćena u porodici De Fonseka jer opravdano sumnjaju u stvarne namere ovog stranca. Naime, Žorž Monforte je novi identitet Ze Marie, za koga su petnaest godina svi mislili da je mrtav. Ze Maria se vraća kako bi osvetio smrt svoje porodice. Žoao Magalhesa, otac Ze Marie, pre petnaest godina je bio finansijski direktor u vreme velike finansijske prevare i zloupotrebe kapitala u kompaniji porodice De Fonseka. Žoao je iskorišten kao žrtveni jarac i firma ga optužuje za prevaru. Žoao preti da će u javnost izneti sav prljavi veš kompanije, ukoliko se optužbe ne povuku. On i njegova porodica bivaju ubijeni, a cela situacija je izlažirana kako bi izgledala kao ubistvo i samoubistvo. Igrom slučaja, jedini preživeli je Žorž. Kada se probudi iz kome, Ze Maria je zbunjen i u početku se ne seća događaja. Potražiće Miguela, kako bi mu pomogao da pronađe posao. Istog dana upoznaje devojku u koju se zaljubljuje, ne znajući da je ona Miguelova kćerka. Vremenom mu se vraća sećanje, a Miguelova tajna više nije sigurna.

programme.title: Ten years with Haja Miazaki / Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem
programme.desc: The documentary for ten years with Haja Majazaki through four episodes is the chronicle of the creative process of the legendary director and the founder of even legendiary studies Gibli. Covering a period of work on the film on the cliff end of the 2008. The wind rises from 2013, the documentary shows Meisaki as a passionate artist, but also a father who is in a creative conflict with his son. If there are Japanese directions with which the Western world is well acquainted, it is probably a dead race between Kurosava and Mihazaki. But if we talk about animation, there is no takers. Midazaki was quiet, a modest man largest part of his career, and was only the last few decades among his fans (especially those who do not speak Japanese) became a clear relationship between Meusaki with Gibli. It is a great part of the merit of the student of the Acera, which received the permission to enter the Studio Gibli and record part of the atmosphere during work on Mijazaki's film. Arakava still does not know why Midazaki allowed that from a short documentary film, such, a completely exclusive series. Through four episodes of fifty minutes, we follow how the cult characters and plots are created from the imagination of a miraculous mind. There are also memories of Mother, Childhood, Mijazaki's relationship with his son, and then the devastating earthquake that shook Japan, followed by a nuceal disaster in Fukushima. The series ends with another Mijazaki triumph, but also the topics of aging and meaning to the creation of animated films in these turbulent times. / Dokumentarni film Deset godina sa Hajaom Mijazakijem kroz četiri epizode predstavlja hroniku kreativnog procesa legendarnog reditelja i osnivača još legendarnijeg Studija Gibli. Pokrivajući period od rada na filmu Ponjo na litici kraj mora iz 2008. godine do Vetar se diže iz 2013., dokumentarac prikazuje Mijazakija kao strastvenog umetnika, nepokolebljivog tragaoca, ali i oca koji je u kreativnom sukobu sa sinom. Ukoliko postoje japanski reditelji sa kojima je zapadni svet dobro upoznat, verovatno je mrtva trka izmedju Kurosave i Mijazakija. Ali ako govorimo o animaciji, takmaca nema. Mijazaki je bio tih, skroman čovek najvećim delom svoje karijere, a tek je poslednjih par decenija medju svojim obožavaocima (naročito onim koji ne govore japanski) postao jasan odnos Mijazakija sa Giblijem. Velikim delom to je zasluga studenta Kaku Arakave, koji je dobio dozvolu da dodje u Studio Gibli i snimi deo atmosfere tokom rada na Mijazakijevom filmu. Arakava i dalje ne zna zbog čega je Mijazaki dozvolio da od kratkog dokumentarnog filma nastane ovakav, sasvim ekskluzivan serijal. Kroz četiri epizode od pedeset minuta pratimo kako se iz mašte jednog čudesnog uma stvaraju kultni likovi i zapleti. Tu su i sećanja na majku, detinjstvo, Mijazakijev odnos sa sinom, a potom i razorni zemljotres koji je potresao Japan, praćen nukearnom katastrofom u Fukušimi. Serijal završava još jednim Mijazakijevim trijumfom, ali i temama starenja i smisla stvaranja animiranih filmova u ovim turbulentnim vremenima.

programme.title: A woman's paradise / Ženski raj
programme.desc: The main character is Teresa, a young woman who leaves Salva, a fiancée father chose her because the mayor's son, and from Sicily, goes to Milan. Teresa hopes to hire this in the Uncle's store there. But when he arrives in Milan, he learns that he is an uncle on the edge of bankruptcy and that he was accused of lighting the van of the reputable department stores for a paradise for the ladies that he loses his job. The owner of the department store is PieTro Mori, a young entrepreneur the mysterious past, who managed to open an elegant and modern department store after the trip, where Teresa applies for the saleswoman competition. After a number of peripetia, he manages to hire and show that he is an ambitious and entrepreneurish girl who soon acquires the trust of the colleagues. The girl in the end is madly falling in love with Roeiter Moria, but he must return to Sicilia because her father promised the mayor of Kastelbuono that Teresa would marry his son Salva ... / Glavni lik je Tereza, mlada žena koja ostavlja Salva, verenika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Tereza se nada da će se tu zaposliti u stričevoj prodavnici. Ali kad stigne u Milano, saznaje da joj je stric na ivici bankrota i da je optužen da je zapalio kombi ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pijetro Mori, mladi preduzetnik tajanstvene prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD, posle rata uspeo da otvori elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću, gde se Tereza prijavljuje na konkurs za prodavačicu. Nakon niza peripetija uspeva da se zaposli i pokaže da je ambiciozna i preduzimljiva devojka koja ubrzo stiče poverenje kolega. Devojka se na kraju ludo zaljubljuje u Pijetra Morija, ali mora da se vrati na Siciliju jer je njen otac obećao gradonačelniku Kastelbuonoa da će se Tereza udati za njegovog sina Salva...

programme.title: Me, we and others / Ja, mi i drugi
programme.desc: In series, I and others enter the skin of the famous film and theater heroes to understand ourselves and the world around us. programme.title: RTS Lab / RTS Lab
programme.desc: Welcome to the new episode RTS Lab, where we will explore how the digital world shapes our privacy and the influence that is popularity on everyday life. In the time when it is almost impossible to avoid social networks, the question arises: how much is it really private what we share online? How popularity affects our behavior and perceive of security? / Dobro došli u novu epizodu RTS LABA, gde ćemo istraživati kako digitalni svet oblikuje našu privatnost i uticaj koji popularnost ima na svakodnevni život. U vremenu kada je gotovo nemoguće izbeći društvene mreže, postavlja se pitanje: koliko je zaista privatno to što delimo online? Kako popularnost utiče na naše ponašanje i percepciju sigurnosti?

programme.title: Man and stone / Čovek i kamen
programme.desc: The stone is the most beautiful gift of nature. It has a given form and always feel nice when the stone is around us. / Kamen je najlepši dar prirode. Ima zadatu formu i uvek se lepo osećamo kada je kamen oko nas.

programme.title: Concert: Metamorphosis The Pillars / Koncert: Metamorfozis The Pillars
programme.desc: One of the most prominent and most active string chamber compositions today - the ensemble Metamorphosis, is led by the founding and art manager, Violist Sasha Mirković. / Jedan od najistaknutijih i najaktivnijih gudačkih kamernih sastava danas - ansambl Metamorfozis, predvođen je osnivačem i umetničkim rukovodiocem, violistom Sašom Mirkovićem.

programme.title: The bite of China / Zalogaj Kine
programme.desc: This documentary series in the most beautiful way represents Chinese food. Chinese food goes beyond culinary frames, giving another, new and quite comprehensive view of Chinese civilization. / Ovaj dokumentarni serijal na najlepši način predstavlja kinesku hranu. Kineska hrana nadilazi okvire kulinarstva, dajući još jedno, novo i prilično sveobuhvatno viđenje kineske civilizacije.

programme.title: Mom and Daddy play war / Mama i tata se igraju rata
programme.desc: Veljko played the main role - Inspector, in the series television. Comes to the cinema on the premiere of the first episode. He has a great tremphy and he can't look at himself on a big canvas. / Veljko je odigrao glavnu ulogu - inspektora, u televizijskoj krimi seriji. Dolazi u bioskop na premijeru prve epizode. Ima veliku tremu i ne može sebe da gleda na velikom platnu.

programme.title: Diary 2 in sign language / Dnevnik 2 na znakovnom jeziku
programme.desc: Follow the latest news that can accompany and people with hearing impairment follow the Dnevnik 2 in Serbian sign language. / Pratite najnovije vesti koje mogu da prate i osobe sa oštećenjem sluha, sledi Dnevnik 2 na srpskom znakovnom jeziku.

programme.title: Contemporary Serbian Drama (and her crisis) / Savremena srpska drama (I njena kriza)
programme.desc: Contemporary Serb drama has been in crisis in crisis for years. New dramatic texts are rarely performed, and even more orders have artistic significant stage interpretations that would take a respectable place in important domestic and foreign festivals. / Savremena srpska drama je već godinama u krizi produkcije. Novi dramski tekstovi se retko izvode, a još ređe imaju umetnički značajna scenska tumačenja koja bi zauzela ugledno mesto na važnim domaćim i inostranim festivalima.

programme.title: Creative District / Kreativni distrikt
programme.desc: The creative district is the title of the new 15 episode series in the production of the editorial office for the culture and art of RTS. The series intends to present our audience exceptional artists from our country who achieved great success in the world to their works. Each episode is dedicated to one of them, and the entire series represents the creative community of our artists connecting the life and creativity abroad. / Kreativni distrikt je naslov novog serijala od 15 epizoda u produkciji Redakcije za kulturu i umetnost RTS-a. Serijal ima nameru da našoj publici predstavi izuzetne umetnike poreklom iz naše zemlje koji su svojim delima postigli veliki uspeh u svetu. Svaka epizoda posvećena je jednom od njih, a čitav serijal predstavlja kreativnu zajednicu naših umetnika koje povezuje život i stvaralaštvo van zemlje.

programme.title: Studio 6 / Studio 6
programme.desc: Australian composer, Sound artist and electronic Lorens Inglish guest in the study of 6 Radio Belgrade and presented the European Prime Minister of his project Wilderness of Mirrors, as well as material from the Peregerin album. In addition to Lawrence, the Inligiš, at this evening, experimental improvised electronics, also performed Andrija Pavlović, Piano, and Aljoša Andrejević, percussion. / Australijski kompozitor, saund umetnik i elektroničar Lorens Ingliš gostovao je u Studiju 6 Radio Beograda i predstavio evropsku premijeru svog projekta Wilderness of Mirrors, kao i materijal sa albuma Peregerin. Pored Lorensa Ingliša, u ovoj večeri eksperimentalne improvizovane elektronike, nastupili su i Andrija Pavlović, klavir, i Aljoša Andrejević, udaraljke.

programme.title: Lubarda from Peter's side / Lubarda sa Petrove strane
programme.desc: On the occasion of Fifty years since the death of Petra Lubard, we remember the big artist whose eternal inspiration was Montenegro and who changed his artistic art in Yugoslavia in his paintings in Yugoslavia. / Povodom pedeset godina od smrti Petra Lubarde, prisećamo se velikog umetnika čija je večna inspiracija bila Crna Gora i koji je svojim slikarskim promišljanjima sredinom prošlog veka promenio tokove likovne umetnosti u Jugoslaviji.

programme.title: Milunka Savic - the heroin of the Great War / Milunka Savić - Heroina Velikog rata
programme.desc: The film is a biographical story of the most delicacies of the most delicacies among the women participating in the First World War, a woman who fought side by side with Serbian soldiers. / Film je biografska priča o dobitnici najviše odlikovanja među ženama učesnicama Prvog svetskog rata, o ženi koja se na frontu borila rame uz rame sa srpskim vojnicima.

programme.title: Life is a miracle / Život je čudo
programme.desc: TV series filmed in 2005. Based on the material of the same name. The action series takes place in Bosnia in 1992. years. / TV serija snimljena 2005. na osnovu materijala istoimenog filma. Radnja serije se odvija u Bosni 1992. godine.

programme.title: Group / Grupa
programme.desc: The Gaga Police Inspector comes to the hotel and his owner, Strahinje, trying to know more about why the Strahinje was the target of the sniper. His strahinity, however, does not help in that purpose. Vanja traveled from Belgrade to the village of Amajlija, located in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Boris followed him, a criminal that was hardly fell that his vanja ran away. Petrina Aunt is upset, because the revolver was discovered in the apartment, which Petra hid. / Policijski inspektor Gaga ponovo dolazi do hotela i od njegovog vlasnika, Strahinje, pokušava da sazna nešto više o tome zašto je Strahinja bio meta snajperiste. Strahinja mu, međutim, ne pomaže u toj nameri. Vanja je otputovao iz Beograda u selo Amajlije, koje se nalazi u Bosni i Hercegovini. Za njim je krenuo Boris, kriminalac kojem je teško palo to što mu je Vanja pobegao. Petrina tetka je uznemirena, jer je u stanu otkrila revolver koji je Petra skrivala.

programme.title: In a clinch / U klinču
programme.desc: Tea came to the holiday from Milan to Belgrade and, to the surprise of Aljoša and the rest of the team, appeared at the party of opening a renovated coffee tab. Tein sudden return brings chaos into Aljosin emotional life and after finally his connection with the spark became official. programme.title: In a clinch / U klinču
programme.desc: In the Hower Family, the government advice before large business changes awaiting Father Jovan, and the tain emotional life is in turning over the Aljošina connection with the Iskra. During that time, spark is persistent in the idea to find a job, and Aljoša comes in an unexpected idea of how to help her. And Filip is obsessed with ideas about improving his business, which drives up. And Milica's job in this episode is to take advantage of the last days of the Veljina and Mira's absence from the apartment in the best possible way. / U Teinoj porodici vlada napetost pred velike poslovne promene koje čekaju oca Jovana, a i Tein emotivni život je u previranju zbog Aljošine veze sa Iskrom. Za to vreme, Iskra je uporna u ideji da pronađe posao, a Aljoša dolazi na neočekivanu ideju kako da joj pomogne. I Filip je obuzet idejama o unapređenju svog biznisa što izluđuje Vanju. A, Milicin posao u ovoj epizodi je da iskoristi poslednje dane Veljinog i Mirinog odsustva iz stana na najbolji mogući način.

programme.title: Penalty area / Kazneni prostor
programme.desc: Frightened and worried men from one, and ambitious, successful and beautiful women on the other hand, it is the thematic backbone of the Humorist series box. The urban humor in the spirit of a small, makes this series very dynamic. / Uplašeni i zabrinuti muškarci s jedne, i ambiciozne, uspešne i lepe žene s druge strane, to je tematska okosnica humorističke serije Kazneni prostor. Urbani humor u duhu sitkoma, čini ovu seriju vrlo dinamičnom.

programme.title: Pinch / Žmurke
programme.desc: The batch of Žmurke presents an intimate, autobiographical and anti-war story from the childhood of Miša Radivojević and his friends in a small town in Serbia. Blocks are a series with children, but intended primarily to adults. The series talks about children in the war, but it is directed to what adults could learn from Hal view. In a series of six episodes, touching, exciting and tragic stories through visor children were told. All the cruelty of the world is shown through turbulence in the newly liberated small town, where children did not have the same treatment, although they were not responsible for the sins or success of parents. The topic of Žmurki is not typical only for the period processing the series, but it is also related to the destiny of the modern world in which there are hundreds of millions of children, what is happiness for them, what is justice or guilt. / Serija Žmurke predstavlja intimnu, autobiografsku i antiratnu priču iz detinjstva Miše Radivojevića i njegovih drugara u malom mestu u Srbiji. Žmurke su serija sa decom, ali namenjena pre svega odraslima. Serija govori o deci u ratu, ali je usmerena ka tome šta bi odrasli mogli da nauče iz njhovog pogleda. U seriji od šest epizoda ispričane su dirljive, uzbudljive i tragične priče kroz vizuru dece. Sva surovost sveta prikazana je kroz turbulencije u tek oslobođenom malom gradu, gde deca nisu imala isti tretman, iako nisu bila odgovorna za grehe ili uspehe roditelja. Tema Žmurki nije tipična samo za period koji obrađuje serija, već je ona vezana i za sudbinu dece savremenog sveta u kome živimo, gde desetine, stotine miliona ljudi u potrazi za srećom ne pitaju i ne osluškuju vlastitu decu, šta je za njih sreća, šta je za njih pravda ili krivda.

programme.title: Group / Grupa
programme.desc: Boris came to Stanislay's parents and seeks five thousand euros from them, which Stanislav allegedly owed him. His parents don't have so much money, so Stanislav's mother goes to the bank and brings money to Boris. Vanja goes to Peter. He asks her to take him to SLOMIC. Petra helped him and bring him to SLOMIC which is ready to listen to him. Vanja Sremici announced that he knows who killed her brother, Rade Sremac. / Boris je došao kod Stanislavljevih roditelja i od njih traži pet hiljada evra koje mu Stanislav navodno duguje. Njegovi roditelji nemaju toliko para, pa Stanislavljeva majka odlazi u banku i donosi novac Borisu. Vanja ode kod Petre. Traži od nje da ga odvede do Sremice. Petra mu pomogne i dovede ga do Sremice koja je spremna da ga sasluša. Vanja Sremici saopšti da zna ko je ubio njenog brata, Radeta Sremca.

programme.title: Jagodici / Jagodići
programme.desc: Jagodići is the 2012 television series, the sequel to the series all that plain. The action of the series is located in the thirties of the last century in the Banatsko Selo. The main characters are the father and his sons, who pass through turbulent ties. Count Milan Jagodić reveals the sons of a long hidden family secret. The one, who believed that a robber who hides was hiding in the Tavan Kaštela, is actually their close relative. The rim around him is clenched and the Milan Count is requested from all to help a fugitive in hiding and escaping. But that's not the only secret that was discovered. Inspector of the International Police, Oto Kunc is involved in everything. Another crime is happening. / Jagodići je televizijska serija iz 2012. godine, nastavak serije Sva ta ravnica. Radnja serije je smeštena u tridesete godine prošlog veka u banatskom selu. Glavni likovi su otac i njegovi sinovi, koji prolaze kroz turbulentne veze. Grof Milan Jagodić otkriva sinovima dugo skrivanu porodičnu tajnu. Onaj, za koga su verovali da je razbojnik koji se krije na tavanu Kaštela, zapravo je njihov blizak rođak. Obruč oko njega se steže i grof Milan zahteva od svih da pomognu beguncu u skrivanju i bekstvu. Ali to nije jedina tajna koja je otkrivena. U sve je umešan i inspektor međunarodne policije Oto Kunc. Dešava se još jedan zločin.

programme.title: TV Theater / TV Teatar
programme.desc: Hit of the play of the Star Teatra - General Probro suicide, according to the text and directed by the most important modern Serbian Comediographer, Dusan Kovacevic. The man tries to kill himself with a jump from the bridge. However, however, in the most notional ways, interferes with other characters, which produces a range of humorous situations and absurdities, with a witty, occasional fantasagoric, and occasionally almost a coordinary tone. / Hit predstava Zvezdara teatra - Generalna proba samoubistva, po tekstu i u režiji najznačajnijeg modernog srpskog komediografa, Dušana Kovačevića. Čovek pokušava da se ubije skokom sa mosta. To, međutim, na najbizarnije načine ometa druge likove, što proizvodi niz humornih situacija i apsurdnih obrta, uz duhovit, povremeno fantazmagoričan, a povremeno gotovo prizeman ton.

programme.title: Pinch / Žmurke
programme.desc: The batch of Žmurke presents an intimate, autobiographical and anti-war story from the childhood of Miša Radivojević and his friends in a small town in Serbia. Blocks are a series with children, but intended primarily to adults. The series talks about children in the war, but it is directed to what adults could learn from Hal view. In a series of six episodes, touching, exciting and tragic stories through visor children were told. All the cruelty of the world is shown through turbulence in the newly liberated small town, where children did not have the same treatment, although they were not responsible for the sins or success of parents. The topic of Žmurki is not typical only for the period processing the series, but it is also related to the destiny of the modern world in which there are hundreds of millions of children, what is happiness for them, what is justice or guilt. / Serija Žmurke predstavlja intimnu, autobiografsku i antiratnu priču iz detinjstva Miše Radivojevića i njegovih drugara u malom mestu u Srbiji. Žmurke su serija sa decom, ali namenjena pre svega odraslima. Serija govori o deci u ratu, ali je usmerena ka tome šta bi odrasli mogli da nauče iz njhovog pogleda. U seriji od šest epizoda ispričane su dirljive, uzbudljive i tragične priče kroz vizuru dece. Sva surovost sveta prikazana je kroz turbulencije u tek oslobođenom malom gradu, gde deca nisu imala isti tretman, iako nisu bila odgovorna za grehe ili uspehe roditelja. Tema Žmurki nije tipična samo za period koji obrađuje serija, već je ona vezana i za sudbinu dece savremenog sveta u kome živimo, gde desetine, stotine miliona ljudi u potrazi za srećom ne pitaju i ne osluškuju vlastitu decu, šta je za njih sreća, šta je za njih pravda ili krivda.

programme.title: Portrait of the Composer Aleksandra Vujić - Music language is communication / Portret kompozitora Aleksandra Vujića - Jezik muzike je komunikacija
programme.desc: Aleksandar Vujić graduated in composition (Klase Stanojla Rajičić, Breading (Class of Dusan Skaviran and Zdravina Zdravir (Class of the Faculty of Music in Belgrade. He was the founder, manager and conductor of the Chamber Orchestra Sinfonietta and Madrigal Hora FMU and conductor numerous ensembles: Đakon Avakum Baruh, Ph.D. The Choir of the FMU in Belgrade and the Diaspora. His compositional opus is part of chamber and chamber and symphony orchestra. His works They published publishers from the USA, Germany, Italy, Hungary and Serbia. / Aleksandar Vujić je diplomirao kompoziciju (klase Stanojla Rajičića, Petra Ozgijana i Vasilja Mokranjca), dirigovanje (klase Dušana Skovrana i Živojina Zdravkovića, i magistrirao klavir (klasa Olge Mihailović) na Fakultetu muzičke umetnosti u Beogradu. Bio je osnivač, rukovodilac i dirigent kamernog orkestra Sinfonietta i Madrigalskog hora FMU i dirigent brojnih ansambala: Đakon Avakum kamerni hor, Hor Braća Baruh, hor Iuventus cantat i dr. Redovni je profesor FMU u Beogradu, predsednik Saveza srpskih horova otadžbine i dijaspore. Njegov kompozitorski opus čine dela horske i kamerne muzike, kao i kompozicija za kamerni i simfonijski orkestar. Njegova dela su objavili izdavači iz SAD-a, Nemačke, Italije, Mađarske i Srbije.

Drugi deo koncerta obeležili su odlomci iz Liturgije domestika Aleksandra Grečaninova i premijerno izvođenje Narodnih pesama domaćeg kompozitora Vladimira Đorđevića.

programme.desc: Bogdan Dugalić is a pianist, born in Belgrade, where he attended the Musical School of Mokranjac. He won over 30 awards at domestic and international competitions, of which are the most important: 1. Award at the International Piano Competition of the Città di San Donà Di Piave, Italy, Maj Lind, Finland and Phone. Isidor Bajic, Serbia. The winner of the full scholarship at the Academy of Peros and the Foundation Scholarship is a good voice. / Bogdan Dugalić je pijanista, rođen u Beogradu gde je pohađao Muzičku školu Mokranjac. Osvojio je preko 30 nagrada na domaćim i međunarodnim takmičenjima, od kojih su najznačajnije: 1. nagrada na Međunarodnom pijanističkom takmičenju Arona, Italija, 1. nagrada na Međunarodnom pijanističkom takmičenju Città di San Donà di Piave, Italija, 2. nagrada kao i specijalna nagrada za kamernu muziku na Međunarodnom pijanističkom takmičenju Maj Lind, Finska i 2. nagrada i nagrada publike na 10. međunarodnom memorijalu Isidor Bajić, Srbija. Dobitnik je pune stipendije na Akademiji Perozi i stipendije fondacije Dobar Glas.

programme.title: I love the classic / Volim klasiku
programme.desc: Tango inspires authors, performers and dancers. It is the music of passion and love, and in the new edition of the show, I like the classic of Liberquatro Ensemble: Martina Dimic Radovanovic - Violin, Petar Mirkov - Bandoneon, Boban Stošić - Konvir and Ksenija Ristic - Piano. Vocal art in this show are two ladies: Željka Zdjelar - Mecosopran, she is a soloist of the National Theater in Belgrade and Dr. Dentistry, and Danijela Jovanović - soprano, brokerage of the Serbian National Theater and it brings the interpretation of Arija Silva from Kalman's Operate Kneginja Čardasha, with Piano cooperation of singers and pianists Strahinje Đokić. The contributions will be discussed by RTS Symphony Orchestra, Dinić's conductine baton, with a solist flutist, Silvia Kared, on the Anthology of Serbian Horska's award, and a small portrait of the young violinist Luka Fausi. / Tango inspiriše autore, izvođače i plesače. To je muzika strasti i ljubavi, a u novom izdanju emisije Volim klasiku tango muziku interpretira ansambl Liberquatro čiji su članovi: Martina Dimić Radovanović – violina, Aleksandar Mišović – vokal, Petar Mirkov – bandoneon, Boban Stošić – kontrabas i Ksenija Ristić – klavir. Vokalnu umetnost u ovoj emisiju predstavljaju dve dame: Željka Zdjelar – mecosopran, ona je solistkinja opere Narodnog pozorišta u Beogradu i doktor stomatologije, a u emisiji izvodi Il Vito Obradorsa i Danijela Jovanović – sopran, prvakinja Opere Srpskog Narodnog pozorišta i ona donosi interpretaciju arije Silve iz Kalmanove operete Kneginja Čardaša, uz klavirsku saradnju pevača i pijaniste Strahinje Đokića. U prilozima će biti reči o koncertu Simfonijskog orkestra RTS pod dirigentskom palicom maestra Srboljuba Dinića, sa solistkinjom flautistkinjom Silvijom Karedu, o Antologiji srpske horske muzike, o ovogodišnjoj Mokranjčevoj nagradi, a biće prikazan i mali portret mladog violiniste Luke Fausija.

programme.title: Nemanja Radulovic: Korena / Nemanja Radulović: Koreni
programme.desc: The emission dedicated to Nemanja Radulović and his album roots were filmed in October 2022. in Studio 6 Radio Belgrade. In addition to presenting selected compositions, Nemanja in the show talks about the process of the new album (Warner Classics). The tracks were selected during the first favoré, when the famous violinists with colleague Aleksandar Sedlar researched traditional music from different parts of the world and for her tied characteristic ways of playing violins. The album contains seventeen compositions, ie styling of traditional songs of several different peoples - from better known parts, through the melodies of European countries, to those from China, India and Japan. / Emisija posvećena Nemanji Raduloviću i njegovom albumu Koreni snimljena je u oktobru 2022. godine u Studiju 6 Radio Beograda. programme.title: Itamar Zorman I Liza Stepanova / Itamar Zorman i Liza Stepanova
programme.desc: The Violinist of Itam Zorman and the Pianist Lisa Stepanov held a concert 2. February 2015. in the Kolarac's endowment hall, within the cycle winners. They presented to the works of Franco Šubert, Moris Ravel and Johannes Brams. Itamar Zorman was born in 1985. in Tel Aviv, and graduated from the Academy of Music and Game in Jerusalem, Master Studies ended at Jury-2012. Years. He won the Trust Award - Buleto-Buitoni in 2014, as well as the Eigher Fešer Mispinese for 2013, as a soloist performed with the Israeli Philharmonic, the American Symphony Orchestra and the Tokyo Symphony Orchestra and the Chamber Orchestra of the Polish Radio. The pianist Lisa Stepanov was born in Minsk, and was educated in Berlin and Jergiarna. Its career moves from solo and chamber music to very successful pedagogical results. It is a member of the Lisander Piano Trio with whom he won numerous awards. Is dedicated to modern creativity. / Violinista Itamar Zorman i pijanistkinja Liza Stepanova održali su koncert 2. februara 2015. godine u dvorani Kolarčeve zadužbine, u okviru ciklusa Pobednici. Predstavili su se delima Franca Šuberta, Morisa Ravela i Johanesa Bramsa. Itamar Zorman je rođen 1985. godine u Tel Avivu, a diplomirao je na Akademiji za muziku i igru u Jerusalimu, master studije završio je na Džulijardu 2012. godine. Dobitnik je nagrade Trusta Borleti-Buitoni za 2014. godinu, kao i EJVERI Fišer stipendije za 2013. Kao solista nastupao je sa Izraelskom filharmonijom, Američkim simfonijskim orkestrom, Tokijskim simfonijskim orkestrom i Kamernim orkestrom Poljskog radija. Dela Rajka Maksimovića povezuju reči, od monumentalnih horskih i vokalno-instrumentalnih među kojima su Buna protiv dahija, Kad su živi zavideli mrtvima, Testamenat vladike crnogorskog Petra Petrovića Njegoša i Pasija Svetoga kneza Lazara do lirskih i prefinjenih Možda spava ili Tri haiku. Vocal art in this show are two ladies: Željka Zdjelar - Mecosopran, she is a soloist of the National Theater in Belgrade and Dr. Dentistry, and Danijela Jovanović - soprano, brokerage of the Serbian National Theater and it brings the interpretation of Arija Silva from Kalman's Operate Kneginja Čardasha, with Piano cooperation of singers and pianists Strahinje Đokić. The contributions will be discussed by RTS Symphony Orchestra, Dinić's conductine baton, with a solist flutist, Silvia Kared, on the Anthology of Serbian Horska's award, and a small portrait of the young violinist Luka Fausi. / Tango inspiriše autore, izvođače i plesače. programme.title: One hundred Serb trumpets / Sto srpskih truba
programme.desc: Orchestra composed of members of the best trumpet orchestras from the south and west of Serbia held a concert in April 2012. in the center of Sava. programme.desc: The emission from the series of place known, and time given to the customs and songs related to the grape harvest and the possession after harvest. He was filmed in the heart of Šumadija and Vineyards with Topola. They perform: Aleksandar Trandafilović, Kruna Janković, Andrija Bajić, Radiša Pavlićević, Kud Abrašević from Kragujevac and the National Orchestra RTB under the administration of Miodrag Jašarević. / Emisija iz serijala Mesta znana, a vremena davna prikazuje običaje i pesme vezane za berbu grožđa i poselo posle berbe. programme.title: To know to the mora to my / Da znaeš mori mome
programme.desc: If you know Mori is the name of the Music Poster Merime Njemomir in which the most beautiful songs of the southern Serbia: And what do you ask the mothers, Stojanke Bela Vranjanke, Maljunje Dejča Mori, MoLa Padnala, Doud Mori Moma and others. / Da znaeš mori mome je naziv muzičkog postera Merime Njegomir u kome peva najlepše pesme Južne Srbije: A što pitaš džanum majke, Stojanke bela Vranjanke, Blagunjo dejče mori, Magla padnala, Da znaeš mori mome i druge.

programme.title: Royal frule / Kraljevi frule
programme.desc: Concert called the King's Frule, held on 23. May 2019, the Kombank Hall, gathered three famous musicians from the Balkans: Bora Dugića (Frule), the Teodosija Spasova (Kaval) and Madalina Luka. / Koncert pod nazivom Kraljevi frule, održan 23. maja 2019. godine u Kombank dvorani, okupio je trojicu slavnih muzičara sa Balkana: Boru Dugića (frula), Teodosija Spasova (kaval) i Madalina Luku (panova frula).

programme.title: One song, one wish / Jedna pesma, jedna želja
programme.desc: Collage of songs from the popular series of folk music One song, one wish. The famous singers of the National Music and the National Orchestra of RTS under the administration of Ljubiša Pavković are participating. / Kolaž pesama iz popularnog serijala narodne muzike Jedna pesma, jedna želja. Učestvuju poznati pevači narodne muzike i Narodni orkestar RTS pod upravom Ljubiše Pavkovića.

programme.title: Concert of Snezana Đurišić, Collage / Koncert Snežane Đurišić, kolaž
programme.desc: Part of the concert of the solo concert of Snežana Đurišić held in the Sava Center 17. April 2019 years. Snezana was accompanied by Aleksandar Sofronijevic's orchestra, and her guests were Ana Bekuta and Dejan Petrovic's brass. With this concert, Snezana marked the 50 years of careers. / Deo koncerta solističkog koncerta Snežane Đurišić održanog u Sava centru 17. aprila 2019. godine. Snežanu je pratio orkestar Aleksandra Sofronijevića, a njeni gosti bili su Ana Bekuta i Duvački orkestar Dejana Petrovića. Ovim koncertom Snežana je obeležila 50 godina karijere.

programme.title: Gold plates / Zlatne ploče
programme.desc: The show resembles the great hits of the famous singer of folk music, which abounds in our archive. The selected recordings from popular emissions and New Year's programs will return you in the golden television, but also composed folk music. / Emisija podseća na velike hitove poznatih pevača narodne muzike, kojima obiluje naša arhiva. Odabrani snimci iz popularnih emisija i novogodišnjih programa vratiće vas u zlatno vreme televizije, ali i komponovane narodne muzike.

programme.title: Raspevana Subota / Raspevana subota
programme.desc: The musical issue of the crucified Saturday is dedicated to the cultural heritage of Serbia - old folk songs and dances. / Muzička emisija Raspevana subota posvećena je kulturnom nasleđu Srbije - starim narodnim pesmama i plesovima.

programme.title: Nis autumn 95 / Niška jesen 95
programme.desc: Due to the Festival Nišen Jesen 1995. year, the second evenings were guested by legendary singers who celebrated city songs. / U oviru festivala Niška jesen 1995. godine, druge večeri gostovale su legendarni pevači koji su proslavili gradske pesme.

programme.title: Under the star deck / Pod zvezdanim krovom
programme.desc: Gala concert by which the delegation of the European Union in Serbia marked Europe Day. On that occasion, the Big Bend Rts and their guests: Zoe Kida, Bojana Stamenov, Marko Luis and Vasil Hadžimanov. The repertoire at the concert included a wide range of musical genres, from classical music, through jazz, pop-deadline, all the way to folk music are especially arranged for jazz orchestra. The Big band RTS was conducted by Vladimir Krnetić. / Gala koncert kojim je Delegacija Evropske unije u Srbiji obeležila Dan Evrope. Tom prilikom nastupili su Big bend RTS i njihovi gosti: Zoe Kida, Bojana Stamenov, Marko Luis i Vasil Hadžimanov. Repertoar na koncertu obuhvatio je širok dijapazon muzičkih žanrova, od klasične muzike, preko džeza, pop-roka, sve do narodne muzike posebno aranžirane za džez orkestar. Big bendom RTS je dirigovao Vladimir Krnetić.

programme.title: RTS music presents / RTS Muzika predstavlja
programme.desc: We present you promising domestic bands and their tracks that threaten to become popular across Europe, and too. / Predstavljamo vam perspektivne domaće bendove i njihove numere koje prete da postanu popularne širom Evrope, a i šire.

programme.title: The most sought after / Najtraženiji
programme.desc: Among the most sought after musical topics in our area are the Colon Vuntrišević tracks, bands Artan Lili, Violet, King Čačak, Dubioza Kolektiv, KKN, Sars, 2 Cellos and others. / Među najtraženijim muzičkim temama na našim prostorima nalaze se numere Bojane Vunturišević, bendova Artan Lili, Ljubičice, Kralj Čačka, Dubioza Kolektiv, KKN, Sars, 2 cellos i drugih.

programme.title: Vlatko Stefanovski - 50 years with you / Vlatko Stefanovski - 50 godina sa vama
programme.desc: Vlatko Stefanovski marked the 50 years of career concert in the Sava Center. His guests were reputable musicians, his friends and colleagues. Five decades of Career of the Vlatko Stefanovsky was marked by the repertoire that is the cross-section of his opus. In the evening, the emotions filled with all the most important points of the work of Stefanovski, from the Group's period of Leb and Salt to the Solo career. Almost 40 recorded albums, legendary music themes forgotten, Šmeker, Harvest, need three and others, only part of the rich career, in our area, as well as the boy's fascination guitar, present and after five decades of music. / Vlatko Stefanovski obeležio je 50 godina karijere koncertom u Sava centru. Gosti su mu bili ugledni muzičari, njegovi prijatelji i kolege. Pet decenija karijere Vlatka Stefanovskog obeleženo je repertoarom koji je presek njegovog opusa. U veče ispunjeno emocijama stale su sve najvažnije tačke rada Stefanovskog, od perioda grupe Leb i sol do solo karijere. Skoro 40 snimljenih albuma, legendarne muzičke teme za filmove Zaboravljeni, Šmeker, Nebeska udica, Ciganska magija, Za sreću je potrebno troje i druge, samo je deo bogate karijere jednog od najvećih gitarista na našim prostorima, kod koga su kondicija, strast, posvećenost, kao i dečačka fascinacija gitarom, prisutne i posle pet decenija bavljenja muzikom.

programme.title: Musical time machine / Muzički vremeplov
programme.desc: Among the highest hits preserved in the program archives of Belgrade include songs that perform: TBF, Batabatibi, colored program, lolobriyder, cold beer and Josipa Lisac, Darko Rundek, Renaissance, 2Cellos, Naked and others. / Među najveće hitove sačuvane u Programskom arhivu Televizije Beograd spadaju numere koje izvode: TBF, Bitipatibi, Obojeni program, Lolobriđida, Hladno pivo i Josipa Lisac, Darko Rundek, Renesans, 2Cellos, Naked i drugi.

programme.title: Kolja, concert from Kombank halls / Kolja, koncert iz Kombank dvorane
programme.desc: Guitarist, singer, composer, screenwriter and director Nikola Pejaković Kolja played and sang in November 2018. almost two hours to the audience in the full hall of Kombank hall. At the end of the concert, he was accompanied by thunderous ovation and scaling. The Kolja used the concert to present his fans and his author's four-fingered album. The band played perfectly through the blues, deadline and related genres that are characteristic of the music. / Gitarista, pevač, kompozitor, scenarista i reditelj Nikola Pejaković Kolja svirao je i pevao u novembru 2018. godine skoro dva sata publici u punoj sali Kombank dvorane. Na kraju koncerta ispraćen je gromoglasnim ovacijama i skandiranjem. Kolja je iskoristio koncert da svojim obožavaocima predstavi i autorski album 4 prsta. Bend je svirački savršeno plovio kroz bluz, rok i srodne žanrove koji su karakteristični za Koljinu muziku.

programme.title: From the PGP archive / Iz PGP arhive
programme.desc: Just for nostalgic - music that will bring you back to the past, and while some will awaken memories, others will have the opportunity to learn something about that time through music. / Samo za nostalgičare - muzika koja će vas vratiti u prošlost, i dok će jednima probuditi uspomene, drugi će imati priliku da kroz muziku saznaju nešto o tom vremenu.

programme.title: RTS music presents / RTS Muzika predstavlja
programme.desc: We present you promising domestic bands and their tracks that threaten to become popular across Europe, and too. / Predstavljamo vam perspektivne domaće bendove i njihove numere koje prete da postanu popularne širom Evrope, a i šire.

programme.title: Rock / Rokumenti
programme.desc: Series Rokumenti was done in 1995. and processed large authors, texts, composers, groups marked by the development of the rock music in this area. In today's episodes, we learn what the art of Pesnik Duško Trifunović was, whose unforgettable texts have marked the development of the development of music in this area. / Serija Rokumenti rađena je 1995. godine i obrađivala je velike autore, tekstopisce, kompozitore, grupe koje su obeležile razvoj rok muzike na ovim prostorima. U današnjoj epizodi saznajemo kakav je bio umetnički put pesnika Duška Trifunovića, čiji su nezaboravni tekstovi obeležili razvoj rok muzike na ovim prostorima.

programme.title: Eco perspectives / Eko perspektive
programme.desc: The main heroine show with science through life is a young scientist, a geophysician Dr. Anna Mladenović, who combined several scientific disciplines: geology, speleology and seismology. This exceptional woman is a real visionary who spreads the views, realizes new discoveries and knows how to decipher what the land from his womb tells us. Commitment to scientific work and research requires a lot of knowledge, exceptional commitment, mind and ambition to embody the greatest challenges. It is all woven into the character and work of the doctor of science Ana Mladenović from the Faculty of Mining and Geology, University of Belgrade. Ana's love for geology started in an early age in a five, when listening to a student decided that the tectonics of the plate, just what he wanted to explore. With Dr. Mladenovic, we discussed the earthquakes, which is specific to the territory of Serbia, why it is important to know how to react when threatening danger. Ana revealed to us in what way in exploring pits and caves studied earthquakes. We learned what projects are currently working and how dynamic and exciting life with science and science is. / Glavna junakinja emisije Naukom kroz život je mlada naučnica, geofizičar dr Ana Mladenović koja je u svom radu objedinila nekoliko naučnih disciplina: geologiju, speleologiju i seizmologiju. Ova izuzetna žena je prava vizionarka koja širi vidike, spoznaje nova otkrića i ume da dešifruje šta nam zemlja iz svoje utrobe poručuje. Posvećenost naučnom radu i istraživanju zahteva mnogo znanja, izuzetnu posvećenost, um i ambiciju da se upustiš u najveće izazove. Sve je to utkano u lik i delo doktora nauka Ane Mladenović sa Rudarsko-geološkog fakulteta Univerziteta u Beogradu. Anina ljubav prema geologiji počela je još u ranoj mladosti u Petnici, kada je slušajući jednu studentkinju odlučila da je tektonika ploča, baš ono što želi da istražuje. Sa dr Mladenović smo razgovarali o tome kako nastaju zemljotresi, šta je specifično za teritoriju Srbije, zašto je važno da znamo kako da reagujemo kada zapreti opasnost. Ana nam je otkrila na koji način istražujući jame i pećine proučava zemljotrese. Saznali smo na kojim projektima trenutno radi i koliko je dinamičan i uzbudljiv život sa naukom i za nauku.

programme.title: Na skriveno te vodim mesto / Na skriveno te vodim mesto
programme.desc: In this episode of the show on the hidden and I go to Kopaonik. Kopaonik is the largest mountain massif in Serbia, with an altitude of 2017 meters. It spreads from northwest to the southeast, about 75 kilometers in length. This is of course the most popular, but also the most expensive tourist center of our country. But we will not talk about the commercial side of Kopaonik, the people who know the hidden places of this beautiful mountain, people living in accordance with nature, are kept and respected and respected, and dealing with extreme sports. / U ovoj epizodi emisije Na skriveno te vodim mesto idemo na Kopaonik. Kopaonik je najveći planinski masiv u Srbiji, sa nadmorskom visinom od 2017 metara. Prostire se od severozapada ka jugoistoku, dužinom od oko 75 kilometara. To je naravno i najpopularniji, ali i najskuplji turistički centar naše zemlje. No mi nećemo govoriti o komercijalnoj strani Kopaonika, već će o njemu govoriti ljudi koji poznaju skrivena mesta ove prelepe planine, ljudi koji žive u skladu sa prirodom, čuvaju je i poštuju, a bave se ekstremnim sportovima.

programme.title: History in Nauk / Istorija nauke
programme.desc: Milutin Milanković (1879-1958) The scientist who solved the secret of the ice age and founded modern climatology. He enabled the mathematical reconstruction of the climatic past and proved the crucial influence of the sun on earthly developments. Professor of heavenly mechanics and theoretical physics, he suggested the reform of the calendar and was a tireless traveler through the universe and centuries. / Milutin Milanković (1879-1958) naučnik koji je rešio tajnu ledenog doba i utemeljio savremenu klimatologiju. On je omogućio matematičku rekonstrukciju klimatske prošlosti i dokazao presudni uticaj Sunca na zemaljska dešavanja. Profesor nebeske mehanike i teorijske fizike, predložio je reformu kalendara i bio neumorni putnik kroz vasionu i vekove.

programme.title: From pigment to concept / Od pigmenta do koncepta
programme.desc: Painting techniques have countless - from fingers to brushes, thick pigments and airy watery nanos. Beautiful images arise in all these ways. Painting Technology Temper is as old as the painters. Medieval relaying painting is almost entirely characterized by color speaking and surface gloss thanks to the precinctive temperature methods. Pictures of Đota, Botičeli and many others, are characterized by exceptional freshness, almost incomprehensible in the context of the time distance. However, as tempera is dry technique without shine, painters have been ancient times, at the end of the work, paintings coated with a thin layer of oil. As a need to overcome the limit that has tempera, in the 15th. The new painting technique gave, primarily Jan Van Ajk, and Antonelo to transferred this way of painting to Italy, in which she developed more slowly than in Northern Europe. / Slikarskih tehnika ima bezbroj - od prstiju do četkica, gustih pigmenata i prozračnih vodenastih nanosa. Na sve te načine nastaju predivne slike. Slikanje tehnikom tempere staro je koliko i slikarsvo. Srednjovekovno štafelajno slikarstvo se skoro u celini odlikuje zvučnošću boja i površinskim sjajem zahvaljujući upravo specifičnim metodama rada u temperi. Slike Đota, Botičelija i mnogih drugih, karakteriše izuzetna svežina, skoro neshvatljiva u kontekstu vremenske distance. Međutim, pošto je tempera suva tehnika bez sjaja, slikari su još od davnina, po završetku rada, slike premazivali tankim slojem ulja. Kao potreba za prevazilaženjem ograničenja koje ima tempera, u 15. veku nastala je nova slikarska tehnika kojoj je nove impulse dao, pre svega Jan van Ajk, a Antonelo da Mesina je ovaj način slikanja preneo u Italiju, u kojoj se ona sporije razvijala nego u severnoj Evropi.

programme.title: Bosk's stories / Boškove priče
programme.desc: Boško Mandić, Poet, writer, actor, garden, friend of nature and the founder of the Bistrih stream, has lived in his small world on the slopes of the mountain mine. They meet with winds and mice, with sources and stones, with paths and trees and from each encounter occurs for some interesting stories. Ten such stories next days, Boško will tell its young guests Iva and Srecka and all young viewers of RTS. The screenwriter and the chief actor series is Božidar Mandić, and with him Iva Miletić, Srećko Jeremic and Zoran Miletić - Šilja as the musically scarecrow Dobrić. / Boško Mandić, pesnik, pisac, glumac, baštovan, prijatelj prirode i osnivač Porodice Bistrih Potoka, već preko trideset godina živi u svom malom svetu na padinama planine Rudnik. Tu se sreće sa vetrovima i miševima, sa izvorima i kamenjem, sa puteljcima i drvećem i iz svakog tog susreta nastaje po neka zanimljiva priča. Deset takvih priča sledećih dana Boško će ispričati svojim mladim gostima Ivi i Srećku i svim mladim gledaocima RTS-a. Scenarista i glavni glumac serije je Božidar Mandić, a uz njega igraju Iva Miletić, Srećko Jeremić i Zoran Miletić - Šilja kao muzikalno strašilo Dobrić.

programme.title: Anja / Anja
programme.desc: Anja is at first glance, ordinary girl, curious, curious that the twelve-year-olds can be. When her dad, she finds her that he bought a maternal ring, Anja has no peace. The ring is attracted and can't calm down until he loses him. And the day of the anniversary when Dad needs to hand over the ring to Mom approaches. Kad joj njen tata, otkrije da je kupio prsten za majku, Anja nema mira. Prsten je privlači i ne može da se smiri dok ga ne izgubi. A dan godišnjice kad tata treba da preda prsten mami se približava. Anja je igrana drama rađena za razmenu sa evropskim javnim servisima i uz super viziju čelnika evropske televizijske produkcije i do sada je emitovana u deset zemalja.

programme.title: The torment of one lion / Muke jednog Lava
programme.desc: The new feature series of editorials of the school program of a single lion is intended for primary school age. The main characters are a boy's lion and his timeless, none chosen and a friend of the dragonfly used to move into his computer. Starting from everyday problems that torment of a teenager, and who at that moment represent an insurmountable obstacle, in every episode, through three unusual examples from history, Leo finds out how people used to live. Through the array, the wolf draws a lion into his world and leads him to adventure of knowing. In that world, the wolf has a omniscient book-cinema, a portal through which they enter second time and guests walking through the Vukin room and illustrate her story. / Nova igrana serija Redakcije školskog programa Muke jednog Lava namenjena je osnovnoškolskom uzrastu. Glavni likovi su dečak Lav i njegova vanvremenska, ničim izabrana i ničim izazvana drugarica Vuka koja se uselila u njegov kompjuter. Polazeći od svakodnevnih problema koji muče jednog tinejdžera, i koji u tom trenutku za njega predstavljaju nepremostivu prepreku, u svakoj epizodi, kroz tri neobična primera iz istorije, Lav saznaje kako su nekada ljudi živeli. Kroz niz zavrzlama, Vuka uvlači Lava u svoj svet i vodi ga u avanturu saznavanja. U tom svetu, Vuka ima na raspolaganju sveznajuću knjigu-bioskop, portal kroz koji ulaze u drugo vreme i goste iz prošlosti koji se šetaju kroz Vukinu sobu i ilustruju njenu priču.

programme.title: Strumf / Štrumfovi
programme.desc: This large, characterized different colored family led by a large smush that knows how to make various magical drinks and throws. He is a company to make a smurfeth and everyone famous and his favorite Mrgud, Kefalo, Gruber, Luftica and others. The smurfs live mostly quiet, idyllic life. This happiness spoils only an evil wizard Gargamel with his assistant, cat Azrael. / Ovu veliku, karakterno različito obojenu porodicu predvodi Veliki Štrumpf koji zna da napravi razne čarobne napitke i baca čini. Društvo mu prave Štrumpfeta i svima poznati i omiljeni Mrgud, Kefalo, Gruber, Luftika i ostali. Štrumpfovi žive uglavnom mirnim, idiličnim životom. Ovu sreću kvari jedino zli čarobnjak Gargamel sa svojim pomoćnikom, mačkom Azraelom.

programme.title: Interested in child / Zanimanje dete
programme.desc: Documentary series Occupation - child of the children's program, deals with children in that most convenient sense. It was recorded over forty episodes in four cycles and each represents a portrait of a child. The basic idea of the series was to make the youngest thinking and the need to use the likes of the youngest time to deal with various creative activities. From the idea that the free time can be helpful with various contents, reached the authentic sociological study that they could give professionals dealing with this issue. The actors of this series are children from 8 to 12 years, divided by cycles. The satisfaction of the screenwriter and editors of Ljiljana Stojković, Optional Chat with these small, major people has grown into mutual trust that results in the world in which they live, grow, are formed. They shared their cosmos with a huge trust with a TV team, providing selfless positive energy, which is a special quality of this series. About acting, sports, music, ballet, and about very serious life issues about how parents may affect their children, about justice, injustices, about the other serious issues: Milica, Rastko, Marta, Todor, Matthew, Angel and others. / Dokumentarna serija Zanimanje - dete dečjeg programa, bavi se decom u onom najbukvalnijem smislu. Snimljeno je preko četrdeset epizoda u četiri ciklusa i svaka predstavlja portret jednog deteta. Osnovna ideja serije bila je da na što pitkiji način pokrene najmlađe na razmišljanje i potrebu da se slobodno vreme iskoristi za bavljenje raznim kreativnim aktivnostima. Od ideje da se slobodno vreme može korisno ispuniti raznim sadržajima, stiglo se do autentične sociološke studije o kojoj bi svoje mišljenje mogli da daju stručnjaci koji se bave ovom problematikom. Akteri ovog serijala su deca od 8 do 12 godina, podeljeni po ciklusima. Na zadovoljstvo scenariste i urednika Ljiljane Stojković, neobavezno ćaskanje sa ovim malim, velikim ljudima preraslo je u uzajamno poverenje koje za rezultat ima autentična razmišljanja o svetu u kome žive, odrastaju, formiraju se. Svoj kosmos su sa ogromnim poverenjem podelili sa TV ekipom, pružajući nesebično pozitivnu energiju što predstavlja poseban kvalitet ove serije. O bavljenju glumom, sportom, muzikom, baletom, i o veoma ozbiljnim životnim pitanjima o tome koliko roditelji smeju da utiču na izbor svoje dece, o pravdi, nepravdi, o tome čemu služe kazne i drugim ozbiljnim pitanjima govore: Milica, Rastko, Marta, Todor, Marija, Stefan, Ana, Matej, Anđela i drugi.

programme.title: Between play and mathematics / Između igre i matematike
programme.desc: The semi-grade series between the game and mathematics deals with the treatment of basic concepts in mathematics adapted to the youngest age of primary school. The series aims to get to know the youngest through play and entertainment with basic concepts in mathematics. This age requires the greatest attention, because of their preparation, it depends on the work and understanding of teaching from this case. My idea involves a more interesting and more relaxed approach and children and topics. The work includes a group of children and two animators-clown. They encourage children to discuss children with their interesting story and thus get the necessary explanations and responses related to these terms. By applying the appropriate graphics and animation all this is even clearer and more complete. / Poluigrana serija Između igre i matematike bavi se obradom osnovnih pojmova iz matematike prilagođenih najmlađem uzrastu osnovne škole. Serija ima za cilj da se najmlađi kroz igru i zabavu upoznaju sa osnovnim pojmovima iz matematike. Ovaj uzrast zahteva najveću pažnju, jer od njihove pripremljenosti zavisi kasnije uključivanje u rad i razumevanje nastave iz ovog predmeta. Moja ideja podrazumeva jedan zanimljiviji i opušteniji pristup i deci i temama. U rad je uključena grupa dece i dva animatora-klovna. Oni svojom interesantnom pričom podstiču decu na razgovor i na taj način dobijamo potrebna objašnjenja i odgovore vezane za ove pojmove. Primenom odgovarajuće grafike i animacije sve ovo je još jasnije i potpunije.

programme.title: Language doubts / Jezičke nedoumice
programme.desc: The first episode shows that we are often surrounded on the street by language errors that entries confusion. / Prva epizoda pokazuje da smo i na ulici često okruženi jezičkim greškama koje unose zabunu.

programme.title: Hemis for everyone / Hemija za sve
programme.desc: If you heard (and believe it) that something is good just because it comes from nature, that it is very good for your health to eat only raw foods, don't take milk, but you take a zeolite or petroleum or pure lemon's heart juice, think once more. Such statements, from which only a few clicks on internet browsers are shared, science did not confirm. There are dangerous among them. Misconceptions are made to take tribute to health, interpersonal relationships, money. We exacerbate some of them with the help of Dr. Zoran Vujčić, Professor Faculty of Chemistry in Belgrade, and Spaso and Stanoja Chemic, large fans of the truth and the Internet. / Ako ste čuli (i poverovali) da je nešto dobro samo zato što dolazi iz prirode, da je jako dobro za vaše zdravlje da jedete samo sirovu hranu, ne pijete mleko ali da uzimate zeolit ili petrolej ili čist limunov sok našte srca, razmislite još jednom. Ovakve tvrdnje, od kojih nas deli samo par klikova na internet pretraživačima, nauka nije potvrdila. Među njima ima i opasnih. Zablude umeju da uzmu danak- u zdravlju, međuljudskim odnosima, novcu. Neke od njih raskrinkavamo uz pomoć dr Zorana Vujčića, profesora Hemijskog fakulteta u Beogradu, i Spasoja i Stanoja Hemića, velikih obožavaoca istine i interneta.

programme.title: Literary blocks / Književno blokče
programme.desc: In a somewhat to the in-touch family, which consists of grandmother, the grandchildren of Nadj and Vuk and Nadjina is constantly present else Miloš, will show that literary terms are not only related to school and classes. In a witty, interesting way, through various situations and relationships of family members, fantasy, irony, is the familiarity of the youngest member, a wolf, which with ease of communication and various situations, in the course of the metaphor, the anecdotes, metonymia, during consciousness and various other terms from literary terminology. A series of literary blocks has ten episodes of ten minutes each, and each episode deals with one term. In the first episode, he explains in an interesting way what the epithet is. / U jednoj pomalo netipičnoj porodici, koju čine baka, unuci Nađa i Vuk i Nađin stalno prisutni drug Miloš, pokazaće se da književni pojmovi nisu vezani samo za školu i časove. Na duhovit, zanimljiv način, kroz razne situacije i odnose članova porodice, objašnjeni su termini poput epiteta, fantastike, ironije, groteske... Nesvesna koliko su ti pojmovi prisutni u njenom svakodnevnom životu, porodica ima jednu prednost - najmlađeg člana, Vuka, koji sa lakoćom uočava da su svakodnevna komunikacija i razne situacije preplavljeni metaforama, anegdotama, metonimijom, tokom svesti i raznim drugim pojmovima iz književne terminologije. Serija Književno blokče ima deset epizoda od po deset minuta, a svaka epizoda bavi se jednim pojmom. U prvoj epizodi se na zanimljiv način objašnjava šta je to epitet.

programme.title: Ask nature / Pitajte prirodu
programme.desc: In the series, ask nature, we observe the forms and behaviors of animals and discover how these models can be applied to solve problems in architecture, medicine, traffic, robotics and bioengineering. / U serijalu Pitajte prirodu posmatramo oblike i ponašanja životinja i otkrivamo kako se ti modeli mogu primeniti za rešavanje problema u arhitekturi, medicini, saobraćaju, robotici i bioinžinjeringu.

programme.title: Serbian music through centuries / Srpska muzika kroz vekove
programme.desc: In series Serbian music through centuries, the viewers can see the history of Serbian music under various circumstances, the penetration of Christianity, the Panzsan Romantic, the first decades of the 20th century when final Serbian music becomes part of the global mainstream. / U seriji Srpska muzika kroz vekove gledaoci mogu sagledati istoriju srpske muzike kao niz kulturnih pojava pod različitim okolnostima, još od vremena paganstva, prodora hrišćanstva, feudalnog doba, vizantijskih uticaja, turskog ropstva, muzike u Miloševoj kneževini, panslovenskog romantizma pa sve do prvih decenija XX veka kad konačno srpska muzika postaje deo globalnog mainstream-a.

programme.title: Hemis for everyone / Hemija za sve
programme.desc: If you heard (and believe it) that something is good just because it comes from nature, that it is very good for your health to eat only raw foods, don't take milk, but you take a zeolite or petroleum or pure lemon's heart juice, think once more. Neke od njih raskrinkavamo uz pomoć dr Zorana Vujčića, profesora Hemijskog fakulteta u Beogradu, i Spasoja i Stanoja Hemića, velikih obožavaoca istine i interneta.

programme.title: Strumf / Štrumfovi
programme.desc: This large, characterized different colored family led by a large smush that knows how to make various magical drinks and throws. He is a company to make a smurfeth and everyone famous and his favorite Mrgud, Kefalo, Gruber, Luftica and others. The smurfs live mostly quiet, idyllic life. This happiness spoils only an evil wizard Gargamel with his assistant, cat Azrael. / Ovu veliku, karakterno različito obojenu porodicu predvodi Veliki Štrumpf koji zna da napravi razne čarobne napitke i baca čini. Društvo mu prave Štrumpfeta i svima poznati i omiljeni Mrgud, Kefalo, Gruber, Luftika i ostali. Štrumpfovi žive uglavnom mirnim, idiličnim životom. Ovu sreću kvari jedino zli čarobnjak Gargamel sa svojim pomoćnikom, mačkom Azraelom.

programme.title: Interested in child / Zanimanje dete
programme.desc: Documentary series Occupation - child of the children's program, deals with children in that most convenient sense. It was recorded over forty episodes in four cycles and each represents a portrait of a child. The basic idea of the series was to make the youngest thinking and the need to use the likes of the youngest time to deal with various creative activities. From the idea that the free time can be helpful with various contents, reached the authentic sociological study that they could give professionals dealing with this issue. The actors of this series are children from 8 to 12 years, divided by cycles. The satisfaction of the screenwriter and editors of Ljiljana Stojković, Optional Chat with these small, major people has grown into mutual trust that results in the world in which they live, grow, are formed. They shared their cosmos with a huge trust with a TV team, providing selfless positive energy, which is a special quality of this series. About acting, sports, music, ballet, and about very serious life issues about how parents may affect their children, about justice, injustices, about the other serious issues: Milica, Rastko, Marta, Todor, Matthew, Angel and others. / Dokumentarna serija Zanimanje - dete dečjeg programa, bavi se decom u onom najbukvalnijem smislu. Snimljeno je preko četrdeset epizoda u četiri ciklusa i svaka predstavlja portret jednog deteta. Osnovna ideja serije bila je da na što pitkiji način pokrene najmlađe na razmišljanje i potrebu da se slobodno vreme iskoristi za bavljenje raznim kreativnim aktivnostima. Od ideje da se slobodno vreme može korisno ispuniti raznim sadržajima, stiglo se do autentične sociološke studije o kojoj bi svoje mišljenje mogli da daju stručnjaci koji se bave ovom problematikom. Akteri ovog serijala su deca od 8 do 12 godina, podeljeni po ciklusima. Na zadovoljstvo scenariste i urednika Ljiljane Stojković, neobavezno ćaskanje sa ovim malim, velikim ljudima preraslo je u uzajamno poverenje koje za rezultat ima autentična razmišljanja o svetu u kome žive, odrastaju, formiraju se. Svoj kosmos su sa ogromnim poverenjem podelili sa TV ekipom, pružajući nesebično pozitivnu energiju što predstavlja poseban kvalitet ove serije. O bavljenju glumom, sportom, muzikom, baletom, i o veoma ozbiljnim životnim pitanjima o tome koliko roditelji smeju da utiču na izbor svoje dece, o pravdi, nepravdi, o tome čemu služe kazne i drugim ozbiljnim pitanjima govore: Milica, Rastko, Marta, Todor, Marija, Stefan, Ana, Matej, Anđela i drugi.

programme.title: Between play and mathematics / Između igre i matematike
programme.desc: The semi-grade series between the game and mathematics deals with the treatment of basic concepts in mathematics adapted to the youngest age of primary school. The series aims to get to know the youngest through play and entertainment with basic concepts in mathematics. This age requires the greatest attention, because of their preparation, it depends on the work and understanding of teaching from this case. My idea involves a more interesting and more relaxed approach and children and topics. The work includes a group of children and two animators-clown. They encourage children to discuss children with their interesting story and thus get the necessary explanations and responses related to these terms. By applying the appropriate graphics and animation all this is even clearer and more complete. / Poluigrana serija Između igre i matematike bavi se obradom osnovnih pojmova iz matematike prilagođenih najmlađem uzrastu osnovne škole. Serija ima za cilj da se najmlađi kroz igru i zabavu upoznaju sa osnovnim pojmovima iz matematike. Ovaj uzrast zahteva najveću pažnju, jer od njihove pripremljenosti zavisi kasnije uključivanje u rad i razumevanje nastave iz ovog predmeta. Moja ideja podrazumeva jedan zanimljiviji i opušteniji pristup i deci i temama. U rad je uključena grupa dece i dva animatora-klovna. Oni svojom interesantnom pričom podstiču decu na razgovor i na taj način dobijamo potrebna objašnjenja i odgovore vezane za ove pojmove. Primenom odgovarajuće grafike i animacije sve ovo je još jasnije i potpunije.

programme.title: Language doubts / Jezičke nedoumice
programme.desc: The new series of linguistic concerns deals with live Serbian and different problems that occur in it every day. This series is unique in that language issues are processed in animated form, in a humorous way. The viewer through the story is leading a professor who photographs and explores everything and who encourages them to constantly think about the language. The second episode tells about this, which is why the vacuum cleaner (not a vacuum cleaner) is formed, from freezing - freezer (not freezer), etc. / Nova serija Jezičke nedoumice bavi se živim srpskim jezikom i različitim problemima koji se u njemu svakodnevno javljaju. Ova serija je jedinstvena po tome što se jezička pitanja obrađuju u animiranoj formi, na šaljiv način. Gledaoce kroz priču vodi profesor koji sve fotografiše i istražuje i koji ih podstiče da stalno razmišljaju o jeziku. Druga epizoda govori o tome zbog čega je od reči usisavanje nastalo usisivač (a ne usisavač), od zamrzavanje – zamrzivač (a ne zamrzavač), itd.

programme.title: Hemis for everyone / Hemija za sve
programme.desc: If you heard (and believe it) that something is good just because it comes from nature, that it is very good for your health to eat only raw foods, don't take milk, but you take a zeolite or petroleum or pure lemon's heart juice, think once more. Such statements, from which only a few clicks on internet browsers are shared, science did not confirm. There are dangerous among them. Misconceptions are made to take tribute to health, interpersonal relationships, money. We exacerbate some of them with the help of Dr. Zoran Vujčić, Professor Faculty of Chemistry in Belgrade, and Spaso and Stanoja Chemic, large fans of the truth and the Internet. / Ako ste čuli (i poverovali) da je nešto dobro samo zato što dolazi iz prirode, da je jako dobro za vaše zdravlje da jedete samo sirovu hranu, ne pijete mleko ali da uzimate zeolit ili petrolej ili čist limunov sok našte srca, razmislite još jednom. Ovakve tvrdnje, od kojih nas deli samo par klikova na internet pretraživačima, nauka nije potvrdila. Među njima ima i opasnih. Zablude umeju da uzmu danak- u zdravlju, međuljudskim odnosima, novcu. Neke od njih raskrinkavamo uz pomoć dr Zorana Vujčića, profesora Hemijskog fakulteta u Beogradu, i Spasoja i Stanoja Hemića, velikih obožavaoca istine i interneta.

programme.title: Literary blocks / Književno blokče
programme.desc: Wanting to be impressed, Miloš begs a wolf for help: ask him to stand out and records the most interesting anecdote about famous personalities. Through preparations for this feat, he also finds out that the anecdotes do not have to be related only for Aristotle, Socrates, Beethoven, Edison, but various everyday agenda can become family anecdotes that will be recounted for a long time. / Želeći da zadivi Nađu, Miloš moli Vuka za pomoć: traži od njega da mu izdvoji i zapiše najzanimljivije anegdote o čuvenim ličnostima. Kroz pripreme za ovaj podvig, on saznaje i da anegdote ne moraju biti vezane samo za Aristotela, Sokrata, Betovena, Edisona, već da razne svakodnevne dogodovštine mogu postati porodične anegdote koje će se dugo prepričavati.

programme.title: Body figure / Odgonetanje tela
programme.desc: If all living beings, thus, the subject of study with the prefix was, and if the medicine is applied by the study, health and disease, or the treatment of living, and then man, what makes the difference between the man and the body of other living beings? Do we love the body in which we are? Do we accept it as an inseparable part of your being or beautify it because of others? What is common to Vilendorf Venus and modern beauties? Is there a universal, ideal, perfect beauty or is it hidden in the eye of the beholder? Is it just a beauty of gold cutting ideal? Does the harmony of human personality depend on the balance between the needs of the Spirit and the needs of the body? / Ako su sva živa bića, pa time i čovek, predmet izučavanja nauka sa prefiksom bio, i ako je medicina primenjena biološka nauka koja se bavi proučavanjem, zdravljem i bolešću, odnosno lečenjem živih bića, pa i čoveka, šta onda pravi razliku između čovečijeg i tela drugih živih bića? Volimo li telo u kome se nalazimo? Prihvatamo li ga kao neodvojivi deo svoga bića ili ga ulepšavamo zbog drugih? Šta je zajedničko Vilendorfskoj Veneri i savremenim lepoticama?
