programme.title: Astor Pjacola in Belgrade / Astor Pjacola u Beogradu
programme.desc: Great Master of Tango and the top innovator of this genre, Astor Pyacola, this game stole from tired dancers, drowsy bandonionists and nostalgic parodists and led to the world tour, through the brave of experimentation and revival. In the spiritual sense, Pjacola returned Tango to Arabal, the border zone in which Buenos Aires is lost in Pampasas and where European, African and Kreole cultures were created by Tango and Milonga. / Veliki majstor tanga i vrhunski inovator ovog žanra, Astor Pjacola, ovu igru je ukrao od umornih plesača, pospanih bandoneonista i nostalgičnih parodista i poveo je na svetsku turneju, kroz hrabru odiseju eksperimentisanja i oživljavanja. U duhovnom smislu, Pjacola je tango vratio u Arabal, graničnu zonu u kojoj se Buenos Ajres gubi u pampasima i gde su u sudaru evropske, afričke i kreolske kulture stvoreni tango i milonge.

programme.title: Putem Melografa / Putem melografa
programme.desc: The emission cycle through melographs, whose scenarios were our reputable ethnomucologists, in the late 1960s and in a specific way, in a specific way, the music program of Belgrade television was marked. Customs related to the various ends of Serbia and the region are presented in the shows. As some of these customs have disappeared over time, broadcasting these shows is the only way to see them again. / Ciklus emisija Putem melografa, čiji su scenaristi bili naši ugledni etnomuzikolozi, krajem šezdesetih i početkom sedamdesetih godina prošlog veka na specifičan način obeležio je Muzički program Televizije Beograd. U emisijama su prikazivani običaji vezani za različite krajeve Srbije i regiona. Kako su neki od tih običaja tokom vremena nestali, emitovanje tih emisija je jedini način da se oni ponovo vide.

programme.title: Indirectly / Indirekt
programme.desc: A sports show that tried to convey the beauties of sports, at the same time, not overwhelmed to tackle problems and irregularities that numerous sports disciplines carry with them. / Sportska emisija koja je mnogobrojnom gedalaštvu nastojala da prenese lepote sporta, istovremeno ne prezajući od toga da se uhvati u koštac sa problemima i nepravilnostima koje brojne sportske discipline nose sa sobom.

programme.title: Serbian sports legends / Srpske sportske legende
programme.desc: In this show he talked about himself, easy and modest. Doyen sports journalism, Marko Markovic reported with 40 championships of Europe and the world and the Olympic Games and the myriad of football matches. He was the author and leader of the Cult TV show indirect, more radio and TV shows on sports, a large number of interviews and six monographs. He worked as a responsible editor of the TV Belgrade's sports program, the editor of the RTS sports program, as well as the President of the Association of Sports Journalists FRY. / U ovoj emisiji pričao je o sebi, lako i skromno. Doajen sportskog novinarstva, Marko Marković izveštavao je sa 40 šampionata Evrope i sveta i Olimpijskih igara i bezbroj fudbalskih utakmica. Bio je autor i voditelj kultne TV emisije Indirekt, više radio i TV emisija o sportu, velikog broja intervjua i šest monografija. Radio je kao odgovorni urednik Sportskog programa TV Beograd, odgovorni urednik Sportskog programa RTS-a, kao i predsednik Udruženja sportskih novinara SRJ.

programme.title: Return to the stars / Povratak zvezdama
programme.desc: Some facts are indisputable. One of them is that the sport does not know the borders and easily removes every obstacle on the path to people, no matter what part of the world you people live and what language they speak. There are also elderly among sports lovers, there are younger ones. RTS program archive, the first reminds and gives others the opportunity to find out what in sport occurred at the time when they were small or may not yet be born. In this show on the Yugoslav box, Radivoje Markovic spoke, and there are recordings of numerous matches of Yugoslav and European and American boxers, held in the 1950s. Enjoy sports weatherplosion! / Neke činjenice su neosporne. Jedna od njih je, da sport ne zna za granice i da lako uklanja svaku prepreku na putu ka ljudima, bez obzira u kom delu sveta ti ljudi žive i kojim jezikom govore. Među ljubiteljima sporta ima i starijih, ima i mlađih. Programski arhiv RTS-a, prve podseća a drugima daje priliku da saznaju šta se u sportu dešavalo u vreme kada su bili mali ili možda još i nisu bili rođeni. U ovoj emisiji o jugoslovenskom boksu govorio je Radivoje Marković, a tu su i snimci brojnih značajnih mečeva jugoslovenskih i evropskih i američkih boksera, održanih 50-tih godina prošlog veka. Uživajte u sportskom vremeplovu!

programme.title: Tremendous / Titoizam
programme.desc: The documentary series of titoism is dedicated to one of the most controversial political leaders of the 20th. Century, Josip Broz Titu. It contains numerous reports, archival shots and interviews. / Dokumentarni serijal Titoizam posvećen je jednom od najkontroverznijih političkih vođa 20. veka, Josipu Brozu Titu. Sadrži brojne reportaže, arhivske snimke i intervjue.

programme.title: Bijelo Dugme near Hajduk Česme / Bijelo dugme kod Hajdučke česme
programme.desc: The show from August 1977. He deals with the phenomenon of the rock music and a concert of the white buttons near the Hajdučka fountain on Kosutnjak. The concert announced as the last performance of the then the most popular Yugoslav term group gathered tens of students about the popularity, identity, a psychologist. / Emisija iz avgusta 1977. godine bavi se fenomenom rok muzike i koncertom Bijelog dugmeta kod Hajdučke česme na Košutnjaku. Koncert najavljen kao poslednji nastup tada najpopularnije jugoslovenske rok grupe okupio je desetine hiljada gledalaca i otvorio mnoga pitanja o popularnosti, identitetu, muzici... O svemu tome, uz delove sa koncerta, govore psiholog Žarko Korać, kompozitor i estetičar Dragutin Gostuški, rok kritičar Dražen Vrdoljak i posetioci koncerta, a voditelj je Bogdan Tirnanić.

programme.title: The seventh art / Sedma umetnost
programme.desc: In this show the Seventh Art series, the editor of Snezana Zarić will introduce you to the image and part of Vitoria de Sike. The banking clerk, who is acquaintance with the daughter's owner of the theater, opened the way to the boards that mean, that he then discovered the charms of the Great Canvas where he started his career as an episodist. In the show you will see the recordings of Vitoria de Sike who talks about the beginning of your career and the people who helped him selflessly. There is also a collage of inserates of his films in which he was playing and directed by, as well as the saying of the famous director and actors he cooperated with. Knowers and Films of Film Arts will surely watch with a lot of attention because De Sika, who was directed by the 1940, the originator of Italian neorealism and in his post-war achievements can be seen by a nearly documentary approach to the topics he was processed. His four films, which directed were won by the Oscar: Shoe cleaners and bicycle thieves (honorary), while yesterday, today and tomorrow and garden fins - continents in the category best film in a foreign language. The films for which he received an honorary Oscar, are responsible for establishing the American Academy of Film Arts on a permanent prize for the best foreign film. / U ovoj emisiji serijala Sedma umetnost, urednica Snežana Zarić upoznaće vas sa likom i delom Vitoria de Sike. Bankarski činovnik, kome je poznanstvo sa kćerkom vlasnika pozorišta, otvorilo put prema daskama koje život znače, da bi potom otkrio čari velikog platna gde je karijeru započeo kao epizodista. U emisiji ćete videti snimke Vitoria de Sike koji govori o početku svoje karijere i ljudima koji su mu tada nesebično pomogli. Tu je i kolaž inserata njegovih filmova u kojima je glumio i koje je režirao, kao i kazivanja poznatih reditelja i glumaca sa kojima je sarađivao. Poznavaoci i ljubitelji filmske umetnosti ovu emisiju će sigurno odgledati sa puno pažnje jer je de Sika, koji je režijom počeo da se bavi 1940, začetnik italijanskog neorealizma i u njegovim posleratnim ostvarenjima vidi se gotovo dokumentaristički pristup temama koje je obrađivao. Njegova četiri filma, koje je režirao osvojila su Oskara: Čistači cipela i Kradljivci bicikla (počasni), dok su Juče, danas i sutra i Vrt Finci - Kontinijevih nagrađeni u kategoriji najbolji film na stranom jeziku. Filmovi za koje je dobio počasnog Oskara, zaslužni su što je američka Akademija filmskih umetnosti ustanovila stalnu nagradu za najbolji strani film.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: Krk island, next to Cres is one of the biggest pearls of the Adriatic Sea. The name of the Golden Island (Insula Aurea) received ancient times, thanks to the wealth of the country and the sea. The island was inhabited by Japodi and Liburna, Romans, Goti and Slavs since the earliest days. Located in the Kvarner Bay, the largest island of Adriatic Sea, framed by smaller islands, cliffs and ridges, interpreted by fertile fields, caves, bays, pebble beaches, lakes and rivers. The highest point of the island is 569 meters above sea level. Tourism is very well developed on the island and it is the main industry of the Krk. Since 1980. Krk island is connected to the mainland over Tito's bridge in length 1430 m whose works began in July 1976. Sponsorship of Josip Broz Tito. / Ostrvo Krk, je pored Cresa jedan od najvećih bisera Jadranskog mora. Ime Zlatno ostrvo (Insula Aurea) je dobilo još u antičko doba, zahvaljujući bogatstvu zemlje i mora. Ostrvo su još od najranijih dana naseljavali Japodi i Liburni, Rimljani, Goti i Sloveni. Smešteno u Kvarnerskom zalivu, najveće je ostrvo Jadranskog mora, uokvireno manjim ostrvima, hridima i grebenima, ispresecano plodnim poljima, pećinama, zalivima, šljunkovitim plažama, jezerima i rekama. Najviša tačka ostrva nalazi se na 569 metara nadmorske visine. Na ostrvu je veoma dobro razvijen turizam i to je glavna privredna grana na Krku. Od 1980. godine ostrvo Krk povezano je sa kopnom preko Titovog mosta dužine 1430 m čiji su radovi započeli u julu 1976. sponzorstvom Josipa Broza Tita.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Which island does the Latin name of Melita apply? Two significant shipwrecks occurred on this island: one Odysseus, and the other Sv. Apostle Paul. For a long time, the name of this island identified exclusively with Malta. And then ... at first, quiet, and then all the louder Echo truth echoed with the scientific world: Melita is actually Mljet, not Malta. The secret of this island continues to preserve the story of its legendary and mythological past. / Na koje ostrvo se odnosi latinski naziv Melita? Dva značajna brodoloma su se dogodila upravo na ovom ostrvu: Jedan Odisejev, a drugi Sv. apostola Pavla. Dugo vremena se ime ovog ostrva poistovećivalo isključivo sa Maltom. A onda... isprva tihi, a zatim sve glasniji eho istine je odjeknuo naučnim svetom: Melita je zapravo Mljet, a ne Malta. Tajna ovog ostrva i dalje čuva priču svoje legendarne i mitološke prošlosti.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: Krk island, next to Cres is one of the biggest pearls of the Adriatic Sea. The name of the Golden Island (Insula Aurea) received ancient times, thanks to the wealth of the country and the sea. The island was inhabited by Japodi and Liburna, Romans, Goti and Slavs since the earliest days. Located in the Kvarner Bay, the largest island of Adriatic Sea, framed by smaller islands, cliffs and ridges, interpreted by fertile fields, caves, bays, pebble beaches, lakes and rivers. The highest point of the island is 569 meters above sea level. Tourism is very well developed on the island and it is the main industry of the Krk. Since 1980. Krk island is connected to the mainland over Tito's bridge in length 1430 m whose works began in July 1976. Sponsorship of Josip Broz Tito. / Ostrvo Krk, je pored Cresa jedan od najvećih bisera Jadranskog mora. Ime Zlatno ostrvo (Insula Aurea) je dobilo još u antičko doba, zahvaljujući bogatstvu zemlje i mora. Ostrvo su još od najranijih dana naseljavali Japodi i Liburni, Rimljani, Goti i Sloveni. Smešteno u Kvarnerskom zalivu, najveće je ostrvo Jadranskog mora, uokvireno manjim ostrvima, hridima i grebenima, ispresecano plodnim poljima, pećinama, zalivima, šljunkovitim plažama, jezerima i rekama. Najviša tačka ostrva nalazi se na 569 metara nadmorske visine. Na ostrvu je veoma dobro razvijen turizam i to je glavna privredna grana na Krku. Od 1980. godine ostrvo Krk povezano je sa kopnom preko Titovog mosta dužine 1430 m čiji su radovi započeli u julu 1976. sponzorstvom Josipa Broza Tita.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Which island does the Latin name of Melita apply? Two significant shipwrecks occurred on this island: one Odysseus, and the other Sv. Apostle Paul. For a long time, the name of this island identified exclusively with Malta. And then ... at first, quiet, and then all the louder Echo truth echoed with the scientific world: Melita is actually Mljet, not Malta. The secret of this island continues to preserve the story of its legendary and mythological past. / Na koje ostrvo se odnosi latinski naziv Melita? Dva značajna brodoloma su se dogodila upravo na ovom ostrvu: Jedan Odisejev, a drugi Sv. apostola Pavla. Dugo vremena se ime ovog ostrva poistovećivalo isključivo sa Maltom. A onda... isprva tihi, a zatim sve glasniji eho istine je odjeknuo naučnim svetom: Melita je zapravo Mljet, a ne Malta. Tajna ovog ostrva i dalje čuva priču svoje legendarne i mitološke prošlosti.

programme.title: TV time / Vreme televizije
programme.desc: Ninety seventh episode series Television time refers to the genre in Belgrade television program since 1987. Including 1991. year. The editorial office of the Magazine Program until 1990 was operated within a broader-recreational program, and then renamed the contact program within a new, artistic-entertainment program. In programming documents until 1990. year as the basic task of the magazine program is raising entertainment levels and, quotes, information and vivals. In 1987. Ikarov flight quiz was launched - attempt to restore this type of program. Unfortunately, due to the way the issue of emission, as indicated in the editorial board report, the remarks of criticism and the public could not be met. The editor was Miloš Teodorović. The editorial office felt that one of its most significant results of emissions video club intended for youth. The success of the video club has contributed to the news from video production, rarity concerts of the pop and rock music and charming and modern inerpretation of young leaders. The editor was Dragoslav Ž. Savic. Cooperation with foreign televisions was achieved by TV bridges. They were so-called duplex programs in which television contents and the TV station were represented, which was established by a TV bridge, with the share of the program 50% to 50%. Thus, the emissions of Prague-Belgrade, Belgrade-Beijing (the first project, which Beijing television has realized with a foreign TV station), Belgrade-Warsaw, Belgrade-Lisbon et al. In the next episode we will testify about the work of the editorial office / Devedeset sedma epizoda serije Vreme televizije odnosi se na taj žanr u programu Televizije Beograd od 1987. zaključno sa 1991. godinom. Redakcija magazinskog programa do 1990. godine delovala je u okviru šireg Zabavno-rekreativnog programa, a potom je preimenovana u Redakciju kontakt programa u okviru novog, Umetničko-zabavnog programa. U programskim dokumentima do 1990. godine kao osnovni zadatak magazinskog programa je podizanje nivoa zabave i, citiramo, informativnost i životnost. U 1987. godini pokrenut je kviz Ikarov let - pokušaj da se obnovi ta vrsta programa. Na žalost, zbog načina pripreme emisije, kako je naznačeno u izveštaju redakcije, primedbama kritike i javnosti nije se moglo udovoljiti. Urednik je bio Miloš Teodorović. Redakcija je smatrala da je jedan od njenih najznačajnijih rezultata emisija Video klub namenjena omladini. Uspehu Video kluba doprinele su novosti iz video produkcije, raritetni koncerti pop i rok muzike i šarmantna i moderna inerpretacija mladih voditelja. Urednik je bio Dragoslav Ž. Savić. Saradnja sa inostranim televizijama ostvarivana je TV mostovima. Bili su to takozvani dupleks programi u kojima su bili zastupljeni i sadržaji Televizije Beograd i strane TV stanice kojom je uspostavljan TV most, pri čemu je udeo u programu bio 50% prema 50%. Tako su ostvarene emisije Prag-Beograd, Beograd-Peking (prvi projekat koju je pekinška televizija ostvarila sa nekom stranom TV stanicom), Beograd-Varšava, Beograd-Lisabon i dr. U narednoj epizodi svedočićemo o radu Redakcije

programme.desc: From the episode in the episode, this show will introduce us to the history, but also the natural beauties of the island in the Adriatic. / Iz epizodu u epizodu ova emisija upoznaće nas sa istorijom, ali i prirodnim lepotama ostrva u Jadranu.

programme.title: Adriatic Islands / Jadranska ostrva
programme.desc: Ivan Jurjevich Knez, Vinogradar, oliveber, fisherman, sculptor, painter, Masonry, Hunter, told his story of native Korcula. More than 700 years builders left a mark on this island, a lot was destroyed, but the new generations of neimar are considering. Loza and wine always meant life on Korcula. There is still a knight of the Moriška game, which used to play throughout the Mediterranean. There is a house in which it is, he is believed, grew up Marko Polo, and Legenda says that there was a court of Kirke's court on this island and that Odysseus stayed in it. / Ivan Jurjevič Knez, vinogradar, maslinar, ribar, vajar, slikar, zidar, lovac, ispričao je svoju priču o rodnoj Korčuli. Više od 700 godina graditelji su ostavljali trag na ovom ostrvu, mnogo toga je uništeno, ali stasavaju nove generacije neimara. Loza i vino uvek su na Korčuli značili život. Još uvek se tu izvodi viteška igra moreška, koja se nekada igrala na celom Mediteranu. Postoji kuća u kojoj je, veruje se, odrastao Marko Polo, a legenda kaže da se na ovom ostrvu nalazio dvor čarobnice Kirke i da je u njemu boravio Odisej.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: From Kornati, through Durmitor, Prokletie, Bačka, Obolje to Danube, through the canyon, went to Istria, a tireless television creator who was filming the RTB's in the very best of the most precious. / Od Kornata, preko Durmitora, Prokletija, Bačke, Đerdapa, od Homolja do Dunava, preko Tare, kroz kanjon Nevidio pa sve do Istre, vodili su putevi Milana Kovačevića, neumornog televizijskog stvaraoca koji je 60-ih i 70-ih godina snimao putopise, deo najdragocenije arhivske građe RTB-a.

programme.title: Caravan / Karavan
programme.desc: Krk island, next to Cres is one of the biggest pearls of the Adriatic Sea. The name of the Golden Island (Insula Aurea) received ancient times, thanks to the wealth of the country and the sea. The island was inhabited by Japodi and Liburna, Romans, Goti and Slavs since the earliest days. Located in the Kvarner Bay, the largest island of Adriatic Sea, framed by smaller islands, cliffs and ridges, interpreted by fertile fields, caves, bays, pebble beaches, lakes and rivers. The highest point of the island is 569 meters above sea level. Tourism is very well developed on the island and it is the main industry of the Krk. Since 1980. Krk island is connected to the mainland over Tito's bridge in length 1430 m whose works began in July 1976. Sponsorship of Josip Broz Tito. / Ostrvo Krk, je pored Cresa jedan od najvećih bisera Jadranskog mora. Ime Zlatno ostrvo (Insula Aurea) je dobilo još u antičko doba, zahvaljujući bogatstvu zemlje i mora. Ostrvo su još od najranijih dana naseljavali Japodi i Liburni, Rimljani, Goti i Sloveni. Smešteno u Kvarnerskom zalivu, najveće je ostrvo Jadranskog mora, uokvireno manjim ostrvima, hridima i grebenima, ispresecano plodnim poljima, pećinama, zalivima, šljunkovitim plažama, jezerima i rekama. Najviša tačka ostrva nalazi se na 569 metara nadmorske visine. Na ostrvu je veoma dobro razvijen turizam i to je glavna privredna grana na Krku. Od 1980. godine ostrvo Krk povezano je sa kopnom preko Titovog mosta dužine 1430 m čiji su radovi započeli u julu 1976. sponzorstvom Josipa Broza Tita.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Which island does the Latin name of Melita apply? Two significant shipwrecks occurred on this island: one Odysseus, and the other Sv. Apostle Paul. For a long time, the name of this island identified exclusively with Malta. And then ... at first, quiet, and then all the louder Echo truth echoed with the scientific world: Melita is actually Mljet, not Malta. The secret of this island continues to preserve the story of its legendary and mythological past. / Na koje ostrvo se odnosi latinski naziv Melita? Dva značajna brodoloma su se dogodila upravo na ovom ostrvu: Jedan Odisejev, a drugi Sv. apostola Pavla. Dugo vremena se ime ovog ostrva poistovećivalo isključivo sa Maltom. A onda... isprva tihi, a zatim sve glasniji eho istine je odjeknuo naučnim svetom: Melita je zapravo Mljet, a ne Malta. Tajna ovog ostrva i dalje čuva priču svoje legendarne i mitološke prošlosti.

programme.title: Those days of that year / Ti dani te godine
programme.desc: The emissions of the documentary program of the film chronicle, deal with important events in the then SFRY and the world. / Emisije dokumentarnog programa Filmska hronika, bave se važnim dešavanjima u tadašnjoj SFRJ i svetu.

programme.title: TV time / Vreme televizije
programme.desc: Ninety seventh episode series Television time refers to the genre in Belgrade television program since 1987. Including 1991. year. The editorial office of the Magazine Program until 1990 was operated within a broader-recreational program, and then renamed the contact program within a new, artistic-entertainment program. In programming documents until 1990. year as the basic task of the magazine program is raising entertainment levels and, quotes, information and vivals. In 1987. Ikarov flight quiz was launched - attempt to restore this type of program. Unfortunately, due to the way the issue of emission, as indicated in the editorial board report, the remarks of criticism and the public could not be met. The editor was Miloš Teodorović. The editorial office felt that one of its most significant results of emissions video club intended for youth. The success of the video club has contributed to the news from video production, rarity concerts of the pop and rock music and charming and modern inerpretation of young leaders. The editor was Dragoslav Ž. Savic. Cooperation with foreign televisions was achieved by TV bridges. They were so-called duplex programs in which television contents and the TV station were represented, which was established by a TV bridge, with the share of the program 50% to 50%. Thus, the emissions of Prague-Belgrade, Belgrade-Beijing (the first project, which Beijing television has realized with a foreign TV station), Belgrade-Warsaw, Belgrade-Lisbon et al. In the next episode we will testify about the work of the editorial office / Devedeset sedma epizoda serije Vreme televizije odnosi se na taj žanr u programu Televizije Beograd od 1987. zaključno sa 1991. godinom. Redakcija magazinskog programa do 1990. godine delovala je u okviru šireg Zabavno-rekreativnog programa, a potom je preimenovana u Redakciju kontakt programa u okviru novog, Umetničko-zabavnog programa. U programskim dokumentima do 1990. godine kao osnovni zadatak magazinskog programa je podizanje nivoa zabave i, citiramo, informativnost i životnost. U 1987. godini pokrenut je kviz Ikarov let - pokušaj da se obnovi ta vrsta programa. Na žalost, zbog načina pripreme emisije, kako je naznačeno u izveštaju redakcije, primedbama kritike i javnosti nije se moglo udovoljiti. Urednik je bio Miloš Teodorović. Redakcija je smatrala da je jedan od njenih najznačajnijih rezultata emisija Video klub namenjena omladini. Uspehu Video kluba doprinele su novosti iz video produkcije, raritetni koncerti pop i rok muzike i šarmantna i moderna inerpretacija mladih voditelja. Urednik je bio Dragoslav Ž. Savić. Saradnja sa inostranim televizijama ostvarivana je TV mostovima. Bili su to takozvani dupleks programi u kojima su bili zastupljeni i sadržaji Televizije Beograd i strane TV stanice kojom je uspostavljan TV most, pri čemu je udeo u programu bio 50% prema 50%. Tako su ostvarene emisije Prag-Beograd, Beograd-Peking (prvi projekat koju je pekinška televizija ostvarila sa nekom stranom TV stanicom), Beograd-Varšava, Beograd-Lisabon i dr. U narednoj epizodi svedočićemo o radu Redakcije

programme.title: Art evening / Umetničko veče
programme.desc: The show where Dragoslav Srejović, as he said, teaches his spiritual will. Explaining his human and scientific credo, Sretovic gives a completely specific view of archeology, as a layered and complex science. All his research, consciously or subconsciously, subordinated with aesthetic principles, which he considered primary and in the creation of cultural heritage. This is one of the last Srejović's appearances on television. Materials from the Gamzigrad Materials were used in the show - Seven questions about one late antique location and history of one discovery the imperial palace in Gamzigrad. / Emisija u kojoj Dragoslav Srejović, kako je sam rekao, predaje svoj duhovni testament. Objašnjavajući svoj ljudski i naučnički kredo, Srejović daje jedno sasvim specifično viđenje arheologije, kao slojevite i kompleksne nauke. Sva svoja istraživanja, svesno ili podsvesno, podređivao je estetskim načelima, koja je smatrao primarnim i u stvaranju kulturnog nasleđa. Ovo je jedno od poslednjih Srejovićevih pojavljivanja na televiziji. U emisiji su korišćeni materijali iz emisije Gamzigrad - sedam pitanja o jednom kasnoantičkom lokalitetu i Istorija jednog otkrića Carska palata u Gamzigradu.

programme.title: Sundial / Sunčani sat
programme.desc: Once the medieval structures of the cities were designed in relation to the defense against the attacking army; Today, they cannot resist many armies of visitors. The idea of the show is that through the prism of romantic dreams of the Adriatic Trash Snatk only one square - a long thousand miles, as our leader says. That square should be a syncretism of styles and spirits. Neimari east and west, they met in one place, but not in the same time. The coastal squares are the witnesses of that encounter. / Nekada srednjovekovne strukture gradova bile su projektovane u odnosu na odbranu od napadačke vojske; danas one ne mogu da odole mnogim armijama posetilaca. Ideja emisije je da se kroz prizmu romantičnog snoviđenja jadranskih trgova satka samo jedan trg - dug hiljadu milja, kako kaže naš voditelj. Taj trg treba da bude sinkretizam stilova i duhova. Neimari istoka i zapada, sreli su se na jednom mestu, ali ne i u istom vremenu. Primorski trgovi jesu svedoci tog susreta.

programme.title: Adriatic Islands / Jadranska ostrva
programme.desc: Stevan Krtinić lives on Brioni and cares about animals in the zoo. The archipelago has 14 islands, and the largest is Brion, who became known thanks to Titu and in which the whole archipelago was named. This island visited 600 guests every day. In his residence, Tito received the statesmen of 90 countries from all over the world. Brions are considered one of the largest salar reserves, many of the African statesmen. / Stevan Krtinić živi na Brionima i brine o životinjama u zoo vrtu. Arhipelag ima 14 ostrva, a najveći je Veli Brion, koji je postao poznat zahvaljujući Titu i po kome je ceo arhipelag dobio ime. Ovo ostrvo svakodnevno je posećivalo 600 gostiju. Tito je u svojoj rezidenciji primio državnike 90 zemalja iz celog sveta. Brioni se smatraju i jednim od najvećih rezervata divljači, mnoge su poklonili afrički državnici.

programme.title: Diary / Rokovnik
programme.desc: The diary series, which deals with the SFRY scene, represents the most important authors and performers of the most popular music of the 20th century. Organizer name is a play of words. Organizer is a place where the most important events were recorded in the period from 1958. until 2000. years. The series was filmed for several years, in important locations where the scene was created: in Belgrade, Zagreb, Sarajevo, Kragujevac, Pula, Rijeka, Ljubljana, Novi Sad and Skopje. On that occasion, talks were recorded with more than 300 participants and witnesses, and a complete video archive of that time was collected, which will be presented for the first time in the series. / Serijal Rokovnik, koji se bavi rok scenom SFRJ, predstavlja najznačajnije autore i izvođače najpopularnije muzike XX veka. Naziv Rokovnik je igra reči. Rokovnik je mesto gde su zabeleženi najvažniji događaji u periodu od 1958. do 2000. godine. Serija je snimana nekoliko godina, na bitnim lokacijama na kojima je stvarana rok scena: u Beogradu, Zagrebu, Sarajevu, Kragujevcu, Puli, Rijeci, Ljubljani, Novom Sadu i Skoplju. Tom prilikom, snimljeni su razgovori sa više od 300 učesnika i svedoka, i prikupljena je kompletna video-arhiva tog vremena, koja će prvi put biti prezentovana u serijalu.

programme.title: Fantastic planeta / Fantastična planeta
programme.desc: Vladimir Banić with a fantastic planet in the ninth episode travel to Italy, Brazil and the Great Britain to learn how to deal with different forms of crime in these cultures. In Italy, Vladimir Banić spoke with Atili Bolzoni journalism that reports 50 years of the mafia. Prvobitni živopis je u potpunosti uništen, a današnje freske potiču iz 16. veka kada je manastir obnovio patrijarh Makarije Sokolović.

programme.title: Circle square footage / Kvadratura kruga
programme.desc: 35 years ago, one of the largest endeavors in construction in Serbia was performed in Serbia. It is then on the Temple of Saint Sava, at a height of 40 meters, the central dome is raised heavy 4,000 tons. Until then, a similar feat, nowhere in the world was not performed. / Pre 35 godina, u Srbiji je izveden jedan od najvećih poduhvata u građevinarstvu. Tada je na Hram Svetog Save, na visinu od 40 metara, podignuta centralna kupola teška 4.000 tona. Do tada, sličan podvig, nigde u svetu nije izveden.

programme.title: Eco miniatures: old Serbian varieties / Eko minijature: Stare srpske sorte
programme.desc: Each Serbian household has a garden on whose rims were located at which a vicar, vegetables and around the house of ornamental plants. Obavezno perunika, cvet starog slovenskog boga Peruna, busera, i svakako ruža.

programme.title: Roman / Romanipen
programme.desc: We tried several types of raspberries mostly grown in the western part of Serbia. We also tried to describe the path and some of the difficulties that raspberries crossed, to reach the consumer from the plantation. The family of Muratović helped us generally engaged in raspberry production. We visited their Malinjak in the This Selo Konjic, otherwise the majority Roma place, where most locals grow red gold. / Probali smo nekoliko vrsta maline koja se najviše gaji u zapadnom delu Srbije. Takođe smo pokušali da opišemo put i neke od poteškoće koje malina pređe, da bi od zasada stigla do potrošača. U tome nam je pomogla porodica Muratović koja se generacijski bavi proizvodnjom maline. Posetili smo njihove malinjake u pitomom selu Konjic, inače većinski romskom mestu, gde većina meštana uzgaja crveno zlato.

programme.title: RTS practice / RTS ordinacija
programme.desc: Central topics in the practice segment will be those who are interested in a large number of people, as: Low blood Pristis, how to learn the most reliable information on the proper use of pharmaceutics products, and but in the first issue of the new TV season we will learn how safe natural agencies are. Well-known thematic emission blocks as a medicine - will make the clarification of food dilemma: what we feel a strong need for specific foods, which kind of flour are the highest quality, how to leave Turkey as a healthier way. / Centralne teme u segmentu Ordinacija biće one koje zanimaju veliki broj ljudi, kao što su: usporen rad štitaste žlezde, nizak krvni pristisak, kako održati u balansu hormone stresa… Iz rubrike Apoteka i dalje ćemo saznavati najpouzdanije informacije o pravilnoj upotrebi farmaceutksih proizvoda, a već u prvoj emisiji nove TV sezone saznaćemo koliko su bezbedna prirodna sredstva za smirenje. Dobro poznati tematski blok emisije Hrana kao lek - doneće razjašnjenje dilema u vezi sa hranom: šta nedostaje organizmu kada osećamo jaku potrebu za specifičnim namirnicama, koje vrsta brašna su najkvalitetnije, kako na što zdraviji način ostaviti turšiju i još mnogo toga.

programme.title: SAT / SAT
programme.desc: The team shows the clock again moves the boundaries. This time they are taking you on the patrol of 1,500 kilometers long. They tour Italy and her attractions. As the road is extremely long, they decided to broadcast the show from two parts. This week you will see most of the trip, but with trips to Bologna, Florence and Rome as a whipped cream on the cake. You will find out how you can visit eternal city in just a few hours and see the most important sights. The road to Naples, Town and All its specifics, Volcania, Pompeii, Sorrento as the final destination, but also the famous buildings of Amalfi, Positano and Kapri island. / Ekipa emisije SAT ponovo pomera granice. Ovoga puta vode vas na patrolu dugačku 1.500 kilometara. Obilaze Italiju i njene atrakcije. Kako je put izuzetno dugačak, odlučili su da emisiju emituju iz dva dela. Ove nedelje videćete veći deo putovanja, ali sa izletima u Bolonju, Firencu i Rim kao šlag na torti. Saznaćete kako za samo par sati možete obići Večni grad i videti najvažnije znamenitosti. Već sledeće nedelje čeka vas put do Napulja, obilazak grada i sve njegove specifičnosti, vulkan Vezuv, Pompeja, Sorento kao finalna destinacija, ali i čuveni gradići Amalfi, Pozitano i ostrvo Kapri.

programme.title: SAT / SAT
programme.desc: Everyone seeking the current and, above all, useful information in the field of traffic, automotive and tourism for a full 17 years are gathered around the emissions of the clock, emissions and drivers and pedestrians. Although recognizable by their unique presentations of the latest cars praise-we remember, as well as numerous practical types of fuel quality, the clock is intended for everyone who is a car insurance, customer advice, and similar topics actually its indispensable part. At the same time, the SAT emission is also known as a large traffic safety fighter and as an inevitable travel partner especially through the famous patrols, the original trafficked reports in a kilometer-per-kilometer. Of course, it should not be forgotten to detect the forgotten tourist pearls of Serbia, the free legal counseling, the stories of economic topics, trucks, buses and all other columns that make an hour interesting for the whole family. / Svi koji traže aktuelnu i, pre svega, korisnu informaciju iz oblasti saobraćaja, automobilizma i turizma već punih 17 godina okupljeni su oko emisije SAT, emisije i za vozače i za pešake. programme.title: Serbian shrines in Kosovo and Metohija / Srpske svetinje na Kosovu i Metohiji
programme.desc: The series of Serbian shrines in Kosovo and Metohija, shows Kosovo - Metohija Srpsko spiritual and artistic heritage. The capital project of film news, has been recorded for three years and gathered 70 historians, art historians, archaeologists, anthropologists, theologics and ethnologists. 179 churches and churches, monasteries and monasteries in Kim were filmed. All this with the suggestions of the Republic Institute for the Protection of Cultural Monuments, the support of the Ministry of Culture and UNESCA, and the Blessing of the then Patriarch Irinaj and Vladika Raško - Prizren Teodosi. Djordje Kadijevic, a consultant on the series, says that the series draws heritage, as Arbanas want to prove that they are the authors of the territory they consider their own and have taken films on Serbian monasteries, presenting them as - their own. / Serijal Srpske svetinje na Kosovu i Metohiji, prikazuje kosovsko - metohijsko srpsko duhovno i umetničko pravoslavno nasleđe. Kapitalni projekat Filmskih novosti, sniman je tri godine i okupio je 70 istoričara, istoričara umetnosti, arheologa, antropologa, teologa i etnologa. Snimljeno je 179 crkava i crkvišta, manastira i manastirišta na KiM. Sve to uz sugestije republičkog Zavoda za zaštitu spomenika kulture, podršku Ministarstva kulture i Uneska, i blagoslov tadašnjeg patrijarha Irineja i vladike raško - prizrenskog Teodosija. Đorđe Kadijević, konsultant na serijalu, kaže da serijal skreće pažnju na poreklo baštine, budući da Arbanasi žele da dokažu da su oni autori spomenika koji se nalaze na teritoriji koju smatraju svojom i da su snimili filmove o srpskim manastirima predstavivši ih kao - svoje.

programme.title: First service / Prvi servis
programme.desc: The first service is the first Serbian pseudo-documentary series. It was broadcast for the first time in 2016. years and has notes over 200 recorded episodes so far. In addition to the main characters, the series abounds in interesting episodists, of which the characters of Stojan Savić, Bosilj, Baneta and the banet and unsurpassed electrical lies are especially emphasized. Prvi put je emitovana 2016. godine i do sada beleži preko 200 snimljenih epizoda. Radnja serije se odvija u maloj automehaničarskoj radionici u vlasništvu Hranislava Đrića koji uz pomoć svog šegrta Mikice pokušava da vodi posao u servisu. Uz nesebičnu podršku supruge Kaće i pomoć auto dilera Safeta Hranislav pokušava da se popne na zdravu granu i počne da posluje legalno. Problem je u tome što ni jedna grana ne može da podnese težinu njegovih poslovnih poduhvata. Uprkos činjenici da svaki biznis plan ove trojke završi u kanalu, njihovo neodustajanje stvara niz komičnih situacija. Sa druge stane, sposobnost aktera da se kao mačke dočekaju na noge i poput ptice Feniksa ponovo rode čine ovu seriju neodoljivo zabavnom. Pored glavnih likova serija obiluje zanimljivim epizodistima od kojih se posebno ističu likovi Stojana Savića, Bosiljka, Baneta i nenadmašnog Elektro Lazija. Ovaj alanfordovski univerzum koji umesto Cvijećarnice kao centar zbivanja ima automehaničarsku radnju i koji je zabeležio ogromnu popularnost na Ju-Tjubu, konačno dobija i svoj televizijski život na Radio-televiziji Vojvodine.

programme.title: First service / Prvi servis
programme.desc: The first service is the first Serbian pseudo-documentary series. It was broadcast for the first time in 2016. years and has notes over 200 recorded episodes so far. The action series takes place in a small car mechanic workshop owned by Hranislav Đrić, who is trying to lead a business in the service with the help of his Šegrt Mikica. His desire to do as little as possible is directly proportional to the costs that accumulate each day. With selfless support of the wife, the help of car dealers Safet Hranislav tries to climb a healthy branch and begins to operate legally. The problem is that no branch can bear the weight of its business ventures. Despite the fact that every business plan of these triplets end up in the canal, their neodustuction creates a number of comic situations. From another fit, the ability of actors to meet like cats and like a bird of phoenix again, race make this series irresistibly fun. In addition to the main characters, the series abounds in interesting episodists, of which the characters of Stojan Savić, Bosilj, Baneta and the banet and unsurpassed electrical lies are especially emphasized. This AlanFord's universe that has a car mechanical shop instead of the flowers and who recorded huge popularity on Ju-Tjuba, finally got its television life on the Radio-Television of Vojvodina. / Prvi servis je prva srpska pseudodokumentarna serija. Prvi put je emitovana 2016. godine i do sada beleži preko 200 snimljenih epizoda. Radnja serije se odvija u maloj automehaničarskoj radionici u vlasništvu Hranislava Đrića koji uz pomoć svog šegrta Mikice pokušava da vodi posao u servisu. Njegova želja da što manje radi je direktno proporcijalna troškovima koji se svakodnevno gomilaju. Uz nesebičnu podršku supruge Kaće i pomoć auto dilera Safeta Hranislav pokušava da se popne na zdravu granu i počne da posluje legalno. Problem je u tome što ni jedna grana ne može da podnese težinu njegovih poslovnih poduhvata. Uprkos činjenici da svaki biznis plan ove trojke završi u kanalu, njihovo neodustajanje stvara niz komičnih situacija. Sa druge stane, sposobnost aktera da se kao mačke dočekaju na noge i poput ptice Feniksa ponovo rode čine ovu seriju neodoljivo zabavnom. Pored glavnih likova serija obiluje zanimljivim epizodistima od kojih se posebno ističu likovi Stojana Savića, Bosiljka, Baneta i nenadmašnog Elektro Lazija. Ovaj alanfordovski univerzum koji umesto Cvijećarnice kao centar zbivanja ima automehaničarsku radnju i koji je zabeležio ogromnu popularnost na Ju-Tjubu, konačno dobija i svoj televizijski život na Radio-televiziji Vojvodine.

programme.title: State job / Državni posao
programme.desc: The cult series of state work takes us to the office of one non-existent state firm, where they will introduce us to three characteristic characters and their short, witty comments and remarks on all possible topics that surround us. Their satirical conversations will have us entertained and laughed to tears, but we will certainly be imagined. The idea of the series is that while actors in a witty way comment on current events, they laugh and encourage them to think about. / Kultni serijal Državni posao vodi nas u kancelariju jedne nepostojeće državne firme, gde će nas upoznati sa trojicom karakterističnih likova i njihovim kratkim, duhovitim komentarima i opaskama na sve moguće teme koje nas okružuju. Njihovi satirični razgovori će nas zabaviti i nasmejati do suza, ali ćemo se sigurno nad njima i zamisliti. Ideja serijala je da dok akteri na duhovit način komentarišu aktuelna zbivanja, nas nasmeju i podstaknu na razmišljanje.

programme.title: TV chiffon / TV šifonjer
programme.desc: This documentary emission represents us in an interesting way of some of the historical stories and events. / Ova emisija dokumentarnog karaktera predstavlja nam na zanimljiv način neke od istorijskih priča i događaja.

programme.title: TV dnevnik (RTS 1) / TV dnevnik (RTS 1)
programme.desc: Stay up to date with the most important and most current news from our country and the world with the Serbian Radio and Television. / Budite u toku sa najvažnijim i najaktuelnijim vestima iz naše zemlje i sveta uz informativni program Radio-televizije Srbije.

programme.title: The heroes of our time / Junaci našeg doba
programme.desc: The main hero of the series is Velimir Chichanovic, aka Čičko. He married in the fourth year of the faculty, studied for another five years, lost his self-confidence and changed three parties. In the last party, he occurred to the Function of the Umbrella Head of the Party, fell into debts and joined the big army of the losers. The story begins with an unexpected bid of Čička to take over an important and responsible position in society. The biography is empty in him, without significant success, he did nothing, nor well, neither bad. It is important that he didn't do anything wrong, he messed up, spoiled or stole. Life changed his cards and the Čička ignited finally the right. Is it really, right? Is our hero capable of playing properly? Is his family ready to file success and new status in society? Punching to a better future crosses the roads of our series, and the parts of the better past will emerge from oblivion. Their destinies will come across unexpected switches, intersections, dilemmas and temptations ... / Glavni junak serije je Velimir Čičanović, zvani Čičko. Oženio se na četvrtoj godini fakulteta, studirao još pet godina, izgubio samopouzdanje i promenio tri stranke. U poslednjoj stranci je dogurao do funkcije držača kišobrana šefa stranke, zapao je u dugove i priključio se velikoj armiji gubitnika. Priča počinje neočekivanom ponudom Čičku da preuzme važan i odgovoran položaj u društvu. Biografija mu je prazna, bez značajnog uspeha, nije uradio ništa, ni dobro, ni loše. Bitno je da nije uradio ništa loše, ništa zabrljao, pokvario niti ukrao. Život je promenio svoje karte i Čička je zapala konačno ona prava. Da li je zaista ,,prava? Da li je naš junak sposoban da odigra kako treba? Da li je njegova porodica spremna da podnese uspeh i novi status u društvu? Probijanje ka boljoj budućnosti ukrstiće puteve junaka naše serije, a iz zaborava će izroniti delovi bolje prošlosti. Njihove sudbine naići će na neočekivane skretnice, raskrsnice, dileme i iskušenja...

programme.title: Civil servant / Državni službenik
programme.desc: The civil servant is the Serbian criminal television series about the exciting story about the agents of the public, which remove the most dangerous threats to Serbia every day and water fighting in the maze of domestic and foreign intrigues. Lazar is the main hero, a young agent in a rise that tries to find a balance between family and business life. When a great danger is overwhelmed over Serbia and when he no longer knows who to rely on, Lazar will realize that he will have to file a great sacrifice. / Državni službenik je srpska kriminalistička televizijska serija o uzbudljivoj priči o agentima BIE, koji daleko od očiju javnosti svakodnevno uklanjaju najopasnije pretnje po Srbiju i vode borbu u lavirintu domaćih i inostranih intriga. Lazar je glavni junak, mladi agent u usponu koji pokušava da nađe ravnotežu između porodičnog i poslovnog života. Kada se velika opasnost nadvije nad Srbijom i kad više ne bude znao na koga da se osloni, Lazar će shvatiti da će morati da podnese veliku žrtvu.

programme.title: Vojvodina Dnevnik / Vojvođanski dnevnik
programme.desc: In addition to our Central Information Emission, the diary in 17 hours, the editorial office of the Information Program prepares and implement the Vojvodina Dnevnik whose terms of broadcasting is 22 hours on the first channel of the Radio-Television of Vojvodina. In that half-hour show you can see the information summary of the day on the domestic and international scene, and the most space occupies certainly current topics and interesting events from Vojvodina. We believe that, as a public service of Vojvodina, the task and obligation that events in this region, through our channel, become available to the wider auditorium. Thanks to the correspondent network, rapid response and cooperation with institutions, but also citizens - our viewers, we place news, reports and reports from different fields - economy, agriculture, policies, cultures, sports, interethnic relations, human rights, etc. / Pored naše centralne informativne emisije, Dnevnika u 17 sati, redakcija Informativnog programa priprema i realizuje Vojvođanski dnevnik čiji je termin emitovanja u 22 sata na Prvom kanalu Radio-televizije Vojvodine. U toj polusatnoj emisiji možete videti informativni sažetak dana na domaćoj i međunarodnoj sceni, a najviše prostora zauzimaju svakako aktuelne teme i zanimljivi događaji iz Vojvodine. Smatramo da nam je, kao javnom servisu Vojvodine, zadatak i obaveza da dešavanja u ovom regionu, preko našeg kanala, postanu dostupna širem gledalištu. Zahvaljujući dopisničkoj mreži, brzom reagovanju i saradnji sa institucijama, ali i građanima - našim gledaocima, plasiramo vesti, izveštaje i reportaže iz različitih oblasti - privrede, poljoprivrede, politike, kulture, sporta, međuetničkih odnosa, ljudskih prava i dr.

programme.desc: This is a show where you can learn how to protect your agricultural cultures and get accurate and timely information. Zelena prognoza emituje se na programu RTV.

programme.title: Arthery / Art-erija
programme.desc: In order to affirm and popularize the domestic cultural scene, the media does not pay attention to the Cultural Magazine of the Art and the City and the Province, but IM goes to the announcements, talks with influential guests, the actors of the most important daily events. Also, thematic approaches and processes important phenomena and segments of modern creation in the field of literature, theater, articles, film, music, architecture, museology. Provides the festivals, successes and the guests of artists in our country and the anniversary of the national culture, we add the news of the Day and in the world, and we pay for activities on the preparation of Novi Sad for the European Capital of Culture. In one place, the widest auditorium gets a picture of culture throughout the day. / U cilju afirmacije i popularizacije domaće kulturne scene kojoj se u medijima ne posvećuje dostojna pažnja, kulturni magazin Art-erija svakog radnog dana donosi najaktuelnije događaje iz umetnosti i kulture grada i pokrajine, ali im i ide u susret najavama, razgovorima sa uticajnim gostima, akterima najvažnijih dnevnih zbivanja. Takođe, i tematski pristupa i obrađuje vazne pojave i segmente savremenog stvaralaštva u domenu književnosti, pozorišta, likovnosti, filma, muzike, arhitekture, muzeologije. Progovara se o festivalima, uspesima i gostovanjima umetnika kod nas i u svetu, obeležavamo godišnjice i važne datume nacionalne kulture, sabiramo vesti dana kod nas i u svetu, preporučujemo i ukazujemo na vredne poduhvate, a poseban prostor posvećujemo aktivnostima oko pripreme Novog Sada za evropsku prestonicu kulture. Na jednom mestu najširi auditorijum dobija sliku kulture tokom dana.

programme.title: Most / Most
programme.desc: One evening of light on the bridge suddenly turned off, and when they turned on again, it was found to be exactly in the middle of him, at the border between Sweden and Denmark, is the corpse. The police, however, soon realizes that they are two corpses. At the crime scene, there are Danish detective Martin Roda and Young Saga Noren, which performs the same job in Malmo. The difference between them is huge. Martin is a police veteran, in the third marriage and has just performed vasectomy as he would no longer make children; As it turned out, it's too late. In contrast, Saga has elements of Asperger's behavioral syndrome, badly reads and interprets the emotions of other people, cannot be converted and often everything literally understands. Saga, however, has a valuable virtue: It is incredibly insightful, extremely analytical mind and very persistent. / Jedne večeri svetla na mostu su se iznenada ugasila, a kada su se ponovo upalila, ustanovljeno je da se tačno nasred njega, na granici između Švedske i Danske, nalazi leš. Policija, međutim, uskoro shvata da su u pitanju dva leša. Na mestu zločina nalaze se danski detektiv Martin Rode i mlada Saga Noren, koja isti posao obavlja u Malmeu. Razlika među njima je ogromna. Martin je policijski veteran, u trećem braku i upravo je obavio vazektomiju kako više ne bi pravio decu; kako se ispostavilo, ipak prekasno. Nasuprot njemu, Saga ima elemente Aspergerovog sindroma u ponašanju, loše čita i tumači emocije drugih ljudi, ne ume da se pretvara i često sve bukvalno shvata. Saga, međutim, ima dragocenu vrlinu: neverovatno je pronicljiva, izrazito analitičnog uma i veoma uporna.

programme.title: Plane / Aviondžije
programme.desc: Macan, Ceger, Nina and Medena work as a steward in one domestic airline. During the flights they fall into different adventures and meet colorful travelers who often have unusual requirements. Despite frequent disagreements, the stewards and other crew members solve all the problems with common forces. / Macan, Ceger, Nina i Medena rade kao stjuardi u jednoj domaćoj avio-kompaniji. Tokom letova upadaju u različite avanture i upoznaju živopisne putnike koji često imaju neobične zahteve. Uprkos čestim nesuglasicama, stjuardi i drugi članovi posade sve probleme rešavaju zajedničkim snagama.

programme.title: Students in the Great War / Đaci u Velikom ratu
programme.desc: The First World War brought a large suffering from the Serbian people and the ruin of all state institutions that were built since the end of the 19th century. This documentary series shows how the war and occupation has influenced education and in what conditions, the education of students in occupied territories, but also how to organize the teaching for Serbs who found the temporary refuge abroad. / Prvi svetski rat doneo je veliko stradanje srpskom narodu i propast svih državnih institucija koje su građene od kraja 19. veka. Ovaj dokumentarni serijal prikazuje kako su rat i okupacija uticali na školstvo i u kakvim uslovima je teklo obrazovanje đaka u okupiranim teritorijama, ali i kako se organizovala nastava za Srbe koji su privremeno utočište pronašli u inostranstvu.

programme.title: Hearths / Ognjišta

programme.title: From the Senka past / Iz senke prošlosti
programme.desc: Time as a strict and unmistakable judge makes many facts hidden in the shadows of the past when it comes to life in some period. / Vreme kao strogi i nepogrešivi sudija, čini da mnoge činjenice skrivene u senkama prošlosti kad tad ožive u nekom razdoblju.

programme.title: Hilandar / Hilandar
programme.desc: This issue was created on the occasion of the marking 800 years of existence of the most significant spiritual hospitality of Serbs. Hilandar is an Orthodox male monastery. It was built on the initiative of St. Sava. It is located in the northern part of St. Up, on the Halkidiki peninsula, ie on his third arm - atos. / Ova emisija nastala je povodom obeležavanja 800 godina postojanja najznačajnijeg duhovnog staništa Srba. Hilandar je pravoslavni muški manastir. Sagrađen je na inicijativu Svetog Save. Nalazi se u severnom delu Svete gore, na poluostrvu Halkidiki, odnosno na njegovom trećem kraku - Atosu.

programme.title: Old Serbian written inheritance / Staro srpsko pisano nasleđe

programme.desc: The story of the letter created by the followers of Cyril and Methodius. programme.title: Miniature doctor / Kisvárosi doktor
programme.desc: Doctor Kleist is a teddy bear, velvety, pleasant equality, but basically a man of seven days. The secret to this is that. Not only does his patients stew, he also helps with a warm -hearted, charming impression on the problems of everyday life. At the beginning of our cake, the small town doctor is in Berlin, and he celebrates his day with his family, little boy, daughter and wife. programme.desc: Markus, after an action to fail to buy the hotel's group, will be bad and hospital. The doctor advises him a strict and long rest, and his grandmother, Dorothea, former leader of the group, will go to their Moroccan hotel to relax the fatigue there. But he belongs there, he had a wife who hadn't seen twenty years after they were divorced because Gabrielle cheated on her best friend. Dorothea travels to Morocco to arrange the same thing because she wants to spare Markus from excitement. However, things are more complicated, so Dorothea is an impossible to involve Markus. Jamila, the hotel director, suggests Markus to compromise Kosson. Pay Ferfins in three millions of Keszpens and then avoid closing the hotel. Leonie, who has already one year away with Ahmed, is presenting the boy to his father, who is able to help the folder of the folder of the folds. / Markus, egy, a szálloda konszern ellenseges kivásárlását meghiúsíto akcio után rosszul lesz es korházba kerul. programme.title: An angel of revenge / Anđeo osvete
programme.desc: Santa Martinez is a woman of poor origin, married to Willie, with whom he has a son who wears his father's name. In order to further earn, the villa gives music classes to Daniela Kano, grandchildren of one of the most powerful lawyers in the country, Gaspar Kana. But Danielel's mother Barbara, although he married happily, throws around on Willie, trying to seduce him in all ways. The villa remains immune, but it reveals Daniel drugs. The two of them realize it as a threat, so they decide to solve him. When she invent that Villa raped Daniel, he in fear for a woman and child, asked the Santa to leave the country with his son. Although innocent, he gets 30 years in prison. The judge decides to reconsider the case, but Barbarian brother, Umberto, ordered his murder. Santi communicate that the villa was killed in a prison fight, but it doubts the official version of the story. So decide to take revenge into their hands. Will destroy members of a powerful family one by one. She came up with a plan, which is why he becomes the devil of Amanda first. Umberta will seduce, become his fiancée, and accuse him crime, so he will not be able to defend himself. Barbarians will destroy the marriage, and separate her from the child, and her husband George sent behind bars. It will make Daniel to admit to the truth, Gaspar and his wife will lead to poverty. But then the seductive Santiago, Umbert's brother, where he falls in love with her. It has nothing to do with the murder, but he is a member of the hated family, and Aamanda is in the dilemma. Will they allow to overwhelm love or desire for revenge? / Santa Martinez je žena siromašnog porekla, udata za Vilija, sa kojim ima sina koji nosi očevo ime. Kako bi dodatno zaradio, Vili daje časove muzike Danijeli Kano, unuci jednog od najmoćnijih advokata u zemlji, Gaspara Kana. Ali, Danijelina majka Barbara, iako srećno udata, baca oko na Vilija, pokušavajući na sve načine da ga zavede. Vili ostaje imun, ali otkrije da se Danijela drogira. Njih dve to shvate kao pretnju, pa odluče da ga se reše. Kada izmisle da je Vili silovao Danijelu, on u strahu za ženu i dete, zamoli Santu da sa sinom napusti zemlju. Iako nevin, dobije 30 godina zatvora. Sudija odluči da ponovo razmotri slučaj, ali Barbarin brat, Umberto, naručuje njegovo ubistvo. Santi saopštavaju da je Vili poginu u zatvorskoj tuči, ali ona sumnja u zvaničnu verziju priče. Zato odlučuj da osvetu preuzme u svoje ruke. Uništiće članove moćne porodice jednog po jednog. Ali onda joj na put staje zavodljivi Santjago, Umbertov brat, u koga se zaljubi. Nema veze sa ubistvom, ali je član omražene porodice, a aAmanda je u dilemi. Da li će dopustiti da nadvalda ljubav ili želja za osvetom?

programme.title: Samra / Samra
programme.desc: Samra is a beautiful dancer, without a personal card and formal education. Live nomadic, in tents, rejected and depressed. When a deadly virus takes several children's lives, including Samrina's sister, the Nomadic settlement in Lebanon from Dubai is arriving a young doctor Thamer. Thamer is a wealthy and married English language professor, but soon is fascinated by samrina indescribable beauty and simplicity. After he saved her brother, Thamer became the only spark that he associates with her arms and hopes - that the day he will lose fear of love and replace his nomadic life with a warm family atmosphere worthy of a good man. Can honest love win all social and class differences? The director signs Rasha Shurbatji, and the main roles are played by: Khaled el-Sayed, Toni Issa, Nadine NasiB Nadi ... / Samra je lepa plesačica, bez lične karte i formalnog obrazovanja. Živi nomadski, u šatorima, odbačeno i potišteno. Kada smrtonosni virus odnese nekoliko dečijih života, među kojima je i Samrina sestra, u nomadsko naselje u Libanu iz Dubaija stiže mladi lekar Thamer. Thamer je imućan i oženjen profesorkom engleskog jezika, ali uskoro biva očaran Samrinom neopisivom lepotom i jednostavnošću. Nakon što je spasio njenog brata, Thamer je postao jedina iskra koja Samru povezuje sa njenim strepnjama i nadama - da će doći dan kada će izgubiti strah od ljubavi i svoj nomadski život zameniti toplom porodičnom atmosferom dostojnom čoveka. Može li iskrena ljubav pobediti sve socijalne i klasne razlike? Režiju potpisuje Rasha Shurbatji, a glavne uloge igraju: Khaled el-Sayed, Toni Issa, Nadine Nassib Njeim...

programme.title: An angel of revenge / Anđeo osvete
programme.desc: Santa Martinez is a woman of poor origin, married to Willie, with whom he has a son who wears his father's name. programme.title: The alphabet of our lives / Azbuka našeg života
programme.desc: In the center of the intriguing, entertainment, but on moments and heavy and tragicomic stories is an urban Belgrade family and a married couple Popović. Behind Vesna and Uroš is twenty-five years of living together, in which, from the juvenile rapture and passion, they entered with student love, eager for a better tomorrow and success in a trivial society in which it is all permitted to reach status, career and money. Nevertheless, a quarter of a century later, after acquired all material goods, while their children are studying abroad, this seemingly ideal family, begins to break up. Vesna and Uroš then realize that they are in the fight for material - lost itself. Such, defeated and embarrassed, running away from reality, wander through love adventures, scams, lies, solitude, biting conscience and the crisis of their own identities. The story follows the parallel female and male side. Through a dynamic action, frequent Fleshbekov, which evoke us otherwise, the past dimension of their priority, which enriches the drama of the main characters of the family and the crisis of the family and the crisis of our society, identity crisis. Excised through the fate of a married couple, this is actually a story about all of us, about modern families, about the divorce epidemic, about the loneliness of the modern man. The alphabet of our lives is a story about love, about missed lives, about disappointment, ostentation and repentance, about trying to catch at least a fraction of the Procedure of happiness. / U središtu intrigantne, zabavne, ali na momente i teške i tragikomične priče je urbana beogradska porodica i bračni par Popović. Iza Vesne i Uroša je dvadeset i pet godina zajedničkog života, u koji su, iz mladalačke zanesenosti i strasti, ušli nošeni studentskom ljubavlju, željni boljeg sutra i uspeha u trivijalnom društvu u kojem je sve dozvoljeno da bi se došlo do statusa, karijere i novca. Ipak, četvrt veka kasnije, nakon što su stekli sva materijalna dobra, dok im se deca školuju u inostranstvu, ova naizgled idealna porodica, počinje da se raspada. Vesna i Uroš tada shvataju da su u borbi za materijalno – izgubili sebe. Takvi, poraženi i posramljeni, bežeći od realnosti, tumaraju kroz ljubavne avanture, prevare, laži, samoću, grižu savesti i krizu sopstvenih identiteta. Priča prati paralelno žensku i mušku stranu. Kroz dinamičnu radnju, česte flešbekove, koji nam dočaravaju drugačiju, onu prošlu dimenziju njihove životne priče, zatim kroz voice-over naraciju koja obogaćuje dramu ličnim doživljajima glavnih likova, serija nam donosi iskrenu priču o veoma aktuelnim društvenim pojavama – o krizi porodice i međuljudskih odnosa, krizi srednjih godina, krizi našeg društva, krizi identiteta. Ispričano kroz sudbinu jednog bračnog para, ovo je zapravo priča o svima nama, o modernim porodicama, o epidemiji razvoda, o usamljenosti savremenog čoveka. Azbuka našeg života je priča o ljubavi, o promašenim životima, o razočaranju, o otrežnjenju i pokajanju, o pokušaju da se uhvati makar delić proćerdane sreće.

Uprkos svemu uspevaju da ostanu srećni čak i kad sve krene naopako!

programme.title: Wild / Samonikli
programme.desc: Dawn, a well -known influenser, grew up in a careful child's home, left with violin and a key on the red ribbon. In search of glory, he moves away from close people and faces loneliness, illness and false friendships. When he decides to swing everything, his past knocks on his door again. / Svaj, poznati influenser, odrastao je u domu za nezbrinutu decu, ostavljen s violinom i ključem na crvenoj vrpci. U potrazi za slavom udaljava se od bliskih ljudi i suočava s usamljenošću, bolešću i lažnim prijateljstvima. Kada odluči sve promeniti, prošlost mu ponovo pokuca na vrata.

programme.title: Long to sea / Dug moru
programme.desc: The disappearance of Olga introduces us to the maze of puzzling events that leave a deep impression on everything. We quickly realize that the search for her is not just a physical search, but also a spiritual journey through time, space and different worlds. On the mystical peninsula of Lustica, Olga faces the secrets that must reveal before its dark visions are achieved. While Olga explores the world of the dead and reveals an unknown side of his personality, her mother Svetlana reveals his roots. At the same time, Perish, searching for the treasure of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia, experiencing the experience of the attendance. The destinies of our heroes intertwine, revealing not only the past, but also deep traumas and losses they wore. All our heroes help Olga in a task to end a curse, but they are looking for something that may be most difficult to find: yourself. / Nestanak Olge uvodi nas u lavirint zagonetnih događaja koji ostavljaju dubok utisak na sve. Brzo shvatamo da potraga za njom nije samo fizičko traganje, već i duhovno putovanje kroz vreme, prostor i različite svetove. Na mističnom poluostrvu Luštica, Olga se suočava s tajnama koje mora otkriti pre nego što se njene mračne vizije ostvare. Dok Olga istražuje Svet mrtvih i otkriva nepoznatu stranu svoje ličnosti, njena majka Svetlana otkriva svoje korene. U isto vreme Periša, tragajući za blagom Kraljevine Jugoslavije, doživljava iskustvo onostranog. Sudbine naših junaka se isprepliću, otkrivajući ne samo prošlost, već i duboke traume i gubitke koje su nosili. Svi naši junaci pomažu Olgi u zadatku da okonča prokletstvo, ali istovremeno traže nešto što je možda najteže pronaći: sebe.

programme.title: Let life go / Nek ide život
programme.desc: These are family members Savković. Mother Grozda, proud owner of the florists. The younger son of Ljubisa, mathematics teacher. Daughter Silvana is a misunderstood, the older son of Siniša is a shoemaker, and all three, everyone in his own way, they wander in love ... There is also a daughter-in-law, her mother, and many others, who arrested in a dam ... / Ovo su članovi porodice Savković. Majka Grozda, ponosna vlasnica cvećare. Mlađi sin Ljubiša, nastavnik matematike. Ćerka Silvana je neshvaćana umetnica, stariji sin Siniša je obućar, i svo troje, svako na svoj način, lutaju u ljubavi... Tu je i snaja Katarina, njena majka Radmila i mnogi drugi, koji svraćaju u kafanu kod Brane...

programme.title: Team drim / Drim tim
programme.desc: Jorgačević, Ciga and Slađa are trying to elaborate the tavern, which he goes for the beginning. Boske and the boss successfully started in political parties. Gandra has not yet connected to the gay population, and the bribe has no idea how the criminal becomes. Ilija seeks the help of a chalia to help Miti enters crime, but unsuccessful. Gandra, on Ilijah, and with Bogdan's support, connects reluctantly with Hagji Tosic, who will introduce him to the gay population. The bribe is looking for advice from the late grandfather of a drakchet, how to become a criminal. The late grandfather is enigmatic. / Jorgačević, Ciga i Slađa pokušavaju da razrade kafanu, što im za početak slabo ide. Boske i Šefke su uspešno startovali u političkim partijama. Gandra se još uvek nije povezaao sa gej populacijom, a Mita nema ideju kako se postaje kriminalac. Ilija traži pomoć Čalije da pomogne Miti da uđe u kriminal, ali bezuspešno. Gandra se, na Ilijin nagovor i uz Bogdaninu podršku, nevoljno povezuje sa Hadži Tošićem, koji će ga uvesti u gej populaciju. Mita traži savet od pokojnog deda Drakčeta, kako da postane kriminalac. Pokojni deda mu zagonetno odgovara.

programme.title: Red horse / Crveni konj
programme.desc: Upon completion of the Greek civil war, many fighters of defeated forces were sent to political persecution. He was forced to go to the Soviet Union is both Boris, a widower and a father of three daughters. He falls in love with Olga and starts with her. / Po završetku Grčkog građanskog rata, mnogi borci poraženih snaga su poslati u političko progonstvo. Prinuđen da ode u Sovjetski Savez je i Boris, udovac i otac tri ćerke. On se zaljubljuje u Olgu i sa njom započinje vezu.

programme.title: Happy Nova 49 / Srećna nova 49
programme.desc: Post-war Yugoslavia, the time of the KPJ conflict with Stalinism and Informer. The story follows two brothers, various commitments and destinies. Older on return from Russia is unjustly accused and arrested. He is younger disinterested in politics, but very interested in his brother's wife and the mafia underground and money. When it turns out that the young woman belongs to the Soviet spy agent, additionally eaten by the baptism of conscience, which cheats the unfairly accused husband with Neu's brother, she chooses the way to death. Brother, on the other hand, chooses a road across the border. / Posleratna Jugoslavija, vreme sukoba KPJ sa staljinizmom i informbiroa. Priča prati dva brata, različitih opredeljenja i sudbina. Stariji po povratku iz Rusije biva nepravedno optužen i uhapšen. Mlađi je nezainteresovan za politiku, ali itekako zainteresovan za ženu svog brata i mafijaško podzemlje i novac. Kada se ispostavi da mlada žena pripada sovjetskoj špijunskoj agenturi, dodatno izjedena grižom savesti što vara nepravedno optuženog muža sa nejgovim bratom, ona izabere put u smrt. Brat, pak, bira put preko granice.

programme.title: Tattoo / Tetoviranje
programme.desc: When he wondered with a woman, Ilko leaves the house, wearing only that he has with him - an empty suitcase. He stopped at the train station, but as he is doubtful policemen, they arrest him. It only remains to fit into a prison life. / Kada se posvađa sa ženom, Ilko napušta kuću, noseći jedino što ima sa sobom - prazan kofer. Zastane na železničkoj stanici, ali kako biva sumnjiv policajcima, oni ga hapse. Preostaje mu jedino da se uklopi u zatvorski život.

programme.title: Gypsy magic / Ciganska magija
programme.desc: The story of a poor, Roma family from the surroundings of Skopje. Although they fight for bare survival, they dream big dreams, which are their escape from the cruel reality in which they are often rejected and unadjusted. / Priča o jednoj siromašnoj, romskoj porodici iz okoline Skoplja. Iako se bore za goli opstanak, oni sanjaju velike snove, koji su njihov beg iz surove realnosti u kojoj su često odbačeni i neprilagođeni.

programme.title: Steppe for or / Stepenice za nebo
programme.desc: The young architect is located in the crisis period of life, which states him to leave Belgrade and look for a job in Subotica. Since he failed to manage and adapt to the north, he returns to Belgrade where he meets with old friends. The time spent with them causes only additional reconsideration of decisions made. / Mladi arhitekta nalazi se u kriznom periodu života što ga navodi da napusti Beograd i potraži posao u Subotici. Pošto ne uspeva da se snađe i prilagodi na severu, vraća se u Beograd gde se sastaje sa starim drugarima. Vreme provedeno sa njima kod njega izaziva samo dodatno preispitivanje donesenih odluka.

programme.title: Happened to this day / Dogodilo se na današnji dan
programme.desc: This film takes us to Belgrade during the sixties, where younger people live in one building completely different characters, but almost the same views. Tenants represent one generation trying to ripen in the same yard and under similar conditions. / Ovaj film nas odvodi u Beograd tokom šezdesetih godina, gde u jednoj zgradi žive mlađi ljudi potpuno drugačijih karaktera, ali gotovo istih pogleda na vrednosti. Stanari predstavljaju jednu generaciju koja pokušava da sazre u istom dvorištu i pod sličnim uslovima.

programme.title: Better than escape / Bolje od bekstva
programme.desc: The American Yugoslav origin comes for the first time in the country of their ancestors to learn the language. By playing the case, he meets a young Belgrade actor in falling in love. programme.desc: After twenty years of life abroad, the former Kockar Pop returns to his country. On su brži, jači i spretniji od običnih ljudi, nemaju emocije, ni grižu savesti, ne osećaju bol, a po izgledu se ne razlikuju od običnih smrtnika. Osim što ih nemilosrdno ubijaju.

programme.title: Past and present / Passato e presente
programme.desc: In the history of the Rome Rome the figure of Livia Drusilla, wife of Ottaviano Augusto, occupies a special place. Woman of power, he conquered fame and respect and left a decisive imprint on the future of Rome, entrusting his son Tiberius and his descent the control of the empire created by his wife. The Latin historians of orientation senatorial orientation, like Tacitus, have handed down a portrait of Livia full of shadows, accusing her of having plotted against the natural descendants of Augustus to encourage the power of his son Tiberius, had from a previous marriage. Other historians, such as Supponio, are more indulgent on his figure and describe long between Livia and Augustus not as a political deal but as a long duck history. In the studio, with Paolo Mieli, the historic Francesca Cenerini. / Nella storia dellantica Roma la figura di Livia Drusilla, moglie di Ottaviano Augusto, occupa un posto speciale. Donna di potere, si è conquistata fama e rispetto e ha lasciato unimpronta decisiva sul futuro di Roma, affidando al figlio Tiberio e alla sua discendenza il controllo dellImpero creato dal consorte. Gli storici latini di orientamento filo senatoriale, come Tacito, ci hanno tramandato un ritratto di Livia pieno di ombre, accusandola di aver tramato contro i naturali discendenti di Augusto per favorire lascesa al potere di suo figlio Tiberio, avuto da un precedente matrimonio. Altri storici, come Svetonio, sono più indulgenti sulla sua figura e descrivono lunione tra Livia e Augusto non come un affare politico ma come una lunga storia damore. In studio, con Paolo Mieli, la storica Francesca Cenerini.

Among these, Professor Jacopo Buongiorno, engaged in the development of advanced nuclear energy systems, Professor Paola Cappellaro, quantum computer scholar, Claudia Cea, inventor of a new type of neural system. Finally, Luciano Floridi, philosopher director of the Department of Digital Ethics of the University of Yale, tries to shed light on the complexity of the technological revolution that is changing our era. / Fjona Cakalli è volata a Boston, nel leggendario Massachusets Institute of Technology, una delle più prestigiose università al mondo, per svelare i segreti dellIntelligenza Artificiale grazie allaiuto di alcuni tra i massimi esperti del settore. Voliamo in Pakistan, ultima tappa di questa edizione a cui partecipa anche il mitico Beppe Tenti, papà di Filippo e di Overland. Iniziamo il nostro itinerario dalla ex capitale del Paese, Karachi, per poi addentrarci in quella attuale: Islamabad. programme.title: Past and present / Passato e presente
programme.desc: Francesco Crispi's political affair crosses almost all Italian Lottimento. As a hero of the Risorgimento and paladin of democratic and republican ideas, in the last years of his life he will become the symbol of authoritarian and imperialist power. During the Risorgimento, the Sicilian Crispi fights against the power of the Bourbons in Southern Italy and organizes with Garibaldi Limpresa dei Mille. After length, political realism leads him to abandon republican ideals and to become a monarchist. In 1887 he became prime minister, and his governments start a large reformer plan to make it modern and efficient institutional lacrchical of the new state. In recent years Crispi has been the protagonist of an authoritarian turning point to repress social crises such as that of Sicilian bundles. His political career ends in 1896 with the defeat of Adua, in Ethiopia, and the end of the Italian colonial event he strongly desired. In the studio, with Paolo Mieli, the historian Fulvio Cammarano. / La vicenda politica di Francesco Crispi attraversa quasi tutto lOttocento italiano. Da eroe del Risorgimento e paladino delle idee democratiche e repubblicane, negli ultimi anni della sua vita diventerà il simbolo di un potere autoritario e imperialista. Nel corso del Risorgimento il siciliano Crispi si batte contro il potere dei Borbone nel sud Italia e organizza con Garibaldi limpresa dei Mille. Dopo lUnità il realismo politico lo induce ad abbandonare gli ideali repubblicani e a diventare monarchico. Nel 1887 diventa primo ministro, e i suoi governi avviano un grande piano riformatore per rendere moderna ed efficiente larchitettura istituzionale del nuovo stato. Negli ultimi anni Crispi è protagonista di una svolta autoritaria per reprimere crisi sociali come quella dei Fasci siciliani. La sua carriera politica si conclude nel 1896 con la disfatta di Adua, in Etiopia, e la fine dellavventura coloniale italiana da lui fortemente voluta. In studio, con Paolo Mieli, lo storico Fulvio Cammarano.

programme.title: Stupid / Dum dum
programme.desc: Dum Dum emissions deals with reviews of different types of weapons. The viewers will be presented at the shooting range the most attractive specimens of infantry weapons in action. programme.title: River fleet / Rečna flotila

programme.title: Ordnance / Borbena tehnika

programme.desc: Dum Dum emissions deals with reviews of different types of weapons. The viewers will be presented at the shooting range the most attractive specimens of infantry weapons in action. programme.title: Jelena / Jelena
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Jelena, a daughter of a high official in the party and reputable Belgraders, and the young, poor wolf decided to escape from the city. But someone found out about it, so he seducle deer and locks into the room, at the same time, someone performed an assassination on Jelena's father. As everyone is convinced that the wolf was shot on her father, he flees from Yugoslavia. After thirty years, wanting to expel justice, he returns. He also comes with Helen daughter, unlike the son of Michael, with which he is not in the best relationships. He opens his firm. Deer married in the meantime, and has two children, Sasa and Lydia. When Helen and Sasha meets, he gets closer together, planning a joint life. / Sedamdesetih godina 20. veka Jelena, ćerka visokog funkcionera u partiji i uglednog Beograđanina, i mladi, siromašni Vuk odlučili su da pobegnu iz grada. Ali, neko je saznao za to, pa Jelenu uspavljuje i zaključava u sobu, Istovremeno, neko je izvršio atentat na Jeleninog oca. Kako su svi ubeđeni da je Vuk pucao na njenog oca, on beži iz Jugoslavije. Nakon trideset godina, želeći da istera pravdu, vraća se. Sa njim dolazi i ćerka Helen, za razliku od sina Majkla, sa kojim nije u najboljim odnosima. Otvara svoju firmu. Jelena se u međuvremenu udala, i ima dvoje dece, Sašu i Lidiju. Kada se Helen i Saša upoznaju, brzo se zbliže, planirajući zajednički život.
