programme.title: The mystery of the universe / Misterija svemira
programme.desc: Come with us to explore and execute what everything lies outside the bounds of our planet. This is a series of spaceships and stories, with information about the universe, about everything that surrounds us and everything we can see around ourselves, about how we can live in space, about what science says about the past and the future of the universe. Topics that series includes are: solar system, telescopes, stars, solar eruptions, asteroids, nebula, universe, black holes, jupiter, latest year, food in space, apollo 11, kuiper belt, Uranus, Seti, NASA, Laws in space, Solar winds, Neptune, Orbite, Orbite, Tide and Tide, Walking in the Universe, Space Way, Zvezdane Maps, Pluto. / Pođite sa nama da istražimo i razotkrijemo šta sve leži izvan granica naše planete. Ovo je serija o svemirskim temama i pričama, sa informacijama o univerzumu, o svemu što nas okružuje i svemu što vidimo oko sebe, o tome kako bismo mogli da živimo u svemiru, o tome šta nauka kaže o prošlosti i budućnosti univerzuma. Teme koje serija obuhvata su: Solarni sistem, teleskopi, zvezde, Zemlja, životinje u svemiru, Mesec, solarne erupcije, Habl teleskop, Nil Armstrong, asteroidi, komete, Venera, meteroiti, nebule, svemirski programi, crne rupe, Jupiter, Međunarodna svemirska stanica, svetlosna godina, hrana u svemiru, Apolon 11, Kuiper pojas, Uran, SETI, NASA, zakoni u svemiru, paradoks Fermi, solarni vetrovi, Neptun, velika crvena mrlja (na Jupiteru), orbite, Mlečni put, Saturn, plima i oseka, pomračenja Sunca i Meseca, pogled u prošlost, šetnja po svemiru, svemirsko odelo, zvezdane mape, Pluton.

programme.title: Take / Oteta
programme.desc: The story of the Orhun, who wants to revenge his sister, and hiri, which is a prisoner of his conscience, which he grew up in a rich family without love together with his sister by Nursah and his cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan went to work voluntarily as a doctor in Eritrea, but it was unable to contact, and her family was worried about her. While looking for his sister, he encounters a hira, a poor girl who lives as a prisoner in the hands of traffickers. When they learn that Nihan has poisoned and killed a local gang, Orhun breaks. When it turns out that Hira was actually the one who poisoned his sister, Orhun bitches the evil plan for revenge: he will take the hira home with him and make her worse. In the meantime, the Afife, their mother, was secretly held by Orhun's father away from his childhood. Orhun decides to marry a hiree of revenge. Afife hates lower status people and is obsessed with clean blood. Will this marriage close afife, or will a couple find redemption after paying all your obligations? / Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je čistom krvlju. Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: A trap of love / Klopka ljubavi
programme.desc: The dark curse hangs over the rich family Develoglula. Her successor must be a boy, but for jihan, the successor of the family empire, children are just an unfulfilled desire. He doesn't believe in love. He married a marriage by arrangement and believes that it is simply impossible to be successful in business and in love. Love is a weakness for him. His mother Mukader, a ruthless guardian of the family tradition and the future, is ready to ensure his son of the heir. It offers Bayy, Jihan's infertile woman, dangerous agreement: Divorce for Jigan's offspring, with the promise to return after his son's birth. Otherwise, Bays is also from a wealthy Turkish family. On the other hand, in the poor neighborhood, Istanbul, a young hancer who struggles with life in poverty. He lives with a sick brother, his wife and a brother. Hancher gets an offer that will change her fate: marriage with the jihan. Of course, the condition is that it is fertile and obedient, as well as agree to marriage without emotions. Although her heart is looking for true love, the sick brother is tered on the victim. Jihan and Hancher are neither aware of making a grant step. Life will be filled with intrigues and secrets, nothing will be the same again. Jihan's ex-wife Bayy will not disappear from their lives. The sharp and powerful mucader will do everything that marriage is only a deal and that Hancer is resolved after the birth of the heir. Hancher just dreams of helping his unhappy family, while Jihan is looking for a woman exclusively for hereditary. Will love still find the way in the world where everyone strives for better? / Mračna kletva visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice. Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu. Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika. Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Revenge / Osveta
programme.desc: The story of Dylan, whose dreams and hopes are subtracted, and a baran that must marry in order to interrupt the quarrel and saved his brother. However, this marriage is a prison for the two, and his uncle, who is interested in Baran's wealth, wants to reduce the quarrel. This relationship full of conflict will bring strong borets between two hearts. Will this marriage turn into a real marriage? / Priča o Dilan, čiji su snovi i nade oduzeti, i Baranu koji se mora oženiti kako bi prekinuo svađu i spasao brata. Međutim, ovaj brak je zatvor za njih dvoje, a njegov ujak, kojeg zanima Baranovo bogatstvo, želi da ponovo rasplamsa svađu. Ova veza puna sukoba doneće jake bure između dva srca. Hoće li se ovaj brak pretvoriti u pravi brak?

programme.title: Fate / Sudbina
programme.desc: Zejnep is the embodiment of grace and intelligence, which everyone admires. Still, she has a hidden warrior spirit. Halil, young without parents and burdened with sadness, faced life's adversity. Their roads intertwine - Zejnep, the free spirit below his steading exterior, and Halil, loyal to the family. Together in the whirling of love, they find that their fate are inextricably linked. While moving through crowded choices and consequences, the question remains: Can their love stand with whom they face? / Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću – Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Take / Oteta
programme.desc: The story of the Orhun, who wants to revenge his sister, and hiri, which is a prisoner of his conscience, which he grew up in a rich family without love together with his sister by Nursah and his cold, distant mother Afife. Nihan went to work voluntarily as a doctor in Eritrea, but it was unable to contact, and her family was worried about her. While looking for his sister, he encounters a hira, a poor girl who lives as a prisoner in the hands of traffickers. When they learn that Nihan has poisoned and killed a local gang, Orhun breaks. When it turns out that Hira was actually the one who poisoned his sister, Orhun bitches the evil plan for revenge: he will take the hira home with him and make her worse. In the meantime, the Afife, their mother, was secretly held by Orhun's father away from his childhood. Orhun decides to marry a hiree of revenge. Afife hates lower status people and is obsessed with clean blood. Will this marriage close afife, or will a couple find redemption after paying all your obligations? / Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je čistom krvlju. Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: A trap of love / Klopka ljubavi
programme.desc: The dark curse hangs over the rich family Develoglula. Her successor must be a boy, but for jihan, the successor of the family empire, children are just an unfulfilled desire. He doesn't believe in love. He married a marriage by arrangement and believes that it is simply impossible to be successful in business and in love. Love is a weakness for him. His mother Mukader, a ruthless guardian of the family tradition and the future, is ready to ensure his son of the heir. It offers Bayy, Jihan's infertile woman, dangerous agreement: Divorce for Jigan's offspring, with the promise to return after his son's birth. Otherwise, Bays is also from a wealthy Turkish family. On the other hand, in the poor neighborhood, Istanbul, a young hancer who struggles with life in poverty. He lives with a sick brother, his wife and a brother. Hancher gets an offer that will change her fate: marriage with the jihan. Of course, the condition is that it is fertile and obedient, as well as agree to marriage without emotions. Although her heart is looking for true love, the sick brother is tered on the victim. Jihan and Hancher are neither aware of making a grant step. Life will be filled with intrigues and secrets, nothing will be the same again. Jihan's ex-wife Bayy will not disappear from their lives. The sharp and powerful mucader will do everything that marriage is only a deal and that Hancer is resolved after the birth of the heir. Hancher just dreams of helping his unhappy family, while Jihan is looking for a woman exclusively for hereditary. Will love still find the way in the world where everyone strives for better? / Mračna kletva visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice. Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu. Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika. Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Fate / Sudbina
programme.desc: Zejnep is the embodiment of grace and intelligence, which everyone admires. Still, she has a hidden warrior spirit. Halil, young without parents and burdened with sadness, faced life's adversity. Their roads intertwine - Zejnep, the free spirit below his steading exterior, and Halil, loyal to the family. Together in the whirling of love, they find that their fate are inextricably linked. While moving through crowded choices and consequences, the question remains: Can their love stand with whom they face? / Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću – Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Three sisters / Tri sestre
programme.desc: The action of the new Turkish series will follow the story of the destinies of three sisters. One of them is known for its beauty, second per way, third by rebel, and all three are loyal to each other. As they dream simple dreams like their pork, the shadow of the past will not leave them alone, nor will happiness will be on their side. All three sisters were led by a happy life with his parents, until the marriage of one of them, Turkan. Then it will start to overlay dark clouds over the family and nothing will be like before. As Turkan tries to cover his misfortune in the "Fairy Trap in which she is stuck, Donian life will reverse a big secret from the past, and Derya will step without returning. Sadik and Nessrin will, on the other hand, get to the point of losing them sometimes, and sometimes each other to pull out his daughter from the edge of the cliff. Love, betrayal, mercy, friendship and nursing are the elements that will be permeated through all the episodes of this series. / Radnja nove turske serije pratiće priču o sudbinama tri sestre. Jedna od njih je poznata po lepoti, druga po smernosti, treća po buntovnosti, a sve tri su odane jedna drugoj. Dok sanjaju jednostavne snove kao njihove vršnjakinje, senka prošlosti ih neće ostaviti na miru, niti će sreća biti na njihovoj strani. Sve tri sestre su vodile srećan život sa roditeljima, sve do braka jedne od njih, Turkan. Tada će nad porodicom početi da se nadvijaju tamni oblaci i ništa više neće biti kao pre. Dok Turkan pokušava da prikrije svoju nesreću u ,,zamku iz bajke u kojem je zaglavila, Donenin život će preokrenuti velika tajna iz prošlosti, a Derya će zakoračiti putem bez povratka. Sadik i Nesrin će, s druge strane, doći do tačke da izgube ponekad sebe, a ponekad jedno drugo kako bi svoju ćerku izvukli sa ivice litice. Ljubav, izdaja, milost, prijateljstvo i sestrinstvo su elementi koji će se prožimati kroz sve epizode ove serije.

programme.title: Wine and viticulture / Vino i vinogradarstvo
programme.desc: We bring you all about making the best wines, growing vineyards, but also the development of viticulture and wine tourism in Serbia. Depending on the annual age, our topics are diverse, regarding planting, harvels, vintage maintenance. The emphasis is on making wine in the Balkans, but our team has toured the wineries in the larger part of Europe. / Donosimo vam sve o pravljenju najboljih vina, uzgajanju vinograda, ali i razvoju vinogradarstva i vinskog turizma u Srbiji. U zavisnosti od godišnjeg doba, naše teme su raznolike, a tiču se sadnje, berbe, održavanja vinograda. Akcenat je na pravljenju vina na Balkanu, ali naša ekipa obišla je vinarije u većem delu Evrope.

programme.title: The crimes of the past / Zločini iz prošlosti
programme.desc: Detective Lili Raš works in the Philadelphic Police Department, which is in charge of resolving cases that were unexplained unprecedented due to lack of evidence. With the help of evidence that recently appeared and modern technologies, Detective and its team manage to correct injustice and in prison finally send killers who have been avoiding the crimes committed for years. / Detektivka Lili Raš radi u odeljenju filadelfijske policije koje je zaduženo za rešavanje slučajeva koji su zbog nedostatka dokaza ostali nerazjašnjeni. Uz pomoć dokaza koji su se nedavno pojavili i moderne tehnologije, detektivka i njen tim uspevaju da isprave nepravdu i u zatvor konačno pošalju ubice koji su godinama izbegavali kaznu za zločine koje su počinili.

Uz pomoć dokaza koji su se nedavno pojavili i moderne tehnologije, detektivka i njen tim uspevaju da isprave nepravdu i u zatvor konačno pošalju ubice koji su godinama izbegavali kaznu za zločine koje su počinili.

programme.title: Wine and viticulture / Vino i vinogradarstvo
programme.desc: We bring you all about making the best wines, growing vineyards, but also the development of viticulture and wine tourism in Serbia. Depending on the annual age, our topics are diverse, regarding planting, harvels, vintage maintenance. The emphasis is on making wine in the Balkans, but our team has toured the wineries in the larger part of Europe. / Donosimo vam sve o pravljenju najboljih vina, uzgajanju vinograda, ali i razvoju vinogradarstva i vinskog turizma u Srbiji. U zavisnosti od godišnjeg doba, naše teme su raznolike, a tiču se sadnje, berbe, održavanja vinograda. Akcenat je na pravljenju vina na Balkanu, ali naša ekipa obišla je vinarije u većem delu Evrope.

programme.desc: The news arriving from South Africa threw the whole lifeline of the Molinette hospital in despair. Cesare has accused the blow, but it doesn't take long to find the desire to fight, also because a new patient arrives in the hospital, who could be the ideal candidate to try the transplant ... / Le notizie arrivate dal Sudafrica hanno gettato nello sconforto tutta lequipe dellospedale Molinette. programme.title: Hearts / Cuori
programme.desc: Caesar's conditions are worsening. The primary needs a new heart and wants it to be Alberto a - to implant it. Alberto, however, is not lucid: he feels guilty for what happened to Luisa and for the feelings he feels for Delia. Cardiologist also feels uncomfortable in the presence of her husband ... / Le condizioni di Cesare stanno peggiorando. Il primario ha bisogno di un cuore nuovo e vuole che sia proprio Alberto a - impiantarglielo. Alberto però, non è lucido: si sente in colpa per quello che è successo a Luisa e per i sentimenti che prova per Delia. Anche la cardiologa si sente a disagio in presenza del marito...

programme.title: Hearts / Cuori
programme.desc: A new medical director arrives, who immediately proves to be a faithful ally of Moscow. Caesar is certainly not willing to surrender, but now only the signature of the Council is missing and the leader will have won. And so, while Alberto and Delia remain in the hospital to study the medical bulletins who arrived from South Africa, Cesare decides to go home ... / Allospedale arriva un nuovo direttore sanitario, che si dimostra fin da subito fedele alleato di Mosca. Cesare non è certo disposto ad arrendersi, ma ormai manca solo la firma del Consiglio e il capochirurgo avrà vinto. E così, mentre Alberto e Delia restano in ospedale per studiare i bollettini medici che sono arrivati dal Sudafrica, Cesare decide di tornare a casa...

We follow how work in the fashion industry seems to make decisions and create fashion trends, and everything is stitched with a hot love story between Albert and Ana. / Glavna tema serije je, naravno, ljubavna priča, i to između Alberta, bogatog naslednika Galerije Velvet, jedne od najprestižnijih modnih kuća u Španiji sredinom prošlog veka, i Ane, koja tu radi kao šnajderka. Radnja se, dakle, odvija tokom pedesetih i šezdesetih godina dvadesetog veka, tako da obiluje prelepim kostimima i automobilima tog perioda. Pratimo kako izgleda rad u modnoj industriji, kako se donose odluke i stvaraju modni trendovi, a sve prošarano vrelom ljubavnom pričom između Alberta i Ane.

programme.title: People and events / Ljudi i događaji
programme.desc: This show has an informative-educational character, and the goal of her to remind us through time which people and events marked a certain date. / Ova emisija ima informativno-edukativni karakter, a cilj joj da nas putujući kroz vreme podseti koji su ljudi i događaji obeležili određeni datum.

programme.title: The path around the world / Put oko sveta
programme.desc: This quiz invites you to travel - you will learn something new about the countries throughout the world, from different areas such as geography, biology, even everyday life. / Ovaj kviz poziva vas na putovanje - uz njega ćete naučiti nešto novo o zemljama širom sveta, i to iz različitih oblasti kao što su geografija, biologija, čak i svakodnevni život.

programme.title: Better prevent / Bolje sprečiti
programme.desc: Prevention is half health. How to preserve the health of our organism and how to treat yourself successfully?
